  board_certification_expiry_date date [note: 'Date on which the PI\'s board certification expires. Monitored to ensure ongoing qualification compliance during study conduct.']
  created_timestamp timestamp [note: 'Timestamp when the PI master record was first created in the system. Supports ALCOA+ data integrity principles and audit trail requirements under 21 CFR Part 11.']
  ctms_investigator_code varchar [note: 'Source system investigator identifier from the source system Used for cross-system reconciliation and data lineage tracing between the lakehouse silver layer and the operational CTMS.']
  cv_version_date date [note: 'Date of the most recent version of the PI\'s curriculum vitae (CV) on file. The CV is a required TMF document demonstrating the PI\'s qualifications per ICH E6(R2).']
  debarment_check_date date [note: 'Date on which the most recent FDA debarment check was performed for this PI. Periodic re-checks are required per sponsor SOPs.']
  debarment_check_status varchar [note: 'Result of the FDA debarment check confirming the PI is not listed on the FDA Debarment List under 21 CFR Part 312.70. Mandatory pre-study qualification step.']
  delegation_log_current boolean [note: 'Indicates whether the PI\'s delegation of authority log is current and up-to-date in the eTMF. A delegation log documents tasks delegated to sub-investigators and CRCs per ICH E6(R2).']
  disqualification_date date [note: 'Date on which the PI was disqualified from conducting clinical trials, either by a regulatory authority or by the sponsor. Nullable for active investigators.']
  disqualification_reason varchar [note: 'Narrative description of the reason for PI disqualification, if applicable. Populated only when lifecycle_status is \'disqualified\'. Required for regulatory audit trail.']
  email varchar [note: 'Primary professional email address for the PI used for regulatory correspondence, system access provisioning, and CTMS notifications.']
  eudract_investigator_number varchar [note: 'European Clinical Trials Database (EudraCT / CTIS) identifier assigned to the PI for EU-based clinical trial registrations under EU CTR 536/2014.']
  fda_investigator_number varchar [note: 'FDA-assigned investigator identifier, if applicable, used in IND applications and regulatory submissions to uniquely identify the PI in FDA systems.']
  financial_disclosure_date date [note: 'Date on which the PI\'s financial disclosure form (FDA Form 3454 or 3455) was most recently submitted. Required for NDA/BLA/MAA regulatory submissions.']
  financial_disclosure_status varchar [note: 'Status of the PI\'s financial disclosure filing (FDA Form 3454/3455) required under 21 CFR Part 54. Discloses financial interests that could affect study objectivity.']
  first_name varchar [note: 'Legal given name of the Principal Investigator as it appears on medical licensure and FDA Form 1572.']
  form_1572_date date [note: 'Date on which the most recent FDA Form 1572 was signed and submitted for this PI. Used for regulatory compliance tracking and TMF completeness verification.']
  form_1572_status varchar [note: 'Current submission status of the FDA Form 1572 (Statement of Investigator) for this PI. The Form 1572 is a regulatory commitment by the PI to conduct the study per GCP and the approved protocol.']
  gcp_training_date date [note: 'Date on which the PI most recently completed ICH Good Clinical Practice (GCP) training. Required for regulatory compliance and site initiation visit (SIV) clearance.']
  gcp_training_expiry_date date [note: 'Date on which the PI\'s current GCP training certification expires. Triggers re-training workflow in MasterControl to maintain continuous compliance.']
  gcp_training_provider varchar [note: 'Name of the organization or platform that delivered the GCP training (e.g., CITI Program, TransCelerate, NIH). Used for audit trail and regulatory inspection readiness.']
  inspection_history_flag boolean [note: 'Indicates whether the PI has been subject to a prior FDA, EMA, MHRA, or other regulatory authority inspection. Used in risk-based site selection and monitoring planning.']
  institution_country varchar [note: 'ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 country code of the country where the PI\'s primary institution is located. Determines applicable regulatory framework (FDA, EMA, PMDA, TGA, Health Canada, MHRA).']
  institution_name varchar [note: 'Name of the primary academic or medical institution with which the PI is affiliated (e.g., Johns Hopkins Hospital, Mayo Clinic). Used for site identification and regulatory submissions.']
  irb_iec_approval_status varchar [note: 'Current IRB/IEC approval status for the PI at their primary investigational site. Tracks whether the PI is authorized to conduct human subjects research under the approved protocol.']
  last_inspection_date date [note: 'Date of the most recent regulatory inspection (FDA, EMA, MHRA, PMDA, TGA, or Health Canada) at a site where this PI was the Principal Investigator.']
  last_inspection_outcome varchar [note: 'Outcome classification of the most recent regulatory inspection involving this PI. FDA classifications: No Action Indicated (NAI), Voluntary Action Indicated (VAI), Official Action Indicated (OAI).']
  last_name varchar [note: 'Legal family name of the Principal Investigator as it appears on medical licensure and FDA Form 1572.']
  lifecycle_status varchar [note: 'Current operational status of the PI within the organization\'s investigator registry. Drives eligibility for new study assignments and regulatory reporting.']
  medical_license_expiry_date date [note: 'Date on which the PI\'s medical license expires. Triggers renewal alerts in CTMS to ensure continuous licensure compliance throughout study conduct.']
  medical_license_number varchar [note: 'State or national medical license number issued to the PI by the relevant medical licensing authority. Required for FDA Form 1572 and site qualification documentation.']
  medical_license_state varchar [note: 'Two-letter U.S. state code (or equivalent jurisdiction code) where the PI\'s medical license is issued and active. Used to validate practice authority at the investigational site.']
  npi_number varchar [note: '10-digit National Provider Identifier (NPI) assigned by CMS to the PI. Used for U.S.-based regulatory submissions, billing reconciliation, and provider identity verification.']
  orcid_number varchar [note: 'Globally unique ORCID identifier for the PI, enabling unambiguous researcher identification across publications, regulatory submissions, and clinical trial registries.']
  phone varchar [note: 'Primary professional contact phone number for the PI, used for urgent safety communications and site monitoring coordination.']
  pi_type varchar [note: 'Classification of the investigator role within the study hierarchy. Distinguishes the PI with full regulatory accountability from sub-investigators and coordinating investigators.']
  prior_study_count varchar [note: 'Total number of clinical studies the PI has previously conducted as Principal Investigator. Used as a key metric in site feasibility assessments and sponsor qualification reviews.']
  professional_title varchar [note: 'Academic or professional degree designation of the PI (e.g., MD, PhD, PharmD). Used to verify minimum qualification requirements per protocol and regulatory submissions.']
  protocol_training_complete boolean [note: 'Indicates whether the PI has completed all required protocol-specific training for their currently assigned studies. Managed via MasterControl training management module.']
  qualification_date date [note: 'Date on which the PI was formally qualified and approved by the sponsor or CRO to conduct clinical trials. Marks the start of the PI\'s active lifecycle in the investigator registry.']
  specialty varchar [note: 'Primary medical or scientific specialty of the PI (e.g., Oncology, Cardiology, Neurology, Infectious Disease). Used for protocol feasibility matching and site selection scoring.']
  updated_timestamp timestamp [note: 'Timestamp of the most recent update to the PI master record. Supports change tracking, audit trail compliance, and incremental data pipeline processing per 21 CFR Part 11.']
  years_of_experience varchar [note: 'Total number of years the PI has been conducting clinical trials. Used in site feasibility scoring and sponsor qualification assessments.']

  Note: 'Master record for Principal Investigators (PIs) conducting clinical trials. Captures PI credentials, medical license numbers, specialty, board certifications, GCP training history, FDA Form 1572 submission status, financial disclosure status, debarment'
}

Table site.feasibility_assessment {
  feasibility_assessment_id varchar [pk, note: 'Unique system-generated identifier for the site feasibility assessment record. Primary key for this entity.']
  country_id varchar [note: 'Foreign key linking to study.country. Business justification: Site feasibility scoring is evaluated against country-level enrollment rate assumptions, screen failure rate assumptions, and feasibility scores stored in study.country.']
  investigational_site_id varchar [note: 'Reference to the investigational site being evaluated for feasibility.']
  lab_facility_id varchar [note: 'Foreign key linking to laboratory.lab_facility. Business justification: Feasibility assessments formally evaluate a specific lab facility\'s capability (lab_capabilities_available flag).']
  principal_investigator_id varchar [note: 'Reference to the Principal Investigator (PI) proposed for this site and study during the feasibility evaluation.']
  protocol_id varchar [note: 'Foreign key linking to study.protocol. Business justification: Feasibility assessments evaluate a site against a specific protocol version — protocol complexity, visit burden, and eligibility criteria drive feasibility scoring.']
  sample_size_calc_id varchar [note: 'Foreign key linking to biostatistics.sample_size_calc. Business justification: Feasibility assessments are conducted against a specific enrollment target derived from the sample size calculation.']
  study_id varchar [note: 'Reference to the clinical study for which this feasibility assessment is being conducted.']
  study_site_id varchar [note: 'Foreign key linking to site.study_site. Business justification: A feasibility assessment is conducted for a specific study-site pairing. study_site is the canonical association entity representing the full lifecycle of a study at a site.']
  tmf_document_id varchar [note: 'Foreign key linking to document.tmf_document. Business justification: Feasibility questionnaires and assessment reports are TMF artifacts (DIA Zone 2, pre-study documentation).']
  assessment_date date [note: 'The date on which the feasibility assessment questionnaire was initiated or formally submitted by the site. Principal business event date for this transaction.']
  assessment_number varchar [note: 'Externally-known business identifier for the feasibility assessment, used in CTMS and sponsor communications (e.g., FA-2024-0042). Unique within a study.']
  assessment_status varchar [note: 'Current lifecycle status of the feasibility assessment workflow within the CTMS. Tracks progression from initial draft through sponsor review to final decision.']
  competing_trial_count varchar [note: 'Number of currently active or planned clinical trials at the site that compete for the same patient population or therapeutic area. High competing trial load may reduce enrollment capacity.']
  created_timestamp timestamp [note: 'Timestamp when this feasibility assessment record was first created in the source system. Supports audit trail requirements under GCP and 21 CFR Part 11.']
  decision_date date [note: 'Date on which the sponsor or CRO made the final site selection decision (selected, not selected, or on hold) based on this feasibility assessment.']
  dedicated_research_staff_count varchar [note: 'Number of dedicated clinical research staff (Clinical Research Coordinators (CRCs), research nurses, data entry staff) available at the site to support this study.']
  edc_access_available boolean [note: 'Indicates whether the site has the necessary IT infrastructure, internet connectivity, and hardware to access the study\'s Electronic Data Capture (EDC) system (e.g., Medidata Rave).']
  enrollment_experience_score decimal(5,2) [note: 'Sub-score component reflecting the site\'s historical enrollment performance, patient population access, and therapeutic area experience. Contributes to the composite feasibility score.']
  estimated_enrollment_capacity varchar [note: 'The site\'s self-reported estimate of the number of eligible subjects it can enroll for this specific study over the planned enrollment period. Core metric for site selection decisions.']
  estimated_screen_failure_rate decimal(5,2) [note: 'Site\'s estimated percentage of screened subjects expected to fail eligibility criteria for this study. Used to adjust enrollment projections and calculate required screening numbers.']
  feasibility_score decimal(5,2) [note: 'Composite numeric score (typically 0–100) assigned to the site based on weighted evaluation of all feasibility criteria including enrollment potential, infrastructure, and experience. Used for comparative site ranking.']
  feasibility_score_tier varchar [note: 'Categorical tier classification derived from the feasibility score (e.g., High ≥ 75, Medium 50–74, Low < 50). Used for rapid site prioritization and sponsor reporting.']
  gcp_training_current boolean [note: 'Indicates whether the site\'s Principal Investigator and key study staff hold current GCP training certifications as required by ICH E6(R2) and applicable regulatory authorities.']
  imaging_capabilities_available boolean [note: 'Indicates whether the site has the required imaging infrastructure (e.g., MRI, CT, PET) specified in the study protocol for efficacy or safety assessments.']
  irb_iec_status varchar [note: 'Current status of the site\'s Institutional Review Board (IRB) or Independent Ethics Committee (IEC) relationship at the time of feasibility assessment. Active IRB/IEC is a prerequisite for site activation.']
  lab_capabilities_available boolean [note: 'Indicates whether the site has on-site or contracted laboratory capabilities required by the study protocol (e.g., local lab processing, sample storage, cold chain management).']
  patient_population_size varchar [note: 'Estimated number of patients in the site\'s catchment area who match the study\'s target indication and could potentially be eligible for enrollment.']
  pharmacy_capabilities_available boolean [note: 'Indicates whether the site has an investigational drug pharmacy with appropriate storage, dispensing, and accountability capabilities as required by the study protocol.']
  phase varchar [note: 'The regulatory phase of the clinical trial (Phase I through Phase IV) for which the site is being assessed. Influences the complexity and infrastructure requirements evaluated.']
  prior_study_experience_count varchar [note: 'Number of prior clinical studies the site has conducted in the same therapeutic area or indication. Reflects site expertise and GCP compliance track record.']
  questionnaire_response_notes varchar [note: 'Free-text field capturing additional site comments, clarifications, or qualitative responses provided by the site during the feasibility questionnaire completion.']
  questionnaire_version varchar [note: 'Version identifier of the feasibility questionnaire template used for this assessment (e.g., v2.1). Ensures traceability of assessment criteria across protocol amendments.']
  regulatory_compliance_score decimal(5,2) [note: 'Sub-score component reflecting the site\'s GCP compliance history, inspection findings, audit outcomes, and regulatory standing. Derived from CTMS compliance tracking data.']
  reviewed_by varchar [note: 'Name or identifier of the sponsor or CRO representative who reviewed and approved the feasibility assessment and made the site selection decision.']
  selection_decision varchar [note: 'Final site selection outcome derived from this feasibility assessment. Indicates whether the site was selected, not selected, placed on hold, or awaiting decision.']
  site_country_code varchar [note: 'ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 three-letter country code for the country in which the investigational site is located. Used for regional enrollment planning and regulatory jurisdiction determination.']
  site_infrastructure_score decimal(5,2) [note: 'Sub-score component of the overall feasibility score reflecting the site\'s physical and technical infrastructure readiness (EDC, lab, pharmacy, imaging). Scored on a standardized scale.']
  site_region varchar [note: 'Geographic region classification of the investigational site (e.g., North America, Europe, Asia-Pacific). Used for regional enrollment tracking and sponsor reporting.']
  source_system_record_code varchar [note: 'The native primary key or record identifier of this feasibility assessment in the originating source system (the source system or the source system Enables lineage tracing and reconciliation.']
  sponsor_comments varchar [note: 'Free-text comments entered by the sponsor or CRO reviewer following evaluation of the feasibility questionnaire. Documents rationale for selection decisions or follow-up requirements.']
  submission_date date [note: 'Date on which the completed feasibility questionnaire was formally submitted by the site to the sponsor or CRO for review.']
  updated_timestamp timestamp [note: 'Timestamp of the most recent modification to this feasibility assessment record. Supports audit trail and data integrity requirements under GCP and 21 CFR Part 11.']

  Note: 'Records the site feasibility evaluation conducted prior to site selection for a specific study. Captures feasibility questionnaire responses, estimated enrollment capacity, patient population availability, competing trial load, infrastructure readiness'
}

Table site.selection {
  selection_id varchar [pk, note: 'Unique surrogate identifier for the site selection decision record. Primary key for the site_selection data product in the Databricks Silver Layer.']
  activation_id varchar [note: 'Reference to the site activation record that was initiated as a result of this selection decision. Null until the site transitions from selected to activation workflow. Establishes the selection-to-activation traceability chain.']
  compliance_sop_id varchar [note: 'Reference to the selection committee or governance body that reviewed and approved or rejected this site selection decision.']
  country_id varchar [note: 'Foreign key linking to study.country. Business justification: Site selection decisions are made against country-level enrollment targets, planned site counts, and activation status in study.country.']
  feasibility_assessment_id varchar [note: 'Reference to the prior feasibility assessment record that informed this site selection decision, establishing traceability from feasibility to selection.']
  ind_application_id varchar [note: 'Foreign key linking to regulatory.ind_application. Business justification: Site selection decisions for Phase 1-3 trials must reference the IND under which the study operates.']
  investigational_site_id varchar [note: 'Reference to the investigational site being evaluated and selected or rejected for participation in the study.']
  irb_iec_approval_id varchar [note: 'Foreign key linking to site.irb_iec_approval. Business justification: selection already captures irb_iec_approval_date and irb_iec_status as denormalized fields.']
  principal_investigator_id varchar [note: 'Reference to the Principal Investigator (PI) proposed or confirmed for this study-site pairing at the time of selection. The PI\'s qualifications are a key selection criterion per GCP.']
  protocol_id varchar [note: 'Foreign key linking to study.protocol. Business justification: Site selection decisions are made against a specific protocol version; protocol_version is a plain-text denormalization.']
  risk_assessment_id varchar [note: 'Foreign key linking to compliance.risk_assessment. Business justification: Risk-based site selection methodology incorporates site risk assessments for GCP compliance, enrollment capacity, and regulatory history.']
  sample_size_calc_id varchar [note: 'Foreign key linking to biostatistics.sample_size_calc. Business justification: Site selection assigns target_enrollment_count and enrollment_rate_per_month to each site based on the study\'s sample size calculation.']
  study_id varchar [note: 'Reference to the clinical study (protocol) for which this site selection decision was made. Links the selection event to the governing protocol.']
  study_site_id varchar [note: 'Foreign key linking to site.study_site. Business justification: site_selection records the formal site selection decision for a study-site pairing. study_site is the canonical association entity representing the full lifecycle of that pairing.']
  tmf_document_id varchar [note: 'Foreign key linking to document.tmf_document. Business justification: Site selection documentation (selection rationale, committee decisions) is a TMF artifact (DIA Zone 2). The existing tmf_document_reference is a plain string.']
  activation_target_date date [note: 'Planned date by which the selected site should complete all activation requirements and be ready to enroll the first subject. Used for study timeline management and milestone tracking.']
  competing_trial_count varchar [note: 'Number of other active clinical trials running concurrently at this site at the time of selection. Used to assess site capacity and potential enrollment competition.']
  conditional_requirements varchar [note: 'Description of conditions that must be met before a conditionally selected site can proceed to activation (e.g., additional staff training, equipment procurement, IRB approval). Populated when selection_status is \'conditionally_selected\'.']
  created_timestamp timestamp [note: 'Timestamp when this site selection record was first created in the source system. Used for audit trail and data lineage per ALCOA+ principles.']
  ctms_site_record_code varchar [note: 'The source system record identifier from the source system for this site selection record, enabling traceability and reconciliation between the Silver Layer and the operational CTMS.']
  decision_timestamp timestamp [note: 'Precise date and time (with timezone offset) at which the site selection decision was formally recorded in the CTMS system, supporting 21 CFR Part 11 audit trail requirements.']
  enrollment_rate_per_month decimal(5,2) [note: 'Projected number of subjects the site is expected to enroll per calendar month, based on feasibility assessment data. Used for study timeline planning and site performance forecasting.']
  feasibility_score decimal(5,2) [note: 'Composite numeric score derived from the feasibility assessment, summarizing the site\'s overall suitability for the study. Higher scores indicate greater suitability. Used as a key input to the selection decision.']
  first_patient_in_target_date date [note: 'Target date for enrolling the first subject (First Patient In / FPI) at this site. A key study milestone used for enrollment planning and sponsor KPI reporting.']
  gcp_compliance_confirmed boolean [note: 'Indicates whether the site has been confirmed as GCP-compliant at the time of selection, based on prior audit history, inspection records, and training verification.']
  last_updated_timestamp timestamp [note: 'Timestamp of the most recent modification to this site selection record. Supports change tracking and audit trail requirements per ALCOA+ and 21 CFR Part 11.']
  notes varchar [note: 'Free-text field for additional comments, observations, or contextual information recorded by the selection committee or CRA that do not fit into structured fields. Supports comprehensive documentation per ALCOA+ principles.']
  number varchar [note: 'Externally-known business identifier for this site selection decision record, used in CTMS, eTMF, and sponsor communications (e.g., SS-PROT001-00042). Serves as the human-readable reference number.']
  patient_population_size varchar [note: 'Estimated number of eligible patients in the site\'s catchment area who meet the study\'s inclusion/exclusion criteria, as assessed during feasibility. A primary driver of the selection decision.']
  pi_qualification_verified boolean [note: 'Indicates whether the Principal Investigator\'s (PI) qualifications, CV, and GCP training have been verified and confirmed as adequate for this study at the time of selection, per ICH E6(R2) requirements.']
  prior_audit_finding boolean [note: 'Indicates whether the site has any prior significant audit findings or regulatory inspection observations that were considered as part of the selection decision. Supports risk-based site selection.']
  rationale varchar [note: 'Narrative justification for the site selection decision, documenting the business and scientific reasons the site was chosen or rejected. Required for TMF documentation and sponsor oversight.']
  region varchar [note: 'Sponsor-defined geographic region grouping for the site (e.g., North America, Europe, Asia-Pacific). Used for regional enrollment tracking, CRA assignment, and operational reporting.']
  regulatory_submission_required boolean [note: 'Indicates whether a regulatory submission (e.g., IND amendment, CTA, or national competent authority notification) is required before this site can be activated. Drives regulatory workflow initiation.']
  rejection_reason_code varchar [note: 'Standardized code indicating the primary reason a site was not selected. Populated only when selection_status is \'rejected\' or \'withdrawn\'. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE']
  rejection_reason_detail varchar [note: 'Free-text elaboration of the rejection reason, providing additional context beyond the standardized rejection_reason_code. Populated only when the site is rejected or withdrawn.']
  selection_date date [note: 'The calendar date on which the formal site selection decision was made and approved by the selection committee. This is the principal business event date for this transaction.']
  selection_status varchar [note: 'Current lifecycle status of the site selection decision. Drives workflow transitions from feasibility through activation. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: selected|rejected|pending_review|conditionally_selected|withdrawn|on_hold — promote to reference product]']
  selection_type varchar [note: 'Categorizes the nature of the site selection: whether the site is a newly added site, a replacement for a terminated site, a backup site held in reserve, or an expansion site added to increase enrollment capacity.']
  sponsor_approval_date date [note: 'Date on which the sponsor formally approved the site selection decision. Null if sponsor approval is not required or has not yet been received.']
  sponsor_approval_required boolean [note: 'Indicates whether the sponsor must provide explicit written approval before this site selection decision is finalized. Relevant for CRO-managed studies where sponsor sign-off is a contractual requirement.']
  sponsor_site_number varchar [note: 'Sponsor-assigned alphanumeric identifier for the site within the context of this specific study, used in EDC, RTSM, and regulatory submissions. Distinct from the internal site_id.']
  target_enrollment_count varchar [note: 'The planned number of subjects to be enrolled at this site as agreed at the time of selection. Used for enrollment planning, site performance benchmarking, and resource allocation.']
  visit_conducted boolean [note: 'Indicates whether a formal site selection visit (also known as a pre-study site visit or PSSV) was conducted at this site prior to the selection decision, as recommended by ICH E6(R2).']
  visit_date date [note: 'Date on which the site selection visit (pre-study site visit / PSSV) was conducted. Null if no visit was conducted or if the visit is pending.']

  Note: 'Records the formal site selection decision for a study-site pairing, including selection rationale, selection committee approval, selection date, rejection reasons (if applicable), and the transition from feasibility to activation.'
}

Table site.study_site {
  study_site_id varchar [pk, note: 'Unique surrogate identifier for the study-site association record in the Databricks Silver Layer. Primary key for this entity.']
  audit_id varchar [note: 'Foreign key linking to compliance.audit. Business justification: Study site audits assess GCP compliance, data integrity, and regulatory readiness. Audit scheduling, findings tracking, and CAPA closure verification at study site level require direct audit']
  central_lab_facility_id varchar [note: 'Foreign key linking to laboratory.lab_facility. Business justification: Each study_site is assigned a central laboratory for specimen analysis. This drives specimen shipment routing, lab kit ordering, result reporting, and eTMF documentation.']
  clinical_trial_authorization_id varchar [note: 'Foreign key linking to regulatory.clinical_trial_authorization. Business justification: Each study_site in EU member states is governed by a specific CTA for that country.']
  country_id varchar [note: 'Foreign key linking to study.country. Business justification: Each study_site belongs to exactly one study-country record. Country-level enrollment targets, CTA approval status, and regulatory hold flags in study.country directly govern site activation']
  investigational_site_id varchar [note: 'Reference to the investigational site master record. Links to the site entity representing the physical or organizational research location.']
  primary_depot_id varchar [note: 'Foreign key linking to supply.depot. Business justification: Sites require a designated primary depot for supply chain operations. Resupply orders, shipment routing, and supply planning all depend on knowing which depot serves each study site.']
  principal_investigator_id varchar [note: 'Reference to the Principal Investigator (PI) assigned to lead clinical research activities at this site for this study. The PI is responsible for the conduct of the trial per ICH E6(R2) GCP.']
  rand_list_id varchar [note: 'Foreign key linking to randomization.rand_list. Business justification: In site-stratified randomization, each study_site is assigned a specific randomization list in the IRT/RTSM system.']
  study_id varchar [note: 'FK to study.study.study_id — Critical for study-site relationship — study_site is the association entity linking studies to sites, must have direct FK to study for enrollment tracking and site activation workflows.']
  budget_agreed_amount decimal(18,2) [note: 'Total agreed budget amount for this site\'s participation in the study, as specified in the Clinical Trial Agreement. Covers per-patient fees, overhead, and procedure costs. Managed in the source system accounting.']
  budget_currency varchar [note: 'ISO 4217 three-letter currency code for the agreed site budget amount (e.g., USD, EUR, GBP, JPY). Required for multi-currency financial reporting and reconciliation in the source system']
  capacity_subjects varchar [note: 'Maximum number of subjects the site has declared capacity to enroll and manage concurrently for this study, based on staff resources, facilities, and patient population. Used in feasibility assessment and enrollment planning.']
  cda_execution_date date [note: 'Date on which the Confidential Disclosure Agreement (CDA) between the sponsor/CRO and the site was fully executed. A prerequisite milestone in the site activation workflow before protocol sharing.']
  contract_execution_date date [note: 'Date on which the Clinical Trial Agreement (CTA) or Clinical Site Agreement between the sponsor/CRO and the site institution was fully executed. A mandatory activation milestone before site initiation.']
  created_timestamp timestamp [note: 'Timestamp when this study-site association record was first created in the system. Supports audit trail requirements under 21 CFR Part 11 and ALCOA+ data integrity principles.']
  drug_shipment_auth_date date [note: 'Date on which authorization was granted to ship investigational medicinal product (IMP) to this site. A critical activation milestone managed via RTSM/IRT (e.g., Medidata RTSM). Shipment cannot proceed without IRB approval and regulatory clearance.']
  edc_provisioning_date date [note: 'Date on which the site was provisioned and granted access to the Electronic Data Capture (EDC) system (e.g., Medidata Rave) for this study. Required before site staff can enter subject data into eCRFs.']
  enrolled_count varchar [note: 'Actual number of subjects who have been enrolled (consented and randomized or assigned to treatment) at this site to date. Updated from EDC/RTSM data feeds. Used for real-time enrollment performance monitoring.']
  enrollment_close_date date [note: 'Date on which enrollment of new subjects at this site was formally closed, either due to target achievement, sponsor decision, or protocol amendment. Marks transition to \'enrollment_complete\' status.']
  enrollment_open_date date [note: 'Date on which the site was authorized to begin enrolling subjects into the study. Marks the transition to \'enrolling\' status. Used for site performance analytics and FPFV (First Patient First Visit) tracking.']
  enrollment_target varchar [note: 'Planned number of subjects to be enrolled at this site for this study, as agreed between the sponsor/CRO and the site during feasibility and site selection. Used for site performance tracking and enrollment forecasting.']
  fpfv_date date [note: 'Date of the first subject\'s first protocol-specified visit at this site. A critical KPI milestone in clinical trial management used to measure site activation speed and study startup performance.']
  gcp_compliance_status varchar [note: 'Current GCP compliance status of the site for this study based on monitoring visit findings, audit results, and CAPA resolution. Drives risk-based monitoring intensity and escalation decisions.']
  irb_iec_approval_date date [note: 'Date on which the IRB or IEC granted initial approval for the study protocol at this site. Milestone tracked in CTMS and eTMF for regulatory compliance.']
  irb_iec_approval_number varchar [note: 'Official approval reference number issued by the Institutional Review Board (IRB) or Independent Ethics Committee (IEC) authorizing the conduct of this study at this site. Required before any subject enrollment can begin.']
  irb_iec_expiry_date date [note: 'Date on which the current IRB/IEC approval expires. Sites must obtain renewal before this date to continue enrollment. Triggers automated alerts in CTMS for renewal tracking.']
  last_monitoring_visit_date date [note: 'Date of the most recent monitoring visit (on-site or remote) conducted at this site for this study. Used to calculate time since last visit and trigger overdue monitoring alerts in CTMS.']
  lplv_date date [note: 'Date of the last subject\'s last protocol-specified visit at this site. Marks the end of active subject participation and triggers site close-out activities. Key milestone for study timeline management.']
  monitoring_visit_count varchar [note: 'Total number of monitoring visits (on-site and remote) conducted at this site for this study to date. Used for site oversight reporting and resource planning.']
  next_monitoring_visit_date date [note: 'Planned date for the next monitoring visit at this site for this study. Scheduled in CTMS based on risk tier, enrollment activity, and monitoring plan requirements.']
  open_query_count varchar [note: 'Number of currently open data queries (discrepancies or clarification requests) raised against eCRF data submitted by this site in the EDC system. A key data quality KPI for site performance management.']
  protocol_deviation_count varchar [note: 'Cumulative number of protocol deviations recorded at this site for this study. Includes both minor and major deviations. Used for site quality oversight, regulatory reporting, and CAPA management.']
  protocol_number varchar [note: 'Sponsor-assigned protocol identifier for the study associated with this site. Denormalized here for operational convenience and regulatory traceability without requiring a join to the study entity.']
  regulatory_approval_date date [note: 'Date on which the national competent authority (e.g., FDA, EMA, MHRA, PMDA) granted approval or authorization for this site to conduct the study. Required in certain jurisdictions before site activation.']
  regulatory_submission_date date [note: 'Date on which the required regulatory submission (e.g., IND amendment, national competent authority notification) was made for this site to participate in the study. Applicable for sites in jurisdictions requiring site-level regulatory approval.']
  rejection_reason varchar [note: 'Documented reason why a candidate site was not selected or was subsequently withdrawn from the study. Populated only when site_status transitions to a rejected or withdrawn state. Supports feasibility learning and sponsor reporting.']
  risk_tier varchar [note: 'Risk-based monitoring tier assigned to this site for this study, reflecting overall site risk profile based on enrollment performance, GCP compliance history, data quality, and PI experience. Determines monitoring visit frequency and SDV scope.']
  sae_count varchar [note: 'Total number of Serious Adverse Events (SAEs) reported from subjects enrolled at this site for this study. Used for safety signal monitoring and site-level safety oversight. Sourced from the source system']
  screen_failure_count varchar [note: 'Number of subjects who were screened but did not meet eligibility criteria and were not enrolled. Used to calculate screen failure rate, a key site performance metric for feasibility planning.']
  screened_count varchar [note: 'Total number of subjects who have undergone screening procedures at this site, regardless of eligibility outcome. Used to calculate screen failure rate and assess site recruitment efficiency.']
  selection_date date [note: 'Date on which the site was formally selected by the sponsor or CRO for participation in the study, following feasibility assessment and committee review.']
  selection_rationale varchar [note: 'Narrative justification for selecting this site for the study, including patient population access, PI expertise, infrastructure capability, and prior performance. Captured during the site selection committee review.']
  site_closeout_date date [note: 'Date on which the formal site close-out visit was completed and the site was officially closed for this study. Triggers archival of site documents in eTMF and final reconciliation activities.']
  site_number varchar [note: 'Sponsor-assigned alphanumeric site number unique within the study protocol. Used in EDC, RTSM, and regulatory submissions to identify the site within the trial context. Typically formatted as a 3–10 character code (e.g., \'US001\', \'DE002\').']
  site_status varchar [note: 'Current lifecycle status of the site within this study. Drives operational workflows in CTMS: candidate (under feasibility review), selected (approved for activation), initiated (Site Initiation Visit completed), enrolling (actively recruiting subjects)']
  siv_date date [note: 'Date on which the Site Initiation Visit (SIV) was conducted by the CRA. The SIV confirms site readiness, trains site staff on the protocol and EDC system, and is a key activation milestone before first subject enrollment.']
  updated_timestamp timestamp [note: 'Timestamp of the most recent update to this study-site association record. Supports audit trail requirements and change tracking under 21 CFR Part 11 and ALCOA+ data integrity principles.']
  withdrawn_count varchar [note: 'Number of enrolled subjects who withdrew consent or were discontinued from the study at this site. Tracked for safety reporting, ITT/PP population analysis, and site performance assessment.']

  Note: 'Association entity representing the full lifecycle relationship between a specific study (protocol) and an investigational site, from selection through activation to closeout.'
}

  submission_status varchar [note: 'Current lifecycle state of the site-level regulatory submission. Tracks progression from draft preparation through regulatory authority review to final disposition (approved, rejected, withdrawn, or superseded by an amendment).']
  submission_type varchar [note: 'Classification of the site-level regulatory submission. Includes FDA Form 1572 (Statement of Investigator), FDA Form 3454/3455 (Financial Disclosure), IRB/IEC applications, local health authority notifications, and country-specific site authorization']
  submission_version varchar [note: 'Version identifier for this submission document, used to track amendments and resubmissions (e.g., v1.0, v2.0, Amendment 1). Supports version control of regulatory documents in the eTMF.']
  updated_timestamp timestamp [note: 'The timestamp when this regulatory submission record was last modified in the CTMS or data platform. Supports audit trail requirements under 21 CFR Part 11 and ALCOA+ data integrity principles.']

  Note: 'Tracks site-level regulatory submissions required for trial conduct, including FDA Form 1572 (Statement of Investigator), financial disclosure forms (FDA Form 3454/3455), local health authority notifications, and country-specific site authorization'

  source_system_record_code varchar [note: 'The native primary key or record identifier of this SIV record in the originating operational system (e.g., the source system visit ID). Enables reverse traceability from the lakehouse back to the system of record.']

  Note: 'Records the Site Initiation Visit (SIV) event conducted by the CRA prior to first patient enrollment. Captures visit date, CRA assigned, attendees, training topics covered (protocol, EDC, RTSM, safety reporting, ICF process), action items identified'

  irb_iec_approval_id varchar [note: 'Foreign key linking to site.irb_iec_approval. Business justification: enrollment_performance tracks irb_iec_approval_status and irb_iec_approval_expiry_date as part of the performance reporting context.']
  principal_investigator_id varchar [note: 'Foreign key linking to site.principal_investigator. Business justification: Enrollment performance is tracked at the study-site level, and the Principal Investigator is the responsible party for enrollment at that site.']
  protocol_id varchar [note: 'Foreign key linking to study.protocol. Business justification: Enrollment performance reports are protocol-version-specific — screen failure rates and enrollment targets can change with amendments. protocol_number is a plain-text denormalization.']
  risk_assessment_id varchar [note: 'Foreign key linking to compliance.risk_assessment. Business justification: Enrollment performance metrics (screen failure rate, dropout rate, deviation count, open queries) are primary inputs to site-level risk assessments under risk-based monitoring']
  site_risk_assessment_id varchar [note: 'Foreign key linking to monitoring.site_risk_assessment. Business justification: Enrollment performance metrics (dropout rate, screen failure rate, enrollment variance) are key inputs to site risk tier calculations.']
  study_id varchar [note: 'Reference to the clinical study (protocol) for which enrollment performance is being tracked. Links to the study master record in the CTMS.']
  study_site_id varchar [note: 'Foreign key linking to site.study_site. Business justification: enrollment_performance tracks actual vs. planned enrollment at the study-site level over time.']
  subject_randomization_id varchar [note: 'Foreign key linking to randomization.subject_randomization. Business justification: Enrollment milestone billing trigger: enrollment milestones (first patient in, 50% enrollment, last patient in) are standard billing milestone triggers in clinical trial']

  actual_enrolled_count varchar [note: 'The actual number of subjects enrolled (randomized or consented per protocol definition) at this site during the reporting period. Sourced from Medidata Rave EDC and the source system randomization data.']
  actual_screened_count varchar [note: 'The actual number of subjects who underwent screening procedures at this site during the reporting period, as captured in the EDC (Medidata Rave) and reconciled with CTMS.']
  completed_count varchar [note: 'The number of subjects who completed all protocol-required study procedures and visits at this site during the reporting period. Used for PP population analysis and study close-out planning.']
  cumulative_dropout_count varchar [note: 'The total number of enrolled subjects who have discontinued participation at this site from study activation through the end of the current reporting period. Used for retention analysis and ITT/PP population tracking.']
  cumulative_enrolled_count varchar [note: 'The total number of subjects enrolled at this site from study activation through the end of the current reporting period. Primary metric for tracking progress toward the site\'s enrollment target.']
  cumulative_screened_count varchar [note: 'The total number of subjects screened at this site from study activation through the end of the current reporting period. Enables longitudinal enrollment trend analysis and forecasting.']
  data_source varchar [note: 'Indicates the originating system from which this enrollment performance record was sourced or integrated. Supports data lineage tracking and reconciliation between CTMS and EDC systems.']
  dropout_count varchar [note: 'The number of enrolled subjects who discontinued participation (withdrew consent, were lost to follow-up, or were discontinued by investigator) during the reporting period. Impacts ITT and PP population sizes.']
  dropout_rate decimal(5,2) [note: 'The proportion of enrolled subjects who dropped out during the reporting period, expressed as a percentage (dropout_count / actual_enrolled_count × 100). Stored as a raw business metric from CTMS; used for retention risk assessment and site performance']
  enrollment_rate_per_month decimal(8,2) [note: 'The average number of subjects enrolled per calendar month at this site during the reporting period. Sourced from CTMS enrollment tracking; used for enrollment forecasting and site performance benchmarking.']
  enrollment_target_achievement_pct decimal(5,2) [note: 'The percentage of the site\'s total enrollment target achieved cumulatively as of the end of the reporting period (cumulative_enrolled_count / site_enrollment_target × 100). Stored as a raw business metric from CTMS for site performance dashboards.']
  enrollment_variance varchar [note: 'The difference between actual enrolled subjects and planned enrolled subjects for the reporting period (actual_enrolled_count - planned_enrolled_count). Negative values indicate under-enrollment; positive values indicate over-enrollment.']
  gcp_compliance_status varchar [note: 'The current GCP compliance status of the site as assessed by the most recent monitoring visit or audit. Drives risk-based monitoring decisions and regulatory escalation. Sourced from the source system monitoring records.']
  icf_signed_count varchar [note: 'The number of subjects who signed the Informed Consent Form (ICF) at this site during the reporting period. ICF signature is the first step in the enrollment process and is tracked separately from screening and randomization per GCP requirements.']
  irb_iec_approval_expiry_date date [note: 'The date on which the current IRB/IEC approval for this study at this site expires. Sites must obtain renewal before this date to continue enrollment. Tracked in Veeva Vault regulatory module.']
  irb_iec_approval_status varchar [note: 'Current approval status of the study at this site from the governing Institutional Review Board (IRB) or Independent Ethics Committee (IEC). Sites may not enroll subjects without valid IRB/IEC approval.']
  last_monitoring_visit_date date [note: 'The date of the most recent on-site or remote monitoring visit conducted by the CRA at this site. Used to assess monitoring frequency compliance and identify sites overdue for monitoring.']
  next_monitoring_visit_date date [note: 'The date of the next scheduled monitoring visit at this site, as planned in the CTMS. Used for CRA workload planning and ensuring monitoring frequency meets the risk-based monitoring plan.']
  open_query_count varchar [note: 'The number of unresolved data queries (discrepancies or missing data flags) raised against this site\'s eCRF data in the EDC system as of the end of the reporting period. A key data quality indicator for site performance.']
  performance_status varchar [note: 'Current enrollment performance status of the site for the reporting period, indicating whether the site is meeting, exceeding, or falling short of its planned enrollment targets. Drives CRA escalation and site management actions in the CTMS.']
  planned_completion_date date [note: 'The originally planned date by which the site was expected to complete enrollment of its assigned target, as defined in the site enrollment plan or study protocol timeline.']
  planned_enrolled_count varchar [note: 'The target number of subjects planned to be enrolled (randomized or consented per protocol definition) at this site during the reporting period. Derived from the site-level enrollment plan agreed with the sponsor.']
  planned_screened_count varchar [note: 'The number of subjects planned to be screened at this site during the reporting period, as defined in the site enrollment plan or feasibility agreement. Baseline for screen failure rate analysis.']
  projected_completion_date date [note: 'The forecasted date by which the site is expected to complete enrollment of its assigned target, based on current enrollment rate. Updated each reporting period in the CTMS for timeline management.']
  protocol_deviation_count varchar [note: 'The number of protocol deviations recorded at this site during the reporting period. Includes both major and minor deviations as classified per the study deviation management plan. Sourced from CTMS deviation tracking.']
  randomized_count varchar [note: 'The number of subjects who were randomized (assigned to a treatment arm via RTSM/IVRS) at this site during the reporting period. Distinct from enrolled count in studies where enrollment precedes randomization.']
  record_created_timestamp timestamp [note: 'The date and time when this enrollment performance record was first created in the data platform. Supports audit trail requirements per 21 CFR Part 11 and ALCOA+ principles.']
  record_updated_timestamp timestamp [note: 'The date and time when this enrollment performance record was most recently updated in the data platform. Supports audit trail requirements and change tracking per 21 CFR Part 11.']
  reporting_period_end_date date [note: 'The last calendar date of the enrollment performance reporting period. Together with reporting_period_start_date, defines the window for all enrollment metrics in this record.']
  reporting_period_start_date date [note: 'The first calendar date of the enrollment performance reporting period (e.g., start of a monthly or weekly reporting window). Used to define the temporal boundary for all enrollment metrics in this record.']
  reporting_period_type varchar [note: 'Granularity of the reporting period for this enrollment performance record. Determines the cadence at which site-level enrollment metrics are aggregated and reviewed.']
  sae_count varchar [note: 'The number of Serious Adverse Events (SAEs) reported at this site during the reporting period. Sourced from the source system Used to assess site safety profile and trigger risk-based monitoring escalation.']
  screen_failure_count varchar [note: 'The number of subjects who were screened but did not meet eligibility criteria and were therefore not enrolled during the reporting period. A key metric for site feasibility and protocol amendment decisions.']
  screen_failure_rate decimal(5,2) [note: 'The proportion of screened subjects who failed screening, expressed as a percentage (screen_failure_count / actual_screened_count × 100). Stored as a raw business metric captured from CTMS; used to assess site eligibility criteria adherence and protocol']
  site_capacity varchar [note: 'The maximum number of subjects the site can concurrently manage based on staff, facilities, and resources, as assessed during site feasibility. Used to evaluate whether the site is operating within capacity.']
  site_enrollment_target varchar [note: 'The total number of subjects the site is contracted or planned to enroll over the full duration of the study, as agreed in the site initiation agreement or enrollment plan. Denominator for cumulative enrollment progress percentage.']
  site_number varchar [note: 'The sponsor- or CRO-assigned unique site identifier code for the investigational site. Used as the externally-known business identifier for the site in regulatory submissions and CTMS reporting.']

  Note: 'Tracks actual vs. planned enrollment performance at the study-site level over time. Captures reporting period, planned enrollment target, actual subjects screened, subjects enrolled, screen failure count, screen failure rate, dropout count, and cumulative'
}

  clinical_trial_authorization_id varchar [note: 'Foreign key linking to regulatory.clinical_trial_authorization. Business justification: Site contracts in EU and other regions must cite the CTA number as the legal basis for trial conduct.']
  country_id varchar [note: 'Foreign key linking to study.country. Business justification: Country-level budget assumptions, currency codes, and regulatory requirements in study.country directly drive site agreement financial terms (per_patient_fee, currency_code, overhead_rate_pct).']

  study_site_id varchar [note: 'Foreign key linking to site.study_site. Business justification: site_agreement tracks site-level contractual agreements (CTA, CDA, budget) for a specific study-site combination. study_site is the canonical association entity for the study-site pairing.']
  tmf_document_id varchar [note: 'Reference identifier of the executed agreement document as stored in the Electronic Trial Master File (eTMF) in Veeva Vault. Enables direct navigation from the CTMS record to the source document for inspection readiness.']

  amendment_number varchar [note: 'Sequential amendment version number for this agreement record. A value of 0 indicates the original agreement; values ≥1 indicate successive amendments. Enables version tracking of negotiated changes over the study lifecycle.']
  closeout_fee decimal(18,2) [note: 'Fixed fee payable to the investigational site upon study close-out to cover archival, final monitoring visit support, and regulatory document finalization activities. Expressed in the currency defined by currency_code.']
  confidentiality_term_years varchar [note: 'Duration in years for which confidentiality obligations under the agreement remain in force after the agreement\'s expiration or termination. Particularly relevant for CDA (Confidential Disclosure Agreement) components.']
  created_timestamp timestamp [note: 'Timestamp indicating when this site agreement record was first created in the system. Supports audit trail requirements under 21 CFR Part 11 and ALCOA+ data integrity principles.']
  cro_entity varchar [note: 'Name of the Contract Research Organization (CRO) acting as the contracting party on behalf of the sponsor, if applicable. Captures the legal entity name when the CRO executes the agreement under delegated authority.']
  currency_code varchar [note: 'ISO 4217 three-letter currency code applicable to all financial terms within this site agreement (e.g., USD, EUR, GBP). Ensures consistent financial reporting across multi-country trials.']
  data_privacy_addendum boolean [note: 'Indicates whether a data privacy addendum (DPA) or data processing agreement is included as part of or annexed to this site agreement, addressing GDPR, HIPAA, or other applicable data protection obligations for patient data.']
  effective_date date [note: 'Date on which the site agreement becomes legally binding and operative. Marks the start of the contractual relationship between the sponsor/CRO and the investigational site. Aligns with MASTER_AGREEMENT EFFECTIVE_FROM category.']
  execution_date date [note: 'Date on which all required parties signed and fully executed the site agreement. May differ from the effective date when agreements are backdated or have a future effective date. Critical for regulatory inspection readiness.']
  expiration_date date [note: 'Date on which the site agreement is scheduled to expire or cease to be operative. Nullable for open-ended agreements. Triggers renewal workflow alerts in Veeva Vault. Aligns with MASTER_AGREEMENT EFFECTIVE_UNTIL category.']
  governing_law_country varchar [note: 'ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 country code identifying the jurisdiction whose laws govern the interpretation and enforcement of this site agreement. Critical for multi-national trial legal compliance and dispute resolution.']
  indemnification_clause boolean [note: 'Indicates whether the site agreement includes an indemnification clause protecting the investigational site and PI from third-party claims arising from the sponsor\'s negligence. Standard in CTA templates but may be absent in certain jurisdictions.']
  insurance_coverage_required boolean [note: 'Indicates whether the agreement mandates that the sponsor or CRO maintain clinical trial insurance coverage for the duration of the study at this site. Regulatory requirement in many jurisdictions.']
  insurance_policy_number varchar [note: 'Reference number of the clinical trial insurance policy covering this site agreement. Populated when insurance_coverage_required is True. Used for regulatory inspection documentation.']
  ip_ownership_clause boolean [note: 'Indicates whether the site agreement contains an intellectual property ownership clause specifying that all study data, inventions, and results generated at the site are owned by the sponsor. Standard in CTA templates.']
  irb_iec_approval_required boolean [note: 'Indicates whether IRB (Institutional Review Board) or IEC (Independent Ethics Committee) approval is a condition precedent to the agreement becoming operative.']
  legal_review_completed boolean [note: 'Indicates whether the sponsor\'s or CRO\'s legal team has completed their review and approved the final agreement text prior to execution. Part of the quality control workflow tracked in Veeva Vault.']
  legal_review_date date [note: 'Date on which the legal review of the site agreement was completed and sign-off was granted. Populated when legal_review_completed is True. Supports audit trail requirements under 21 CFR Part 11.']
  negotiation_start_date date [note: 'Date on which formal contract negotiation commenced between the sponsor/CRO and the investigational site. Used to calculate cycle time KPIs for site activation performance reporting in CTMS.']
  notes varchar [note: 'Free-text field for capturing supplementary notes, special conditions, deviations from standard templates, or negotiation context relevant to this site agreement. Supports audit trail and institutional knowledge retention.']
  overhead_rate_pct decimal(5,2) [note: 'Institutional overhead or indirect cost rate (expressed as a percentage) applied on top of direct site costs as negotiated in the site budget agreement. Typically charged by academic medical centers or hospital institutions.']
  payment_schedule_type varchar [note: 'Defines the payment trigger mechanism agreed upon in the site budget agreement. Determines how and when invoices are generated and processed in the source system Payable.']
  payment_terms_days varchar [note: 'Number of days from invoice receipt within which payment must be remitted to the investigational site, as stipulated in the site agreement (e.g., Net 30, Net 45, Net 60). Drives accounts payable processing in the source system']
  per_patient_fee decimal(18,2) [note: 'Agreed fee payable to the investigational site for each evaluable patient who completes the study per protocol. Core financial term in the site budget agreement. Expressed in the currency defined by currency_code.']
  publication_rights_clause boolean [note: 'Indicates whether the site agreement includes a publication rights clause defining the investigator\'s right to publish study results and the sponsor\'s right to review manuscripts prior to submission. Relevant for academic site agreements.']
  site_signature_date date [note: 'Date on which the authorized representative of the investigational site (e.g., PI or institutional official) signed the agreement. May differ from the sponsor/CRO signature date in multi-party execution workflows.']
  sponsor_signature_date date [note: 'Date on which the authorized representative of the sponsor or CRO signed the agreement. The later of site_signature_date and sponsor_signature_date typically defines the execution_date.']
  startup_fee decimal(18,2) [note: 'One-time fixed fee payable to the investigational site upon activation to cover site initiation activities such as staff training, IRB/IEC submission preparation, and regulatory document collection. Expressed in the currency defined by currency_code.']
  termination_date date [note: 'Date on which the site agreement was early-terminated prior to its scheduled expiration. Populated only when agreement_status is \'Terminated\'. Supports regulatory close-out documentation.']
  termination_reason varchar [note: 'Categorized reason for early termination of the site agreement. Required for regulatory reporting and site performance analytics. Populated only when agreement_status is \'Terminated\'.']
  total_budget_amount decimal(18,2) [note: 'Total contracted budget value for this site agreement, inclusive of all per-patient fees, procedures, overhead, and any fixed fees. Expressed in the currency defined by currency_code.']
  updated_timestamp timestamp [note: 'Timestamp indicating when this site agreement record was last modified. Supports change tracking, audit trail requirements under 21 CFR Part 11, and data lineage in the Databricks Silver Layer.']

  Note: 'Tracks site-level contractual agreements including Clinical Trial Agreements (CTA), Confidential Disclosure Agreements (CDA), and site-specific budget agreements.'
}

  planned_end_date date [note: 'The originally planned end date for the CRA assignment at the time of creation. Enables comparison against actual end date to track assignment duration variances and resource planning accuracy.']

  sdv_rate_pct decimal(5,2) [note: 'The agreed or actual percentage of critical data fields subject to Source Data Verification (SDV) for this CRA-site assignment, as defined in the monitoring plan. Reflects risk-based monitoring (RBM) strategy. Valid range: 0.00 to 100.00.']

Table subject.trial_subject {
  trial_subject_id varchar [pk, note: 'Unique surrogate identifier for a trial subject record in the lakehouse Silver layer. Primary key for the trial_subject entity. All subject-level transactional records in the subject domain reference this identifier.']
  arm_id varchar [note: 'Foreign key linking to study.study_arm. Business justification: SDTM ACTARM/ARM derivation and enrollment-by-arm reporting require linking each subject to their assigned study_arm.']
  clinical_trial_authorization_id varchar [note: 'Foreign key linking to regulatory.clinical_trial_authorization. Business justification: Regulatory compliance requires every enrolled subject to be traceable to the active CTA for their country.']
  protocol_id varchar [note: 'Foreign key linking to study.protocol. Business justification: SDTM DM domain and regulatory submissions require direct protocol traceability on the master subject record.']
  study_id varchar [note: 'Reference to the clinical study in which this subject is enrolled or screened. Links the subject to the parent study master record.']
  study_site_id varchar [note: 'Reference to the investigational site at which this subject was screened or enrolled. Supports site-level enrollment analytics and monitoring.']
  age_at_enrollment varchar [note: 'Subject\'s age in years at the time of enrollment or first dose, calculated from date of birth and enrollment date. Used for eligibility verification, demographic reporting, and subgroup analyses.']
  completion_date date [note: 'Date on which the subject completed all required study procedures per protocol, including end-of-study visit. Used for subject disposition reporting, CSR preparation, and database lock readiness assessment.']
  country varchar [note: 'ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 country code of the investigational site where the subject is enrolled. Used for geographic stratification, regulatory jurisdiction determination, and multi-regional trial reporting. Corresponds to CDISC SDTM DM COUNTRY variable.']
  created_timestamp timestamp [note: 'Timestamp when the trial subject record was first created in the lakehouse Silver layer. Supports ALCOA+ audit trail requirements and data lineage tracking. Stored in ISO 8601 format (yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX).']
  data_lock_flag boolean [note: 'Indicates whether the subject\'s data has been locked as part of the Database Lock (DBL) process, preventing further modifications to the subject\'s eCRF data. True = subject data locked; False = data still open for entry or query resolution.']
  date_of_birth date [note: 'Subject\'s date of birth used to calculate age at screening, enrollment, and key study milestones. Classified as restricted PHI/PII. Stored in yyyy-MM-dd format.']
  eligible_flag boolean [note: 'Indicates whether the subject met all inclusion and exclusion criteria as assessed during screening. True = all eligibility criteria confirmed met; False = one or more criteria not met. Sourced from the source system eligibility assessment.']
  enrollment_date date [note: 'Date on which the subject was formally enrolled in the study following confirmation of eligibility criteria. Distinct from screening date and randomization date. Used for enrollment tracking, site performance KPIs, and study timeline reporting.']
  enrollment_status varchar [note: 'Current lifecycle status of the subject within the study, reflecting their progression from screening through completion or withdrawal. Drives subject disposition reporting and ITT/PP population flags.']
  ethnicity varchar [note: 'Subject\'s self-reported ethnic origin as collected at screening, coded per CDISC SDTM controlled terminology. Distinct from race per FDA demographic reporting requirements. Used in regulatory demographic summary tables.']
  first_dose_date date [note: 'Date on which the subject received the first dose of investigational product. Used as the reference anchor for treatment-emergent adverse event (TEAE) analysis, PK sampling schedules, and per-protocol population definitions.']

Table subject.visit {

  regulatory_protocol_amendment_id varchar [note: 'Foreign key linking to regulatory.regulatory_protocol_amendment. Business justification: ICH E6 GCP requires subject visits to be traceable to the protocol amendment version governing visit procedures and schedules at time of conduct.']
  study_id varchar [note: 'Foreign key to the study this record belongs to.']
  study_site_id varchar [note: 'Reference to the investigational site where this visit was conducted or was scheduled to occur. Supports site-level visit compliance monitoring.']

  submission_id varchar [note: 'Foreign key linking to regulatory.submission. Business justification: Billing milestones in study contracts are triggered by specific subject visit events (FPFV, LPLV, visit count targets). billing_milestone has visit_count_target confirming this.']
  actual_visit_date date [note: 'The actual calendar date on which the subject attended the visit and assessments were performed. Maps to SVSTDTC in CDISC SDTM SV domain. Null if the visit was missed or not yet conducted. Principal real-world event date for this transaction.']
