  regulatory_binder_id varchar [note: 'Foreign key linking to document.regulatory_binder. Business justification: SUSARs are expedited safety reports submitted to health authorities and compiled into regulatory binders for CTA/IND submissions.']
  study_id varchar [note: 'Reference to the clinical study (protocol) under which this SUSAR occurred. Links the SUSAR to the sponsoring study for regulatory reporting and safety surveillance.']
  study_site_id varchar [note: 'Foreign key linking to site.study_site. Business justification: SUSARs require investigator and IRB/IEC notification at the study-site level. Linking susar to study_site drives per-site SUSAR notification workflows and enables study-site-level SUSAR']
  subject_randomization_id varchar [note: 'Foreign key linking to randomization.subject_randomization. Business justification: SUSAR causality and expectedness determination requires the subject\'s authoritative treatment assignment from the randomization system.']
  subject_visit_data_id varchar [note: 'Foreign key linking to datamanagement.subject_visit_data. Business justification: SUSARs originate from eCRF visit data; regulatory inspectors verify SUSAR source data against subject_visit_data records during GCP inspections.']
  submission_id varchar [note: 'Foreign key linking to regulatory.submission. Business justification: SUSARs require expedited regulatory submission (7-day fatal/life-threatening, 15-day others).']
  tmf_document_id varchar [note: 'Foreign key linking to document.tmf_document. Business justification: SUSAR expedited reports are essential TMF documents (DIA TMF Reference Model Zone 1, Section 11).']
  trial_subject_id varchar [note: 'Reference to the study subject (patient) who experienced the SUSAR. Links to the subject master record for patient-level safety surveillance and regulatory reporting.']
  ae_term varchar [note: 'Verbatim description of the adverse event as reported by the investigator or subject, prior to MedDRA coding. Preserved for source data verification (SDV) and coding audit trail per ALCOA+ principles.']
  argus_case_reference varchar [note: 'System-generated case identifier from the source system the operational system of record for adverse event and SUSAR management. Used to trace the SUSAR back to its source case in Argus.']
  awareness_date date [note: 'Date on which the sponsor (or CRO acting on behalf of the sponsor) first became aware of the SUSAR. This date starts the regulatory reporting clock for 7-day and 15-day expedited reporting obligations under ICH E2A.']
  blind_break_date date [note: 'Date on which the treatment blind was broken for this subject. Populated only when blind_broken is True. Required for audit trail and regulatory documentation of unblinding events.']
  blind_broken boolean [note: 'Indicates whether the treatment blind was broken for this subject in order to perform the causality assessment for this SUSAR. A blind break is a significant event requiring documentation and regulatory notification.']
  blind_status varchar [note: 'Blinding status of the study at the time of SUSAR reporting. Indicates whether the study was blinded, and if so, whether the blind was broken for this subject to determine treatment assignment for causality assessment.']
  case_number varchar [note: 'Externally-known alphanumeric case number assigned by the sponsor or CRO for this SUSAR, used in all regulatory submissions and correspondence. Serves as the BUSINESS_IDENTIFIER for this transaction.']
  created_timestamp timestamp [note: 'Timestamp when the SUSAR record was first created in the source system Serves as the RECORD_AUDIT_CREATED field for this transaction header, supporting ALCOA+ data integrity requirements.']
  ctcae_grade varchar [note: 'CTCAE severity grade assigned to the adverse reaction (1=Mild, 2=Moderate, 3=Severe, 4=Life-threatening, 5=Death). Used for safety signal detection, DSMB/DMC reviews, and regulatory reporting.']
  deadline_15day date [note: 'Calculated deadline for 15-day expedited reporting to regulatory authorities for non-fatal/non-life-threatening SUSARs. Derived from the reporting clock start date plus 15 calendar days per ICH E2A and FDA 21 CFR 312.32.']
  deadline_7day date [note: 'Calculated deadline for 7-day expedited reporting to regulatory authorities for fatal or life-threatening SUSARs. Derived from the reporting clock start date plus 7 calendar days per ICH E2A and FDA 21 CFR 312.32.']
  dsmb_notification_date date [note: 'Date on which the Data Safety Monitoring Board (DSMB) or Data Monitoring Committee (DMC) was notified of this SUSAR. Populated only when dsmb_notified is True.']
  dsmb_notified boolean [note: 'Indicates whether the Data Safety Monitoring Board (DSMB) or Data Monitoring Committee (DMC) was notified of this SUSAR. Required for studies with an active DSMB/DMC per ICH E6(R2) and study protocol.']
  eudravigilance_number varchar [note: 'Unique case identifier assigned by the EudraVigilance system upon submission of the SUSAR to the EMA. Used for tracking and referencing the case in EU regulatory correspondence and EudraVigilance database.']
  expectedness_assessment varchar [note: 'Assessment of whether the serious adverse reaction is unexpected — i.e., not listed or not consistent with the nature, severity, or frequency described in the current Investigator\'s Brochure (IB).']
  fatal_date date [note: 'Date of subject death if the outcome of the SUSAR is fatal. Triggers the 7-day expedited reporting clock and is required for death narratives in regulatory submissions.']
  follow_up_number varchar [note: 'Sequential number of the follow-up report for this SUSAR case (e.g., 1 for first follow-up, 2 for second). Zero or null for initial reports. Tracks the version history of regulatory submissions for this case.']
  irb_iec_notification_date date [note: 'Date on which the Institutional Review Board (IRB) or Independent Ethics Committee (IEC) was notified of this SUSAR. Populated only when irb_iec_notified is True.']
  irb_iec_notified boolean [note: 'Indicates whether the Institutional Review Board (IRB) or Independent Ethics Committee (IEC) was notified of this SUSAR as required by GCP and local regulations.']
  narrative varchar [note: 'Medical narrative summarizing the SUSAR case, including patient demographics, event description, clinical course, causality assessment, and outcome. Required component of all expedited regulatory reports per ICH E2A.']
  onset_date date [note: 'Date on which the subject first experienced the serious adverse reaction. This is the principal real-world event time (BUSINESS_EVENT_TIMESTAMP) for the SUSAR and is the anchor for all regulatory reporting clocks per ICH E2A.']
  outcome varchar [note: 'Clinical outcome of the serious adverse reaction at the time of reporting. Required for regulatory submissions and DSMB/DMC safety reviews. Tracks resolution status of the event.']
  reporting_clock_start_date date [note: 'The date from which the regulatory reporting clock begins for this SUSAR. Typically the sponsor awareness date, but may be adjusted based on the date of unblinding or receipt of minimum reportable information per ICH E2A.']
  reporting_status varchar [note: 'Current lifecycle state of the SUSAR regulatory reporting workflow. Tracks progression from initial draft through submission to regulatory authority acknowledgement and case closure. Serves as the LIFECYCLE_STATUS for this transaction.']
  route_of_administration varchar [note: 'Route by which the investigational product was administered (e.g., oral, intravenous, subcutaneous). Required for regulatory case narratives and pharmacovigilance signal assessment.']

  submission_report_type varchar [note: 'Indicates whether this SUSAR submission is an initial report, a follow-up report with additional information, or a final report closing the case. Regulatory authorities require tracking of report versions per ICH E2A.']
  updated_timestamp timestamp [note: 'Timestamp of the most recent modification to the SUSAR record in the source system Serves as the RECORD_AUDIT_UPDATED field for this transaction header, supporting audit trail and data integrity requirements.']

  Note: 'Transactional record for Suspected Unexpected Serious Adverse Reactions (SUSARs) — SAEs that are both unexpected (not in the Investigator Brochure) and causally related to the investigational product.'

Table safety.ae_meddra_coding {
  ae_meddra_coding_id varchar [pk, note: 'Unique surrogate identifier for each MedDRA coding record assigned to an adverse event. Primary key for the ae_meddra_coding data product in the safety domain.']
  adverse_event_id varchar [note: 'Reference to the parent adverse event record for which this MedDRA coding assignment was made. Links the coding record back to the originating AE in the source system']
  discrepancy_query_id varchar [note: 'Foreign key linking to datamanagement.discrepancy_query. Business justification: MedDRA coding discrepancies generate EDC queries that must be resolved before database lock.']
  ecrf_field_id varchar [note: 'Foreign key linking to datamanagement.ecrf_field. Business justification: MedDRA coding traceability requires identifying which specific eCRF field contained the verbatim AE term that was coded.']
  study_id varchar [note: 'Reference to the clinical study (protocol) under which the adverse event and its MedDRA coding were recorded. Supports study-level aggregate safety reporting.']
  subject_visit_data_id varchar [note: 'Foreign key linking to datamanagement.subject_visit_data. Business justification: MedDRA coding is performed on AE verbatim terms captured in subject visit eCRF data.']
  trial_subject_id varchar [note: 'Reference to the clinical trial subject (patient) who experienced the adverse event being coded. Enables subject-level safety queries and MedDRA-coded AE listings.']
  argus_case_reference varchar [note: 'The case identifier from the source system that corresponds to this MedDRA coding record. Serves as the source system business key for traceability back to the originating safety case in the system of record.']
  argus_event_reference varchar [note: 'The event-level identifier from the source system for the specific adverse event record within a case that this MedDRA coding applies to. Enables precise traceability to the source system event record.']
  coded_date date [note: 'Calendar date on which the MedDRA code was assigned to the verbatim adverse event term. Used for coding timeliness metrics and regulatory submission audit trails.']
  coded_timestamp timestamp [note: 'Precise date and time (with timezone) at which the MedDRA code was assigned. Provides granular audit trail for 21 CFR Part 11 electronic records compliance. Sourced from the source system system timestamp.']
  coding_comment varchar [note: 'Free-text comment entered by the coder to document coding rationale, ambiguities, or special considerations for this MedDRA assignment. Supports coding consistency reviews and regulatory inspection readiness.']
  coding_method varchar [note: 'Indicates how the MedDRA code was assigned: \'auto\' for system-generated auto-coding by the source system \'manual\' for coder-assigned coding, \'auto_confirmed\' for auto-coded and confirmed by a coder, \'recoded\' for a previously coded term that was']
  coding_status varchar [note: 'Current workflow status of the MedDRA coding assignment. \'pending\' indicates awaiting coding, \'coded\' indicates a code has been assigned, \'confirmed\' indicates QC-approved, \'rejected\' indicates coding was rejected and requires rework, \'under_review\'']
  confirmed_date date [note: 'Date on which the MedDRA coding assignment was confirmed (QC-approved) by a second reviewer or coding supervisor. Null if coding has not yet been confirmed. Supports dual-coder QC workflows.']
  ctcae_grade varchar [note: 'Severity grade assigned to the adverse event using the NCI Common Terminology Criteria for Adverse Events (CTCAE) scale (1=Mild, 2=Moderate, 3=Severe, 4=Life-threatening, 5=Death).']
  ctcae_version varchar [note: 'Version of the NCI CTCAE grading scale used for severity assessment (e.g., \'5.0\', \'4.03\'). Required for regulatory submissions to ensure consistent severity grading interpretation across study sites and time periods.']
  dictionary_language varchar [note: 'Three-letter ISO 639-2 language code of the MedDRA dictionary used for coding (e.g., \'ENG\' for English, \'JPN\' for Japanese). Relevant for multi-regional studies where local language MedDRA versions may be used (e.g., PMDA submissions in Japan).']
  effective_from_date date [note: 'Date from which this MedDRA coding record version is considered effective. Used in conjunction with is_current_version and effective_to_date to implement SCD Type 2 versioning for coding history tracking.']
  hlgt_code varchar [note: 'Eight-digit MedDRA numeric code for the High Level Group Term (HLGT), which sits between the HLT and SOC in the MedDRA hierarchy. Used for broad safety grouping in regulatory submissions.']
  hlgt_name varchar [note: 'Descriptive text of the MedDRA High Level Group Term (HLGT) corresponding to hlgt_code. Supports broad-level safety grouping in aggregate analyses and CSR appendices.']
  hlt_code varchar [note: 'Eight-digit MedDRA numeric code for the High Level Term (HLT) in the MedDRA hierarchy above the PT. Used for grouping related PTs in aggregate safety analyses and signal detection.']
  hlt_name varchar [note: 'Descriptive text of the MedDRA High Level Term (HLT) corresponding to hlt_code. Supports mid-level grouping in safety tabulations and DSMB/DMC review packages.']
  is_current_version boolean [note: 'Indicates whether this record represents the current (active) MedDRA coding assignment for the associated adverse event. Set to false for superseded coding records retained for historical audit trail.']
  is_sae boolean [note: 'Indicates whether the adverse event associated with this MedDRA coding record meets the regulatory definition of a Serious Adverse Event (SAE) per ICH E2A criteria (death, life-threatening, hospitalization, disability, congenital anomaly, or other']
  is_susar boolean [note: 'Indicates whether this adverse event has been classified as a Suspected Unexpected Serious Adverse Reaction (SUSAR), requiring expedited regulatory reporting (7-day or 15-day) to health authorities. Sourced from the source system case classification.']
  llt_code varchar [note: 'Eight-digit MedDRA numeric code for the Lowest Level Term (LLT) assigned to the verbatim adverse event term. The LLT is the most granular level of the MedDRA hierarchy and is the primary coding target. Sourced from the source system MedDRA dictionary.']
  llt_name varchar [note: 'Descriptive text of the MedDRA Lowest Level Term (LLT) corresponding to llt_code. Provides the human-readable label for the most granular MedDRA coding level. Sourced from the source system MedDRA dictionary.']
  meddra_version varchar [note: 'Version of the MedDRA dictionary used for this coding assignment (e.g., \'26.0\', \'26.1\'). Critical for regulatory submissions as coding must reference the specific MedDRA version in use at the time of the submission.']
  previous_pt_code varchar [note: 'The MedDRA PT code that was previously assigned before a recoding event. Populated only when coding_method = \'recoded\'. Enables before/after comparison for coding change impact analysis and regulatory audit.']
  previous_soc_code varchar [note: 'The MedDRA SOC code that was previously assigned before a recoding event. Populated only when coding_method = \'recoded\'. Enables assessment of whether a recoding changed the SOC-level classification, which may affect regulatory safety tables.']
  primary_soc_flag boolean [note: 'Indicates whether this SOC assignment is the primary (true) or secondary (false) SOC for the PT. MedDRA PTs may be linked to multiple SOCs; the primary SOC is used for standard regulatory safety tables. Sourced from the source system']
  pt_code varchar [note: 'Eight-digit MedDRA numeric code for the Preferred Term (PT) to which the LLT maps. The PT is the primary level used for regulatory reporting, safety queries, and signal detection. Sourced from the source system']
  pt_name varchar [note: 'Descriptive text of the MedDRA Preferred Term (PT) corresponding to pt_code. Used as the standard term in regulatory submissions, CIOMS forms, and safety narratives.']
  recoding_reason varchar [note: 'Free-text justification provided by the coder when a previously assigned MedDRA code is revised (coding_method = \'recoded\'). Required for audit trail integrity and regulatory inspection readiness. Null when coding_method is not \'recoded\'.']
  record_created_timestamp timestamp [note: 'Timestamp at which this MedDRA coding record was first created in the data lakehouse Silver layer. Supports audit trail and data lineage requirements per 21 CFR Part 11 and ALCOA+ principles.']
  record_updated_timestamp timestamp [note: 'Timestamp at which this MedDRA coding record was last modified in the data lakehouse Silver layer. Tracks the most recent update for change detection, incremental processing, and audit trail compliance.']
  soc_code varchar [note: 'Eight-digit MedDRA numeric code for the System Organ Class (SOC), the highest level of the MedDRA hierarchy. SOC is the primary axis for organizing adverse events in regulatory safety tables (e.g., Table 14.3.1 in ICH E3 CSR).']
  soc_name varchar [note: 'Descriptive text of the MedDRA System Organ Class (SOC) corresponding to soc_code. Used as the primary grouping header in all regulatory safety tabulations, PSUR/PBRER narratives, and DSMB reports.']
  verbatim_term varchar [note: 'The exact, unmodified adverse event term as reported by the investigator or subject in the source document or eCRF prior to MedDRA coding. Preserved for ALCOA+ compliance and audit trail. Sourced from the source system verbatim field.']

  Note: 'Stores the MedDRA coding assignment for each adverse event, capturing the verbatim term reported, the coded Lowest Level Term (LLT), Preferred Term (PT), High Level Term (HLT), High Level Group Term (HLGT), and System Organ Class (SOC).'
}

Table safety.causality_assessment {
  causality_assessment_id varchar [pk, note: 'Unique surrogate identifier for each causality assessment record in the Silver layer lakehouse. Primary key for this entity.']
  adverse_event_id varchar [note: 'Reference to the adverse event record for which this causality assessment is being performed. Links the assessment to the parent AE in the source system']
  ae_meddra_coding_id varchar [note: 'Foreign key linking to safety.ae_meddra_coding. Business justification: causality_assessment evaluates the relationship between an AE and the IMP. The MedDRA-coded term is essential context for causality assessors to evaluate temporal relationship']
  arm_id varchar [note: 'Foreign key linking to study.arm. Business justification: Causality assessments are arm-specific — the treatment arm determines which investigational product and dose the subject received. Unblinded causality reviews for DSMB require arm context.']
  dispensing_record_id varchar [note: 'Foreign key linking to supply.dispensing_record. Business justification: Causality assessment requires authoritative dispensing data (exact dose, formulation, timing) per ICH E2A guidelines.']
  dosing_regimen_id varchar [note: 'Foreign key linking to study.dosing_regimen. Business justification: Causality assessment requires the exact dosing regimen (dose level, frequency, escalation step) to evaluate temporal relationship and dose-response.']
  enrollment_id varchar [note: 'Foreign key linking to subject.enrollment. Business justification: Causality assessments require enrollment population context (safety population flag, ITT flag, randomization date) for regulatory reporting stratification in CSRs.']
  investigational_product_id varchar [note: 'Reference to the investigational product (drug, biologic, or device) being assessed for causal relationship to the adverse event.']
  lab_result_id varchar [note: 'Foreign key linking to laboratory.lab_result. Business justification: Causality assessments evaluate AE-drug relationships using lab evidence (e.g., liver function tests, renal markers).']
  prior_assessment_causality_assessment_id varchar [note: 'Self-referencing identifier pointing to the immediately preceding causality assessment record that this revision supersedes. Null for original (first) assessments. Enables full revision chain reconstruction.']
  protocol_deviation_id varchar [note: 'Foreign key linking to compliance.protocol_deviation. Business justification: Causality assessors must evaluate whether a protocol deviation (wrong dose, wrong timing) is an alternative explanation for the AE rather than the investigational product.']
  study_id varchar [note: 'Reference to the clinical study protocol under which the adverse event occurred and this causality assessment was conducted.']
  study_site_id varchar [note: 'Reference to the investigational site where the subject was enrolled and the adverse event was reported.']
  subject_randomization_id varchar [note: 'Foreign key linking to randomization.subject_randomization. Business justification: Causality assessment explicitly evaluates temporal relationship between treatment and AE onset, requiring the authoritative randomization record.']
  subject_visit_data_id varchar [note: 'Foreign key linking to datamanagement.subject_visit_data. Business justification: Causality assessments use eCRF visit data (concomitant medications, medical history, lab results).']
  treatment_arm_id varchar [note: 'Foreign key linking to randomization.treatment_arm. Business justification: PBRER Section 16 and DSUR require causality assessments aggregated by treatment arm.']
  trial_subject_id varchar [note: 'Reference to the clinical trial subject (patient) for whom the adverse event and causality assessment applies.']
  visit_id varchar [note: 'Foreign key linking to subject.subject_visit. Business justification: Causality assessments are performed at specific visits (e.g., end-of-treatment, unscheduled safety visit).']
  alternative_explanation varchar [note: 'Free-text description of alternative causes considered by the assessor (e.g., concomitant medications, underlying disease, concurrent procedures). Documents the differential diagnosis reasoning supporting the causality determination.']
  argus_case_number varchar [note: 'The case number assigned by the source system to the parent safety case containing this causality assessment. Enables direct traceability back to the source system for audit and regulatory purposes.']
  argus_workflow_state varchar [note: 'The workflow routing state of the causality assessment within the source system at the time of data extraction (e.g., Open, Closed, Submitted, Archived). Supports reconciliation between the lakehouse Silver layer and the source system.']
  assessment_date date [note: 'The calendar date on which the causality assessment was performed or last confirmed by the assessor. Used to track compliance with expedited reporting timelines (e.g., 7-day/15-day clock).']
  assessment_number varchar [note: 'Externally-known business identifier for this causality assessment record, typically generated by the source system (e.g., CA-2024-00123). Used for cross-system traceability and regulatory correspondence.']
  assessment_status varchar [note: 'Current workflow state of the causality assessment record within the source system Tracks progression from initial draft through regulatory submission. \'Superseded\' indicates a newer revision exists.']
  assessor_role varchar [note: 'The professional role of the individual performing the causality assessment. Distinguishes between the Principal Investigator (PI) site-level assessment and the Sponsor Medical Monitor\'s independent assessment, as required by ICH E2A and GCP guidelines.']
  causality_category varchar [note: 'The assessor\'s determination of the causal relationship between the investigational product and the adverse event. Standard WHO/ICH causality categories used in the source system and regulatory submissions.']
  causality_category_code varchar [note: 'Standardized short code for the causality category used in CDISC SDTM AE domain submissions and the source system exports (UN=Unrelated, UL=Unlikely, PO=Possible, PR=Probable, DE=Definite, NA=Not Assessable).']
  concomitant_medication_flag boolean [note: 'Indicates whether this causality assessment pertains to a concomitant medication (True) rather than the primary investigational product (False). Enables differentiation of IP-related versus concomitant drug-related assessments within the same AE case.']
  concomitant_medication_name varchar [note: 'Name of the concomitant medication being assessed for causal relationship when concomitant_medication_flag is True. Populated from WHO Drug Dictionary (WHO-DD) preferred drug name.']
  created_timestamp timestamp [note: 'The date and time when this causality assessment record was first created in the source system (the source system Supports ALCOA+ audit trail requirements and regulatory inspection readiness.']
  dechallenge_result varchar [note: 'Outcome observed when the investigational product was withdrawn (dechallenged) following the adverse event. A positive dechallenge (AE resolved or improved upon withdrawal) supports a causal relationship. Captured per ICH E2A causality criteria.']
  dsmb_review_date date [note: 'The date on which the DSMB/DMC formally reviewed this causality assessment during a scheduled or ad hoc safety review meeting.']
  dsmb_reviewed boolean [note: 'Indicates whether this causality assessment was reviewed by the Data Safety Monitoring Board (DSMB) or Data Monitoring Committee (DMC) as part of a formal safety review. Supports DSMB/DMC meeting documentation and regulatory oversight.']
  expectedness varchar [note: 'Determination of whether the adverse event is listed in the current Investigator\'s Brochure (IB) or Reference Safety Information (RSI) as a known effect of the investigational product. Drives SUSAR classification and expedited reporting obligations.']
  expedited_report_required boolean [note: 'Indicates whether this causality assessment triggers an obligation for expedited regulatory reporting (7-day or 15-day report) to health authorities such as FDA, EMA, or PMDA based on SUSAR classification.']
  is_revised boolean [note: 'Indicates whether this causality assessment is a revision of a previously submitted assessment. True when the assessor has changed their causality determination after initial submission, triggering regulatory follow-up reporting obligations.']
  rationale_narrative varchar [note: 'Free-text clinical narrative provided by the assessor explaining the reasoning behind the causality determination. Includes consideration of temporal relationship, biological plausibility, dechallenge/rechallenge results, and alternative explanations.']
  rechallenge_result varchar [note: 'Outcome observed when the investigational product was re-administered (rechallenged) after the adverse event resolved. A positive rechallenge (AE recurred) provides strong evidence of causal relationship. Captured per ICH E2A causality criteria.']
  report_due_date date [note: 'Calculated deadline date by which the expedited regulatory report (SUSAR/IND safety report) must be submitted to health authorities. Derived from the date of first awareness plus the applicable reporting timeline.']
  reporting_timeline_days varchar [note: 'The applicable expedited reporting timeline in calendar days from the date of first awareness of the SUSAR (typically 7 days for fatal/life-threatening or 15 days for other serious unexpected reactions). Drives compliance monitoring.']
  revision_number varchar [note: 'Sequential revision version number for this causality assessment. Starts at 1 for the original assessment and increments with each revision. Enables audit trail tracking of assessment changes over the case lifecycle.']
  signal_detection_flag boolean [note: 'Indicates whether this causality assessment has been flagged for inclusion in pharmacovigilance signal detection analysis within the source system Supports aggregate safety review and cumulative causality trend monitoring.']
  source_record_reference varchar [note: 'The native record identifier from the source system (the source system case assessment ID or Medidata Rave record ID) for this causality assessment. Enables bidirectional traceability between the lakehouse Silver layer and the operational system.']
  sponsor_causality_category varchar [note: 'The Sponsor Medical Monitor\'s independent causality determination, captured separately from the investigator\'s assessment. When sponsor_causality_override is True,']
  sponsor_causality_override boolean [note: 'Indicates whether the Sponsor Medical Monitor\'s causality determination differs from (overrides) the Investigator\'s assessment. When True, both assessments are retained and the sponsor\'s determination governs regulatory reporting obligations per ICH E2A.']
  susar_flag boolean [note: 'Indicates whether this adverse event has been classified as a Suspected Unexpected Serious Adverse Reaction (SUSAR) based on the combination of seriousness, causality (at least possible), and unexpectedness criteria.']
  temporal_relationship varchar [note: 'Assessment of whether the timing between investigational product administration and adverse event onset is consistent with a causal relationship. A key criterion in WHO and ICH causality assessment frameworks.']
  updated_timestamp timestamp [note: 'The date and time when this causality assessment record was most recently modified in the source system. Tracks the latest change for audit trail compliance and Silver layer incremental load processing.']
  who_dd_drug_code varchar [note: 'WHO Drug Dictionary standardized drug code for the product (investigational or concomitant) being assessed. Enables cross-study signal detection and regulatory pharmacovigilance reporting.']

  Note: 'Records the investigator and sponsor medical monitor causality assessments for each adverse event relative to the investigational product and concomitant medications.'
}

Table safety.narrative {
  narrative_id varchar [pk, note: 'Unique surrogate identifier for the safety narrative record in the Databricks Silver Layer. Primary key for this data product.']
  adverse_event_id varchar [note: 'Foreign key linking to safety.adverse_event. Business justification: Safety narratives are written for SAEs and SUSARs, which are adverse events. While safety_narrative already has icsr_id → icsr → adverse_event, a direct adverse_event_id FK is essential']
  ae_meddra_coding_id varchar [note: 'Foreign key linking to safety.ae_meddra_coding. Business justification: narrative carries six redundant MedDRA fields (meddra_llt_code, meddra_pt_code, meddra_pt_term, meddra_soc_code, meddra_soc_term, meddra_version) that are authoritatively stored in']
  ecrf_form_id varchar [note: 'Foreign key linking to datamanagement.ecrf_form. Business justification: Narratives reference the specific eCRF form (AE/SAE form) from which safety event data was collected.']
  enrollment_id varchar [note: 'Foreign key linking to subject.enrollment. Business justification: Safety narratives require enrollment context (randomization date, first dose date, population flags) for case chronology and regulatory report completeness per ICH E2B ICSR requirements.']
  icsr_id varchar [note: 'Reference to the parent safety case (SAE or SUSAR) for which this narrative is authored. Links to the safety case master record in the source system']
  investigational_site_id varchar [note: 'Foreign key linking to site.investigational_site. Business justification: Regulatory case narratives per ICH E2B(R3) and FDA guidance must identify the site where the event occurred. safety_narrative has no site FK despite describing site-specific events.']
  protocol_id varchar [note: 'Foreign key linking to study.protocol. Business justification: Safety narratives for ICSRs and SAEs must reference the protocol version under which the event occurred. ICH E2B(R3) narrative format requires protocol reference.']
  safety_narrative_tmf_document_id varchar [note: 'Foreign key linking to document.tmf_document. Business justification: Safety narratives are formal ICSR components filed as TMF documents. Medical writers and pharmacovigilance teams need to link the narrative record to its TMF-filed version for audit']
  serious_adverse_event_id varchar [note: 'Foreign key linking to safety.serious_adverse_event. Business justification: The narrative product description explicitly states it stores clinical narratives for SAEs and SUSARs.']
  study_id varchar [note: 'Reference to the clinical study (protocol) under which this safety narrative was generated.']
  subject_visit_data_id varchar [note: 'Foreign key linking to datamanagement.subject_visit_data. Business justification: Safety narratives are authored using source eCRF visit data; medical writers and safety physicians reference subject_visit_data to verify accuracy of event descriptions']
  susar_id varchar [note: 'Foreign key linking to safety.susar. Business justification: The narrative product description explicitly states it stores clinical narratives for SAEs and SUSARs.']
  trial_subject_id varchar [note: 'Reference to the clinical trial subject (patient) associated with this safety narrative. Links to the subject master record.']
  visit_id varchar [note: 'Foreign key linking to subject.subject_visit. Business justification: Safety narratives must reference specific visit context where AE was reported/assessed.']
  withdrawal_id varchar [note: 'Foreign key linking to consent.withdrawal. Business justification: Safety narratives for cases where the subject withdrew must reference the withdrawal record.']
  ae_onset_date date [note: 'Date on which the adverse event first began, as reported by the investigator or subject. Critical for calculating reporting timelines and for CDISC SDTM AE domain mapping.']
  ae_outcome varchar [note: 'Coded outcome of the adverse event at the time of narrative authoring or case closure. Aligns with ICH E2B(R3) outcome codes and CDISC SDTM AE.AEOUT controlled terminology.']
  ae_resolution_date date [note: 'Date on which the adverse event resolved or stabilized. Null if the event is ongoing at the time of narrative authoring. Used to determine event duration and outcome status.']
  approval_date date [note: 'Date on which the medical monitor formally approved the final version of the safety narrative for regulatory submission. Represents the final lifecycle milestone before submission.']
  argus_case_number varchar [note: 'The externally-known case number assigned by the source system to the adverse event case. Used as the primary business identifier for cross-system traceability and regulatory submissions.']
  authoring_date date [note: 'Date on which the safety narrative was initially authored or drafted. Supports ALCOA+ audit trail requirements and version history tracking.']
  case_summary varchar [note: 'High-level executive summary of the safety case, synthesizing the patient description, event, treatment, and outcome into a concise paragraph suitable for inclusion in the ICSR narrative field of E2B(R3) submissions.']
  case_type varchar [note: 'Classification of the safety case for which this narrative is written. SAE = Serious Adverse Event; SUSAR = Suspected Unexpected Serious Adverse Reaction; AE = Adverse Event; AESI = Adverse Event of Special Interest.']
  causality_assessment varchar [note: 'Medical monitor\'s or investigator\'s assessment of the causal relationship between the investigational product and the adverse event. Used in regulatory reporting and signal detection.']
  created_timestamp timestamp [note: 'Timestamp when this safety narrative record was first created in the system. Supports ALCOA+ audit trail and 21 CFR Part 11 electronic record requirements.']
  ctcae_grade varchar [note: 'Common Terminology Criteria for Adverse Events (CTCAE) severity grade assigned to the adverse event (1=Mild, 2=Moderate, 3=Severe, 4=Life-threatening, 5=Death). Used for safety signal detection and regulatory reporting.']
  ctcae_version varchar [note: 'Version of the NCI Common Terminology Criteria for Adverse Events used for severity grading in this narrative (e.g., \'5.0\'). Ensures consistency in grading across study sites and regulatory submissions.']
  dsmb_review_date date [note: 'Date on which the DSMB or DMC reviewed this safety case. Populated only when dsmb_reviewed is True. Used to track safety oversight compliance.']
  dsmb_reviewed boolean [note: 'Indicates whether this safety case and its narrative have been reviewed by the Data Safety Monitoring Board (DSMB) or Data Monitoring Committee (DMC). True if reviewed; False if not yet presented to the DSMB/DMC.']
  e2b_message_reference varchar [note: 'Unique message identifier assigned to the ICSR transmission in E2B(R3) XML format as submitted via eCTD to health authorities. Enables traceability between the narrative record and the regulatory submission artifact.']
  event_description varchar [note: 'Detailed narrative describing the onset, nature, severity, and clinical course of the adverse event or serious adverse event, including signs, symptoms, and diagnostic findings. Core narrative section for ICSR submissions.']
  expedited_report_due_date date [note: 'Regulatory deadline by which the expedited safety report (ICSR) must be submitted to health authorities. Calculated from the date of first awareness per ICH E2A (7-day for fatal/life-threatening; 15-day for other serious unexpected).']
  expedited_report_submitted_date date [note: 'Actual date on which the expedited safety report (ICSR) was submitted to the relevant health authority via eCTD/E2B(R3) format. Used to verify compliance with regulatory reporting timelines.']
  is_blinded boolean [note: 'Indicates whether the narrative was authored under blinded conditions (True) or after unblinding of treatment assignment (False). Critical for maintaining study integrity in double-blind trials; blinded narratives must not reveal treatment allocation.']
  medical_monitor_commentary varchar [note: 'Clinical commentary and causality assessment provided by the medical monitor, including their opinion on the relationship between the investigational product and the adverse event, and any recommendations for protocol amendments or safety actions.']
  medical_monitor_name varchar [note: 'Full name of the medical monitor or safety physician who reviewed and approved the safety narrative. Required for regulatory audit trail and ICSR submission accountability.']
  narrative_status varchar [note: 'Current workflow status of the safety narrative document. Tracks progression from initial authoring through medical monitor review and approval to regulatory submission. \'superseded\' indicates a newer version has replaced this record.']
  outcome_description varchar [note: 'Narrative section describing the resolution or current status of the adverse event, including recovery details, sequelae, or death information. Corresponds to the outcome field in E2B(R3) regulatory submissions.']
  regulatory_authority_notified varchar [note: 'Pipe-delimited list of regulatory authorities to which this safety report was submitted (e.g., FDA|EMA|PMDA|MHRA). Supports multi-jurisdictional compliance tracking.']
  report_type varchar [note: 'Indicates whether this narrative supports an initial expedited report, a follow-up report with updated information, or a final report closing the case. Drives regulatory submission timelines under ICH E2A.']
  review_date date [note: 'Date on which the medical monitor or safety physician completed their clinical review of the narrative. Distinct from the authoring date; marks the transition from draft to reviewed status.']
  seriousness_criteria varchar [note: 'Pipe-delimited list of ICH E2A seriousness criteria met by the adverse event (e.g., death|life_threatening|hospitalization|disability|congenital_anomaly|medically_significant). Determines expedited reporting obligations.']
  source_document_reference varchar [note: 'Reference identifier or path to the source documents (e.g., hospital records, lab reports, investigator notes) used to author this narrative, as stored in Veeva Vault eTMF. Supports SDV and audit trail requirements.']
  subject_description varchar [note: 'Structured narrative section describing the patient\'s relevant medical history, demographics (age, sex, weight), concomitant medications, and pre-existing conditions relevant to the adverse event. Contains protected health information (PHI).']
  treatment_description varchar [note: 'Narrative section describing the investigational product(s) and concomitant medications administered, including dose, route, frequency, start and stop dates, and any dose modifications or interruptions relevant to the adverse event.']
  unblinding_date date [note: 'Date on which the treatment assignment was unblinded for this subject in the context of this safety case. Populated only when is_blinded transitions to False. Relevant for causality re-assessment post-unblinding.']
  updated_timestamp timestamp [note: 'Timestamp when this safety narrative record was most recently modified. Supports ALCOA+ audit trail, version control, and 21 CFR Part 11 electronic record requirements.']
  version varchar [note: 'Sequential version number of the safety narrative document, incremented each time the narrative is revised. Version 1 is the initial draft; subsequent versions reflect amendments or follow-up updates.']

  Note: 'Stores the structured clinical narrative for SAEs and SUSARs, including case summary, patient description, event description, treatment details, outcome, and medical monitor commentary.'
}

Table safety.icsr {
  icsr_id varchar [pk, note: 'Unique surrogate identifier for the Individual Case Safety Report (ICSR) record in the Databricks Silver Layer. Primary key for this entity.']
  adverse_event_id varchar [note: 'Reference to the source adverse event or serious adverse event record in the safety.adverse_event product from which this ICSR was generated.']
  ae_meddra_coding_id varchar [note: 'Foreign key linking to safety.ae_meddra_coding. Business justification: icsr carries redundant MedDRA fields (meddra_pt_code, meddra_soc_code, meddra_version) that are authoritatively stored in ae_meddra_coding.']
  causality_assessment_id varchar [note: 'Foreign key linking to safety.causality_assessment. Business justification: An ICSR must document the causality assessment (relatedness to IMP) as a core regulatory requirement per ICH E2A guidelines. icsr has no direct FK to causality_assessment.']
  clinical_trial_authorization_id varchar [note: 'Foreign key linking to regulatory.clinical_trial_authorization. Business justification: EU ICSRs are submitted to EudraVigilance under the specific CTA. The ICSR must reference the CTA for CTIS reporting compliance, member-state notification tracking, and']
  dispensing_record_id varchar [note: 'Foreign key linking to supply.dispensing_record. Business justification: ICSRs require drug administration details (dose, route, dates) directly from the dispensing record for E2B submission.']
  document_sop_id varchar [note: 'Foreign key linking to document.document_sop. Business justification: Each ICSR is filed to fulfill a specific regulatory reporting obligation. icsr.reporting_obligation_type is a STRING that should be normalized to a FK.']
  ecrf_form_id varchar [note: 'Foreign key linking to datamanagement.ecrf_form. Business justification: ICSRs are generated from data captured on specific eCRF forms. Regulatory submissions require traceability from the ICSR back to the source data collection instrument; health']
  enrollment_id varchar [note: 'Foreign key linking to subject.enrollment. Business justification: ICSR E2B submissions require enrollment date, randomization date, first dose date as mandatory data elements per ICH E2B R3 specification.']
  health_authority_id varchar [note: 'Foreign key linking to regulatory.health_authority. Business justification: ICSRs are submitted to specific health authorities. Linking icsr to health_authority normalizes the regulatory_agency field and enables ICSR submission tracking by authority']
  imp_master_id varchar [note: 'Foreign key linking to supply.imp_master. Business justification: ICSR (E2B) regulatory submissions require precise IMP identification including formulation, strength, and route.']
  ind_application_id varchar [note: 'Foreign key linking to regulatory.ind_application. Business justification: ICSRs are filed under specific IND applications per FDA 21 CFR 312.32 requirements.']
  investigational_product_id varchar [note: 'Foreign key linking to study.investigational_product. Business justification: ICSRs are submitted for a specific investigational product. Protocol-level IP context (IND number, mechanism of action, development phase) is required for ICH E2B(R3) ICSR']
  investigational_site_id varchar [note: 'Foreign key linking to site.investigational_site. Business justification: ICSRs submitted to FDA (MedWatch), EMA (EudraVigilance), and other authorities must identify the reporting site per ICH E2B(R3).']
  manufacture_batch_id varchar [note: 'Foreign key linking to supply.manufacture_batch. Business justification: ICH E2B(R3) ICSR format mandates batch/lot number as a required drug characterization field in electronic submissions to health authorities.']
  protocol_id varchar [note: 'Foreign key linking to study.protocol. Business justification: ICSRs submitted to health authorities via EudraVigilance and FDA FAERS require protocol reference. ICH E2B(R3) ICSR format includes protocol identifier fields.']
  regulatory_binder_id varchar [note: 'Foreign key linking to document.regulatory_binder. Business justification: Expedited ICSRs (15-day/7-day safety reports) are compiled into regulatory binders for health authority submissions (FDA, EMA).']
  study_id varchar [note: 'Reference to the clinical study associated with this ICSR, linking the safety report to the sponsoring trial.']
  susar_id varchar [note: 'Foreign key linking to safety.susar. Business justification: An ICSR (Individual Case Safety Report) is the formal regulatory submission for a SUSAR. icsr.is_susar flag exists but no direct FK to the susar record.']
  trial_subject_id varchar [note: 'Reference to the clinical trial subject (patient) who experienced the adverse event triggering this ICSR.']
  acknowledgement_date date [note: 'The date on which the regulatory agency formally acknowledged receipt of the ICSR submission. For electronic submissions via EudraVigilance or FDA gateway, this is the date of the automated acknowledgement message (ACK).']
  acknowledgement_number varchar [note: 'The unique reference number or message ID returned by the regulatory agency in the acknowledgement (ACK) message confirming receipt of the ICSR. Used for reconciliation and proof of submission.']
  applicable_deadline_date date [note: 'The operative regulatory deadline date for this specific ICSR, reflecting the applicable reporting window (7-day or 15-day) based on the seriousness criteria and expectedness of the adverse event. Used for compliance monitoring.']
  argus_case_number varchar [note: 'The unique case identifier assigned by the source system to the source safety case from which this ICSR was generated. Used for traceability back to the system of record.']
  awareness_date date [note: 'The date on which the sponsor or CRO first became aware of the adverse event that triggered this ICSR. This is the regulatory clock start date (Day 0) from which all expedited reporting deadlines (7-day and 15-day) are calculated per ICH E2A.']
  created_timestamp timestamp [note: 'The date and time at which this ICSR record was first created in the source system and ingested into the Databricks Silver Layer. Supports audit trail and ALCOA+ data integrity requirements.']
  deadline_15day_date date [note: 'The calculated calendar date by which a serious unexpected adverse reaction (non-fatal/non-life-threatening SUSAR) must be submitted to the regulatory agency, computed as awareness_date + 15 calendar days per ICH E2A.']
  deadline_7day_date date [note: 'The calculated calendar date by which a fatal or life-threatening unexpected SUSAR must be submitted to the regulatory agency, computed as awareness_date + 7 calendar days per ICH E2A.']
  delay_reason varchar [note: 'Free-text explanation documenting the reason why the ICSR was not submitted within the applicable regulatory deadline. Required for late submissions to support CAPA processes and regulatory inspection readiness.']
  dsmb_notified boolean [note: 'Indicates whether the Data Safety Monitoring Board (DSMB) or Data Monitoring Committee (DMC) was notified of this ICSR. Required for studies with an active DSMB charter.']
  irb_iec_notification_date date [note: 'The date on which the Institutional Review Board (IRB) or Independent Ethics Committee (IEC) was formally notified of this ICSR. Used for compliance tracking against GCP notification requirements.']
  irb_iec_notified boolean [note: 'Indicates whether the Institutional Review Board (IRB) or Independent Ethics Committee (IEC) overseeing the study was notified of this ICSR, as required by GCP and applicable regulations.']
  is_current_version boolean [note: 'Indicates whether this record represents the most current version of the ICSR. True for the latest version; False for superseded versions retained for audit history.']
  is_fatal boolean [note: 'Indicates whether the adverse event associated with this ICSR resulted in the death of the subject. Fatal cases trigger the 7-day expedited reporting clock per ICH E2A.']
  is_life_threatening boolean [note: 'Indicates whether the adverse event associated with this ICSR was life-threatening (i.e., the subject was at immediate risk of death). Life-threatening cases trigger the 7-day expedited reporting clock per ICH E2A.']
  is_on_time boolean [note: 'Indicates whether the ICSR was submitted to the regulatory agency on or before the applicable regulatory deadline date. True = compliant submission; False = late submission. Key KPI for regulatory compliance monitoring.']
  is_susar boolean [note: 'Indicates whether this ICSR relates to a Suspected Unexpected Serious Adverse Reaction (SUSAR). SUSARs require expedited reporting to regulatory authorities and ethics committees under ICH E2A and EU CTR 536/2014.']
  narrative varchar [note: 'The structured free-text clinical narrative summarizing the adverse event, patient information, treatment details, and outcome as included in the ICSR submission. Corresponds to ICH E2B(R3) H.1 narrative section.']
  rejection_reason varchar [note: 'The reason provided by the regulatory agency when an ICSR submission is rejected (e.g., data validation failure, duplicate case, missing mandatory fields). Populated only when submission_status = \'rejected\'.']
  report_number varchar [note: 'The externally-known, unique regulatory report identifier assigned to this ICSR submission (e.g., the E2B message identifier or MedWatch report number). Used by health authorities to track and acknowledge the submission.']
  report_type varchar [note: 'Indicates whether this ICSR is an initial submission, a follow-up update with new information, or a nullification (withdrawal) of a previously submitted report. Aligns with ICH E2B(R3) A.1.6.']
  report_version varchar [note: 'Sequential version number of this ICSR record. Version 1 is the initial report; subsequent versions represent follow-up or amended submissions for the same case.']
  sender_identifier varchar [note: 'The unique identifier of the organization or individual sending the ICSR to the regulatory agency, as defined in ICH E2B(R3) A.3.1. Typically the sponsor or CRO EudraVigilance/FDA sender ID.']
  submission_date date [note: 'The actual calendar date on which the ICSR was transmitted to the regulatory agency. Used to calculate days-to-submission and determine on-time compliance against the applicable deadline.']
  submission_method varchar [note: 'The technical format or channel used to transmit the ICSR to the regulatory agency. E2B XML is the standard electronic format per ICH E2B(R3); MedWatch and CIOMS I are paper/PDF formats used for specific agencies or fallback scenarios.']
  submission_status varchar [note: 'Current workflow state of the ICSR submission lifecycle. Tracks progression from internal drafting through regulatory acknowledgement or rejection.']
  submission_timestamp timestamp [note: 'The precise date and time (with timezone) at which the ICSR was electronically transmitted to the regulatory agency gateway. Provides audit-grade precision beyond the submission date for 21 CFR Part 11 compliance.']
  updated_timestamp timestamp [note: 'The date and time at which this ICSR record was most recently modified in the source system or the Databricks Silver Layer. Supports change tracking and ALCOA+ data integrity requirements.']

  Note: 'Individual Case Safety Report (ICSR) — the formal regulatory submission record for expedited safety reporting to health authorities (FDA, EMA, PMDA, MHRA).'
}

Table safety.signal {
  signal_id varchar [pk, note: 'Unique surrogate identifier for the safety signal record in the Databricks Silver Layer. Primary key for this entity.']
  application_id varchar [note: 'Foreign key linking to regulatory.application. Business justification: Safety signals are detected for a specific investigational product (pipeline asset).']
  arm_id varchar [note: 'Foreign key linking to study.arm. Business justification: Safety signals are often arm-specific (active vs. placebo). Signal detection and evaluation reports require treatment arm context. DSMB unblinded signal reviews require protocol arm attribution.']
  health_authority_id varchar [note: 'Foreign key linking to regulatory.health_authority. Business justification: Safety signals meeting regulatory notification thresholds must be reported to specific health authorities (e.g., FDA, EMA).']
  imp_master_id varchar [note: 'Foreign key linking to supply.imp_master. Business justification: Signal detection and management is product-centric; pharmacovigilance teams aggregate signals by IMP for DSUR Section 16 and PBRER.']
  investigational_product_id varchar [note: 'Foreign key linking to study.investigational_product. Business justification: Safety signals are IP-specific. The protocol-level investigational_product provides mechanism of action, therapeutic class, and IND context needed for signal evaluation and']
  lab_panel_id varchar [note: 'Foreign key linking to laboratory.lab_panel. Business justification: Safety signals are frequently panel-specific (hepatic panel, renal panel, hematology panel).']
  protocol_id varchar [note: 'Foreign key linking to study.protocol. Business justification: Safety signal management reports reference the protocol version. Protocol amendments may be triggered by signals.']
  study_id varchar [note: 'Reference to the clinical study associated with this safety signal. Links the signal to the study protocol under which the signal was detected.']
  treatment_arm_id varchar [note: 'Foreign key linking to randomization.treatment_arm. Business justification: Safety signals are detected and evaluated at treatment-arm level (active vs. placebo disproportionality).']
  argus_signal_reference varchar [note: 'Native signal identifier assigned by the source system signal detection and evaluation module. Used for traceability back to the source system of record.']
  benefit_risk_summary varchar [note: 'Narrative summary of the benefit-risk assessment conducted as part of signal evaluation. Captures the medical monitor\'s or safety committee\'s conclusion on whether the signal alters the overall benefit-risk profile of the investigational product.']
  case_count varchar [note: 'Total number of adverse event cases contributing to the safety signal at the time of detection or most recent evaluation. Represents the volume of evidence supporting the signal.']
  created_timestamp timestamp [note: 'Timestamp when this safety signal record was first created in the system. Supports audit trail requirements and data lineage tracking per 21 CFR Part 11 and ALCOA+ principles.']
  data_reviewed_summary varchar [note: 'Summary of the data sources and datasets reviewed during signal evaluation, including case narratives, aggregate safety data, literature, and clinical trial data from Medidata Rave or SAS Drug Development outputs.']
  detection_date date [note: 'Date on which the safety signal was first identified or flagged, either by automated detection algorithms in the source system or by a medical monitor during clinical review. Critical for regulatory reporting timelines.']
  detection_method varchar [note: 'Method used to detect the safety signal. Includes quantitative pharmacovigilance methods such as Proportional Reporting Ratio (PRR), Reporting Odds Ratio (ROR), Bayesian Confidence Propagation Neural Network (BCPNN), disproportionality analysis, clinical']
  dsmb_recommendation varchar [note: 'Formal recommendation issued by the DSMB/DMC following their review of the safety signal. Drives sponsor and investigator actions regarding study continuation, protocol modification, or suspension.']
  dsmb_review_date date [note: 'Date on which the DSMB/DMC reviewed this safety signal. Null if not yet reviewed or not referred. Used to track DSMB meeting schedules and signal review timelines.']
  evaluation_completion_date date [note: 'Date on which the formal evaluation of the safety signal was completed and a final disposition was reached. Null if evaluation is still in progress.']
  evaluation_cycle_number varchar [note: 'Sequential cycle number for the current evaluation of this safety signal. Supports multiple evaluation cycles as new data emerges (e.g., Cycle 1 = initial evaluation, Cycle 2 = re-evaluation after new cases).']
  evaluation_due_date date [note: 'Target due date for completing the signal evaluation, based on signal priority and applicable regulatory timelines (e.g., 30 days for high-priority signals per EMA GVP Module IX). Used for SLA tracking and escalation.']
  evaluation_plan varchar [note: 'Narrative description of the planned approach for evaluating the safety signal, including data sources to be reviewed, analyses to be conducted, and timelines. Documented in the source system evaluation module.']
  evaluation_start_date date [note: 'Date on which formal evaluation of the safety signal was initiated. Used to track evaluation timelines against regulatory and internal SOP requirements.']
  final_disposition varchar [note: 'Final outcome of the signal evaluation process. Indicates whether the signal was validated as a new risk, validated as a change in known risk, refuted as not a true signal, requires further monitoring, or requires no action.']
  is_dsmb_referred boolean [note: 'Indicates whether this safety signal has been referred to the Data Safety Monitoring Board (DSMB) or Data Monitoring Committee (DMC) for independent review. True = referred; False = not referred.']
  is_expedited_reporting_required boolean [note: 'Indicates whether this safety signal triggers expedited regulatory reporting obligations (e.g., 7-day or 15-day IND safety report to FDA, or SUSAR report to EMA). True = expedited reporting required; False = routine reporting.']
  is_susar_related boolean [note: 'Indicates whether this safety signal is associated with one or more Suspected Unexpected Serious Adverse Reactions (SUSARs). True = SUSAR-related; False = not SUSAR-related. Relevant for expedited regulatory reporting obligations.']
  meddra_pt_code varchar [note: 'MedDRA Preferred Term (PT) code representing the primary adverse event term associated with the safety signal. Standardized coding per MedDRA hierarchy for regulatory submissions and signal tracking.']
  meddra_soc_code varchar [note: 'MedDRA System Organ Class (SOC) code for the primary adverse event term associated with the safety signal. Used for signal categorization and aggregate safety reporting.']
  meddra_version varchar [note: 'Version of the MedDRA dictionary used for coding the adverse event terms associated with this safety signal (e.g., 26.1). Required for regulatory submissions to ensure coding consistency.']
  number varchar [note: 'Human-readable, externally-known business identifier for the safety signal (e.g., SIG-2024-00123). Used in regulatory correspondence, DSMB/DMC reports, and cross-functional communications.']
  priority varchar [note: 'Priority level assigned to the safety signal based on clinical seriousness, signal strength, and potential public health impact. Drives evaluation timelines and resource allocation.']
  regulatory_action_recommended varchar [note: 'Regulatory action recommended as a result of signal evaluation. Options include label update (update Investigator Brochure or product label), Direct Healthcare Professional Communication (DHPC), study suspension, protocol amendment, risk minimization']
  regulatory_action_status varchar [note: 'Current implementation status of the recommended regulatory action. Tracks whether the recommended action (e.g., label update, protocol amendment) has been initiated, completed, or determined not required.']
  regulatory_report_due_date date [note: 'Deadline by which the regulatory safety report (e.g., IND safety report, SUSAR report) must be submitted to the relevant health authority (FDA, EMA, MHRA, PMDA, etc.) based on the signal\'s seriousness and expectedness.']
  signal_description varchar [note: 'Detailed narrative describing the nature of the safety signal, including the observed drug-event association, population affected, and clinical context. Supports medical monitor review and regulatory reporting.']
  signal_status varchar [note: 'Current lifecycle status of the safety signal in the evaluation workflow. Tracks progression from initial detection through evaluation to final disposition.']
  strength_lower_ci decimal(10,4) [note: 'Lower bound of the 95% confidence interval for the signal strength metric value. A lower CI > 1 (for PRR/ROR) or > 0 (for IC) typically indicates a statistically significant signal.']
  strength_metric_name varchar [note: 'Name of the quantitative disproportionality metric used to measure signal strength (e.g., PRR - Proportional Reporting Ratio, ROR - Reporting Odds Ratio, BCPNN IC - Information Component, EBGM - Empirical Bayes Geometric Mean).']
  strength_value decimal(10,4) [note: 'Numeric value of the signal strength metric (e.g., PRR = 3.45, ROR = 4.12, IC = 2.1). Used to quantify the degree of disproportionate reporting and support signal validation decisions.']
  title varchar [note: 'Concise human-readable title describing the safety signal (e.g., \'Potential hepatotoxicity signal with Study Drug X\'). Used in dashboards, DSMB/DMC agendas, and regulatory submissions.']
  updated_timestamp timestamp [note: 'Timestamp when this safety signal record was most recently modified. Supports audit trail requirements and change tracking per 21 CFR Part 11 and ALCOA+ principles.']

  Note: 'Master record for identified safety signals and their full evaluation lifecycle. Captures signal description, detection method (disproportionality analysis, PRR, ROR, BCPNN, clinical review, literature), detection date, data source, signal strength'
}

  quorum_achieved boolean [note: 'Indicates whether the required quorum of DSMB/DMC members was present for the meeting to be valid per the committee charter (True = quorum met; False = quorum not met). Meetings without quorum may require rescheduling or written ratification.']
  recommendation varchar [note: 'The formal recommendation issued by the DSMB/DMC following the review. Continue = proceed without changes; Continue with modification = proceed with protocol or safety monitoring amendments; Suspend = temporary halt pending further review; Terminate =']

  regulatory_notification_date date [note: 'Date on which the regulatory authority was notified of the DSMB/DMC recommendation or safety findings. Populated only when regulatory_notification_required is True. Used for compliance with expedited reporting timelines.']
  regulatory_notification_due_date date [note: 'Deadline by which the regulatory authority must be notified per applicable regulations (e.g., 7-day or 15-day reporting window). Enables proactive compliance monitoring and escalation.']
  regulatory_notification_required boolean [note: 'Indicates whether the DSMB/DMC recommendation or safety findings from this review require expedited regulatory notification to health authorities (True = notification required; False = no notification required).']
  review_status varchar [note: 'Current lifecycle status of the DSMB/DMC review record. Scheduled = meeting planned but not yet held; In progress = meeting underway or deliberations ongoing; Completed = recommendation issued and documented; Cancelled = meeting cancelled; Postponed =']
  safety_signal_identified boolean [note: 'Indicates whether the DSMB/DMC identified a new or emerging safety signal during this review that requires further investigation or monitoring (True = signal identified; False = no new signal).']
  sponsor_response varchar [note: 'The sponsor\'s formal response to the DSMB/DMC recommendation. Accepted = sponsor will implement as recommended; Accepted with modification = sponsor accepts intent but modifies implementation; Rejected = sponsor disagrees and provides counter-rationale']
  sponsor_response_rationale varchar [note: 'Narrative explanation of the sponsor\'s response to the DSMB/DMC recommendation, particularly required when the sponsor rejects or modifies the recommendation. Documents the sponsor\'s benefit-risk reasoning.']
  stopping_rule_description varchar [note: 'Description of the specific pre-specified stopping rule that was triggered, if applicable (e.g., \'Futility boundary crossed at IA2\', \'Excess SAE rate in treatment arm exceeds 15%\'). Populated only when stopping_rule_triggered is True.']

  study_phase_reviewed varchar [note: 'Clinical development phase of the study at the time of the DSMB/DMC review. Determines the regulatory framework and risk thresholds applicable to the safety assessment.']
  subjects_enrolled_count varchar [note: 'Total number of subjects enrolled in the study at the time of the DSMB/DMC data cutoff. Provides context for the safety data volume reviewed and is a key metric in the committee\'s benefit-risk assessment.']
  subjects_exposed_count varchar [note: 'Number of subjects who received at least one dose of investigational product at the time of the data cutoff. Used for exposure-adjusted safety rate calculations in the DSMB/DMC review.']
  unblinded_statistician_present boolean [note: 'Indicates whether the independent unblinded statistician was present at the DSMB/DMC meeting to present the unblinded safety data package (True = present; False = not present). Required for valid closed-session deliberations.']
  updated_timestamp timestamp [note: 'Timestamp of the most recent update to this DSMB/DMC review record. Required for audit trail compliance under 21 CFR Part 11 and ALCOA+ data integrity principles.']

  Note: 'Master record for Data Safety Monitoring Board (DSMB) / Data Monitoring Committee (DMC) safety governance, covering both committee definition and individual review meetings.'
}

Table safety.dsmb_recommendation {
  dsmb_recommendation_id varchar [pk, note: 'Unique surrogate identifier for each formal DSMB/DMC recommendation record in the safety domain. Entity role: TRANSACTION_HEADER — represents a discrete formal recommendation event issued by the DSMB/DMC following a safety review meeting.']
  affected_treatment_arm_id varchar [note: 'Foreign key linking to randomization.treatment_arm. Business justification: DSMB stopping rules and arm-suspension recommendations target specific treatment arms.']
  dsmb_review_id varchar [note: 'Reference to the parent DSMB/DMC safety review meeting that generated this recommendation. A single review meeting may produce one or more recommendations.']
  interim_analysis_id varchar [note: 'Foreign key linking to biostatistics.dsmb_meeting. Business justification: A DSMB recommendation is a direct output of a specific DSMB meeting. Linking recommendation to meeting enables TMF completeness checks, minutes reconciliation, and traceability of']
  protocol_id varchar [note: 'Foreign key linking to study.protocol. Business justification: DSMB recommendations mandate protocol amendments (dsmb_recommendation.protocol_amendment_required flag). The recommendation must reference the protocol version it applies to.']
  sap_id varchar [note: 'Foreign key linking to biostatistics.sap. Business justification: DSMB recommendations frequently mandate SAP revisions (e.g., stopping rules, sample size re-estimation).']
  signal_evaluation_id varchar [note: 'Foreign key linking to safety.signal_evaluation. Business justification: dsmb_recommendation is issued following a DSMB review that may have evaluated a safety signal.']
  signal_id varchar [note: 'Reference to the specific safety signal or aggregate safety finding in the source system that prompted or informed this DSMB/DMC recommendation. Nullable when the recommendation arises from routine scheduled review rather than a specific signal.']
  study_id varchar [note: 'Reference to the clinical study for which this DSMB/DMC recommendation was issued. Links the recommendation to the study protocol and sponsor context.']
  tmf_document_id varchar [note: 'Document identifier in Veeva Vault eTMF for the official DSMB/DMC recommendation letter or minutes filed in the Trial Master File. Ensures regulatory-compliant document traceability per ICH E6(R2) Section 8.']
  affected_subject_population varchar [note: 'Description of the subject population subgroup to which this recommendation applies (e.g., all enrolled subjects, subjects in a specific age cohort, subjects with a particular comorbidity). Supports targeted safety actions.']
  argus_safety_case_number varchar [note: 'Case number assigned in the source system to the safety case or aggregate safety report associated with this DSMB/DMC recommendation. Enables traceability between the recommendation and the underlying pharmacovigilance case management record.']
  benefit_risk_summary varchar [note: 'Concise summary of the DSMB/DMC benefit-risk assessment that underpins the recommendation, capturing the committee\'s evaluation of the investigational product\'s benefit profile relative to observed safety risks at the time of review.']
  created_timestamp timestamp [note: 'System timestamp when this DSMB recommendation record was first captured in the data platform. Supports ALCOA+ data integrity requirements and audit trail compliance.']
  dissenting_opinion varchar [note: 'Narrative capturing any dissenting opinion(s) from DSMB/DMC members who did not agree with the majority recommendation. Documented for regulatory transparency and governance purposes when vote_outcome is \'split\' or \'majority\'.']
  follow_up_review_date date [note: 'Target date for the follow-up DSMB/DMC review meeting required to assess the outcome of actions taken in response to this recommendation. Populated when follow_up_review_required is True.']
  follow_up_review_required boolean [note: 'Indicates whether this recommendation requires a follow-up DSMB/DMC review meeting to assess implementation effectiveness or monitor evolving safety data. Drives scheduling of unscheduled interim reviews.']
  implementation_date date [note: 'Date on which the sponsor implemented the actions required by the DSMB/DMC recommendation (e.g., protocol amendment effective date, dose modification start date, study suspension date). Critical for regulatory compliance tracking.']
  implementation_deadline date [note: 'Regulatory or charter-mandated deadline by which the sponsor must implement the DSMB/DMC recommendation. Supports compliance monitoring and escalation workflows.']
  informed_consent_update_required boolean [note: 'Indicates whether this DSMB/DMC recommendation necessitates an update to the Informed Consent Form (ICF) to reflect new safety information. Triggers re-consent workflow in Clinpal eConsent system.']
  irb_iec_notification_date date [note: 'Date on which the IRB/IEC was formally notified of this DSMB/DMC recommendation. Required for audit trail and compliance verification against ICH E6(R2) and applicable regulations.']
  irb_iec_notification_required boolean [note: 'Indicates whether this DSMB/DMC recommendation requires notification to the Institutional Review Board (IRB) or Independent Ethics Committee (IEC) overseeing the study. Required for significant safety findings and protocol changes.']
  is_current_version boolean [note: 'Boolean flag indicating whether this record represents the current active version of the recommendation. Set to False for superseded or amended versions retained for audit trail purposes.']

  protocol_amendment_required boolean [note: 'Indicates whether this DSMB/DMC recommendation requires a formal protocol amendment to be submitted to regulatory authorities and IRB/IEC for approval before implementation.']
  rationale varchar [note: 'Detailed narrative explanation of the scientific, clinical, and safety evidence basis for the DSMB/DMC recommendation. Includes reference to interim efficacy data, safety data, benefit-risk assessment, and any stopping rules triggered.']
  recommendation_number varchar [note: 'Externally-known alphanumeric identifier assigned to this recommendation, typically formatted as a sequential reference within the study (e.g., REC-2024-001). Used for regulatory correspondence, sponsor communications, and TMF filing.']
  recommendation_status varchar [note: 'Current lifecycle state of the DSMB/DMC recommendation from initial issuance through sponsor acceptance or rejection and final closure. Drives workflow routing in the source system and the source system']
  recommendation_type varchar [note: 'Formal classification of the DSMB/DMC recommendation issued following the safety review. Drives sponsor response obligations and regulatory notification requirements.']
  recommendation_version varchar [note: 'Version number of this recommendation record, incremented when the recommendation is amended or superseded. Supports version control and audit trail requirements under 21 CFR Part 11 and ALCOA+ principles.']
  regulatory_agencies_notified varchar [note: 'Comma-separated list of health authority agencies notified of this recommendation (e.g., FDA, EMA, MHRA, PMDA, TGA, Health Canada). Supports multi-jurisdictional regulatory compliance tracking.']
  regulatory_notification_date date [note: 'Actual date on which the sponsor submitted the required regulatory notification to health authorities regarding this DSMB/DMC recommendation. Used to verify compliance with expedited reporting timelines.']
  regulatory_notification_deadline date [note: 'Regulatory deadline by which the sponsor must notify health authorities of this DSMB/DMC recommendation and any resulting study actions. Typically 7 or 15 calendar days depending on jurisdiction and recommendation type.']
  regulatory_notification_required boolean [note: 'Indicates whether this DSMB/DMC recommendation triggers a mandatory regulatory notification obligation to health authorities (e.g., FDA, EMA, MHRA). True for recommendations involving study suspension, early termination, or significant safety findings.']
  review_type varchar [note: 'Classification of the DSMB/DMC review that generated this recommendation, distinguishing between planned interim analyses, unscheduled safety reviews triggered by emerging signals, annual reviews, and final study reviews.']
  sponsor_response varchar [note: 'Formal response of the study sponsor to the DSMB/DMC recommendation, indicating whether the recommendation has been accepted, rejected, or partially accepted. Drives implementation and regulatory notification workflows.']
  sponsor_response_date date [note: 'Date on which the sponsor formally communicated their response (acceptance, rejection, or partial acceptance) to the DSMB/DMC recommendation. Used to calculate response timeliness against regulatory and charter obligations.']
  sponsor_response_rationale varchar [note: 'Narrative explanation provided by the sponsor for their response to the DSMB/DMC recommendation, particularly required when the recommendation is rejected or only partially accepted. Documented in the TMF.']
  stopping_rule_description varchar [note: 'Description of the specific pre-specified stopping rule that was triggered, including the boundary type (efficacy, futility, safety), the statistical threshold, and the observed test statistic or safety metric that crossed the boundary.']
  stopping_rule_triggered boolean [note: 'Indicates whether a pre-specified stopping rule defined in the Statistical Analysis Plan (the source system) or DSMB charter was formally triggered as the basis for this recommendation. True when a boundary (efficacy, futility, or safety) was crossed.']
  updated_timestamp timestamp [note: 'System timestamp of the most recent modification to this DSMB recommendation record. Required for change tracking, audit trail, and data lineage in the Silver Layer lakehouse.']
  vote_outcome varchar [note: 'Outcome of the DSMB/DMC committee vote that produced this recommendation, indicating whether the decision was unanimous, by majority, or resulted in a split vote. Relevant for regulatory transparency and committee governance documentation.']

  Note: 'Transactional record for formal DSMB/DMC recommendations issued following a safety review meeting. Captures recommendation type (continue unchanged, protocol amendment required, dose modification, study suspension, early termination), rationale, sponsor'
}
