  freeze_thaw_count varchar [note: 'Cumulative number of freeze-thaw cycles this aliquot has undergone. Exceeding the validated limit may compromise analyte integrity and render the aliquot unsuitable for testing.']
  max_freeze_thaw_allowed varchar [note: 'Validated maximum number of freeze-thaw cycles permitted for this aliquot type before analyte stability is compromised. Defined in the bioanalytical method validation plan.']
  position_code varchar [note: 'Alphanumeric position coordinate within the box (e.g., A1, B12, H08) identifying the exact slot where the aliquot is stored. Enables precise physical retrieval.']
  processing_datetime timestamp [note: 'Date and time the aliquot was separated from the parent specimen and prepared for storage or shipment. Critical for stability and pre-analytical variable tracking.']
  rack_code varchar [note: 'Identifier of the rack within the storage unit where this aliquot is placed. Part of the three-dimensional storage coordinate system (rack/box/position).']
  stability_expiry_date date [note: 'Date beyond which the aliquot is considered analytically unstable based on validated long-term stability data. Triggers discard or re-evaluation workflows.']
  storage_temperature_c decimal(6,2) [note: 'Nominal storage temperature in degrees Celsius for this aliquot (e.g., -80, -20, 4, 25). Used for stability monitoring and deviation assessment.']
  storage_unit_code varchar [note: 'Reference to the physical storage unit (freezer, refrigerator, liquid nitrogen tank) where this aliquot is currently placed. Supports biorepository location management.']
  storage_unit_type varchar [note: 'Classification of the storage unit housing this aliquot (e.g., -80°C freezer, -20°C freezer, refrigerator, liquid nitrogen vapor phase). Determines stability expectations.']
  temperature_excursion_flag boolean [note: 'Indicates whether this aliquot has experienced a documented temperature excursion outside the validated storage range. Triggers stability impact assessment.']
  updated_timestamp timestamp [note: 'Date and time when this aliquot record was last modified. Supports audit trail, change detection, and incremental data pipeline processing.']
  usubjid varchar [note: 'CDISC SDTM-compliant unique subject identifier (sponsor-subject-site concatenation). Required for regulatory submission datasets and cross-domain subject traceability.']
  volume_ml decimal(10,4) [note: 'Volume of the aliquot in millilitres at the time of processing. Used for sufficiency assessment and inventory management.']
  volume_sufficient_flag boolean [note: 'Indicates whether the remaining aliquot volume is sufficient to complete the assigned assay or testing requirement. Drives re-collection or backup aliquot retrieval workflows.']
  volume_unit varchar [note: 'Unit of measure for the aliquot volume. Typically mL for liquid specimens; mg or g for tissue aliquots.']

  Note: 'Master record for aliquots derived from a primary specimen for distribution to multiple testing labs or long-term storage, including storage placement tracking.'
}

Table laboratory.protocol_lab_schedule {
  protocol_lab_schedule_id varchar [pk, note: 'Unique surrogate identifier for each protocol-mandated laboratory assessment schedule record in the Databricks Silver Layer. Primary key for this entity.']
  arm_id varchar [note: 'Foreign key linking to study.arm. Business justification: Protocol lab schedules are frequently arm-specific in multi-arm studies (e.g., PK panels only in treatment arm, different safety panels per dose level).']
  clinical_trial_authorization_id varchar [note: 'Foreign key linking to regulatory.clinical_trial_authorization. Business justification: EU CTAs explicitly authorize the assessment schedule including lab assessments per visit.']
  compliance_sop_id varchar [note: 'Foreign key linking to compliance.compliance_sop. Business justification: Protocol lab schedules define GCP-required assessments; their implementation must comply with SOPs governing collection windows, fasting requirements, and result turnaround.']
  epoch_id varchar [note: 'Foreign key linking to study.study_epoch. Business justification: Lab schedules are organized by study epoch (screening, treatment, follow-up); linking to epoch enables epoch-level lab requirement reporting, SDTM TE domain mapping, and protocol schedule']
  lab_facility_id varchar [note: 'Foreign key linking to laboratory.lab_facility. Business justification: A protocol lab schedule entry designates whether central or local lab is required (central_lab_required, local_lab_allowed flags exist).']
  lab_panel_id varchar [note: 'Reference to the laboratory panel (e.g., hematology, chemistry, urinalysis, PK/PD, DMPK) required or optionally collected at this visit per the protocol schedule.']
  protocol_id varchar [note: 'Foreign key linking to study.protocol. Business justification: Protocol lab schedules are defined per protocol version; regulatory submissions and protocol compliance audits require tracing which lab panels were mandated by which protocol version.']
  regulatory_protocol_amendment_id varchar [note: 'Foreign key linking to regulatory.protocol_amendment. Business justification: Protocol amendments frequently change lab assessment schedules (adding/removing panels, changing timepoints).']
  study_id varchar [note: 'Reference to the clinical study for which this laboratory assessment schedule is defined. Links to the master study record.']
  treatment_arm_id varchar [note: 'Foreign key linking to randomization.treatment_arm. Business justification: Protocol lab schedules are arm-specific in clinical trials — different treatment arms require different panels, collection windows, and processing requirements.']
  backup_sample_required boolean [note: 'Indicates whether a backup or reserve aliquot must be collected and stored alongside the primary specimen for potential future analysis (e.g., for biomarker or pharmacogenomics research).']
  central_lab_required boolean [note: 'Indicates whether this laboratory assessment must be performed at the central laboratory (as opposed to a local laboratory). Drives specimen shipment logistics and result routing.']
  collection_time_constraint varchar [note: 'Time-of-day or dose-relative constraint for specimen collection at this visit (e.g., pre-dose, post-dose, morning only, timed serial PK sampling). Critical for PK/PD and DMPK assessments.']
  collection_time_offset_hours decimal(6,2) [note: 'Nominal time offset in hours relative to dose administration for post-dose or timed serial specimen collection (e.g., 0.5, 1, 2, 4, 8, 24 hours post-dose). Applicable primarily to PK/PD and DMPK assessments.']
  collection_time_window_minutes varchar [note: 'Acceptable deviation window in minutes around the nominal collection time offset for timed specimen collection. Used to assess protocol deviations for PK/PD sampling.']
  collection_tube_type varchar [note: 'Type of collection tube or container required for specimen collection (e.g., EDTA, SST, lithium heparin, sodium citrate, PAXgene). Drives specimen collection kit configuration and laboratory processing instructions.']
  created_timestamp timestamp [note: 'Timestamp when this protocol laboratory schedule record was first created in the system. Supports audit trail requirements under 21 CFR Part 11 and ICH E6(R2) GCP.']
  critical_result_review_required boolean [note: 'Indicates whether results from this laboratory assessment require expedited medical review upon receipt of a critical or panic value. Triggers safety review workflows and potential SAE/SUSAR reporting obligations.']
  edc_form_name varchar [note: 'Name of the eCRF form in Medidata Rave that corresponds to this laboratory assessment at this visit. Used to drive EDC study build configuration and eCRF lab page activation.']
  effective_date date [note: 'Date from which this laboratory schedule entry is effective, typically aligned with the protocol version approval date or protocol amendment effective date.']
  fasting_duration_hours_min decimal(4,1) [note: 'Minimum number of hours the subject must fast prior to specimen collection when fasting is required. Null when fasting_required is false.']
  fasting_required boolean [note: 'Indicates whether the subject must be in a fasted state prior to specimen collection for this laboratory assessment at this visit. Drives subject instructions and site collection procedures.']
  is_exploratory boolean [note: 'Indicates whether this laboratory assessment is an exploratory or research-use-only endpoint not included in the primary or secondary efficacy analyses. Supports data management and the source system']
  is_pd_assessment boolean [note: 'Indicates whether this laboratory assessment is a pharmacodynamic (PD) biomarker collection. Supports differentiation of PD endpoints from standard safety laboratory panels.']
  is_pk_assessment boolean [note: 'Indicates whether this laboratory assessment is a pharmacokinetic (PK) or DMPK sample collection. When true, timed serial collection rules and PK-specific processing instructions apply.']
  is_safety_assessment boolean [note: 'Indicates whether this laboratory assessment is designated as a safety laboratory panel per the protocol. Safety assessments trigger critical value review workflows and DSMB/DMC reporting obligations.']
  local_lab_allowed boolean [note: 'Indicates whether results from a local (site) laboratory are acceptable for this assessment, either as a primary result or as a backup when central lab results are unavailable.']
  panel_requirement varchar [note: 'Indicates whether the laboratory panel is mandatory (required), optional, conditional on a clinical trigger, restricted to the PK cohort, or applicable only to a defined subject subset per the protocol schedule of assessments.']
  processing_required boolean [note: 'Indicates whether the specimen requires on-site processing (e.g., centrifugation, aliquoting) prior to shipment to the central laboratory. Drives site laboratory capability requirements.']
  repeat_allowed boolean [note: 'Indicates whether a repeat specimen collection is permitted at this visit if the initial sample is insufficient, haemolysed, or otherwise unacceptable. Drives site instructions and EDC query management.']
  result_turnaround_days varchar [note: 'Expected number of calendar days from specimen receipt at the laboratory to result reporting. Used for monitoring visit planning, data management timelines, and SLA tracking with the central laboratory.']
  schedule_notes varchar [note: 'Free-text notes or footnotes from the protocol schedule of assessments providing additional instructions, conditional collection rules, or clarifications for this laboratory assessment at this visit.']
  schedule_status varchar [note: 'Current lifecycle status of this protocol laboratory schedule entry. Reflects whether the schedule is in draft, active per the current protocol version, amended, superseded by a protocol amendment, or retired.']
  sdtm_domain varchar [note: 'Target SDTM domain; implements SDTM Dataset.DOMAIN']
  shipment_frequency varchar [note: 'Frequency at which specimens collected at this visit should be shipped to the central laboratory (e.g., immediate same-day shipment for PK samples, weekly batch shipment for routine safety labs).']
  source_system_record_code varchar [note: 'Native identifier of this laboratory schedule record in the originating operational system (e.g., the source system assessment ID, Medidata Rave form OID). Supports data lineage, reconciliation, and audit traceability in the Silver Layer.']
  specimen_type varchar [note: 'Type of biological specimen required for this laboratory panel at this visit (e.g., blood, urine, plasma, serum, CSF). Drives specimen collection kit configuration and chain of custody planning.']
  specimen_volume_ml decimal(8,3) [note: 'Volume of biological specimen in millilitres required for this laboratory panel assessment. Used for specimen collection planning, blood volume burden calculations, and supply chain management.']
  storage_temperature varchar [note: 'Required storage temperature condition for the specimen prior to shipment or analysis (e.g., ambient, refrigerated 2-8°C, frozen -20°C, frozen -80°C, liquid nitrogen). Drives cold chain logistics and supply chain management.']
  study_day_target varchar [note: 'The nominal study day on which this visit and laboratory assessment is scheduled relative to the reference start date (Day 1 = first dose). Negative values indicate pre-dose screening days. Aligns with CDISC SDTM study day conventions.']
  subject_population varchar [note: 'Defines which subject population is required to undergo this laboratory assessment at the specified visit. Supports PK cohort-specific sampling, sentinel cohort rules, and expansion cohort differentiation as defined in the protocol.']
  superseded_date date [note: 'Date on which this laboratory schedule entry was superseded by a protocol amendment or replaced by a new schedule version. Null for currently active entries.']
  updated_timestamp timestamp [note: 'Timestamp when this protocol laboratory schedule record was last modified. Supports change tracking, audit trail requirements, and Silver Layer incremental load processing.']
  visit_name varchar [note: 'Visit name; implements SDTM --VISIT']
  visit_num decimal(6,1) [note: 'Visit number; implements SDTM --VISITNUM']
  visit_type varchar [note: 'Visit type; implements SDTM TV/SV visit metadata (CDISC CT visit-type codelist)']
  visit_window_day_max varchar [note: 'Latest allowable study day (relative to target study day) for the visit window, defining the acceptable upper bound for specimen collection. Used for protocol deviation assessment and site monitoring.']
  visit_window_day_min varchar [note: 'Earliest allowable study day (relative to target study day) for the visit window, defining the acceptable lower bound for specimen collection. Used for protocol deviation assessment and site monitoring.']

  Note: 'Master definition of the protocol-mandated laboratory assessment schedule for a study, mapping each study visit to required lab panels. Captures study ID, visit name/number, visit window (day range), required lab panels, optional panels, fasting'
}

  impd_version varchar [note: 'Version identifier of the IMPD or IND module that governs the current specifications for this IMP. Ensures traceability between the product master record and the regulatory submission version in effect. Supports inspection readiness and TMF completeness.']

  is_cold_chain boolean [note: 'Indicates whether the IMP requires cold-chain logistics (temperature-controlled storage and transport, typically 2–8°C or below). Drives cold-chain packaging selection, qualified shipper requirements, and temperature monitoring obligations.']

  label_language_code varchar [note: 'ISO 639-1 language code (optionally with ISO 3166-1 country subtag) for the primary language of the kit label text (e.g., \'en\', \'fr\', \'de\', \'ja\'). Required for multi-country studies with country-specific labeling.']

  manufacturing_site_code varchar [note: 'The code identifying the manufacturing or packaging site responsible for producing physical kits from this definition. Used for supply chain traceability and GMP compliance.']
  max_storage_temp_c decimal(5,2) [note: 'Maximum acceptable storage temperature in degrees Celsius for kits of this definition. Used for cold-chain monitoring alerts and excursion detection.']
  min_storage_temp_c decimal(5,2) [note: 'Minimum acceptable storage temperature in degrees Celsius for kits of this definition. Used for cold-chain monitoring alerts and excursion detection.']
  modified_timestamp timestamp [note: 'The date and time when this kit definition record was last modified. Supports ALCOA+ audit trail requirements and change tracking for regulatory inspection readiness.']
  pack_size varchar [note: 'The number of individual dosage units (e.g., tablets, capsules, vials) contained in one physical kit of this definition. Used for supply planning, dispensing calculations, and accountability reconciliation.']
  pack_size_unit varchar [note: 'The unit descriptor for the pack size count (e.g., tablet, capsule, vial). Clarifies what each unit in the pack_size count represents. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: tablet|capsule|vial|ampoule|syringe|patch|sachet|bottle — 8 candidates stripped; promote to']
  randomization_scheme varchar [note: 'The randomization methodology applied to kits of this definition type within the RTSM. Determines how kits are allocated to subjects during enrollment and randomization events.']
  retest_period_days varchar [note: 'Number of days from manufacture after which kits of this definition must be retested before continued use. Applicable for IMP components with defined retest periods rather than fixed expiry dates.']
  return_required boolean [note: 'Indicates whether used or unused kits of this definition must be returned to the depot or sponsor for accountability reconciliation and destruction. Drives returns logistics workflows.']
  rtsm_kit_type_code varchar [note: 'The internal kit type code as configured in the Medidata Rave RTSM system. Used for system-to-system integration and reconciliation between the RTSM and downstream data systems.']
  shelf_life_days varchar [note: 'The approved shelf life duration in days for kits manufactured from this definition, measured from the date of manufacture. Used to calculate expiry dates on physical kit instances and to trigger re-supply or destruction workflows.']
  storage_condition varchar [note: 'Required storage condition for kits of this definition type. Drives cold-chain logistics planning, depot storage allocation, and site storage compliance monitoring.']
  version_number varchar [note: 'Version number of this kit definition (e.g., \'1.0\', \'2.1\'). Incremented when the kit definition is amended due to protocol changes, labeling updates, or manufacturing changes. Supports audit trail and regulatory traceability.']
  visit_type varchar [note: 'The type of study visit at which this kit definition is intended to be dispensed (e.g., baseline, treatment, follow-up, unscheduled). Drives RTSM dispensing schedule configuration.']

  Note: 'Defines randomization kit configurations used in RTSM (Medidata Rave). Captures kit type, treatment arm association, blinding level, component IMPs, pack size, label text, kit number range, and applicable study/protocol version.'
}

Table supply.kit_inventory {

  kit_number varchar [note: 'Externally-known unique alphanumeric identifier assigned to the physical randomization kit by the RTSM (Medidata Rave). This is the primary business identifier used in drug accountability logs, dispensing records, and regulatory submissions.']
  kit_status varchar [note: 'Current lifecycle status of the kit within the supply chain. \'available\' = at depot or site, ready for assignment; \'assigned\' = allocated to a subject via RTSM but not yet dispensed; \'dispensed\' = physically given to subject; \'expired\' = past expiry date']
  label_version varchar [note: 'The version identifier of the IMP label applied to this kit. Used to verify that the correct, IRB/IEC-approved label version was used at the time of dispensing and for regulatory label reconciliation.']
  manufacture_date date [note: 'Date on which the investigational medicinal product in this kit was manufactured. Used for shelf-life calculation, batch traceability, and regulatory accountability.']
  protocol_version varchar [note: 'The version of the study protocol under which this kit was dispensed or assigned. Ensures that kit dispensing is traceable to the correct protocol amendment for regulatory compliance.']
  randomization_number varchar [note: 'The unique randomization number assigned to the subject-kit pairing by the RTSM (IRT/IVRS) at the point of subject randomization. Links the kit to the randomization schedule for unblinding and accountability.']
  retest_date date [note: 'Date by which the kit must be retested or re-evaluated for continued use, particularly for products with conditional shelf-life extensions. Distinct from expiry_date; used for stability management.']
  returned_quantity varchar [note: 'The number of dosage units returned by the subject or site for this kit. Used in drug accountability reconciliation to calculate compliance and account for unused medication.']
  returned_timestamp timestamp [note: 'The date and time at which the kit was returned by the subject or site to the depot or destruction facility. Part of the chain-of-custody audit trail for drug accountability.']
  rtsm_kit_code varchar [note: 'The source system identifier for this kit record as assigned by the RTSM module in Medidata Rave. Used for data lineage, reconciliation between the Silver Layer and the operational RTSM system, and audit trail traceability.']
  site_receipt_timestamp timestamp [note: 'The date and time at which the kit was received and confirmed at the investigational site. Marks the transfer of custody from depot/logistics to site. Used for site inventory reconciliation.']
  storage_condition varchar [note: 'Required storage condition for this kit as specified on the label and protocol. Drives warehouse and site storage assignment, cold-chain logistics, and temperature excursion monitoring.']
  temperature_excursion_flag boolean [note: 'Indicates whether a temperature excursion event has been recorded for this kit during storage or transit. When True, the kit must be quarantined and assessed by QA before dispensing.']
  updated_timestamp timestamp [note: 'The date and time at which this kit inventory record was last modified. Supports audit trail requirements and change tracking under 21 CFR Part 11 and ALCOA+ principles.']

  Note: 'Tracks physical randomization kit instances across the supply chain — from manufacture through depot receipt, site shipment, dispensing, and destruction. Each record represents a unique kit number with current status (available, assigned, dispensed'
}

Table supply.depot {

  Note: 'Master record for clinical supply depots (central and regional warehouses) that store and distribute IMPs. Captures depot name, geographic location, GMP certification status, temperature-controlled storage capabilities (ambient, refrigerated, frozen)'

  reorder_point varchar [note: 'Minimum quantity threshold at which a resupply request should be triggered for this IMP or kit type at this location. When qty_on_hand falls at or below this value, the RTSM or supply planner initiates a replenishment shipment.']

  resupply_triggered boolean [note: 'Indicates whether an active resupply request has been triggered for this inventory position. Set to True when qty_on_hand falls at or below the reorder_point and a resupply order has been initiated in the RTSM or supply management system.']
  retest_date date [note: 'Date by which the IMP batch must be retested to confirm continued stability and suitability for use. Applicable for products with defined retest periods rather than fixed expiry dates. Triggers stability testing workflows.']
  rtsm_location_code varchar [note: 'The location identifier assigned to this site or depot within the RTSM system (Medidata Rave). Used to reconcile inventory records between the lakehouse silver layer and the operational RTSM source system.']
  storage_condition varchar [note: 'Required storage condition for the IMP or kit at this location, as specified in the Investigational Medicinal Product Dossier (IMPD) or protocol. Drives cold-chain logistics planning and compliance monitoring.']
  storage_condition_compliant boolean [note: 'Indicates whether the current storage conditions at this location are compliant with the required storage condition specification for this IMP or kit type.']
  temperature_excursion_count varchar [note: 'Cumulative number of recorded temperature excursion events for this inventory position at this location. Used to assess cold-chain compliance history and inform quarantine or destruction decisions.']

  Note: 'Tracks IMP and kit stock positions at supply chain nodes (investigational sites and depots). Each record represents current inventory levels by IMP/kit type at a specific location, including quantity on-hand, received, dispensed, allocated, quarantined'
}

Table supply.supply_plan {
  supply_plan_id varchar [pk, note: 'Unique surrogate identifier for the investigational medicinal product (IMP) supply plan record within the clinical trial supply chain management system.']
  application_id varchar [note: 'Foreign key linking to regulatory.application. Business justification: Supply plans are built around a specific investigational compound\'s development phase, enrollment projections, and manufacturing requirements.']
  clinical_trial_authorization_id varchar [note: 'Foreign key linking to regulatory.clinical_trial_authorization. Business justification: Supply plans are scoped to specific CTAs per country/region — IMP can only be supplied where a valid CTA exists.']
  dosing_regimen_id varchar [note: 'Foreign key linking to study.dosing_regimen. Business justification: Supply quantity forecasting is directly calculated from the dosing regimen (dose frequency, treatment duration, number of subjects per arm).']
  imp_master_id varchar [note: 'Reference to the investigational medicinal product (IMP) being planned, linking to the product master record that defines formulation, dosage form, and strength.']
  ind_application_id varchar [note: 'Foreign key linking to regulatory.ind_application. Business justification: Supply plans are scoped to an IND — the IND defines the protocol coverage, phase, and product authorization that drives manufacturing quantity planning.']
  interim_analysis_id varchar [note: 'Foreign key linking to biostatistics.interim_analysis. Business justification: In adaptive trials, interim analysis outcomes (sample size re-estimation, early stopping) directly trigger supply plan revisions.']
  investigational_product_id varchar [note: 'Foreign key linking to study.investigational_product. Business justification: Supply plans are built for a specific investigational product as defined in the study protocol (IND/IMPD reference, storage conditions, shelf life).']
  protocol_id varchar [note: 'Foreign key linking to study.protocol. Business justification: Supply plans are built against a specific protocol version — planned enrollment, dosing regimen, number of arms, and visit frequency all derive from the protocol.']
  rand_list_id varchar [note: 'Foreign key linking to randomization.rand_list. Business justification: Supply plans are built against a specific randomization list version; when a new rand_list is activated (e.g., post-amendment), the supply plan must reference that version for']
  rand_scheme_id varchar [note: 'Foreign key linking to randomization.rand_scheme. Business justification: Supply planning is directly driven by the randomization scheme — allocation ratios, treatment arm counts, block sizes, and stratification factors determine IMP quantities and']
  regulatory_binder_id varchar [note: 'Foreign key linking to document.regulatory_binder. Business justification: Supply plans are submitted as part of IND/CTA regulatory packages. Linking supply_plan to regulatory_binder enables tracking of which regulatory submission package contains the']
  risk_assessment_id varchar [note: 'Foreign key linking to compliance.risk_assessment. Business justification: Supply plans for clinical trials require a formal risk assessment (supply shortage risk, cold chain risk, expiry risk).']
  sample_size_calc_id varchar [note: 'Foreign key linking to biostatistics.sample_size_calc. Business justification: Supply plan quantities (forecasted_enrollment, dropout_rate_pct, total_units_planned) are derived directly from the approved sample size calculation.']
  study_id varchar [note: 'Reference to the clinical study for which this supply plan is created. Links the supply plan to the study protocol, enrollment projections, and dosing regimen.']
  tmf_document_id varchar [note: 'Foreign key linking to document.tmf_document. Business justification: Supply plans are essential TMF documents filed under DIA TMF Reference Model Section 11 (IP Management).']
  accountability_reconciliation_required boolean [note: 'Indicates whether drug accountability reconciliation is required under this supply plan, as mandated by GCP and regulatory requirements. Drives reconciliation workflow in RTSM and site monitoring activities.']
  approval_date date [note: 'Date on which the supply plan was formally approved by the sponsor supply team and/or CRO supply chain lead. Null if plan has not yet been approved.']
  blinding_type varchar [note: 'Blinding configuration of the study as it affects supply planning. Double-blind studies require matched placebo kits; open-label studies have simpler kit structures. Impacts kit design and labeling requirements.']
  buffer_stock_weeks decimal(5,1) [note: 'Target buffer stock expressed in weeks of supply to be maintained at depot and/or site level. Ensures continuity of supply during manufacturing lead times and logistics delays.']
  cold_chain_required boolean [note: 'Indicates whether the IMP requires cold-chain logistics (temperature-controlled storage and transport) throughout the supply chain. Drives depot selection, packaging specifications, and logistics provider requirements.']
  created_timestamp timestamp [note: 'Timestamp when this supply plan record was first created in the system, in ISO 8601 format (yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX). Supports audit trail and ALCOA+ compliance.']
  destruction_plan_included boolean [note: 'Indicates whether this supply plan version includes a returns and destruction plan for expired, unused, or damaged IMP. Required for GMP compliance and accountability reconciliation.']
  dropout_rate_pct decimal(5,2) [note: 'Assumed subject dropout/discontinuation rate (as a percentage) applied in demand forecasting calculations. Accounts for subjects who withdraw consent, are lost to follow-up, or are discontinued per protocol.']
  expiry_management_strategy varchar [note: 'Strategy applied for managing IMP expiry at depot and site level. FIFO (First In First Out), FEFO (First Expired First Out), manual review, or RTSM-managed automated expiry tracking.']
  forecasted_enrollment varchar [note: 'Total number of subjects projected to be enrolled over the planning horizon, derived from enrollment projections and site feasibility assessments. Primary driver of IMP demand forecasting.']
  geographic_scope varchar [note: 'Description of the geographic coverage of this supply plan, specifying countries or regions included (e.g., USA, GBR, DEU). Drives country-level demand forecasting and depot assignment.']
  horizon_end_date date [note: 'End date of the planning horizon covered by this supply plan. Typically extends to study completion or database lock (DBL) plus a buffer for returns and destruction.']
  horizon_start_date date [note: 'Start date of the planning horizon covered by this supply plan. Defines the beginning of the forecasted demand and manufacturing schedule window.']
  notes varchar [note: 'Free-text field for supply chain planners to document assumptions, constraints, protocol amendment impacts, or sponsor-specific instructions relevant to this supply plan version.']
  overage_pct decimal(5,2) [note: 'Planned overage percentage applied on top of net demand to account for wastage, damaged kits, protocol amendments, and supply chain uncertainties. Agreed with sponsor and documented in the supply agreement.']
  plan_date date [note: 'The principal business date on which this supply plan was formally prepared or issued. Represents the real-world event date distinct from system audit timestamps.']
  plan_number varchar [note: 'Externally-known, human-readable unique identifier for the supply plan, typically formatted as SP-{StudyCode}-{Year}-{Sequence}. Used in sponsor communications, RTSM configuration, and regulatory documentation.']
  planned_manufacturing_batches varchar [note: 'Total number of manufacturing batches planned to fulfill the forecasted IMP demand over the planning horizon, including buffer and overage quantities.']
  planning_cycle varchar [note: 'Frequency or trigger basis for this supply plan update cycle. Typically monthly or per enrollment milestone as defined in the supply agreement with the sponsor.']
  randomization_method varchar [note: 'Randomization methodology used in the RTSM for kit assignment to subjects. Drives kit numbering, stratification factors, and supply allocation logic within Medidata Rave RTSM.']
  resupply_quantity varchar [note: 'Standard quantity of kits or units to be shipped per resupply order when the resupply trigger threshold is reached. Defined per site tier and country in the supply plan.']
  resupply_trigger_threshold varchar [note: 'Minimum kit or unit quantity at depot or site level that triggers an automatic resupply order via RTSM (Interactive Response Technology). When inventory falls to or below this threshold, a resupply shipment is initiated.']
  rtsm_plan_code varchar [note: 'Identifier of the corresponding supply plan configuration record within the Medidata Rave RTSM system. Enables traceability between the lakehouse supply plan record and the operational RTSM configuration.']
  shelf_life_months varchar [note: 'Approved shelf life of the IMP in months from date of manufacture, as defined in the product specification and stability data. Critical for expiry management and resupply timing calculations.']
  site_tier_scope varchar [note: 'Site tier classification covered by this supply plan. Allows differentiated supply planning for high-enrolling versus low-enrolling sites, supporting optimized kit allocation and resupply strategies.']
  storage_temperature_max_c decimal(5,1) [note: 'Maximum acceptable storage temperature in degrees Celsius for the IMP as specified in the product dossier. Defines upper bound for cold-chain and ambient storage qualification.']
  storage_temperature_min_c decimal(5,1) [note: 'Minimum acceptable storage temperature in degrees Celsius for the IMP as specified in the product dossier. Used to define cold-chain logistics requirements and depot qualification criteria.']
  supply_plan_status varchar [note: 'Current lifecycle status of the supply plan. Draft indicates initial creation; under_review indicates sponsor/CRO review; approved indicates sign-off; active indicates currently governing supply operations; superseded indicates replaced by a newer']
  total_units_planned varchar [note: 'Total number of IMP units (e.g., tablets, vials, kits) planned for manufacture and distribution over the planning horizon, inclusive of overage and buffer stock.']
  treatment_arms_count varchar [note: 'Number of treatment arms (including placebo/comparator) in the study protocol that require separate IMP supply planning. Drives kit type differentiation in RTSM randomization configuration.']
  unit_of_measure varchar [note: 'The unit in which IMP supply quantities are expressed and tracked throughout the supply plan (e.g., kit, vial, tablet). Aligns with RTSM kit configuration and dispensing records.']
  updated_timestamp timestamp [note: 'Timestamp of the most recent modification to this supply plan record, in ISO 8601 format (yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX). Updated on every planning cycle revision or status change.']
  version varchar [note: 'Version identifier of the supply plan (e.g., v1.0, v2.3), incremented at each planning cycle or upon significant enrollment milestone updates. Supports version history and audit trail.']

  Note: 'Clinical supply plan - distinct concept, separate owner from monitoring_plan and program_plan.'
}

Table supply.manufacture_batch {
  manufacture_batch_id varchar [pk, note: 'Unique surrogate identifier for the IMP manufacturing batch record in the clinical supply chain. Primary key for all downstream kit, inventory, and accountability traceability.']
  approval_id varchar [note: 'Foreign key linking to regulatory.approval. Business justification: Batch release decisions require traceability to the regulatory approval authorizing the product.']
  capa_id varchar [note: 'Foreign key linking to compliance.compliance_capa. Business justification: CAPAs are frequently initiated against specific manufacture batches (batch release failure, GMP deviation on a specific batch). manufacture_batch has no compliance_capa_id.']
  clinical_trial_authorization_id varchar [note: 'Foreign key linking to regulatory.clinical_trial_authorization. Business justification: In EU/non-US jurisdictions, CTAs govern batch release and authorized use of IMP.']
  imp_master_id varchar [note: 'Foreign key linking to supply.imp_master. Business justification: Each manufacturing batch produces a specific IMP. manufacture_batch.imp_name and imp_code are denormalized from imp_master.product_name and product_code.']
  ind_application_id varchar [note: 'Foreign key linking to regulatory.ind_application. Business justification: IND applications govern which batches can be manufactured and used in US clinical trials.']
  investigational_product_id varchar [note: 'Foreign key linking to study.investigational_product. Business justification: Regulatory batch release and GMP compliance require traceability from each manufactured batch to the protocol-registered investigational product.']
  rand_scheme_id varchar [note: 'Foreign key linking to randomization.rand_scheme. Business justification: Batch release QA documentation must reference the randomization scheme to confirm blinding compliance and correct active/placebo/comparator quantities.']
  regulatory_binder_id varchar [note: 'Foreign key linking to document.regulatory_binder. Business justification: Batch records and CoAs are submitted as part of IND/CTA regulatory submissions. manufacture_batch has ind_number and cta_reference as plain text.']
  study_id varchar [note: 'Foreign key to the study this record belongs to.']
  supply_plan_id varchar [note: 'Foreign key linking to supply.supply_plan. Business justification: Manufacturing batches are produced in accordance with a clinical supply plan. supply_plan has planned_manufacturing_batches count, indicating it governs batch production.']
  tmf_document_id varchar [note: 'Foreign key linking to document.tmf_document. Business justification: Batch release documents (Certificate of Analysis, GMP release certificates) are essential TMF documents per ICH E6 R2 Section 8.']

  batch_number varchar [note: 'Externally-known alphanumeric batch/lot number assigned by the manufacturing site, as printed on the IMP label and referenced in the Certificate of Analysis (CoA).']
  batch_size varchar [note: 'Total number of units (e.g., tablets, vials, kits) manufactured in this batch. Used for supply planning, yield calculations, and accountability reconciliation against dispensed and returned quantities.']
  batch_size_unit varchar [note: 'Unit of measure for the batch size quantity (e.g., units, vials, tablets, kits). Required for unambiguous interpretation of batch_size in supply planning and accountability reports.']

  created_timestamp timestamp [note: 'Timestamp when this manufacture batch record was first created in the system, in ISO 8601 format (yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX). Supports ALCOA+ audit trail requirements and data lineage tracking.']
  cta_reference varchar [note: 'Clinical Trial Authorisation (CTA) reference number issued by the relevant national competent authority (e.g., EMA, MHRA) under which this IMP batch is authorised for use in the clinical trial.']
  destroyed_quantity varchar [note: 'Total number of units from this batch that have been confirmed destroyed, including rejected units, expired returns, and reconciliation destructions. Required for GMP accountability reconciliation and regulatory reporting.']
  destruction_certificate_ref varchar [note: 'Reference number of the destruction certificate issued upon confirmed destruction of batch units. Required for GMP accountability reconciliation and regulatory audit trail. Links to document management system (Veeva Vault).']
  dosage_form varchar [note: 'Pharmaceutical dosage form of the IMP in this batch (e.g., tablet, capsule, injection). Determines storage, handling, and dispensing requirements at clinical sites.']
  expiry_date date [note: 'The date after which the IMP batch must not be used, as determined by stability studies and printed on the IMP label. Critical for expiry management, site recall, and RTSM kit assignment logic to prevent dispensing of expired product.']
  gmp_certificate_number varchar [note: 'Reference number of the GMP manufacturing authorisation or certificate issued by the relevant regulatory authority for the manufacturing site. Confirms the site is authorised to manufacture IMPs for clinical trials.']
  is_comparator boolean [note: 'Indicates whether this batch is a comparator (active control or placebo) product rather than the investigational drug. True = comparator/placebo; False = investigational drug. Used for supply planning, kit assembly, and RTSM randomization configuration.']
  is_placebo boolean [note: 'Indicates whether this batch contains placebo (no active ingredient). True = placebo batch; False = active drug batch. Distinct from is_comparator as a batch may be a comparator active drug. Used for blinded supply management and kit labelling.']
  manufacture_date date [note: 'The date on which manufacturing of this IMP batch was completed, as recorded in the batch manufacturing record. Used as the reference point for shelf-life and expiry date calculation.']
  manufacturing_site_country varchar [note: 'ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 country code of the country where the manufacturing site is located. Used for import/export regulatory compliance and supply chain risk assessment.']
  manufacturing_site_name varchar [note: 'Name of the GMP-certified facility where this IMP batch was manufactured. Used for regulatory traceability, site audit trails, and supply chain accountability.']
  packaging_configuration varchar [note: 'Description of the primary and secondary packaging configuration for this batch (e.g., \'30-count HDPE bottle\', \'10-pack blister card\', \'1 mL pre-filled syringe\'). Used for kit assembly planning and site dispensing instructions.']
  quarantine_quantity varchar [note: 'Number of units from this batch currently held in quarantine pending QP release or investigation. Tracked separately from available quantity for GMP accountability.']
  recall_date date [note: 'Date on which the recall of this batch was initiated. Populated only when recall_flag is True. Used for regulatory reporting timelines and site notification tracking.']
  recall_flag boolean [note: 'Indicates whether this batch has been subject to a product recall. True = batch recalled; False = no recall. Triggers urgent site notification, return logistics, and regulatory reporting obligations.']
  release_date date [note: 'Date on which the Qualified Person (QP) or authorized release authority formally released this batch for clinical use. Marks the transition from quarantine to released status and triggers downstream supply chain activities.']
  release_status varchar [note: 'Current GMP release status of the batch as determined by the Qualified Person (QP) or authorized release authority. Controls whether the batch may be shipped to depots or dispensed to subjects.']
  retest_date date [note: 'Date by which the batch must be retested to confirm continued compliance with specifications before further use. Applicable for APIs and some drug products where retest rather than expiry dating is used.']
  shelf_life_months varchar [note: 'Approved shelf life of the IMP batch in months, as determined by stability data and declared in the product specification. Used to calculate and validate the expiry date relative to the manufacture date.']
  source_system_batch_key varchar [note: 'Native batch record identifier from the originating source system (e.g., Medidata Rave RTSM batch record ID, sponsor ERP batch key from the source system for data lineage, reconciliation, and ETL traceability between the lakehouse silver layer and']
  sponsor_batch_reference varchar [note: 'Sponsor-assigned reference number for this batch as provided in the sponsor batch release documentation. May differ from the manufacturing site batch number. Used for sponsor reconciliation and regulatory submissions.']
  stability_study_reference varchar [note: 'Reference identifier for the ICH stability study protocol under which this batch is enrolled for ongoing stability monitoring. Used to track shelf-life extensions and expiry date updates.']
  storage_condition varchar [note: 'Required storage condition for this IMP batch as specified in the product dossier and CoA. Drives cold-chain logistics planning, depot and site storage requirements, and temperature excursion monitoring.']
  storage_temp_max_c decimal(5,2) [note: 'Maximum acceptable storage temperature in degrees Celsius for this IMP batch, as specified in the product specification. Used for cold-chain monitoring, temperature excursion assessment, and depot/site compliance verification.']
  storage_temp_min_c decimal(5,2) [note: 'Minimum acceptable storage temperature in degrees Celsius for this IMP batch, as specified in the product specification. Used for cold-chain monitoring, temperature excursion assessment, and depot/site compliance verification.']
  strength varchar [note: 'Declared strength or concentration of the active pharmaceutical ingredient (API) per unit dose in this batch (e.g., \'100 mg\', \'5 mg/mL\'). Used for dose verification and dispensing accountability.']
  units_per_kit varchar [note: 'Number of IMP units (e.g., tablets, vials) contained in each randomization kit assembled from this batch. Used by RTSM for kit assembly configuration and dispensing accountability calculations.']
  updated_timestamp timestamp [note: 'Timestamp of the most recent update to this manufacture batch record, in ISO 8601 format (yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX). Required for change tracking, audit trail compliance, and incremental data pipeline processing.']

  Note: 'Records IMP manufacturing batch details including batch number, manufacturing date, batch size, manufacturing site, GMP certificate of analysis reference, release status (quarantine, released, rejected), expiry date, and storage conditions.'

Table supply.shipment {

  country_id varchar [note: 'Foreign key linking to study.study_country. Business justification: Shipments must be blocked to countries under regulatory hold. Linking shipment to study.study_country enables automated regulatory hold checks before dispatch, supports country-level']

  origin_depot_id varchar [note: 'Foreign key linking to supply.depot. Business justification: Shipments originate from depots (depot-to-site or depot-to-depot shipments). shipment.origin_node_name is a denormalized string.']
  site_file_id varchar [note: 'Foreign key linking to document.site_file. Business justification: Shipment delivery confirmations and temperature excursion records are essential site file documents.']

  study_site_id varchar [note: 'Reference to the destination clinical site receiving the IMP shipment. Used for site-level inventory accountability and regulatory reconciliation.']
  tmf_document_id varchar [note: 'Foreign key linking to document.tmf_document. Business justification: IMP shipment records (import permits, temperature monitoring logs, customs clearance documents) are essential TMF documents per ICH E6 R2.']
  actual_delivery_date date [note: 'The confirmed date on which the IMP shipment was received at the destination node. Used for delivery performance measurement, accountability reconciliation, and regulatory documentation.']

  dispatch_date date [note: 'The date on which the IMP shipment was physically dispatched from the origin node. Represents the principal business event timestamp for outbound shipments. Used for lead-time calculations and regulatory documentation.']
  dispatch_timestamp timestamp [note: 'Precise date and time the IMP shipment was dispatched from the origin node. Supports cold-chain elapsed time calculations and ALCOA+ data integrity requirements.']
  excursion_duration_minutes varchar [note: 'Total cumulative duration in minutes during which the shipment temperature was outside the specified storage condition range. Used for product impact assessment and quality disposition decisions.']
  expected_delivery_date date [note: 'The planned date on which the IMP shipment is expected to arrive at the destination node. Used for site inventory planning, expiry management, and supply chain KPI monitoring.']
  expiry_date date [note: 'Expiration date of the IMP batch included in this shipment. Used for expiry management, re-test date tracking, and prevention of expired product administration to subjects.']
  imp_description varchar [note: 'Description of the investigational medicinal product (IMP) or comparator included in the shipment (e.g., drug name, formulation, strength). Supports accountability documentation and regulatory submissions.']
  import_permit_number varchar [note: 'Regulatory import permit or authorization number issued by the receiving country\'s health authority for the IMP shipment. Required for cross-border clinical supply and regulatory compliance documentation.']
  incoterms_code varchar [note: 'International Commercial Terms (Incoterms) code defining the transfer of risk and responsibility between shipper and receiver for the IMP shipment. Governs insurance, customs, and cost allocation.']
  kit_count varchar [note: 'Total number of randomization kits included in this shipment as recorded in the RTSM (Medidata Rave). Core quantity field for inventory accountability and reconciliation.']
  max_recorded_temp_c decimal(5,2) [note: 'Maximum temperature in degrees Celsius recorded by the cold-chain data logger during transit. Used to assess whether the IMP was exposed to excessive heat or out-of-range conditions.']
  min_recorded_temp_c decimal(5,2) [note: 'Minimum temperature in degrees Celsius recorded by the cold-chain data logger during transit. Used to assess whether the IMP was exposed to freezing or sub-optimal low temperatures.']
  notes varchar [note: 'Free-text field for additional operational notes, special handling instructions, or comments related to the shipment (e.g., fragile contents, priority handling, deviation observations).']
  number varchar [note: 'Externally-known, human-readable shipment reference number generated by the RTSM (Medidata Rave) or logistics provider. Used for cross-system reconciliation, carrier communication, and regulatory accountability documentation.']
  origin_node_name varchar [note: 'Human-readable name of the supply chain origin node (e.g., depot name, manufacturer facility name, or site name). Supports logistics documentation and regulatory accountability records.']
  origin_node_type varchar [note: 'Type of supply chain node from which the shipment originates (e.g., manufacturer, central depot, clinical site, CRO warehouse). Used for supply chain network mapping and accountability.']
  quarantine_flag boolean [note: 'Indicates whether the shipment or its contents have been placed under quarantine pending quality investigation (e.g., following a temperature excursion or damaged packaging). Prevents dispensing of affected kits to subjects.']
  rtsm_shipment_ref varchar [note: 'Source system shipment reference identifier from the RTSM module (Medidata Rave). Used for cross-system reconciliation between the lakehouse silver layer and the operational RTSM system.']
  shipment_status varchar [note: 'Current lifecycle state of the IMP shipment within the clinical supply chain workflow. Drives accountability reconciliation and RTSM inventory updates. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: planned|dispatched|in_transit|delivered|returned|destroyed|cancelled — promote to']
  shipment_type varchar [note: 'Classification of the shipment purpose within the clinical supply chain. Distinguishes initial site supply, resupply, site-to-site transfer, returns to depot, and emergency shipments.']
  storage_condition varchar [note: 'Required storage temperature condition for the IMP during transit and at the destination (e.g., refrigerated 2-8°C, frozen -20°C, ambient 15-25°C). Drives cold-chain logistics requirements and excursion assessment.']
  temperature_excursion_flag boolean [note: 'Indicates whether a temperature excursion (deviation from required storage condition) was detected during transit. Triggers quality investigation, product impact assessment, and potential quarantine of affected kits.']
  tracking_number varchar [note: 'Carrier-assigned tracking number for the shipment. Used to monitor real-time transit status, confirm delivery, and investigate temperature excursions or delays.']
  updated_timestamp timestamp [note: 'Timestamp of the most recent update to the shipment record. Supports ALCOA+ audit trail requirements, change tracking, and data integrity compliance per 21 CFR Part 11.']
  waybill_number varchar [note: 'Air waybill (AWB) or bill of lading number issued by the carrier for the shipment. Used for customs documentation, carrier liability, and logistics traceability.']

  Note: 'Transactional record of IMP/kit shipments between supply chain nodes (manufacturer to depot, depot to site, site to site, site to depot for returns). Captures shipment number, origin, destination, carrier, tracking number, shipment date, expected delivery'
}
