  shipment_id varchar [note: 'Reference to the parent shipment header record. Establishes the header/detail relationship linking this line to its parent IMP shipment transaction. TRANSACTION_LINE role: HEADER_REFERENCE category.']
  study_id varchar [note: 'Reference to the clinical study for which this IMP shipment line is associated. Enables study-level supply accountability reporting and cross-domain analytics.']
  study_site_id varchar [note: 'Reference to the clinical trial site (destination) for this shipment line. Used for site-level inventory management, accountability reconciliation, and monitoring visit preparation.']
  blinded boolean [note: 'Indicates whether the IMP kit on this shipment line is blinded (True) or unblinded/open-label (False). Supports blinding integrity controls and restricts access to treatment assignment information per ICH E9 and GCP requirements.']
  certificate_of_analysis_number varchar [note: 'Reference number of the Certificate of Analysis (CoA) issued by the manufacturer for the IMP lot/batch on this shipment line. Required for GMP compliance and regulatory inspection readiness.']
  cold_chain_required boolean [note: 'Indicates whether the IMP on this shipment line requires cold-chain logistics management (True) or can be shipped at ambient temperature (False). Drives carrier selection, packaging requirements, and temperature monitoring obligations.']
  created_timestamp timestamp [note: 'Timestamp when this shipment line record was first created in the system. Supports ALCOA+ audit trail requirements and data lineage tracking per 21 CFR Part 11 and ICH E6(R2) GCP.']
  customs_declaration_number varchar [note: 'Customs or import/export declaration number associated with this shipment line for cross-border IMP shipments. Required for regulatory compliance with import/export regulations and trade documentation.']
  discrepancy_reason varchar [note: 'Free-text explanation for any quantity discrepancy between shipped and received amounts on this line. Captured during site receipt confirmation and used for drug accountability investigation and CAPA tracking.']
  dosage_form varchar [note: 'Pharmaceutical dosage form of the IMP on this shipment line (e.g., TABLET, CAPSULE, INJECTION, INFUSION, PATCH, LIQUID). Used for cold-chain handling classification and dispensing instructions.']
  expiry_date date [note: 'Expiration date of the IMP lot/batch on this shipment line. Used for expiry management, site dispensing eligibility checks, and regulatory compliance. IMP must not be dispensed to subjects after this date.']
  imp_description varchar [note: 'Descriptive name or label text for the IMP on this shipment line, including formulation, strength, and dosage form as defined in the study protocol and IMP dossier.']
  imp_product_code varchar [note: 'Sponsor-assigned product code or study drug identifier for the Investigational Medicinal Product (IMP) on this shipment line. Aligns with the study protocol\'s IMP definition and supply catalog.']
  import_license_number varchar [note: 'Import license or permit number required for cross-border shipment of IMP to the destination country. Applicable for regulated markets including EU, Japan (PMDA), Australia (TGA), and Canada (Health Canada).']
  kit_number varchar [note: 'Human-readable kit identifier assigned by the RTSM (Randomization and Trial Supply Management) system, such as Medidata Rave RTSM. Used for physical label matching and kit-level accountability reconciliation.']
  line_notes varchar [note: 'Free-text notes or comments specific to this shipment line, capturing any special handling instructions, site-specific requirements, or operational remarks not captured in structured fields.']
  line_number varchar [note: 'Sequential line number within the parent shipment, used to order and uniquely identify each line within a shipment transaction. TRANSACTION_LINE role: LINE_SEQUENCE category.']
  line_status varchar [note: 'Current workflow status of this shipment line, tracking progression from dispatch through site receipt confirmation. TRANSACTION_LINE role: LINE_VALUE_OR_RESULT category (status outcome).']
  lot_number varchar [note: 'Manufacturer\'s lot or batch number assigned to the IMP units on this shipment line. Critical for drug accountability, recall traceability, and regulatory compliance per GMP requirements.']
  manufacture_date date [note: 'Date on which the IMP lot/batch on this shipment line was manufactured. Used for shelf-life calculation, stability tracking, and GMP compliance documentation.']
  quantity_discrepancy decimal(18,4) [note: 'Difference between quantity_shipped and quantity_received for this shipment line. A non-zero value triggers a discrepancy investigation per drug accountability SOPs. Positive value indicates shortage; negative indicates overage.']
  quantity_received decimal(18,4) [note: 'Actual quantity of IMP units confirmed as received at the destination site for this shipment line. May differ from quantity_shipped in cases of partial receipt, damage, or discrepancy. Used for accountability reconciliation.']
  quantity_shipped decimal(18,4) [note: 'Number of units, kits, or packs of IMP dispatched on this shipment line. TRANSACTION_LINE role: LINE_QUANTITY category. Used for inventory depletion, accountability reconciliation, and supply planning.']
  quarantine_status varchar [note: 'Current quarantine status of the IMP on this shipment line. Values: NOT_QUARANTINED (available for dispensing), QUARANTINED (held pending quality review), RELEASED (released from quarantine after investigation), DESTROYED (disposed of due to quality']
  receipt_confirmed boolean [note: 'Indicates whether the receiving site has confirmed receipt of the IMP units on this shipment line. True = receipt confirmed by site personnel; False = receipt not yet confirmed. Supports drug accountability reconciliation.']
  receipt_date date [note: 'Date on which the receiving site confirmed receipt of the IMP units on this shipment line. Used for cold-chain compliance verification, accountability records, and site inventory updates.']
  retest_date date [note: 'Date by which the IMP lot/batch must be retested to confirm continued potency and stability before further use or dispensing. Applicable for certain IMP formulations per ICH stability guidelines.']
  source_system_line_ref varchar [note: 'Original line identifier or reference number from the source operational system (e.g., Medidata Rave RTSM shipment line ID or the source system item number). Enables traceability back to the system of record for audit and reconciliation purposes.']
  storage_condition_code varchar [note: 'Required storage condition for the IMP on this shipment line as specified in the IMP dossier. Drives cold-chain logistics requirements and site storage compliance monitoring.']
  strength varchar [note: 'Strength or concentration of the IMP on this shipment line (e.g., \'10 mg\', \'100 mg/mL\'). Captured as a string to accommodate varied unit expressions. Used for dispensing verification and protocol compliance.']
  temperature_excursion_details varchar [note: 'Free-text description of any temperature excursion recorded during transit for this shipment line, including duration, temperature range observed, and initial impact assessment. Populated only when temperature_excursion_flag is True.']
  temperature_excursion_flag boolean [note: 'Indicates whether a temperature excursion was recorded during transit for the IMP on this shipment line (True = excursion detected). Triggers quality investigation and potential quarantine of affected IMP per GDP and GMP requirements.']
  unit_of_measure varchar [note: 'Unit of measure for the quantity shipped on this line (e.g., KIT, VIAL, TABLET, CAPSULE, SYRINGE, PACK). Aligns with the IMP supply catalog and RTSM configuration.']
  updated_timestamp timestamp [note: 'Timestamp when this shipment line record was last modified. Supports audit trail requirements and change tracking per 21 CFR Part 11 and ALCOA+ principles.']

  Note: 'Line-level detail for each IMP shipment, capturing individual kit numbers or batch quantities included in a shipment. Each line records the IMP/kit reference, quantity shipped, unit of measure, lot/batch number, expiry date, and line-level receipt'
}

Table supply.dispensing_record {
  dispensing_record_id varchar [pk, note: 'Unique surrogate identifier for each investigational medicinal product (IMP) dispensing event record in the Databricks Silver Layer. Primary key for this entity.']
  clinical_trial_authorization_id varchar [note: 'Foreign key linking to regulatory.clinical_trial_authorization. Business justification: Each IMP dispensing event must occur under a valid CTA for the site\'s country.']
  consent_subject_consent_id varchar [note: 'Foreign key linking to consent.subject_consent. Business justification: GCP requires verified informed consent before any IMP dispensing. Linking dispensing_record to subject_consent enables inspection-ready drug accountability reports confirming every']
  document_sop_id varchar [note: 'Foreign key linking to document.document_sop. Business justification: IMP dispensing at clinical sites must follow an approved dispensing SOP (ICH GCP requirement).']
  dosing_regimen_id varchar [note: 'Foreign key linking to study.dosing_regimen. Business justification: GCP source data verification requires CRAs to validate each dispensing event against the protocol-specified dosing regimen (dose level, frequency, duration).']
  enrollment_id varchar [note: 'Foreign key linking to subject.enrollment. Business justification: IMP drug accountability and dosing compliance reporting require dispensing events to be directly linked to the enrollment record.']
  icf_version_id varchar [note: 'Foreign key linking to consent.consent_icf_version. Business justification: GCP requires dispensing staff to verify the subject\'s consent is current under the active ICF version before dispensing IMP.']
  irt_transaction_id varchar [note: 'Foreign key linking to randomization.irt_transaction. Business justification: Every dispensing event is confirmed via an IRT/RTSM transaction; GCP compliance and regulatory inspection require direct audit trail from dispensing record to IRT transaction.']
  kit_assignment_id varchar [note: 'Foreign key linking to randomization.kit_assignment. Business justification: kit_assignment is the IRT-side record of what was assigned; dispensing_record is the site-side record of what was physically given.']
  kit_definition_id varchar [note: 'Reference to the kit definition record that specifies the IMP kit type, dose strength, pack size, and labeling configuration dispensed. Links to supply.kit_definition for full kit specification.']
  kit_inventory_id varchar [note: 'Foreign key linking to supply.kit_inventory. Business justification: Each dispensing event dispenses a specific physical kit instance. dispensing_record.kit_number is a denormalized string identifier for the kit; adding kit_inventory_id creates a proper']
  manufacture_batch_id varchar [note: 'Foreign key linking to supply.manufacture_batch. Business justification: Each dispensing event uses IMP from a specific manufacturing batch (dispensing_record.batch_number is denormalized).']
  protocol_id varchar [note: 'Foreign key linking to study.protocol. Business justification: GCP requires dispensing records to be traceable to the protocol version in effect at time of dispensing for regulatory inspection readiness and CSR preparation.']
  site_file_id varchar [note: 'Foreign key linking to document.site_file. Business justification: Dispensing records are essential site file documents. Linking dispensing_record to site_file enables site file completeness tracking and supports CRA verification during monitoring visits']
  site_inventory_id varchar [note: 'Foreign key linking to supply.site_inventory. Business justification: A dispensing event draws IMP/kits from site inventory. Linking dispensing_record to the site_inventory record it drew from enables accurate inventory depletion tracking and drug']
  study_id varchar [note: 'Foreign key to the study this record belongs to.']
  study_visit_schedule_id varchar [note: 'Foreign key linking to study.study_visit_schedule. Business justification: GCP requires that IP dispensing is verified against the protocol-defined visit schedule.']
  subject_visit_data_id varchar [note: 'Foreign key linking to datamanagement.subject_visit_data. Business justification: CRAs performing source data verification must cross-reference IMP dispensing events against eCRF visit-level data completeness and SDV status.']
  tmf_document_id varchar [note: 'Foreign key linking to document.tmf_document. Business justification: IMP dispensing records are essential TMF documents per ICH E6 R2 Section 8. Linking dispensing_record to tmf_document enables TMF completeness tracking for IP accountability']
  trial_subject_id varchar [note: 'Reference to the enrolled trial subject who received the IMP dispensing. Core party reference for subject-level drug accountability and compliance with GCP requirements.']
  visit_id varchar [note: 'Reference to the scheduled or unscheduled study visit during which the IMP was dispensed. Links dispensing to the visit schedule for protocol compliance tracking.']
  accountability_reconciled boolean [note: 'Indicates whether this dispensing record has been included in and reconciled as part of the site-level drug accountability reconciliation (True) or is pending reconciliation (False). Required for study close-out and regulatory inspection readiness.']
  batch_number varchar [note: 'The manufacturing batch (lot) number of the IMP dispensed, as printed on the kit label. Required for drug accountability, pharmacovigilance traceability, and regulatory recall management. Aligns with GMP and GCP requirements.']
  cold_chain_maintained boolean [note: 'Indicates whether the cold chain storage and transport requirements were maintained for this IMP dispensing event (True) or a temperature excursion was recorded (False). Critical for temperature-sensitive biologics and vaccines.']
  created_timestamp timestamp [note: 'The date and time when this dispensing record was first created in the source system (Medidata Rave RTSM). Supports ALCOA+ audit trail requirements for contemporaneous data capture and 21 CFR Part 11 electronic record compliance.']
  dispensed_by_name varchar [note: 'Full name of the site staff member who performed the IMP dispensing, captured at time of dispensing for GCP audit trail. Stored as a denormalized field to preserve the historical record per ALCOA+ enduring data requirements even if staff records change.']
  dispensed_by_role varchar [note: 'The professional role of the staff member who performed the IMP dispensing (e.g., pharmacist, Clinical Research Coordinator (CRC), Principal Investigator (PI)).']
  dispensing_date date [note: 'The calendar date on which the IMP was dispensed to the subject. Derived from dispensing_timestamp for day-level reporting, protocol visit window compliance checks, and CDISC SDTM EX domain mapping.']
  dispensing_method varchar [note: 'The method by which the IMP dispensing was executed — whether via automated RTSM assignment, manual override (with justification), emergency supply, or backup procedure. Used for quality oversight and GCP compliance monitoring.']
  dispensing_notes varchar [note: 'Free-text notes or comments recorded by site staff at the time of dispensing, capturing any relevant observations, deviations, or special circumstances associated with this IMP dispensing event. Supports GCP audit trail and query resolution.']
  dispensing_status varchar [note: 'Current lifecycle status of this dispensing record. Tracks the workflow state from initial dispensing through return, destruction, or reconciliation for GCP drug accountability compliance.']
  dispensing_timestamp timestamp [note: 'The date and time at which the IMP was dispensed to the subject at the investigational site. Principal business event timestamp for this transaction. Recorded in ISO 8601 format with timezone offset per ALCOA+ requirements for contemporaneous data capture.']
  dosage_form varchar [note: 'The pharmaceutical dosage form of the IMP dispensed (e.g., tablet, capsule, injection). Required for drug accountability records and regulatory submissions. Aligns with IMP labeling and CDISC controlled terminology.']
  dose_amount decimal(18,4) [note: 'The numeric dose amount of IMP dispensed to the subject for this dispensing event, expressed in the unit specified by dose_unit. Core quantitative field for pharmacokinetic (PK) analysis and protocol compliance verification.']
  dose_number varchar [note: 'Sequential dose number for this subject within the study, indicating which administration in the subject\'s treatment sequence this dispensing event represents (e.g., Dose 1, Dose 2). Used for protocol compliance and exposure analysis.']
  dose_unit varchar [note: 'Unit of measure for the dose amount dispensed (e.g., mg, mcg, mL, IU). Required for unambiguous dose interpretation in drug accountability, PK analysis, and CDISC SDTM EX domain submission.']
  expiry_date date [note: 'The expiration date of the IMP kit dispensed, as printed on the kit label. Captured at dispensing to verify that no expired product was administered and to support expiry management and drug accountability reconciliation.']
  imp_name varchar [note: 'The name of the investigational medicinal product dispensed, as defined in the study protocol and IMP labeling. May be blinded (e.g., \'Study Drug A\') for double-blind studies. Used for drug accountability and regulatory reporting.']
  is_unblinded boolean [note: 'Indicates whether the blinding for this dispensing record has been broken (True) or remains blinded (False). Set to True only upon authorized emergency unblinding or at database lock (DBL).']
  kit_number varchar [note: 'The unique kit number (barcode or label identifier) of the IMP kit dispensed to the subject. Core drug accountability field used to trace individual kit units from depot to subject. Sourced from Medidata Rave RTSM.']
  protocol_deviation_flag boolean [note: 'Indicates whether this dispensing event was associated with a protocol deviation (True) or was compliant with the protocol (False). Triggers linkage to the compliance.protocol_deviation record for regulatory reporting and CAPA management.']
  quantity_dispensed decimal(18,4) [note: 'The number of units (e.g., tablets, capsules, vials, syringes) of IMP dispensed to the subject in this dispensing event. Used for inventory depletion tracking, drug accountability reconciliation, and return quantity verification.']
  quantity_returned decimal(18,4) [note: 'The number of IMP units returned by the subject at a subsequent visit, as recorded against this dispensing event. Used for drug accountability reconciliation to calculate actual consumption and compliance with protocol dosing instructions.']
  quantity_unit varchar [note: 'Unit of measure for the quantity dispensed (e.g., tablet, capsule, vial, syringe). Distinguishes the dispensing unit from the dose unit for accurate drug accountability and inventory reconciliation.']
  reconciliation_date date [note: 'The date on which this dispensing record was formally reconciled as part of the drug accountability reconciliation process. Populated when accountability_reconciled is True. Used for study close-out documentation and regulatory inspection readiness.']
  return_date date [note: 'The date on which unused IMP units from this dispensing event were returned by the subject to the site. Used for drug accountability reconciliation and calculation of subject compliance with dosing regimen.']
  route_of_administration varchar [note: 'The route by which the IMP was administered to the subject (e.g., oral, intravenous, subcutaneous). Required for CDISC SDTM EX domain submission and pharmacokinetic (PK) analysis.']
  source_system_record_code varchar [note: 'The native record identifier from the Medidata Rave RTSM dispensing module that corresponds to this dispensing event. Enables traceability back to the operational system of record for audit, reconciliation, and data lineage purposes per ALCOA+ and 21 CFR']
  subject_compliance_pct decimal(5,2) [note: 'The calculated medication compliance percentage for this dispensing event, derived from quantity dispensed minus quantity returned divided by expected consumption, expressed as a percentage.']
  temperature_excursion_flag boolean [note: 'Indicates whether a temperature excursion was recorded for the IMP kit at or prior to this dispensing event (True) or not (False). When True, requires sponsor/QA assessment of IMP usability before dispensing is confirmed.']
  unblinding_reason varchar [note: 'The reason for breaking the blind on this dispensing record, if applicable. Populated only when is_unblinded is True. Required for GCP audit trail and regulatory reporting of unblinding events. Null when blinding is intact.']
  updated_timestamp timestamp [note: 'The date and time when this dispensing record was last modified in the source system. Required for ALCOA+ audit trail compliance, change tracking, and incremental data pipeline processing in the Databricks Silver Layer.']

  Note: 'Captures each IMP dispensing event at an investigational site, recording the subject identifier, visit reference, kit number dispensed, IMP name, dose, quantity dispensed, dispensing date and time, dispensing staff, and RTSM confirmation number.'
}

Table supply.return_record {
  return_record_id varchar [pk, note: 'Unique surrogate identifier for each IMP/kit return record in the supply chain accountability system.']
  depot_id varchar [note: 'Reference to the supply depot that is the destination for site-to-depot returns or the originating depot for expired stock returns.']
  deviation_id varchar [note: 'Foreign key linking to subject.subject_deviation. Business justification: Return discrepancies (quantity mismatch, blinding breach, damaged IMP) that generate protocol deviations must be traceable to the specific return event for GCP audit and CAPA']
  dispensing_record_id varchar [note: 'Foreign key linking to supply.dispensing_record. Business justification: A return record documents IMP returned by a subject, which is always associated with a prior dispensing event.']
  document_sop_id varchar [note: 'Foreign key linking to document.document_sop. Business justification: IMP return procedures are governed by GCP SOPs covering return conditions, reconciliation, and disposition.']
  enrollment_id varchar [note: 'Foreign key linking to subject.enrollment. Business justification: Drug accountability reconciliation requires returned IMP to be attributed to a specific enrollment episode.']
  kit_definition_id varchar [note: 'Reference to the kit definition record describing the IMP kit type, dosage form, and pack configuration associated with this return.']
  kit_inventory_id varchar [note: 'Foreign key linking to supply.kit_inventory. Business justification: Each return event returns a specific physical kit instance. return_record.kit_number is a denormalized string identifier; adding kit_inventory_id creates a proper FK to the physical kit']
  manufacture_batch_id varchar [note: 'Foreign key linking to supply.manufacture_batch. Business justification: Return records reference a specific manufacturing batch (return_record.batch_number is denormalized).']
  quality_event_id varchar [note: 'Foreign key linking to compliance.quality_event. Business justification: IMP returns with temperature excursions, damaged packaging, or quantity discrepancies trigger quality events.']
  rand_code_id varchar [note: 'Foreign key linking to randomization.rand_code. Business justification: Returned kits must be traced to their randomization code assignment for IMP accountability and unblinding risk assessment.']
  shipment_id varchar [note: 'Foreign key linking to supply.shipment. Business justification: Return shipments (site-to-depot) are tracked in the shipment table. return_record.shipment_tracking_number is a denormalized string; adding shipment_id creates a proper FK to the return']
  site_file_id varchar [note: 'Foreign key linking to document.site_file. Business justification: IMP return records are essential site file documents. Linking return_record to site_file enables site file completeness tracking and supports CRA verification during monitoring visits that']
  site_inventory_id varchar [note: 'Foreign key linking to supply.site_inventory. Business justification: A return event (subject returning IMP to site, or site returning to depot) affects the site_inventory stock position.']
  study_id varchar [note: 'Reference to the clinical study for which this IMP return is being documented. Links the return to the sponsoring protocol.']
  study_site_id varchar [note: 'Reference to the investigational site initiating or receiving the return. Used for site-level drug accountability reconciliation.']
  subject_randomization_id varchar [note: 'Foreign key linking to randomization.subject_randomization. Business justification: IMP return reconciliation requires calculating compliance (quantity_used vs. expected dose per treatment arm) per randomization number.']
  tmf_document_id varchar [note: 'Foreign key linking to document.tmf_document. Business justification: IMP return records and return authorization documents are essential TMF documents per ICH E6 R2.']
  trial_subject_id varchar [note: 'Reference to the trial subject returning IMP to the site. Nullable for site-to-depot or expired stock returns where no subject is involved.']
  visit_id varchar [note: 'Reference to the subject visit at which the IMP return was collected from the subject. Links the return event to the clinical visit schedule for compliance tracking.']
  visit_report_id varchar [note: 'Foreign key linking to monitoring.visit_report. Business justification: CRAs verify IP return logs during monitoring visits as a mandatory GCP accountability activity, documented in visit reports via ip_accountability_reviewed flag.']
  withdrawal_id varchar [note: 'Foreign key linking to consent.consent_withdrawal. Business justification: Consent withdrawal triggers mandatory IMP return per GCP and protocol. Linking return_record to consent_withdrawal enables direct traceability from withdrawal event to drug']
  batch_number varchar [note: 'Manufacturing batch or lot number of the returned IMP. Required for drug accountability, quality investigations, and regulatory submissions.']
  blinding_intact boolean [note: 'Indicates whether the blinding of the returned IMP kit was maintained at the time of return (True = blinding preserved; False = unblinding occurred or suspected). Critical for double-blind study integrity.']
  comments varchar [note: 'Free-text field for additional observations, notes, or contextual information recorded by site staff, CRA, or depot personnel regarding this return event. Supports ALCOA+ completeness requirements.']
  courier_name varchar [note: 'Name of the logistics or courier company responsible for transporting the returned IMP from site to depot. Required for GDP-compliant cold-chain documentation.']
  created_timestamp timestamp [note: 'System timestamp recording when this return record was first created in the data platform. Part of the mandatory ALCOA+ audit trail for electronic records under 21 CFR Part 11.']
  destruction_authorization_ref varchar [note: 'Reference number or document identifier for the sponsor or depot authorization to destroy the returned IMP. Links to the destruction certificate in the eTMF (Veeva Vault). Required before any IMP destruction can proceed.']
  destruction_date date [note: 'Date on which the returned IMP was physically destroyed per the authorized destruction method. Completes the drug accountability lifecycle for the returned units.']
  destruction_method varchar [note: 'Method used to destroy the returned IMP, as specified in the protocol or sponsor instructions. Must comply with local environmental and pharmaceutical waste regulations.']
  discrepancy_explanation varchar [note: 'Free-text explanation provided by the site or CRA to account for any quantity discrepancy between dispensed and returned IMP. Required for regulatory audit trail when discrepancy_quantity is non-zero.']
  discrepancy_quantity varchar [note: 'Numeric difference between the expected return quantity (dispensed minus used) and the actual quantity returned. A non-zero value triggers a drug accountability discrepancy investigation.']
  dispensing_unit varchar [note: 'Unit of measure for the returned IMP (e.g., tablet, vial, syringe). Required for accurate drug accountability reconciliation across different dosage forms.']
  expiry_date date [note: 'Expiration date of the returned IMP as printed on the label. Used to confirm whether the product was within shelf life at the time of dispensing and return.']
  kit_number varchar [note: 'The unique RTSM-assigned kit number or barcode identifier for the specific IMP kit being returned. Enables unit-level drug accountability traceability.']
  quantity_dispensed varchar [note: 'Number of dispensing units originally dispensed to the subject or site for the associated kit. Stored on the return record to enable direct accountability reconciliation without joining to dispensing records.']
  quantity_returned varchar [note: 'Number of dispensing units (tablets, vials, syringes, etc.) returned. Used in drug accountability reconciliation to verify compliance with dispensing records.']
  quantity_used varchar [note: 'Number of dispensing units confirmed as consumed by the subject, calculated or reported at the time of return. Supports compliance and adherence analysis.']
  receipt_date date [note: 'Date on which the returned IMP or kit was physically received at the destination (site or depot). Used to calculate transit time and confirm chain of custody.']
  reconciliation_date date [note: 'Date on which the drug accountability reconciliation for this return was completed and confirmed by the responsible party (CRA or site staff).']
  reconciliation_status varchar [note: 'Status of the drug accountability reconciliation process for this return, tracking whether dispensed vs. returned quantities have been verified and any discrepancies resolved.']
  return_condition varchar [note: 'Physical condition of the IMP or kit at the time of return, as assessed by the site or depot receiving staff. Critical for determining disposition (destruction vs. re-use) and identifying cold-chain or handling failures.']
  return_date date [note: 'The actual calendar date on which the IMP or kit was physically returned by the subject to the site, or dispatched from the site to the depot. Principal business event date for drug accountability.']
  return_number varchar [note: 'Externally-known, human-readable business identifier for this return transaction, typically generated by the RTSM (Medidata Rave) or CTMS. Used for cross-system traceability and regulatory audit.']
  return_reason varchar [note: 'Narrative or coded reason for the return, such as study completion, subject withdrawal, protocol deviation, product expiry, or damaged packaging. Supports root cause analysis and supply planning.']
  return_status varchar [note: 'Current lifecycle state of the return record, tracking progression from initiation through receipt, reconciliation, and final destruction or disposition.']
  return_type varchar [note: 'Classification of the return event indicating the reason and direction of the return: subject returning unused IMP to site, site returning stock to depot, expired stock return, damaged stock return, or return triggered by a protocol deviation.']
  rtsm_return_code varchar [note: 'Source system identifier for this return transaction as recorded in the RTSM (Medidata Rave). Enables bidirectional traceability between the lakehouse silver layer and the operational RTSM system.']
  shipment_tracking_number varchar [note: 'Courier or logistics provider tracking number for the return shipment from site to depot. Enables cold-chain monitoring and chain-of-custody verification during transit.']
  sponsor_notified_flag boolean [note: 'Indicates whether the sponsor has been formally notified of this return event, particularly relevant for returns involving temperature excursions, damaged product, or significant quantity discrepancies.']
  temperature_excursion_flag boolean [note: 'Indicates whether a cold-chain temperature excursion was recorded or reported for the returned IMP during storage or transit (True = excursion occurred). Triggers quality investigation and potential destruction.']
  updated_timestamp timestamp [note: 'System timestamp recording the most recent modification to this return record. Required for audit trail integrity and change tracking under 21 CFR Part 11 and ALCOA+ principles.']
  verification_date date [note: 'Date on which the CRA or pharmacist completed Source Data Verification (SDV) of the return record against source documents at the site or depot.']
  verified_by varchar [note: 'Name or identifier of the Clinical Research Associate (CRA) or pharmacist who verified the return quantities and condition during a monitoring visit or depot check. Supports Source Data Verification (SDV).']

  Note: 'Documents IMP/kit returns from subjects to sites and from sites to depots. Captures return type (subject return, site-to-depot, expired stock), kit numbers or quantities returned, return date, condition on return (intact, partially used, damaged)'
}

Table supply.destruction_record {
  destruction_record_id varchar [pk, note: 'Unique surrogate identifier for each IMP/kit destruction record in the clinical supply chain. Primary key for this entity.']
  clinical_trial_authorization_id varchar [note: 'Foreign key linking to regulatory.clinical_trial_authorization. Business justification: EU CTA conditions require IMP destruction to be authorized and documented in compliance with CTA-specific requirements.']
  depot_id varchar [note: 'Foreign key linking to supply.depot. Business justification: IMP destruction often occurs at authorized depot facilities (destruction_authorized flag on depot). destruction_record.facility_name is a denormalized string.']
  document_sop_id varchar [note: 'Foreign key linking to document.document_sop. Business justification: IMP destruction must be performed per an approved SOP under GCP/GMP requirements. Linking destruction_record to the governing document_sop provides audit trail evidence that destruction']
  imp_master_id varchar [note: 'Reference to the IMP master record defining the drug product being destroyed. Enables linkage to dosage form, strength, and storage condition specifications.']
  ind_application_id varchar [note: 'Foreign key linking to regulatory.ind_application. Business justification: IMP destruction must be reported and traceable to the IND under which the product was used.']
  kit_inventory_id varchar [note: 'Foreign key linking to supply.kit_inventory. Business justification: A destruction event destroys specific kit inventory instances. destruction_record has kit_count_destroyed and kit_number_list (STRING) but no FK to kit_inventory.']
  manufacture_batch_id varchar [note: 'Foreign key linking to supply.manufacture_batch. Business justification: Destruction records reference a specific manufacturing batch (destruction_record.batch_number is denormalized).']
  monitoring_plan_id varchar [note: 'Foreign key linking to monitoring.monitoring_visit. Business justification: CRAs verify and witness IMP destruction during or following monitoring visits as a GCP regulatory requirement.']
  quality_event_id varchar [note: 'Foreign key linking to compliance.quality_event. Business justification: Destruction events with discrepancies (quantity mismatch, unauthorized destruction, missing witness signature) trigger quality events.']
  return_record_id varchar [note: 'Reference to the inbound return shipment record that delivered the IMP/kits to the destruction facility. Provides traceability from site return to destruction.']
  site_file_id varchar [note: 'Foreign key linking to document.site_file. Business justification: Destruction certificates are essential site file documents required for GCP inspection readiness.']
  site_inventory_id varchar [note: 'Foreign key linking to supply.site_inventory. Business justification: A destruction event depletes the site or depot inventory position. destruction_record has depot_id and study_site_id but no direct FK to site_inventory.']
  study_id varchar [note: 'Reference to the clinical study for which the IMP/kit destruction is being recorded. Links destruction activity to the sponsoring protocol.']
  study_site_id varchar [note: 'Reference to the clinical site or depot facility from which the IMP/kits were returned and subsequently destroyed.']
  tmf_document_id varchar [note: 'Foreign key linking to document.tmf_document. Business justification: Certificate of Destruction is an ICH GCP essential TMF document (Section 8.4). Destruction records must be directly traceable to their filed TMF document for inspection readiness and']
  authorization_date date [note: 'Date on which the destruction was formally authorized by the sponsor or designated authority. Must precede the destruction_date to confirm proper authorization workflow.']
  authorization_number varchar [note: 'Externally assigned or sponsor-issued authorization number approving the destruction of the IMP/kits. Required for GCP audit trail and regulatory inspection readiness. Serves as the primary business identifier for this destruction event.']
  batch_number varchar [note: 'Manufacturing batch or lot number of the IMP being destroyed. Required for pharmaceutical traceability and post-destruction accountability reconciliation.']
  certificate_issue_date date [note: 'Date on which the Certificate of Destruction was formally issued by the destruction facility. May differ from the actual destruction date; both are required for complete GCP documentation.']
  certificate_of_destruction_ref varchar [note: 'Document reference number or identifier for the official Certificate of Destruction issued by the destruction facility. This document is a mandatory GCP audit trail artifact and must be filed in the Trial Master File (TMF).']
  cold_chain_maintained boolean [note: 'Indicates whether cold-chain temperature requirements were maintained during transport to the destruction facility (True) or a cold-chain excursion occurred (False). Relevant for temperature-sensitive IMP products.']
  comments varchar [note: 'Free-text field for additional notes, observations, or contextual information related to the destruction event not captured in structured fields. Supports GCP audit trail completeness.']
  created_timestamp timestamp [note: 'Timestamp when this destruction record was first created in the system. Required for ALCOA+ audit trail compliance and 21 CFR Part 11 electronic record integrity.']
  destruction_date date [note: 'The actual calendar date on which the IMP/kits were physically destroyed. This is the principal real-world event date for the destruction transaction, distinct from authorization or record creation dates.']
  destruction_method varchar [note: 'The physical or chemical method used to destroy the IMP/kits (e.g., incineration, chemical neutralization). Must comply with applicable environmental and pharmaceutical waste regulations.']
  destruction_reason varchar [note: 'The business reason driving the destruction of the IMP/kits (e.g., expired product, returned unused, rejected due to quality failure). Required for accountability reconciliation and regulatory reporting.']
  destruction_status varchar [note: 'Current lifecycle status of the destruction record, tracking progression from authorization request through completion or cancellation.']
  discrepancy_notes varchar [note: 'Free-text description of any discrepancies identified between the quantity/kits expected for destruction and those actually destroyed. Required when reconciliation_status is \'discrepancy_identified\' or \'discrepancy_resolved\'.']
  expiry_date date [note: 'Expiration date of the IMP batch being destroyed. Relevant when destruction_reason is \'expired\'; used to confirm that expired product has been appropriately removed from the supply chain.']
  facility_country_code varchar [note: 'ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 country code of the country where the destruction facility is located. Used for jurisdiction-specific regulatory compliance tracking.']
  facility_license_number varchar [note: 'Regulatory license or permit number of the destruction facility, confirming it is authorized to handle and destroy pharmaceutical/IMP waste.']
  facility_name varchar [note: 'Name of the licensed facility (depot, third-party destruction vendor, or site) where the physical destruction was carried out.']
  imp_name varchar [note: 'Name or description of the Investigational Medicinal Product (IMP) being destroyed. Provides human-readable identification of the drug substance for audit and reporting purposes.']
  is_blinded_destruction boolean [note: 'Indicates whether the destruction was performed under blinded conditions (True) to preserve study integrity, or unblinded (False). Relevant for double-blind studies where kit contents must not be revealed during destruction.']
  kit_count_destroyed varchar [note: 'Number of randomization kits destroyed in this event, as tracked by the RTSM system. Distinct from quantity_destroyed which counts individual IMP units; kit count is the RTSM-level accountability unit.']
  kit_number_list varchar [note: 'Comma-separated or range-notation list of RTSM kit numbers included in this destruction event (e.g., \'KIT-001,KIT-002\' or \'KIT-001 to KIT-050\'). Provides granular kit-level traceability for GCP audit and regulatory inspection.']
  quantity_destroyed varchar [note: 'Total number of IMP units (e.g., tablets, vials, syringes) destroyed in this destruction event. Used for accountability reconciliation against dispensed and returned quantities.']
  quantity_unit varchar [note: 'Unit of measure for the quantity destroyed (e.g., kit, vial, tablet). Ensures consistent accountability reconciliation across different IMP dosage forms. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: kit|vial|tablet|capsule|syringe|blister_pack|bottle — 7 candidates stripped']
  reconciliation_date date [note: 'Date on which the IMP accountability reconciliation for this destruction event was completed and confirmed. Marks closure of the destruction accountability cycle.']
  reconciliation_status varchar [note: 'Status of the IMP accountability reconciliation for this destruction event, confirming that quantities destroyed match quantities returned and recorded in the RTSM. Required for GCP accountability and regulatory inspection.']
  regulatory_notification_date date [note: 'Date on which the regulatory authority was formally notified of the destruction event. Populated only when regulatory_notification_required is True.']
  regulatory_notification_required boolean [note: 'Indicates whether the destruction event requires formal notification to a regulatory authority (e.g., FDA, EMA, PMDA) per applicable regulations or study protocol requirements.']
  rtsm_destruction_confirmation_code varchar [note: 'Confirmation or transaction identifier generated by the RTSM system (Medidata Rave) when kit destruction is recorded in the randomization and trial supply management system.']
  sponsor_representative varchar [note: 'Name of the sponsor or CRO representative who oversaw or confirmed the destruction on behalf of the study sponsor. Relevant for multi-party accountability in outsourced destruction activities.']
  temperature_excursion_noted boolean [note: 'Indicates whether a temperature excursion was documented for the IMP prior to or during transport to destruction. Provides additional context for destruction_reason when product integrity was compromised.']
  tmf_filing_status varchar [note: 'Status of the Certificate of Destruction and supporting documentation filing in the Trial Master File (TMF) or electronic TMF (eTMF). Required for inspection readiness per ICH E6(R2) and TMF Reference Model.']
  updated_timestamp timestamp [note: 'Timestamp of the most recent modification to this destruction record. Required for ALCOA+ audit trail compliance and 21 CFR Part 11 electronic record integrity.']
  weight_destroyed_kg decimal(10,3) [note: 'Total weight in kilograms of the IMP/pharmaceutical waste destroyed. Required by some environmental and waste management regulations for pharmaceutical destruction reporting.']
  witness_name varchar [note: 'Full name of the qualified witness present during the physical destruction of the IMP/kits. Witness attestation is a GCP requirement for IMP destruction events.']
  witness_signature_date date [note: 'Date on which the witness signed the destruction record or certificate, confirming their presence during the destruction event. Required for ALCOA+ compliance.']
  witness_title varchar [note: 'Professional title or role of the destruction witness (e.g., QA Manager, Pharmacist, CRA). Confirms the witness has appropriate qualifications per GCP requirements.']

  Note: 'Records the destruction of returned, expired, or rejected IMP/kits. Captures destruction authorization number, destruction date, destruction method (incineration, chemical neutralization), facility, quantity and kit numbers destroyed, witness details, and'
}

Table supply.temperature_excursion {
  temperature_excursion_id varchar [pk, note: 'Unique surrogate identifier for each cold-chain temperature excursion event record in the clinical supply domain.']
  capa_id varchar [note: 'Foreign key linking to compliance.capa. Business justification: Temperature excursions with adverse disposition decisions require a formal CAPA under GMP/GCP.']
  compliance_sop_id varchar [note: 'Foreign key linking to compliance.compliance_sop. Business justification: Temperature excursions are assessed against SLA thresholds for cold-chain compliance; breaches trigger SLA penalties.']
  depot_id varchar [note: 'Foreign key linking to supply.depot. Business justification: Temperature excursions can occur at depot storage facilities, not just during transit or at sites.']
  inspection_finding_id varchar [note: 'Foreign key linking to compliance.inspection_finding. Business justification: Temperature excursions inadequately resolved can be cited in regulatory inspection findings (inspector cites a specific excursion event as evidence of GDP non-compliance).']
  kit_inventory_id varchar [note: 'Reference to the investigational medicinal product (IMP) kit definition affected by this excursion. Links to kit_definition for storage condition thresholds and product identity.']
  manufacture_batch_id varchar [note: 'Foreign key linking to supply.manufacture_batch. Business justification: A temperature excursion affects specific manufacturing batches (temperature_excursion has affected_batch_numbers as a STRING field listing multiple batch numbers).']
  monitoring_plan_id varchar [note: 'Foreign key linking to monitoring.monitoring_plan. Business justification: Temperature excursion handling, disposition decisions, and CAPA requirements are governed by the monitoring plan\'s escalation criteria and IP accountability requirements.']
  quality_event_id varchar [note: 'Foreign key linking to compliance.quality_event. Business justification: Temperature excursions in IMP supply are a primary trigger for quality events. temperature_excursion already links to compliance_capa and compliance_sop but not to the quality_event']
  safety_report_submission_id varchar [note: 'Foreign key linking to regulatory.safety_report_submission. Business justification: Temperature excursions affecting IMP integrity may trigger expedited safety reporting obligations to health authorities.']
  shipment_id varchar [note: 'Reference to the supply chain shipment record if the excursion occurred during in-transit logistics. Null if the excursion occurred at a static storage location (depot or site).']
  specimen_id varchar [note: 'Foreign key linking to laboratory.specimen. Business justification: GCP requires direct traceability from a temperature excursion event to affected biological specimens for disposition decisions (use/reject).']
  study_id varchar [note: 'Reference to the clinical study during which this temperature excursion occurred. Links the excursion to the governing protocol and sponsor.']
  study_site_id varchar [note: 'Reference to the clinical site or depot where the excursion was detected or occurred. Null if the excursion occurred in-transit between locations.']
  tmf_document_id varchar [note: 'Foreign key linking to document.tmf_document. Business justification: Temperature excursion reports and impact assessments are essential TMF documents per ICH E6 R2.']
  affected_batch_numbers varchar [note: 'Comma-separated list of IMP manufacturing batch/lot numbers affected by this excursion. Required for traceability to the Certificate of Analysis (CoA) and stability data package submitted to the sponsor and regulatory authorities.']
  affected_kit_count varchar [note: 'Total number of IMP kits exposed to the temperature excursion. Used for impact scoping, supply replacement planning, and regulatory reporting.']
  affected_kit_numbers varchar [note: 'Comma-separated list of IMP kit numbers (as assigned in the RTSM/IRT system, e.g., Medidata Rave) that were exposed to the temperature excursion. Captured as a denormalized string for audit readiness; detailed kit-level records are maintained in the']
  capa_required boolean [note: 'Indicates whether a Corrective and Preventive Action (CAPA) has been determined to be required as a result of this excursion event. True = CAPA required; False = no CAPA required. Drives workflow integration with MasterControl CAPA tracking.']
  created_timestamp timestamp [note: 'The date and time when this temperature excursion record was first created in the system. Supports ALCOA+ audit trail requirements and data lineage tracking in the Databricks Lakehouse silver layer.']
  data_logger_code varchar [note: 'Unique identifier of the electronic temperature data logger or continuous monitoring device that recorded the excursion. Used for equipment traceability, calibration verification, and audit trail per 21 CFR Part 11 and EU GMP Annex 11.']
  detection_source varchar [note: 'The mechanism or system that first detected the temperature excursion: data_logger (electronic temperature logger device), continuous_monitor (real-time monitoring system), manual_check (routine manual temperature check), irt_alert (Interactive Response']
  disposition_date date [note: 'The date on which the sponsor or QA team formally issued the disposition decision for the affected IMP kits. Required for regulatory audit trail and supply chain accountability reconciliation.']
  disposition_decision varchar [note: 'The final disposition decision made by the sponsor or QA team following the impact assessment. Distinct from impact_assessment_outcome in that this represents the formal, authorized decision (which may differ from the initial assessment recommendation).']
  duration_minutes varchar [note: 'Total elapsed time in minutes from excursion start to excursion end. Populated once the excursion is closed. Used by QA and the sponsor to assess cumulative thermal exposure against stability data.']
  excursion_end_timestamp timestamp [note: 'The date and time (ISO 8601 with timezone) at which the temperature returned within the acceptable range, marking the end of the excursion event. Null if the excursion is still ongoing at time of record creation.']
  excursion_narrative varchar [note: 'Free-text narrative describing the circumstances of the temperature excursion, including any contextual information provided by the site, depot, or courier at the time of detection. Supports GCP audit readiness and regulatory inspection documentation.']
  excursion_number varchar [note: 'Externally-known, human-readable reference number assigned to this excursion event, used in sponsor communications, QA investigations, and regulatory audit trails. Typically generated by the RTSM or CTMS system (e.g., Medidata Rave or the source system']
  excursion_start_timestamp timestamp [note: 'The date and time (ISO 8601 with timezone) at which the temperature excursion began — i.e., when the temperature first breached the defined threshold. This is the principal real-world event time for the excursion.']
  excursion_status varchar [note: 'Current lifecycle status of the excursion event record. Drives QA workflow: open (newly detected), under_investigation (impact assessment in progress), pending_disposition (awaiting sponsor/QA decision), closed (disposition finalized), voided (false alarm']
  excursion_type varchar [note: 'Classification of the excursion by the nature of the breach: high_temperature (exceeded upper limit), low_temperature (fell below lower limit), freeze_thaw (frozen product that should not be), humidity (relative humidity breach), combined (multiple']
  impact_assessment_outcome varchar [note: 'The outcome of the scientific/QA impact assessment determining the usability of the affected IMP: use (product confirmed acceptable for continued use), quarantine (product held pending further evaluation), destroy (product deemed unusable and scheduled']
  location_type varchar [note: 'Categorizes where in the cold-chain the excursion occurred: depot (central or regional IMP warehouse), site (investigational site pharmacy or storage), in_transit (during shipment between locations), courier_hub (third-party logistics hub), customs (held']
  logger_calibration_date date [note: 'The most recent calibration date of the temperature data logger at the time of the excursion. Required to validate the reliability of the recorded temperature data for GCP audit readiness and regulatory submissions.']
  lower_threshold_c decimal(6,2) [note: 'The minimum acceptable storage temperature (in degrees Celsius) defined for the affected IMP, as specified in the kit definition or product stability data. Breach of this threshold constitutes a low-temperature excursion.']
  max_temp_recorded_c decimal(6,2) [note: 'The highest temperature value (in degrees Celsius) recorded during the excursion event. Used to assess the severity of a high-temperature excursion against product stability specifications.']
  mean_kinetic_temp_c decimal(6,2) [note: 'The Mean Kinetic Temperature (MKT) in degrees Celsius calculated for the excursion period. MKT is the single calculated temperature that, if maintained over the storage period, would produce the same thermal stress as the actual temperature fluctuations.']
  min_temp_recorded_c decimal(6,2) [note: 'The lowest temperature value (in degrees Celsius) recorded during the excursion event. Used to assess the severity of a low-temperature or freeze-thaw excursion against product stability specifications.']
  replacement_kits_required boolean [note: 'Indicates whether replacement IMP kits need to be dispatched to the affected site or depot as a result of the disposition decision (e.g., quarantine or destroy outcome). Drives supply replenishment workflow in the RTSM (Medidata Rave).']
  reported_by varchar [note: 'Name or user identifier of the person (e.g., CRC, CRA, site pharmacist, depot manager) who first reported or logged the temperature excursion into the system. Supports ALCOA+ attributability requirements.']
  reported_timestamp timestamp [note: 'The date and time when the excursion was formally reported or entered into the system. May differ from excursion_start_timestamp if there was a delay in detection or reporting. Supports ALCOA+ contemporaneity assessment.']
  root_cause_category varchar [note: 'High-level categorization of the root cause identified during the CAPA or investigation process: equipment_failure (refrigeration/monitoring device malfunction), process_failure (SOP not followed), human_error (incorrect handling), logistics_failure']
  root_cause_description varchar [note: 'Detailed narrative description of the identified root cause of the temperature excursion, as documented during the QA investigation. Supports CAPA development and regulatory inspection readiness.']
  rtsm_excursion_reference varchar [note: 'The excursion or alert reference identifier as recorded in the RTSM system (Medidata Rave IRT/RTSM module). Used for cross-system traceability between the lakehouse silver layer and the operational source system.']
  sponsor_notification_date date [note: 'The date on which the sponsor was formally notified of the temperature excursion. Null if sponsor_notification_required is False or notification has not yet been sent. Used to track compliance with contractual and regulatory notification timelines.']
  sponsor_notification_required boolean [note: 'Indicates whether the sponsor must be formally notified of this excursion per the clinical supply agreement or protocol requirements. True = notification required; False = not required (e.g., minor excursion within pre-defined acceptable limits).']
  stability_data_reviewed boolean [note: 'Indicates whether the product stability data (from the Investigational Medicinal Product Dossier or stability package) was formally reviewed as part of the impact assessment for this excursion. True = reviewed; False = not yet reviewed.']
  updated_timestamp timestamp [note: 'The date and time when this temperature excursion record was most recently modified. Supports audit trail requirements and incremental data processing in the Databricks Lakehouse silver layer.']
  upper_threshold_c decimal(6,2) [note: 'The maximum acceptable storage temperature (in degrees Celsius) defined for the affected IMP, as specified in the kit definition or product stability data. Breach of this threshold constitutes a high-temperature excursion.']

  Note: 'Records cold-chain temperature excursion events detected during IMP storage or transit. Captures excursion start and end timestamps, affected location (depot, site, in-transit), temperature range breached, duration, affected kit/batch numbers, impact'
}

Table supply.accountability_reconciliation {
  accountability_reconciliation_id varchar [pk, note: 'Unique surrogate identifier for the drug accountability reconciliation record. Primary key for this entity. Entity role: TRANSACTION_HEADER — periodic reconciliation event with a defined lifecycle (open → reconciled / discrepancy-flagged).']
  application_id varchar [note: 'Foreign key linking to regulatory.application. Business justification: IMP accountability reconciliation is a contractual obligation defined in the study contract.']
  arm_id varchar [note: 'Foreign key linking to study.arm. Business justification: GCP requires IMP accountability reconciliation at the treatment arm level — dispensed, returned, and destroyed quantities must balance per arm.']
  clinical_trial_authorization_id varchar [note: 'Foreign key linking to regulatory.clinical_trial_authorization. Business justification: IMP accountability reconciliation is a CTA-specific regulatory obligation.']
  compliance_sop_id varchar [note: 'Foreign key linking to compliance.compliance_sop. Business justification: Accountability reconciliation reports are formal SOW deliverables with acceptance criteria, billing milestone linkage, and TMF filing requirements.']
  imp_master_id varchar [note: 'Reference to the investigational medicinal product (IMP) being reconciled. A single reconciliation record covers one IMP or comparator product at the site for the period.']
  ind_application_id varchar [note: 'Foreign key linking to regulatory.ind_application. Business justification: IND annual reports require IMP accountability data aggregated by IND. Reconciliation records must reference the IND to support annual report preparation and FDA inspection']
  inspection_finding_id varchar [note: 'Foreign key linking to compliance.inspection_finding. Business justification: Regulatory inspectors (FDA, EMA) routinely issue findings against IMP accountability records.']
  kit_definition_id varchar [note: 'Foreign key linking to supply.kit_definition. Business justification: Drug accountability reconciliation is performed at the kit type level — reconciling quantities dispensed, returned, and destroyed for a specific kit definition.']
  monitoring_plan_id varchar [note: 'Reference to the monitoring visit during which this drug accountability reconciliation was performed or reviewed by the Clinical Research Associate (CRA). Null if reconciliation is performed outside a scheduled monitoring visit (e.g., at Database Lock).']
  monitoring_visit_schedule_id varchar [note: 'Foreign key linking to monitoring.monitoring_visit_schedule. Business justification: IP accountability reconciliation is a scheduled CRA activity performed during monitoring visits per the monitoring visit schedule.']
  protocol_deviation_id varchar [note: 'Foreign key linking to compliance.protocol_deviation. Business justification: Accountability reconciliation discrepancies (missing kits, quantity mismatch) are a direct trigger for protocol deviation reporting under GCP.']
  quality_event_id varchar [note: 'Foreign key linking to compliance.quality_event. Business justification: Unresolved accountability reconciliation discrepancies are escalated as quality events under GCP.']
  rand_scheme_id varchar [note: 'Foreign key linking to randomization.rand_scheme. Business justification: IMP accountability reconciliation must validate that kit usage matches the allocation ratios and blinding rules defined in the randomization scheme.']
  site_cra_assignment_id varchar [note: 'Foreign key linking to site.site_cra_assignment. Business justification: Drug accountability reconciliation is performed by the assigned CRA during monitoring visits. The cra_name column is a denormalized reference to the CRA assignment.']
  site_file_id varchar [note: 'Foreign key linking to document.site_file. Business justification: IMP accountability reconciliation records are essential site file documents required for GCP inspection readiness.']
  site_inventory_id varchar [note: 'Foreign key linking to supply.site_inventory. Business justification: Drug accountability reconciliation is performed at the site level against the site inventory position.']
  study_id varchar [note: 'Reference to the clinical study for which this drug accountability reconciliation is performed. Links the reconciliation to the study protocol, IMP details, and regulatory submission context.']
  study_site_id varchar [note: 'Reference to the investigational site at which this drug accountability reconciliation is conducted. Each reconciliation is site-specific and covers all IMP activity at that site for the defined period.']
  tmf_document_id varchar [note: 'Foreign key linking to document.tmf_document. Business justification: IMP accountability reconciliation is an ICH GCP essential TMF document (Section 8.3). The reconciliation record must link to its filed TMF document to support inspection readiness.']
  actual_closing_balance_units varchar [note: 'Physical count of IMP units on hand at the site at the end of the reconciliation period, as verified by the site staff and/or CRA during the monitoring visit. This is the ground-truth inventory count.']
  adjusted_units varchar [note: 'Net quantity adjustment applied to the reconciliation (positive or negative) to account for documented corrections such as data entry errors, kit relabeling, or sponsor-approved adjustments. Zero if no adjustments were made.']
  comments varchar [note: 'Free-text field for additional comments, observations, or contextual notes entered by the CRA, site staff, or data manager regarding this reconciliation. Supplements the discrepancy_detail field for general narrative.']
  cra_signoff_date date [note: 'The date on which the CRA / monitor signed off on this drug accountability reconciliation. Null if cra_signoff_flag is False.']
  cra_signoff_flag boolean [note: 'Indicates whether the Clinical Research Associate (CRA) / monitor has reviewed and signed off on this drug accountability reconciliation record. True = signed; False = pending. Required at every monitoring visit per ICH E6(R2).']
  created_timestamp timestamp [note: 'The date and time when this drug accountability reconciliation record was first created in the system. Supports audit trail requirements under 21 CFR Part 11 and ALCOA+ (Attributable, Legible, Contemporaneous, Original, Accurate) principles.']
  destroyed_units varchar [note: 'Total quantity of IMP units destroyed at the site or returned to depot for destruction during the reconciliation period. Destruction must be documented per sponsor SOP and applicable regulations.']
  discrepancy_count varchar [note: 'Number of individual discrepancy line items identified during this reconciliation (e.g., missing kit, unaccounted return, dispensing record mismatch). Distinct from discrepancy_units which measures total quantity variance.']
  discrepancy_detail varchar [note: 'Free-text narrative describing the nature, root cause, and resolution status of identified discrepancies. Captured by the CRA or site staff. Required when discrepancy_count > 0. Supports regulatory inspection readiness and CAPA documentation.']
  discrepancy_resolution_status varchar [note: 'Current resolution status of identified discrepancies. \'not_applicable\' = no discrepancy found; \'open\' = discrepancy identified, investigation not started; \'under_investigation\' = root cause analysis in progress; \'resolved\' = discrepancy explained and']
  discrepancy_units varchar [note: 'Quantity difference between expected_closing_balance_units and actual_closing_balance_units (actual minus expected). A non-zero value triggers discrepancy investigation. Positive = surplus; negative = shortage.']
  dispensed_units varchar [note: 'Total quantity of IMP units dispensed to subjects at the site during the reconciliation period. Sourced from dispensing records in Medidata Rave RTSM and eCRF dispensing logs.']
  expected_closing_balance_units varchar [note: 'Calculated expected closing balance: opening_balance_units + received_units - dispensed_units + returned_units - destroyed_units + adjusted_units. Used as the reference value against which the physical count is compared to identify discrepancies.']
  expired_units_count varchar [note: 'Number of IMP units that had expired as of the reconciliation period end date. Expired units must be quarantined and destroyed per sponsor SOP; their presence in usable inventory constitutes a protocol deviation.']
  expiry_date_earliest date [note: 'The earliest expiry date among all IMP units currently on hand at the site as of the reconciliation period end date. Used to flag impending expiry risk and trigger resupply or destruction actions.']
  gcp_compliance_flag boolean [note: 'Indicates whether this reconciliation record is fully compliant with GCP §8.3.13 requirements (both investigator and CRA sign-offs obtained, no unresolved discrepancies, all required fields populated). True = compliant; False = non-compliant or pending.']
  inspection_ready_flag boolean [note: 'Indicates whether this reconciliation record and its supporting documentation are complete and ready for regulatory inspection (FDA, EMA, MHRA, etc.). True = inspection-ready; False = documentation gaps exist. Supports eTMF completeness tracking.']
  investigator_name varchar [note: 'Full name of the Principal Investigator (PI) who signed off on this reconciliation. Captured at time of sign-off for audit trail integrity per ALCOA+ principles. Confidential as it identifies a named professional in a regulatory context.']
  investigator_signoff_date date [note: 'The date on which the Principal Investigator (PI) or delegated sub-investigator signed off on this drug accountability reconciliation. Null if investigator_signoff_flag is False.']
  investigator_signoff_flag boolean [note: 'Indicates whether the Principal Investigator (PI) or delegated sub-investigator has reviewed and signed off on this drug accountability reconciliation record. True = signed; False = pending. Required for GCP compliance and regulatory inspection readiness.']
  next_reconciliation_due_date date [note: 'The scheduled due date for the next drug accountability reconciliation at this site for this IMP. Derived from the monitoring visit schedule or protocol-defined reconciliation frequency. Used for proactive compliance tracking.']
  opening_balance_units varchar [note: 'The quantity of IMP units (e.g., tablets, vials, kits) on hand at the site at the start of the reconciliation period. Carried forward from the closing balance of the prior reconciliation period or from the initial receipt if this is the first period.']
  period_end_date date [note: 'The last calendar date of the reconciliation period covered by this record. Defines the closing boundary for all IMP transactions included in this reconciliation.']
  period_start_date date [note: 'The first calendar date of the reconciliation period covered by this record. Together with period_end_date, defines the window of IMP activity (receipts, dispensing, returns, destruction) being reconciled.']
  protocol_deviation_flag boolean [note: 'Indicates whether a protocol deviation was identified during this reconciliation (e.g., expired IMP dispensed, incorrect kit dispensed, dispensing outside visit window). True = deviation identified; False = no deviation.']
  received_units varchar [note: 'Total quantity of IMP units received at the site from the depot or sponsor during the reconciliation period. Sourced from shipment receipt records in Medidata Rave RTSM.']
  reconciliation_date date [note: 'The date on which the drug accountability reconciliation was physically performed (i.e., the date of the physical count and record review). This is the principal business event date for this transaction, distinct from sign-off dates.']
  reconciliation_number varchar [note: 'Externally-known, human-readable business identifier for this reconciliation record, typically generated by the RTSM or CTMS (e.g., RECON-SITE001-20240315). Used in monitoring reports, TMF filings, and regulatory inspection packages.']
  reconciliation_status varchar [note: 'Current workflow status of the reconciliation record. \'open\' = in progress; \'reconciled\' = balances confirmed with no discrepancy; \'discrepancy_flagged\' = unresolved quantity mismatch requiring investigation; \'pending_review\' = awaiting CRA or']
  reconciliation_type varchar [note: 'Classification of the reconciliation trigger. \'routine_monitoring\' = performed at a scheduled CRA monitoring visit; \'pre_dbl\' = required prior to Database Lock (DBL); \'site_closeout\' = performed at study close-out; \'interim\' = ad hoc between visits']
  returned_units varchar [note: 'Total quantity of IMP units returned from subjects to the site (unused or partially used) during the reconciliation period. Includes returns captured in Medidata Rave RTSM return logs.']
  rtsm_reconciliation_ref varchar [note: 'The reconciliation reference or transaction identifier assigned by the Randomization and Trial Supply Management (RTSM) system (Medidata Rave) for this accountability event. Enables traceability back to the source system record.']
  source_document_ref varchar [note: 'Reference identifier for the physical or electronic source document (e.g., drug accountability log, dispensing record binder, eTMF artifact ID in Veeva Vault) that supports this reconciliation record. Required for SDV and regulatory inspection.']
  temperature_excursion_flag boolean [note: 'Indicates whether any cold-chain temperature excursion was recorded for IMP stored at this site during the reconciliation period. True = at least one excursion event occurred; False = no excursion.']
  unit_of_measure varchar [note: 'The unit in which IMP quantities are counted and reconciled (e.g., kit, tablet, vial). Must be consistent with the dispensing unit defined in the kit definition and RTSM configuration.']
  updated_timestamp timestamp [note: 'The date and time when this drug accountability reconciliation record was most recently modified. Required for audit trail completeness under 21 CFR Part 11 and ALCOA+ principles. Tracks the last state change in the reconciliation lifecycle.']

  Note: 'Periodic drug accountability reconciliation record at the site level, capturing the reconciliation period, opening balance, receipts, dispensed quantities, returned quantities, destroyed quantities, closing balance, discrepancy count and detail'
