Table supply.resupply_order {
  resupply_order_id varchar [pk, note: 'Unique surrogate identifier for the resupply order record in the lakehouse silver layer. Primary key for this entity.']
  application_id varchar [note: 'Foreign key linking to regulatory.application. Business justification: Resupply orders are executed under the study contract\'s supply scope and purchase order terms.']
  arm_id varchar [note: 'Foreign key linking to study.arm. Business justification: Resupply orders are triggered per treatment arm when arm-specific stock falls below threshold. Supply managers must validate resupply quantities against arm-specific enrollment targets and dosing']
  clinical_trial_authorization_id varchar [note: 'Foreign key linking to regulatory.clinical_trial_authorization. Business justification: Resupply orders to EU/EEA sites require confirmation of valid CTA status in the destination member state before order approval and dispatch.']
  ind_application_id varchar [note: 'Foreign key linking to regulatory.ind_application. Business justification: Resupply orders for US-based studies must be traceable to the governing IND. FDA inspections require that all IMP supply activities reference the IND — resupply orders without IND']
  kit_definition_id varchar [note: 'Reference to the IMP kit type or kit definition being requested in this resupply order, as defined in the RTSM kit catalogue.']
  protocol_id varchar [note: 'Reference to the specific protocol version in effect at the time the resupply order was generated. Ensures supply is aligned with the current approved protocol and dosing schedule.']
  shipment_id varchar [note: 'Reference to the outbound shipment record created to fulfill this resupply order. Populated once the order transitions to a dispatched or fulfilled state.']
  site_inventory_id varchar [note: 'Foreign key linking to supply.site_inventory. Business justification: A resupply order is triggered when site inventory falls below the minimum stock threshold (stock_at_trigger, min_stock_threshold attributes on resupply_order).']
  source_depot_id varchar [note: 'Reference to the depot or distribution center from which the IMP kits will be dispatched to fulfill this resupply order. Supports depot-to-site and depot-to-depot supply chain tracking.']
  study_id varchar [note: 'Reference to the clinical study for which the resupply order was generated. Links the order to the sponsoring protocol and IMP supply plan.']
  study_site_id varchar [note: 'Reference to the investigational site or depot that triggered or is the destination of the resupply order. Identifies the requesting or receiving location in the supply chain.']
  supply_plan_id varchar [note: 'Reference to the IMP supply plan or forecast that this resupply order is fulfilling. Links operational orders back to strategic supply planning for variance analysis.']
  treatment_arm_id varchar [note: 'Reference to the study treatment arm for which the IMP kits are being resupplied. Ensures blinded or unblinded supply allocation aligns with randomization scheme.']
  accountability_reconciled boolean [note: 'Indicates whether the IMP kits in this resupply order have been reconciled in the drug accountability log at the receiving site or depot. Required for GCP compliance and regulatory inspection readiness.']
  actual_delivery_date date [note: 'Date on which the resupply shipment was confirmed as received at the destination site or depot. Used to calculate fulfillment lead time and identify supply delays.']
  approval_date date [note: 'Date on which the resupply order was reviewed and approved by the supply manager or depot coordinator prior to dispatch.']
  blinding_level varchar [note: 'Blinding status of the IMP kits in this resupply order. Determines handling, labelling, and access control requirements during supply chain operations.']
  cancellation_reason varchar [note: 'Free-text explanation for why the resupply order was cancelled. Populated only when order_status is \'cancelled\'. Required for supply accountability and audit trail.']
  cold_chain_required boolean [note: 'Indicates whether the IMP kits in this resupply order require cold-chain logistics (temperature-controlled transport and storage). Drives courier selection and packaging requirements.']
  courier_name varchar [note: 'Name of the logistics provider or courier company assigned to transport the resupply shipment. Used for tracking, accountability, and vendor performance monitoring.']
  created_timestamp timestamp [note: 'Timestamp when this resupply order record was first captured in the system of record. Supports audit trail and ALCOA+ data integrity requirements.']
  expected_fulfillment_date date [note: 'Target date by which the resupply order is expected to be delivered to the requesting site or depot, based on standard lead times and courier schedules.']
  expiry_date_earliest date [note: 'The earliest expiry date among the IMP kits included in this resupply order. Critical for expiry management to ensure kits will remain within shelf life for the expected dispensing window.']
  is_emergency_override boolean [note: 'Indicates whether this resupply order was processed as an emergency override, bypassing standard approval workflows due to critical patient supply risk. Triggers mandatory post-hoc documentation.']
  min_stock_threshold varchar [note: 'The minimum stock level (in units/kits) at the requesting site or depot that triggered the resupply order. Captured at the time of order creation for audit and analytics.']
  order_comments varchar [note: 'Free-text field for supply manager notes, special handling instructions, or contextual information related to this resupply order. Supports operational communication between depots and sites.']
  order_date timestamp [note: 'The date and time at which the resupply order was formally placed or triggered, either by the RTSM resupply algorithm or by a supply manager. This is the principal business event timestamp for the order.']
  order_number varchar [note: 'Human-readable, externally-known business identifier for the resupply order, typically generated by the RTSM (Medidata Rave) or supply management system. Used in communications with depots, couriers, and sponsors.']
  order_status varchar [note: 'Current lifecycle state of the resupply order workflow, from initial trigger through fulfillment or cancellation. Drives operational dashboards and escalation logic.']
  quantity_approved varchar [note: 'Number of IMP kits or units approved for dispatch after supply manager or depot review. May differ from quantity_requested due to stock availability or protocol constraints.']
  quantity_requested varchar [note: 'Number of IMP kits or units requested in this resupply order, as specified at the time of order creation by the RTSM algorithm or supply manager.']
  quantity_shipped varchar [note: 'Actual number of IMP kits or units included in the outbound shipment fulfilling this resupply order. Populated at dispatch and used for accountability reconciliation.']
  quantity_unit varchar [note: 'Unit of measure for the quantities specified in this resupply order (e.g., kit, vial, blister pack). Ensures consistent interpretation across depots and sites.']
  reconciliation_date date [note: 'Date on which the drug accountability reconciliation was completed for the IMP kits delivered under this resupply order. Populated when accountability_reconciled is True.']
  requesting_location_type varchar [note: 'Classifies whether the resupply order was initiated by an investigational site, a regional depot, or a central pharmacy. Determines routing and fulfillment logic.']
  rtsm_order_reference varchar [note: 'The native order reference or transaction ID assigned by the RTSM system (Medidata Rave) when the resupply order was generated. Used for cross-system reconciliation and audit.']
  rtsm_trigger_rule varchar [note: 'Identifier or name of the RTSM resupply algorithm rule that triggered this order (e.g., minimum stock level rule, days-of-supply threshold rule). Null for manually initiated orders.']
  source_system_order_code varchar [note: 'The native primary key or unique identifier of this resupply order in the originating source system (e.g., Medidata Rave RTSM internal order ID). Enables cross-system traceability and reconciliation.']
  stock_at_trigger varchar [note: 'Actual inventory count at the requesting site or depot at the moment the resupply order was triggered. Used to validate trigger logic and support supply accountability reconciliation.']
  storage_condition varchar [note: 'Required storage condition for the IMP kits in this resupply order during transit and at the destination. Determines packaging, courier, and handling instructions.']
  tracking_number varchar [note: 'Courier-assigned tracking number for the shipment fulfilling this resupply order. Enables real-time shipment tracking and delivery confirmation.']
  trigger_type varchar [note: 'Indicates whether the resupply order was automatically triggered by the RTSM resupply algorithm (e.g., minimum stock threshold breach) or initiated manually by a supply manager or other authorized personnel.']
  updated_timestamp timestamp [note: 'Timestamp of the most recent modification to this resupply order record. Used for change detection, ETL incremental loads, and audit compliance.']
  urgency_level varchar [note: 'Priority classification of the resupply order indicating the speed of fulfillment required. Emergency orders may trigger expedited cold-chain logistics and override standard lead times.']

  Note: 'Captures resupply order requests triggered by RTSM resupply algorithms or manual supply manager intervention. Records the requesting site or depot, IMP/kit type requested, quantity requested, urgency level, order date, expected fulfillment date'
}

Table monitoring.monitoring_plan {
  monitoring_plan_id varchar [pk, note: 'Unique surrogate identifier for the monitoring plan record in the Databricks Silver Layer. Primary key for this entity.']
  blinding_config_id varchar [note: 'Foreign key linking to randomization.blinding_config. Business justification: Monitoring plans must reference the blinding configuration to define CRA blinding status, SDV restrictions on blinded data, and emergency unblinding procedures.']
  dmp_id varchar [note: 'Foreign key linking to datamanagement.dmp. Business justification: The monitoring plan\'s SDV percentage threshold, query rate threshold, and RBM strategy must align with the DMP. ICH E6(R2) requires these documents to be co-developed.']
  document_sop_id varchar [note: 'Foreign key linking to document.document_sop. Business justification: Monitoring plans are authored to comply with sponsor delivery preferences (SDV %, monitoring strategy, reporting cadence).']
  health_authority_id varchar [note: 'Foreign key linking to regulatory.strategy. Business justification: The regulatory strategy defines target agencies, submission timelines, and development phase that directly determine the monitoring approach, RBM strategy, applicable regions, and data']
  ind_application_id varchar [note: 'Foreign key linking to regulatory.ind_application. Business justification: The IND is the governing regulatory application defining safety reporting obligations and protocol requirements that monitoring plans must enforce.']
  investigational_product_id varchar [note: 'Foreign key linking to study.investigational_product. Business justification: Monitoring plans include IP-specific requirements — ip_accountability_required, storage verification, and temperature monitoring are IP-dependent.']
  lab_panel_id varchar [note: 'Foreign key linking to laboratory.lab_panel. Business justification: Monitoring plans explicitly define critical data elements including specific lab panels requiring SDV and centralized monitoring.']
  protocol_id varchar [note: 'Foreign key linking to study.protocol. Business justification: Monitoring plans are authored against a specific protocol version — GCP ICH E6 R2 requires the monitoring plan to reference the governing protocol.']
  rand_scheme_id varchar [note: 'Foreign key linking to randomization.rand_scheme. Business justification: Monitoring plans must explicitly address the randomization scheme to define SDV scope for randomization data, IRT/RTSM oversight requirements, and blinding maintenance procedures.']
  risk_assessment_id varchar [note: 'Foreign key linking to compliance.risk_assessment. Business justification: Monitoring plans (rbm_strategy, sdv_percentage_threshold, site_risk_tier_methodology) are formally derived from the compliance risk_assessment.']
  sap_id varchar [note: 'Foreign key linking to biostatistics.sap. Business justification: Monitoring plans are designed in direct alignment with the SAP — SDV scope, critical data elements, and KRI thresholds are derived from SAP-defined endpoints and analysis populations.']
  study_id varchar [note: 'add column study_id (BIGINT) with FK to study.study.study_id — monitoring_plan has no FK to study despite being study-specific; it should reference the study it governs']
  study_protocol_amendment_id varchar [note: 'Foreign key linking to study.study_protocol_amendment. Business justification: When a protocol is amended, the monitoring plan must be revised — \'Monitoring Plan Amendment Update\' is a named regulatory process.']
  tmf_document_id varchar [note: 'Foreign key linking to document.tmf_document. Business justification: The monitoring plan is a TMF-essential document (DIA TMF Reference Model Zone 11). Sponsors must file the approved monitoring plan in the TMF.']

  applicable_regions varchar [note: 'Comma-separated list of regulatory regions or jurisdictions to which this monitoring plan applies (e.g., USA, EU, JPN, AUS, CAN). Determines which regulatory authority requirements (FDA, EMA, PMDA, TGA, Health Canada) govern monitoring activities.']
  approval_date date [note: 'Date on which the monitoring plan was formally approved by the authorized signatory (e.g., Sponsor, CRO Quality Assurance). Required for regulatory compliance and TMF filing.']
  approved_by varchar [note: 'Name or identifier of the individual (e.g., Sponsor representative, CRO Quality Assurance lead) who formally approved this version of the monitoring plan. Supports ALCOA+ audit trail requirements.']
  capa_resolution_days varchar [note: 'Maximum number of calendar days within which a Corrective and Preventive Action (CAPA) identified during monitoring must be resolved and closed by the site or sponsor. Defined in the monitoring plan to ensure timely remediation.']
  centralized_monitoring_included boolean [note: 'Indicates whether centralized statistical monitoring (e.g., Key Risk Indicator (KRI) dashboards, data trend analysis) is included as a component of the monitoring strategy for this study.']
  closeout_visit_required boolean [note: 'Indicates whether a formal Site Close-Out Visit (COV) is mandated for all sites under this monitoring plan upon study completion or site termination.']
  cra_qualification_requirements varchar [note: 'Description of minimum qualifications, certifications, and experience required for Clinical Research Associates (CRAs) assigned to monitor sites under this plan (e.g., therapeutic area experience, GCP certification, sponsor-specific training).']
  created_timestamp timestamp [note: 'Timestamp when this monitoring plan record was first created in the system. Supports ALCOA+ audit trail requirements and 21 CFR Part 11 electronic records compliance.']
  critical_data_elements varchar [note: 'Comma-separated list or narrative description of data fields designated as critical per ICH E6(R2), such as primary efficacy endpoints, informed consent dates, eligibility criteria, and safety data.']
  critical_processes varchar [note: 'Description of study processes designated as critical per ICH E6(R2), such as randomization, informed consent, Investigational Product (IP) accountability, and Serious Adverse Event (SAE) reporting. These processes receive heightened monitoring focus.']
  data_privacy_requirements varchar [note: 'Description of applicable data privacy and patient data protection requirements governing monitoring activities under this plan, including GDPR, HIPAA, and local data protection laws relevant to the study regions.']
  effective_end_date date [note: 'Date on which this version of the monitoring plan ceases to be operative, typically upon supersession by a new version or study close-out. Nullable for the currently active version.']
  effective_start_date date [note: 'Date from which this version of the monitoring plan becomes operative and binding for study monitoring activities. Aligns with study initiation or amendment approval date.']
  escalation_trigger_criteria varchar [note: 'Defined conditions or thresholds that trigger escalation of monitoring intensity, additional site visits, or Corrective and Preventive Action (CAPA) initiation. Examples include KRI breaches, repeated protocol deviations, or SAE under-reporting.']
  gcp_training_required boolean [note: 'Indicates whether current Good Clinical Practice (GCP) training certification is a prerequisite for all Clinical Research Associates (CRAs) executing monitoring activities under this plan.']
  high_risk_visit_frequency_days varchar [note: 'Monitoring visit interval in calendar days applicable to sites classified as High risk tier. Typically shorter than the standard interval to ensure heightened oversight.']
  icf_review_required boolean [note: 'Indicates whether review of signed Informed Consent Forms (ICFs) for all enrolled subjects is a mandatory component of each monitoring visit under this plan.']
  interim_visit_frequency_days varchar [note: 'Standard interval in calendar days between scheduled interim monitoring visits for an average-risk site. Actual frequency may be adjusted based on site risk tier and Key Risk Indicator (KRI) triggers.']
  ip_accountability_required boolean [note: 'Indicates whether Investigational Product (IP) accountability checks (dispensing, return, destruction reconciliation) are mandated as part of on-site monitoring visits under this plan.']
  kri_tolerance_limits varchar [note: 'Narrative or structured description of the Key Risk Indicator (KRI) thresholds and tolerance limits defined in this monitoring plan. Specifies the upper/lower bounds for metrics such as query rate, protocol deviation rate, and enrollment rate that trigger']
  last_modified_timestamp timestamp [note: 'Timestamp when this monitoring plan record was most recently updated. Supports change tracking, audit trail, and version control requirements under 21 CFR Part 11 and ICH E6(R2).']
  low_risk_visit_frequency_days varchar [note: 'Monitoring visit interval in calendar days applicable to sites classified as Low risk tier. Typically longer than the standard interval, reflecting reduced oversight requirements.']
  missing_data_threshold decimal(5,2) [note: 'Maximum acceptable percentage of missing or incomplete data fields in the Electronic Case Report Form (eCRF) before a site is flagged for corrective action under the centralized monitoring program.']
  monitoring_approach varchar [note: 'Primary monitoring strategy defined for the study. On-Site involves Clinical Research Associate (CRA) visits to investigational sites; Remote involves off-site review of electronic data; Centralized involves statistical and data-driven oversight; Hybrid']
  plan_number varchar [note: 'Externally-known unique business identifier for the monitoring plan, typically formatted as MP-[StudyCode]-[SequenceNumber]. Used in Trial Master File (TMF) references and regulatory submissions.']
  plan_status varchar [note: 'Current lifecycle status of the monitoring plan. Draft indicates work-in-progress; Under Review indicates pending approval; Approved is the active operative version; Superseded indicates replaced by a newer version; Retired indicates no longer applicable.']
  protocol_deviation_threshold decimal(5,2) [note: 'Maximum acceptable protocol deviation rate (expressed as a percentage of total subject visits or data points) before escalation actions are triggered at a site. Defined per the RBM strategy.']
  query_rate_threshold decimal(5,2) [note: 'Maximum acceptable data query rate (expressed as a percentage of total data points entered) before centralized monitoring flags a site for additional review or on-site visit. Supports Electronic Data Capture (EDC) quality oversight.']
  rbm_strategy varchar [note: 'Overarching Risk-Based Monitoring (RBM) strategy classification applied to the study. Determines the balance between on-site, remote, and centralized monitoring activities based on study risk profile per ICH E6(R2) and FDA/EMA guidance.']
  remote_monitoring_allowed boolean [note: 'Indicates whether remote (off-site) monitoring activities are permitted under this monitoring plan as a complement or alternative to on-site visits, per the approved RBM strategy.']
  sdv_percentage_threshold decimal(5,2) [note: 'Minimum percentage of source data records or data points that must be verified per site visit or monitoring cycle, as defined in the Risk-Based Monitoring (RBM) strategy. Expressed as a percentage (0.00–100.00).']
  sdv_scope varchar [note: 'Defines the breadth of Source Data Verification (SDV) to be performed across the study. 100% SDV requires verification of all data points; Risk-Based SDV targets high-risk data fields; Critical Data Only restricts SDV to protocol-defined critical data']
  site_initiation_visit_required boolean [note: 'Indicates whether a formal Site Initiation Visit (SIV) is mandated for all sites under this monitoring plan prior to first patient enrollment.']
  site_risk_tier_methodology varchar [note: 'Methodology used to assign risk tiers (e.g., High, Medium, Low) to investigational sites. Determines how site-level risk scores are calculated to drive adaptive monitoring frequency and intensity.']
  version_number varchar [note: 'Version identifier of the monitoring plan (e.g., 1.0, 2.0, 2.1). Incremented with each approved amendment to support audit trail and regulatory compliance.']
  visit_report_submission_days varchar [note: 'Maximum number of calendar days after a monitoring visit within which the CRA must submit the completed monitoring visit report to the sponsor or CRO. Typically 5–10 business days per GCP standards.']

  Note: 'Master entity defining the risk-based monitoring (RBM) strategy for a clinical study. Specifies monitoring approach (on-site, remote, centralized), SDV scope and percentage thresholds, visit frequency rules, critical data/process definitions per ICH'
}

}

Table monitoring.sdv_record {
  sdv_record_id varchar [pk, note: 'Unique surrogate identifier for each Source Data Verification (SDV) record in the Databricks Silver Layer. Primary key for this entity.']
  action_item_id varchar [note: 'Reference to an action item or follow-up task raised in the source system as a result of this SDV finding. Supports escalation workflows and site management accountability.']
  adverse_event_id varchar [note: 'Foreign key linking to safety.adverse_event. Business justification: Source data verification of AE records is a critical monitoring activity. SDV records for AE fields must reference the specific adverse_event being verified to support data integrity']
  ae_follow_up_id varchar [note: 'Foreign key linking to safety.ae_follow_up. Business justification: AE follow-up data (updated outcomes, resolution dates) must be source-verified during monitoring visits.']
  bioanalytical_result_id varchar [note: 'Foreign key linking to laboratory.bioanalytical_result. Business justification: GCP requires SDV of bioanalytical results against source data. sdv_record already links to laboratory_lab_result but not bioanalytical_result.']
  causality_assessment_id varchar [note: 'Foreign key linking to safety.causality_assessment. Business justification: Causality assessments are critical safety data points requiring source verification during monitoring visits.']
  consent_subject_consent_id varchar [note: 'Foreign key linking to consent.subject_consent. Business justification: GCP requires CRAs to verify valid informed consent was obtained before any study procedures during SDV. The sdv_record verifies source documents including the signed ICF.']
  discrepancy_query_id varchar [note: 'Reference to the data query raised in Medidata Rave EDC as a result of the discrepancy identified during SDV. Populated when sdv_outcome is \'discrepancy_found\' and a query has been issued.']
  ecrf_field_id varchar [note: 'Foreign key linking to datamanagement.ecrf_field. Business justification: SDV verifies specific eCRF field values against source documents. ICH E6(R2) requires field-level SDV traceability.']
  ecrf_form_id varchar [note: 'Reference to the specific eCRF form (e.g., Medidata Rave form) containing the data point that was verified during SDV.']
  field_entry_id varchar [note: 'Foreign key linking to datamanagement.field_entry. Business justification: SDV is the process of verifying a specific EDC field_entry value against the source document.']
  icf_version_id varchar [note: 'Foreign key linking to consent.consent_icf_version. Business justification: SDV of consent forms requires verifying that the signed consent document matches the currently approved ICF version.']
  irt_transaction_id varchar [note: 'Foreign key linking to randomization.irt_transaction. Business justification: CRAs perform SDV on IRT dispensing records as a standard GCP monitoring activity, verifying that IRT system transactions match source dispensing logs.']
  lab_result_id varchar [note: 'Foreign key linking to laboratory.lab_result. Business justification: ICH E6 GCP SDV process: CRAs verify lab result values in the eCRF against the lab-reported source document.']
  monitoring_cra_assignment_id varchar [note: 'Foreign key linking to monitoring.monitoring_cra_assignment. Business justification: SDV is performed by the assigned CRA for a site. Linking sdv_record to monitoring_cra_assignment identifies which CRA performed the verification, supports CRA workload']
  pk_sample_id varchar [note: 'Foreign key linking to laboratory.pk_sample. Business justification: CRAs perform SDV on PK sample collection records (collection timestamp, actual vs. nominal timepoint, volume collected) as a GCP requirement.']
  protocol_deviation_id varchar [note: 'Reference to a protocol deviation record if the SDV discrepancy resulted in a protocol deviation being raised. Links SDV findings to the protocol deviation tracking workflow in the source system']
  quality_event_id varchar [note: 'Foreign key linking to compliance.quality_event. Business justification: Data integrity quality events trigger targeted SDV activities to verify affected data.']
  serious_adverse_event_id varchar [note: 'Foreign key linking to safety.serious_adverse_event. Business justification: SAEs require 100% SDV per ICH E6 GCP guidelines. sdv_record must reference the specific SAE being source-verified to support regulatory-required SAE data verification tracking']
  specimen_collection_id varchar [note: 'Foreign key linking to laboratory.specimen_collection. Business justification: ICH E6 GCP SDV process: CRAs verify specimen collection records (collection time, fasting status, collection method) against eCRF entries.']
  specimen_shipment_id varchar [note: 'Foreign key linking to laboratory.specimen_shipment. Business justification: GCP requires SDV of specimen shipment records (chain of custody, temperature monitor data, receipt confirmation).']
  study_id varchar [note: 'Reference to the clinical study (protocol) under which this SDV record was generated. Links to the study master entity.']
  study_site_id varchar [note: 'Reference to the investigational site where the source data and eCRF data point reside. Supports site-level SDV performance tracking in the source system']
  study_visit_schedule_id varchar [note: 'Foreign key linking to study.study_visit_schedule. Business justification: SDV records document verification of data at protocol-defined visits. visit_name is a denormalized reference to study_visit_schedule.']
  subject_randomization_id varchar [note: 'Foreign key linking to randomization.subject_randomization. Business justification: CRAs performing SDV on randomization-related eCRF fields (randomization number, treatment arm) must cross-reference the subject\'s actual randomization record.']
  subject_visit_data_id varchar [note: 'Foreign key linking to datamanagement.subject_visit_data. Business justification: SDV records are performed at the subject visit level. Linking sdv_record to subject_visit_data enables reconciliation of SDV completion status at the visit level, supports']
  tmf_document_id varchar [note: 'Foreign key linking to document.tmf_document. Business justification: SDV records are GCP-essential TMF documents (DIA TMF Reference Model Section 11). Regulators expect SDV evidence filed in the TMF.']
  trial_subject_id varchar [note: 'Reference to the enrolled study subject whose eCRF data point is being verified against source documents.']
  visit_id varchar [note: 'Foreign key linking to subject.subject_visit. Business justification: GCP requires SDV to be traceable to the specific subject visit verified. sdv_record.visit_name is a denormalized plain-text field; a FK to subject_visit enables regulatory SDV']
  visit_report_id varchar [note: 'Foreign key linking to monitoring.visit_report. Business justification: SDV records are captured during monitoring visits and their results are summarized in the visit_report.']
  created_timestamp timestamp [note: 'The date and time when this SDV record was first created in the system. Supports audit trail requirements under 21 CFR Part 11 and ALCOA+ Contemporaneous principle.']
  discrepancy_category varchar [note: 'Categorical classification of the discrepancy type when sdv_outcome is \'discrepancy_found\'. Supports root cause analysis, CAPA workflows, and site quality trending.']
  discrepancy_description varchar [note: 'Narrative description of the discrepancy identified between the eCRF field value and the source document value. Populated only when sdv_outcome is \'discrepancy_found\'. Supports query generation and protocol deviation assessment.']
  ecrf_page_number varchar [note: 'eCRF page reference. Implements CDASH CRF page metadata concept.']
  is_critical_data_point boolean [note: 'Indicates whether this eCRF field is designated as a critical data point per the study\'s Risk-Based Monitoring (RBM) plan or Data Management Plan (DMP). Critical data points are prioritized for SDV under ICH E6(R2) Addendum.']
  is_sdv_waived boolean [note: 'Indicates whether SDV was formally waived for this data point per the approved RBM plan or protocol amendment. A waiver must be documented and justified in the monitoring plan. Supports RBM audit trail.']
  not_verifiable_reason varchar [note: 'Reason why the data point could not be verified against source documents when sdv_outcome is \'not_verifiable\'. Supports site follow-up actions and regulatory audit readiness.']
  rbm_risk_score decimal(5,2) [note: 'Risk-based monitoring risk score. Implements ICH E6(R2) GCP 5.0 risk-based quality management / RBM concept.']
  regulatory_impact_flag boolean [note: 'Indicates whether the SDV discrepancy has potential regulatory impact (e.g., affects primary endpoint data, safety data, or regulatory submission data). Triggers escalation to the sponsor and regulatory team.']
  resolution_date date [note: 'The date on which the discrepancy was formally resolved and the resolution status was updated to \'resolved\' or \'closed\'. Used for monitoring KPI calculations such as query resolution cycle time.']
  resolution_description varchar [note: 'Narrative explanation of how the discrepancy was resolved, including any eCRF corrections made, source document clarifications obtained, or justifications provided by the site. Supports audit trail under 21 CFR Part 11.']
  resolution_status varchar [note: 'Current resolution status of the discrepancy identified during SDV: open (discrepancy raised, awaiting resolution), resolved (eCRF corrected or explanation accepted), closed (verified resolved and signed off), or cancelled (discrepancy withdrawn).']
  sdv_coverage_percentage decimal(5,2) [note: 'The percentage of eligible data points for this subject visit that have been verified as part of this SDV activity. Supports monitoring KPI reporting and RBM coverage tracking at the visit level.']
  sdv_method varchar [note: 'The SDV sampling strategy applied to this data point: 100% SDV (all data points verified), targeted (specific critical fields), risk-based (driven by RBM algorithm), or triggered (initiated by a specific risk signal or query).']
  sdv_outcome varchar [note: 'The result of the SDV activity for this specific data point: verified (eCRF matches source), discrepancy_found (mismatch identified), not_verifiable (source document unavailable or illegible), or pending (SDV not yet completed).']
  sdv_performed_timestamp timestamp [note: 'The date and time at which the CRA performed the SDV activity for this specific data point. Principal business event timestamp. Supports ALCOA+ Contemporaneous principle and 21 CFR Part 11 audit trail.']
  sdv_reference_number varchar [note: 'Externally-known business identifier for this SDV record, used in monitoring visit reports, audit trails, and regulatory submissions. Generated by the source system']
  sdv_type varchar [note: 'Source data verification type. Implements ICH E6(R2) GCP 5.18 SDV concept.']
  source_document_type varchar [note: 'Classification of the source document used for verification (e.g., medical record, lab report, ECG tracing). Supports audit trail and ALCOA+ Original principle.']
  source_document_value decimal(18,2) [note: 'The value as recorded in the original source document (e.g., medical record, lab report, nurse notes) against which the eCRF field value was verified. Supports ALCOA+ Attributable and Original principles.']
  source_system_record_reference varchar [note: 'The unique identifier of this SDV record as assigned by the originating system (the source system or Medidata Rave). Supports data lineage, reconciliation, and audit trail between the Silver Layer and the operational system of record.']
  subject_number varchar [note: 'Subject identifier. PII. Implements SDTM DM.SUBJID / USUBJID subject identifier concept.']
  updated_timestamp timestamp [note: 'The date and time when this SDV record was last modified. Supports change tracking, audit trail, and incremental data loading in the Databricks Silver Layer.']
  waiver_justification varchar [note: 'Narrative justification for waiving SDV on this data point, referencing the applicable RBM plan section or risk assessment. Populated only when is_sdv_waived is True.']

  Note: 'Source Data Verification (SDV) record capturing the verification of individual eCRF data points against source documents at the site. Tracks subject visit, eCRF field or data point verified, SDV outcome (verified, discrepancy found, not verifiable)'
}

Table monitoring.visit_deviation_finding {
  visit_deviation_finding_id varchar [pk, note: 'Unique surrogate identifier for each protocol deviation finding record captured during monitoring or data review activities in the source system']
  action_item_id varchar [note: 'Foreign key linking to monitoring.action_item. Business justification: Protocol deviation findings identified during monitoring visits typically generate action items for site remediation.']

  arm_id varchar [note: 'Foreign key linking to study.arm. Business justification: Protocol deviations are analyzed by treatment arm for safety and efficacy integrity — \'Arm-Specific Protocol Deviation Analysis\' is critical for DSMB reviews and unblinding decisions.']

  irt_transaction_id varchar [note: 'Foreign key linking to randomization.irt_transaction. Business justification: Protocol deviations caused by IRT system errors (wrong kit dispensed, incorrect randomization number assigned) must be traceable to the specific IRT transaction.']
  lab_result_id varchar [note: 'Foreign key linking to laboratory.lab_result. Business justification: Protocol deviation documentation for lab-related violations (e.g., subject continued on study despite lab value meeting stopping criteria, missed mandatory safety lab).']
  monitoring_cra_assignment_id varchar [note: 'Foreign key linking to monitoring.monitoring_cra_assignment. Business justification: Deviation findings are identified by the CRA assigned to the site. Business justification: Protocol deviation findings are identified during monitoring visits. Linking visit_deviation_finding to monitoring_visit_schedule provides the visit context in which the']
  protocol_id varchar [note: 'Foreign key linking to study.protocol. Business justification: Protocol deviations are classified against specific protocol sections and versions — ICH E6 R2 and FDA 21 CFR require deviation reports to reference the governing protocol.']
  serious_adverse_event_id varchar [note: 'Foreign key linking to safety.serious_adverse_event. Business justification: Protocol deviations related to SAE reporting (late 15-day reporting, missing expedited reports) are captured as visit_deviation_findings and must reference the specific SAE.']
  specimen_collection_id varchar [note: 'Foreign key linking to laboratory.specimen_collection. Business justification: Deviation findings during monitoring visits frequently relate to specimen collection errors (wrong tube type, missed fasting, incorrect timepoint).']
  specimen_shipment_id varchar [note: 'Foreign key linking to laboratory.specimen_shipment. Business justification: Monitoring visits identify shipment-related deviations (temperature excursion during transit, late receipt beyond stability window, missing specimens).']
  study_id varchar [note: 'Foreign key to the study this record belongs to, for study context and traceability.']
  study_protocol_amendment_id varchar [note: 'Foreign key linking to study.study_protocol_amendment. Business justification: Deviations frequently occur because a protocol amendment was not yet implemented at the site — \'Amendment Implementation Deviation Tracking\' is a named CRO process.']
  study_site_id varchar [note: 'Reference to the investigational site at which the protocol deviation occurred. Enables site-level deviation trending and risk-based monitoring (RBM) analytics.']
  subject_randomization_id varchar [note: 'Foreign key linking to randomization.subject_randomization. Business justification: Deviation findings frequently involve randomization errors — wrong treatment arm assignment, IRT non-compliance, or eligibility violations at randomization.']
  subject_visit_data_id varchar [note: 'Foreign key linking to datamanagement.subject_visit_data. Business justification: Protocol deviation findings detected during monitoring (e.g., data entered outside visit window, missing required fields) must link to the specific subject visit data']
  submission_id varchar [note: 'Foreign key linking to regulatory.submission. Business justification: Deviation findings flagged as regulatory_authority_reportable must be linked to the specific submission for filing.']
  tmf_document_id varchar [note: 'Foreign key linking to document.tmf_document. Business justification: Protocol deviation findings must be documented and filed in the eTMF per ICH GCP. Inspectors require direct traceability from each deviation finding record to its supporting TMF-filed']
  trial_subject_id varchar [note: 'Reference to the clinical trial subject (patient) affected by this protocol deviation. Nullable when the deviation is site-level or procedural rather than subject-specific.']
  validation_rule_id varchar [note: 'Foreign key linking to datamanagement.validation_rule. Business justification: Protocol deviations identified during monitoring are often associated with a specific validation rule violation (eligibility check, visit window rule).']
  visit_id varchar [note: 'Foreign key linking to subject.subject_visit. Business justification: Deviation findings are tied to a specific subject visit (e.g., missed assessment at Visit 3, wrong procedure at screening).']
  visit_report_id varchar [note: 'Foreign key linking to monitoring.visit_report. Business justification: Protocol deviation findings identified during a monitoring visit are documented in the visit_report.']
  capa_required boolean [note: 'Indicates whether a formal Corrective and Preventive Action (CAPA) workflow must be initiated for this deviation. Typically True for major deviations and recurring minor deviations. Drives CAPA creation in MasterControl.']
  classification_type varchar [note: 'Indicates whether the deviation was identified and approved prospectively (before the deviation occurred, as a planned exception) or retrospectively (after the deviation occurred).']
  comments varchar [note: 'Free-text field for additional comments, clarifications, or contextual notes related to the deviation finding that do not fit into structured fields. Captured by the CRA or data manager in the source system']
  created_timestamp timestamp [note: 'System timestamp when the deviation finding record was first created in the source system Supports ALCOA+ audit trail requirements and data lineage tracking.']
  data_integrity_impact boolean [note: 'Indicates whether the protocol deviation compromised the integrity or reliability of the clinical data collected for the affected subject or visit. Impacts subject\'s inclusion in the Intent-to-Treat (ITT) or Per Protocol (PP) analysis populations.']
  detection_method varchar [note: 'The method by which the protocol deviation was identified. Supports risk-based monitoring (RBM) effectiveness analysis and helps identify whether centralized monitoring or on-site monitoring is more effective at detecting specific deviation types.']
  deviation_description varchar [note: 'Detailed narrative description of the protocol deviation, including what occurred, which protocol section was deviated from, and the specific circumstances.']
  deviation_status varchar [note: 'Current lifecycle status of the deviation finding record within the monitoring workflow. Drives CAPA initiation, sponsor notification, and regulatory reporting workflows in the source system']
  identification_date date [note: 'The calendar date on which the protocol deviation was first identified, either during an on-site monitoring visit, remote monitoring review, or data management query. Used to calculate detection lag and reporting deadline compliance.']
  identified_by varchar [note: 'Name or role identifier of the person who identified the protocol deviation (e.g., CRA name, data manager, site staff). Supports accountability tracking and ALCOA+ attributability requirements.']
  impact_assessment varchar [note: 'Narrative assessment of the actual or potential impact of the deviation on subject safety, data integrity, and study validity. Informs the severity classification and determines whether regulatory reporting is required.']
  irb_iec_report_date date [note: 'The date on which the protocol deviation was formally reported to the Institutional Review Board (IRB) or Independent Ethics Committee (IEC). Null if irb_iec_reportable is False or reporting is pending.']
  irb_iec_reportable boolean [note: 'IRB/IEC reportability flag. Implements ICH E6(R2) GCP 4.5.1 IRB/IEC reporting concept.']
  last_updated_timestamp timestamp [note: 'System timestamp of the most recent modification to the deviation finding record. Required for audit trail compliance under 21 CFR Part 11 and ICH E6(R2) electronic records requirements.']
  occurrence_date date [note: 'The calendar date on which the protocol deviation actually occurred at the site. This is the real-world event date, distinct from the identification date. Critical for regulatory reporting timelines and IRB/IEC notification windows.']
  protocol_section_reference varchar [note: 'The specific section number or clause of the study protocol that was deviated from (e.g., \'Section 6.3.2 - Visit Window\'). Enables protocol-level deviation frequency analysis and supports regulatory submission documentation.']
  recurrence_flag boolean [note: 'Indicates whether this deviation represents a recurrence of a previously identified deviation of the same category at this site. Recurring deviations trigger escalated CAPA requirements and may indicate systemic site quality issues.']
  regulatory_authority_reportable boolean [note: 'Regulatory authority reportability flag. Implements ICH E6(R2) GCP 5.20 regulatory reporting concept.']
  resolution_date date [note: 'The date on which the protocol deviation was formally resolved and closed in the source system Null if the deviation is still open or under review. Used to calculate deviation resolution cycle time KPIs.']
  resolution_description varchar [note: 'Narrative description of the actions taken to resolve the protocol deviation, including immediate corrective actions implemented at the site. Distinct from the formal CAPA plan, this captures the immediate remediation steps.']
  root_cause varchar [note: 'Narrative description of the identified root cause of the protocol deviation, as determined through investigation by the site or sponsor. Used to drive CAPA development and systemic issue identification across sites.']
  root_cause_category varchar [note: 'Standardized categorical classification of the deviation root cause to enable cross-site and cross-study trending. Supports risk-based monitoring (RBM) signal detection and CAPA effectiveness analysis.']
  sdtm_dv_category varchar [note: 'Protocol deviation category. Implements SDTM DV.DVCAT (Protocol Deviations domain).']
  sdtm_dv_term varchar [note: 'Protocol deviation term. Implements SDTM DV.DVTERM (Protocol Deviations domain).']
  severity varchar [note: 'Regulatory severity classification of the protocol deviation. \'major\' deviations may affect subject safety or data integrity and typically require IRB/IEC and sponsor reporting.']
  source_system_record_reference varchar [note: 'The native record identifier from the originating operational system (the source system for this deviation finding. Supports data lineage, reconciliation, and audit trail requirements between the Silver Layer lakehouse and the system of record.']
  sponsor_report_date date [note: 'The date on which the protocol deviation was formally reported to the study sponsor. Null if sponsor_reportable is False or reporting is pending. Used to track compliance with sponsor notification timelines.']
  sponsor_reportable boolean [note: 'Indicates whether this deviation must be formally reported to the study sponsor per the Clinical Trial Agreement (CTA) and sponsor SOPs. All major deviations and important protocol deviations (IPDs) are typically sponsor-reportable.']
  subject_number varchar [note: 'Subject identifier. PII. Implements SDTM DM.SUBJID subject identifier concept.']
  subject_safety_impact boolean [note: 'Subject safety impact flag. Implements ICH E6(R2) GCP 4.5 subject safety concept.']

  Note: 'Record of each protocol deviation identified at a site during monitoring or data review. Captures deviation category and severity (major, minor, important), description, root cause, affected subject, dates of occurrence and identification, IRB/IEC and'
}

  quality_event_id varchar [note: 'Foreign key linking to compliance.quality_event. Business justification: Monitoring visit findings of sufficient severity (GCP violations, data integrity issues) are escalated as quality events in the QMS.']
  serious_adverse_event_id varchar [note: 'Foreign key linking to safety.serious_adverse_event. Business justification: Monitoring findings about SAE reporting timeliness failures or documentation deficiencies must reference the specific SAE.']
  specimen_collection_id varchar [note: 'Foreign key linking to laboratory.specimen_collection. Business justification: Visit findings frequently relate to specimen collection issues (missed collections, protocol deviations in collection procedure).']
  study_id varchar [note: 'Reference to the clinical study protocol under which this finding was recorded. Supports cross-site and cross-visit finding analysis at the study level.']
  study_protocol_amendment_id varchar [note: 'Foreign key linking to study.study_protocol_amendment. Business justification: Findings are often triggered by protocol amendments not yet implemented at sites.']
  study_site_id varchar [note: 'Reference to the investigational site at which the finding was identified. Enables site-level aggregation and trending of findings for risk-based monitoring (RBM) analytics.']
  subject_randomization_id varchar [note: 'Foreign key linking to randomization.rand_deviation. Business justification: When a CRA identifies a randomization error during a monitoring visit (wrong kit dispensed, incorrect arm assignment), a visit_finding and a rand_deviation are both created.']
  subject_visit_data_id varchar [note: 'Foreign key linking to datamanagement.subject_visit_data. Business justification: Visit findings identifying data integrity issues (missing data, incorrect entries, lock status problems) must be traceable to the specific EDC subject visit data record.']
  temperature_excursion_id varchar [note: 'Foreign key linking to supply.temperature_excursion. Business justification: When a CRA identifies an IP storage finding during a monitoring visit, the visit_finding record must reference the specific temperature_excursion record for CAPA traceability and']
  tmf_document_id varchar [note: 'Foreign key linking to document.tmf_document. Business justification: Monitoring findings must be traceable to their TMF-filed evidence for GCP inspection readiness. QA teams and inspectors navigate from finding records to filed documents during audits.']
  trial_subject_id varchar [note: 'Reference to the study subject (patient) associated with this finding, where the finding is subject-specific (e.g., missing ICF, unreported AE for a specific subject). Null for site-level or system-level findings not attributable to a specific subject.']

  cra_verification_comment varchar [note: 'Narrative comment entered by the CRA when verifying the adequacy of the site\'s corrective action. Documents the CRA\'s assessment of whether the resolution is satisfactory and the finding can be closed.']
  created_timestamp timestamp [note: 'The date and time at which this finding record was first created in the Clinical Trial Management System (CTMS). Supports audit trail requirements under 21 CFR Part 11 and ALCOA+ principles.']
  data_integrity_impact boolean [note: 'Indicates whether this finding has a direct impact on the integrity of clinical trial data, including eCRF entries, source documents, or audit trails. True findings may affect the reliability of data submitted in regulatory dossiers (IND, NDA, BLA, MAA).']
  due_date date [note: 'Target date by which the site is required to resolve the finding and provide evidence of corrective action. Determined based on finding severity and sponsor/CRO standard operating procedures (SOPs).']
  escalation_date date [note: 'The date on which this finding was escalated beyond the standard CRA-site resolution process. Null if escalation_level is \'none\'. Used to track escalation timeliness and sponsor oversight effectiveness.']
  escalation_level varchar [note: 'Current escalation level of the finding indicating how far up the oversight hierarchy the finding has been escalated. none: no escalation required. cra_manager: escalated to CRA line manager or clinical operations lead.']
  finding_category varchar [note: 'High-level classification of the finding domain as observed by the CRA. Categories align with GCP monitoring focus areas: data_integrity (eCRF/EDC discrepancies), informed_consent (ICF process issues), ip_accountability (investigational product handling)']
  finding_description varchar [note: 'Detailed narrative description of the finding as documented by the CRA, including the specific observation, the GCP or protocol requirement that was not met, and the context in which the finding was identified.']
  finding_number varchar [note: 'Externally-visible, human-readable unique reference number assigned to this finding within the Clinical Trial Management System (CTMS). Used in monitoring visit reports, sponsor communications, and regulatory correspondence.']
  finding_subcategory varchar [note: 'Granular sub-classification within the finding category providing more specific context (e.g., \'missing source document\', \'late SAE reporting\', \'temperature excursion\', \'unsigned ICF\'). Supports detailed root cause analysis and CAPA trending.']
  gcp_reference varchar [note: 'GCP reference. Implements ICH E6(R2) Good Clinical Practice guideline reference.']
  identified_date date [note: 'The calendar date on which the CRA identified and documented this finding during the monitoring visit or remote review. Represents the principal real-world event date for this observation.']
  monitoring_approach varchar [note: 'The monitoring methodology used when the finding was identified. on_site: CRA physically present at the investigational site. remote: CRA conducting review via electronic access to site data.']
  preventive_action varchar [note: 'Description of the preventive measures implemented or planned to prevent recurrence of this finding. Captured as part of the CAPA workflow and documented in the monitoring visit report follow-up.']
  regulatory_impact boolean [note: 'Indicates whether this finding has potential regulatory impact requiring notification to or action by a regulatory authority (FDA, EMA, MHRA, PMDA, etc.) or ethics committee (IRB/IEC).']
  repeat_finding boolean [note: 'Indicates whether this finding is a recurrence of a previously identified finding at the same site for the same category. Repeat findings are a key risk indicator in risk-based monitoring (RBM) and may trigger escalation or CAPA initiation.']
  resolution_status varchar [note: 'Current workflow state of the finding in its resolution lifecycle. open: finding identified, awaiting site response. in_progress: site has acknowledged and is working on resolution. resolved: corrective action completed and verified by CRA.']
  resolved_date date [note: 'The actual date on which the finding was resolved and the corrective action was verified as complete by the CRA. Null if the finding has not yet been resolved. Used to calculate resolution cycle time for KPI reporting.']
  root_cause varchar [note: 'The identified root cause of the finding as determined through investigation by the site or CRA. Documented as part of the CAPA or corrective action process.']
  sdv_completed boolean [note: 'Indicates whether the required Source Data Verification (SDV) for this finding has been completed by the CRA. Applicable only when sdv_required is True.']
  sdv_required boolean [note: 'Indicates whether Source Data Verification (SDV) is required as part of the corrective action for this finding. True when the finding involves data discrepancies that require verification against original source documents.']
  severity varchar [note: 'Risk-based severity classification of the finding indicating its potential impact on subject safety, data integrity, or regulatory compliance. Critical: immediate risk to subject safety or data integrity requiring urgent action.']
  site_response varchar [note: 'Narrative response provided by the site (Principal Investigator or Clinical Research Coordinator) acknowledging the finding and describing the corrective actions taken or planned. Captured in the CTMS and included in the monitoring visit report.']
  site_response_date date [note: 'The date on which the site provided its formal response to the finding. Used to measure site responsiveness and compliance with response timelines defined in the monitoring plan.']
  subject_number varchar [note: 'Subject identifier. PII. Implements SDTM DM.SUBJID subject identifier concept.']
  subject_safety_impact boolean [note: 'Indicates whether this finding has a direct or potential impact on the safety or welfare of study subjects. True findings require immediate escalation per GCP requirements and may trigger safety reporting obligations.']
  updated_timestamp timestamp [note: 'The date and time at which this finding record was most recently modified in the CTMS. Supports audit trail requirements and change tracking under 21 CFR Part 11 and ALCOA+ principles.']
  visit_type varchar [note: 'Type of monitoring visit during which this finding was identified. site_initiation: pre-enrollment site setup visit. interim_monitoring: routine on-site or remote monitoring visit. close_out: end-of-study visit.']

  Note: 'Individual finding or observation recorded by a CRA during a monitoring visit or remote review. Captures finding category (data integrity, consent, IP accountability, safety reporting, regulatory compliance), severity, description, site response'
}

  gcp_reference varchar [note: 'GCP reference. Implements ICH E6(R2) Good Clinical Practice guideline reference.']

Includes observed facts, regulatory reference, and expected corrective action per GCP documentation standards (ALCOA+).']

Table monitoring.risk_indicator {

  health_authority_id varchar [note: 'Foreign key linking to regulatory.health_authority. Business justification: KRIs are frequently mapped 1:1 to SLA thresholds in CRO contracts (e.g., query rate, data entry lag, SDV completion).']
  icf_version_id varchar [note: 'Foreign key linking to consent.consent_icf_version. Business justification: Centralized monitoring KRIs are defined to track consent compliance metrics for a specific ICF version (e.g., reconsent completion rate for ICF v3.0, % subjects on current']

  lab_facility_id varchar [note: 'Foreign key linking to laboratory.lab_facility. Business justification: Centralized monitoring KRIs are computed per lab facility (turnaround time breach rate, specimen rejection rate, critical value reporting timeliness).']
  lab_panel_id varchar [note: 'Foreign key linking to laboratory.lab_panel. Business justification: Risk-Based Monitoring (RBM) plans define KRIs per lab panel (e.g., safety panel completion rate, critical value rate by panel).']
  monitoring_cra_assignment_id varchar [note: 'Reference to the monitoring visit (on-site or remote) during which this KRI was reviewed or triggered a visit activity. Links centralized monitoring findings to on-site monitoring actions.']

  rand_scheme_id varchar [note: 'Foreign key linking to randomization.rand_scheme. Business justification: Risk-based monitoring KRIs are computed for randomization-specific metrics — IRT non-compliance rate, randomization error rate, stratification imbalance.']
  risk_assessment_id varchar [note: 'Foreign key linking to compliance.risk_assessment. Business justification: RBM KRI thresholds and amber/red limits are directly derived from the formal compliance risk_assessment.']
  statistical_endpoint_id varchar [note: 'Foreign key linking to biostatistics.statistical_endpoint. Business justification: KRIs in RBM are defined per statistical endpoint (e.g., missing primary endpoint data rate, primary endpoint query rate).']
  study_id varchar [note: 'Reference to the clinical study for which this Key Risk Indicator (KRI) is defined. Links the KRI to its parent protocol and RBM monitoring plan.']
  study_site_id varchar [note: 'Reference to the investigational site for which the KRI value is computed. A single KRI definition may produce one computed record per site, enabling site-level risk scoring within the RBM framework.']
  validation_rule_id varchar [note: 'Foreign key linking to datamanagement.validation_rule. Business justification: RBM KRIs tracking edit check failure rates or query generation rates are directly derived from specific validation rules.']
  alert_status varchar [note: 'Current risk alert status of the KRI for the site, derived by comparing the computed value against amber and red thresholds. Drives site risk scoring and monitoring intensity decisions in the RBM framework.']
  amber_threshold decimal(18,4) [note: 'Numeric threshold value at which the KRI triggers an amber (warning) alert, indicating elevated risk requiring heightened monitoring attention. Defined in the RBM monitoring plan.']
  calculation_method varchar [note: 'Formal description or formula specifying how the KRI value is computed (e.g., \'Number of screen failures / Number of subjects screened × 100\'). Ensures reproducibility and auditability of centralized statistical monitoring (CSM) outputs.']
  capa_required boolean [note: 'Indicates whether a Corrective and Preventive Action (CAPA) must be initiated in response to the KRI breach. Drives workflow integration with MasterControl CAPA tracking.']
  computation_date date [note: 'Calendar date on which the KRI value was most recently computed for the site. Used to assess data currency and trigger recomputation schedules in the RBM monitoring plan.']
  computation_frequency varchar [note: 'Scheduled frequency at which the KRI is recomputed for each site (e.g., weekly for enrollment KRIs, monthly for data quality KRIs). Defined in the RBM monitoring plan.']
  computation_timestamp timestamp [note: 'Precise date and time at which the KRI value was computed, including timezone offset. Supports audit trail requirements under 21 CFR Part 11 and ALCOA+ principles.']
  computed_value decimal(18,4) [note: 'Current computed numeric value of the KRI for the associated site, derived from the source system data as of the last computation run. This is the principal quantitative fact of the risk indicator record.']
  consecutive_breach_count varchar [note: 'Number of consecutive computation cycles during which the KRI has remained at or above the amber or red threshold. Used to trigger escalation workflows and CAPA initiation per the RBM monitoring plan.']
  created_timestamp timestamp [note: 'Timestamp when this KRI record was first created in the system, supporting audit trail requirements under 21 CFR Part 11 and ALCOA+ principles.']
  data_source varchar [note: 'Operational system of record from which the KRI input data is extracted for computation (e.g., Medidata Rave EDC for data quality KRIs, the source system for safety KRIs, the source system for enrollment KRIs).']
  denominator_value decimal(18,4) [note: 'Raw denominator component of the KRI computation (e.g., total subjects screened, total expected data points, total SAEs reported). Stored alongside the numerator to enable independent verification of the computed value.']
  effective_from date [note: 'Date from which this KRI definition became active and applicable to the study and site. Supports versioning of KRI definitions when monitoring plan amendments are issued.']
  effective_until date [note: 'Date on which this KRI definition was superseded or retired. Null for currently active KRI definitions. Supports historical analysis and monitoring plan amendment tracking.']
  escalation_required boolean [note: 'Indicates whether the current KRI alert status and breach history require formal escalation to the sponsor, Data Safety Monitoring Board (DSMB), or senior management per the RBM escalation procedure.']
  indicator_description varchar [note: 'Detailed narrative description of what the KRI measures, its business rationale, and how it supports risk detection within the RBM framework.']
  indicator_name varchar [note: 'Human-readable name of the KRI as defined in the RBM monitoring plan (e.g., \'Screen Failure Rate\', \'Missing Data Rate\', \'SAE Reporting Timeliness\'). Used in dashboards, monitoring visit reports, and sponsor communications.']
  indicator_status varchar [note: 'Current lifecycle status of the KRI definition within the monitoring plan. Active KRIs are computed and monitored; draft KRIs are under review; retired KRIs are no longer in use.']
  indicator_type varchar [note: 'Risk indicator type. Implements ICH E6(R2) GCP 5.0 risk-based quality management KRI/QTL concept.']
  is_centralized_monitoring boolean [note: 'Indicates whether this KRI is part of the Centralized Statistical Monitoring (CSM) program, as opposed to a site-level operational indicator. Supports differentiation of CSM KRIs from operational monitoring metrics.']
  notes varchar [note: 'Free-text field for CRA or data manager annotations regarding the KRI computation, alert status, or remediation context. Supports monitoring visit report narrative and sponsor communication.']
  numerator_value decimal(18,4) [note: 'Raw numerator component of the KRI computation (e.g., number of screen failures, number of missing data points, number of overdue SAE reports). Stored to support audit and recomputation validation.']
  prior_computed_value decimal(18,4) [note: 'KRI computed value from the immediately preceding computation cycle for the same site. Enables trend analysis and detection of rapid deterioration or improvement in site risk profile.']
  red_threshold decimal(18,4) [note: 'Numeric threshold value at which the KRI triggers a red (critical) alert, indicating a significant risk requiring immediate escalation and corrective action per the RBM monitoring plan.']
  reference_period_end date [note: 'End date of the data window used to compute the KRI value. Together with reference_period_start, defines the exact temporal scope of the KRI computation for reproducibility and audit.']
  reference_period_start date [note: 'Start date of the data window used to compute the KRI value (e.g., rolling 30-day window start, or study start date for cumulative KRIs). Defines the temporal scope of the computation.']
  risk_indicator_category varchar [note: 'Business category classifying the domain of risk the KRI monitors. Supports stratified risk reporting across enrollment, data quality, safety, protocol compliance, and Investigational Product (IP) accountability domains.']
  risk_score_contribution decimal(5,2) [note: 'Weighted contribution of this KRI to the overall site risk score, expressed as a percentage (0–100). Reflects the KRI\'s relative importance in the composite site risk scoring model.']
  sdv_impact varchar [note: 'Defines the impact of this KRI\'s alert status on the Source Data Verification (SDV) strategy for the site. A red alert may trigger targeted or increased SDV; a green status may support reduced SDV per the risk-adaptive monitoring plan.']
  sponsor_defined boolean [note: 'Indicates whether this KRI was defined by the sponsor (True) or by the CRO as part of its standard RBM methodology (False). Supports differentiation of sponsor-mandated versus CRO-standard risk indicators.']
  threshold_direction varchar [note: 'Indicates whether the KRI alert is triggered when the computed value exceeds (above) or falls below (below) the defined amber/red thresholds. Critical for correct alert logic in centralized statistical monitoring (CSM).']
  trend_direction varchar [note: 'Directional trend of the KRI value compared to the prior computation cycle. Supports proactive risk management by identifying sites where risk is worsening before threshold breach.']
  unit_of_measure varchar [note: 'Unit in which the KRI value and thresholds are expressed (e.g., \'%\', \'days\', \'count\', \'ratio\'). Ensures consistent interpretation of computed values across sites and studies.']
  updated_timestamp timestamp [note: 'Timestamp of the most recent modification to this KRI record, supporting change tracking and audit trail requirements under 21 CFR Part 11.']
  version_number varchar [note: 'Version identifier of the KRI definition (e.g., v1.0, v2.1), incremented when the calculation method, thresholds, or data source is amended. Supports audit trail and regulatory inspection readiness.']
  weight decimal(5,2) [note: 'Numeric weight assigned to this KRI in the composite site risk scoring model, reflecting its relative importance compared to other KRIs in the monitoring plan. Used in weighted risk score calculations.']

  Note: 'Centralized monitoring risk indicator (also known as Key Risk Indicator or KRI) defined within the RBM monitoring plan. Captures indicator name, category (enrollment, data quality, safety, protocol compliance, IP accountability), calculation method'
}

  critical_kri_breaches_count varchar [note: 'Number of KRI breaches classified as critical severity (i.e., exceeding the upper alert threshold). Critical breaches may trigger immediate unscheduled monitoring visits or escalation.']
  data_entry_lag_days varchar [note: 'Average number of days between the date of clinical observation and the date of entry into the Electronic Data Capture (EDC) system (Medidata Rave) during the assessment period. A key KRI for data quality monitoring.']
  enrollment_rate_percent decimal(5,2) [note: 'Actual subject enrollment as a percentage of the planned enrollment target for the assessment period. Significant under-enrollment is a KRI that may indicate site performance issues.']
  kri_breaches_count varchar [note: 'Total number of individual Key Risk Indicators (KRIs) that exceeded their defined threshold limits during the assessment period. A key input to the overall risk score calculation.']
  major_protocol_deviation_count varchar [note: 'Number of major (significant) protocol deviations recorded at the site during the assessment period. Major deviations may affect subject safety or data integrity and are a high-weight KRI.']
  next_assessment_due_date date [note: 'Scheduled due date for the next periodic site risk assessment, calculated based on the approved monitoring visit frequency and risk tier. Drives scheduling in the source system']
  outstanding_queries_count varchar [note: 'Number of open, unresolved data queries in the EDC system (Medidata Rave) at the end of the assessment period. Reflects site responsiveness and data management performance.']
  overall_risk_score decimal(5,2) [note: 'Composite numeric risk score for the site calculated from weighted Key Risk Indicator (KRI) values. Higher scores indicate greater risk. Used to determine risk tier classification and adaptive monitoring intensity.']
  previous_risk_score decimal(5,2) [note: 'Overall risk score from the immediately preceding assessment cycle. Enables trend analysis and score delta calculation to detect improving or deteriorating site performance.']
  previous_risk_tier varchar [note: 'Risk tier assigned during the immediately preceding assessment cycle. Used to identify tier escalations or de-escalations and trigger CAPA workflows when a site moves to a higher risk tier.']
  protocol_deviation_count varchar [note: 'Total number of protocol deviations recorded at the site during the assessment period. Includes both major and minor deviations as classified per the study deviation management plan.']
  query_rate_percent decimal(5,2) [note: 'Percentage of Electronic Case Report Form (eCRF) fields that generated data queries during the assessment period. High query rates indicate data quality issues and are a primary KRI in the RBM framework.']
  recommended_monitoring_intensity varchar [note: 'Assessor\'s recommendation for adjusting the monitoring visit frequency and SDV scope based on the current risk tier and KRI findings. Drives adaptive monitoring plan updates in the source system']
  recommended_sdv_scope_percent decimal(5,2) [note: 'Recommended percentage of eCRF data fields to be subject to Source Data Verification (SDV) in the next monitoring cycle, adjusted based on the current risk tier.']
  recommended_visit_frequency varchar [note: 'Specific recommended visit frequency for the next monitoring cycle, derived from the risk tier and monitoring intensity recommendation. Used to update the site monitoring schedule in the source system']
  risk_assessment_notes varchar [note: 'Free-text narrative field capturing the assessor\'s qualitative observations, contextual factors, and rationale for the risk score and recommended monitoring adjustments not captured by structured KRI fields.']
  risk_management_plan_version varchar [note: 'Version identifier of the study-level Risk Management Plan (RMP) under which this assessment was conducted. Ensures traceability of KRI thresholds and scoring methodology to the applicable plan version.']
  risk_tier varchar [note: 'Categorical risk tier assigned to the site based on the overall risk score thresholds defined in the Risk Management Plan. Directly drives monitoring visit frequency and Source Data Verification (SDV) scope in the source system']
  screen_failure_rate_percent decimal(5,2) [note: 'Percentage of screened subjects who failed to meet eligibility criteria and were not enrolled during the assessment period. Elevated screen failure rates are a KRI for patient recruitment quality.']
  sdv_completion_percent decimal(5,2) [note: 'Percentage of Source Data Verification (SDV) tasks completed against the planned SDV scope for the assessment period. Reflects monitoring coverage and data integrity assurance.']
  source_system_record_reference varchar [note: 'Native record identifier from the source system for this risk assessment record. Supports data lineage, reconciliation, and audit trail back to the operational system of record.']
  subject_dropout_rate_percent decimal(5,2) [note: 'Percentage of enrolled subjects who discontinued participation during the assessment period. High dropout rates are a KRI that may indicate site management or patient engagement issues.']
  updated_timestamp timestamp [note: 'Timestamp of the most recent modification to this site risk assessment record. Required for change tracking, audit trail, and data lineage in the Databricks Silver Layer.']

  Note: 'Periodic risk assessment of an investigational site within the RBM framework. Captures overall site risk score, individual KRI values and threshold breaches, risk tier classification (low, medium, high), assessment date, assessor, recommended monitoring'
}

  monitoring_approach varchar [note: 'Primary monitoring methodology authorized for this CRA-site assignment under the risk-based monitoring (RBM) plan. \'on_site\' requires physical presence; \'remote\' uses EDC and electronic review; \'hybrid\' combines both; \'centralized\' is performed by a']
  next_planned_visit_date date [note: 'Scheduled date for the next monitoring visit by this CRA at the assigned site. Populated by the source system visit scheduling logic based on visit frequency and last visit date. Supports proactive workload planning.']
