  quantity_destroyed varchar [note: 'The total quantity of investigational product units destroyed at the site or returned to sponsor for destruction, as documented in the destruction records. Required for full IP accountability reconciliation.']
  quantity_dispensed varchar [note: 'The total quantity of investigational product units dispensed to study subjects at the site, as recorded in the dispensing log. Used in the IP accountability reconciliation calculation.']
  quantity_on_hand varchar [note: 'The physical count of investigational product units remaining in site inventory at the time of the CRA verification visit. Compared against the calculated balance (received minus dispensed minus returned minus destroyed) to identify discrepancies.']
  quantity_received varchar [note: 'The total quantity of investigational product units received at the site from the sponsor or depot, as recorded in the site\'s IP receipt log. Expressed in the unit of dispensing (e.g., number of tablets, vials, kits).']
  quantity_returned varchar [note: 'The total quantity of investigational product units returned by subjects to the site (unused or partially used), as recorded in the return log. Included in the reconciliation to account for all IP.']
  quantity_unit varchar [note: 'The unit of measure used for all IP quantity fields (received, dispensed, returned, destroyed, on hand) in this record (e.g., \'tablet\', \'vial\', \'kit\'). Ensures consistent interpretation of quantity values across reconciliation.']
  reconciliation_status varchar [note: 'The outcome status of the IP quantity reconciliation performed by the CRA. \'Balanced\' indicates quantities account for all IP; \'Discrepancy Identified\' indicates a mismatch requiring investigation. Drives CAPA and escalation workflows.']
  return_log_reviewed boolean [note: 'Indicates whether the CRA reviewed the site\'s IP return log during the monitoring visit to verify that all returned IP units are documented with subject ID, return date, and quantity.']
  review_period_end_date date [note: 'The end date of the period covered by this IP accountability review (i.e., the date up to which IP transactions are being reconciled). Typically corresponds to the current monitoring visit date.']
  review_period_start_date date [note: 'The start date of the period covered by this IP accountability review (i.e., the date from which IP transactions are being reconciled). Typically corresponds to the date of the previous monitoring visit or last accountability check.']
  rtsm_irt_reconciled boolean [note: 'Indicates whether the site\'s physical IP accountability records have been reconciled against the RTSM/IRT system (e.g., Medidata Rave RTSM) dispensing and randomization data. Discrepancies between physical records and RTSM/IRT are a critical GCP finding.']
  sponsor_notification_date date [note: 'The date on which the sponsor was notified of IP accountability findings or discrepancies. Populated when sponsor_notified is True. Used to track timeliness of sponsor communication per GCP requirements.']
  sponsor_notified boolean [note: 'Indicates whether the sponsor has been notified of IP accountability discrepancies, temperature excursions, or critical findings identified during this verification. Required for critical and major findings under GCP.']
  storage_condition_verified boolean [note: 'Indicates whether the CRA verified that the investigational product was stored under the protocol-specified conditions (e.g., temperature range, light protection, humidity) at the time of the monitoring visit.']
  storage_temperature_max_c decimal(5,2) [note: 'The maximum temperature (in degrees Celsius) recorded in the IP storage area during the period under review, as verified by the CRA from temperature monitoring logs or data loggers. Used to assess compliance with protocol-specified storage conditions.']
  storage_temperature_min_c decimal(5,2) [note: 'The minimum temperature (in degrees Celsius) recorded in the IP storage area during the period under review, as verified by the CRA from temperature monitoring logs or data loggers. Used to assess compliance with protocol-specified storage conditions.']
  temperature_excursion_details varchar [note: 'Free-text description of any temperature excursion identified, including the duration, magnitude, affected IP units, and any corrective actions taken by site staff. Populated only when temperature_excursion_occurred is True.']
  temperature_excursion_occurred boolean [note: 'Indicates whether a temperature excursion (storage outside the protocol-specified temperature range) was identified during the CRA review of temperature monitoring records. True triggers mandatory sponsor notification and potential IP quarantine.']
  updated_timestamp timestamp [note: 'The date and time at which this IP accountability log record was most recently modified, including timezone offset. Supports 21 CFR Part 11 electronic records audit trail and change tracking requirements.']
  verification_date date [note: 'The date on which the CRA performed the IP accountability verification at the site. This is the principal real-world event date for this record, distinct from the record creation timestamp. Required for GCP compliance documentation.']
  verification_status varchar [note: 'The current workflow status of this IP accountability log record. \'Draft\' indicates the CRA has initiated but not finalized the record; \'Completed\' indicates CRA sign-off; \'Reviewed\' indicates supervisor review; \'Approved\' indicates final approval']
  verification_timestamp timestamp [note: 'Precise date and time at which the CRA completed the IP accountability verification, including timezone offset. Supports ALCOA+ (Attributable, Legible, Contemporaneous, Original, Accurate) audit trail requirements under 21 CFR Part 11.']

  Note: 'Investigational Product (IP) accountability verification record captured during monitoring visits. Records CRA verification of IP receipt, dispensing, return, and destruction records at the site level.'
}

  updated_timestamp timestamp [note: 'Date and time when this monitoring checklist record was last modified in the source system. Supports change tracking, audit trail, and incremental data loading in the Databricks Silver Layer.']
  visit_date date [note: 'The actual date on which the monitoring visit and checklist execution occurred. Principal business event date for this checklist record. Used for compliance reporting and visit frequency analysis.']
  visit_mode varchar [note: 'Modality of the monitoring visit — on-site, remote, or hybrid. Affects which checklist items are applicable and how source data verification (SDV) is conducted under risk-based monitoring (RBM) strategies.']

Table biostatistics.sample_size_calc {
  sample_size_calc_id varchar [pk, note: 'Unique surrogate identifier for each sample size calculation record within the biostatistics domain.']
  analysis_population_id varchar [note: 'Foreign key linking to biostatistics.analysis_population. Business justification: sample_size_calc has analysis_population (STRING) indicating which population the sample size calculation targets.']
  arm_id varchar [note: 'Foreign key linking to study.arm. Business justification: Sample size calculations are performed per treatment arm (sample_size_per_arm is a key attribute).']
  endpoint_id varchar [note: 'Foreign key linking to study.endpoint. Business justification: Sample size calculations are driven by the primary endpoint\'s effect size and variability assumptions.']
  protocol_id varchar [note: 'Reference to the specific protocol version under which this sample size calculation was conducted, supporting traceability to protocol amendments.']
  rand_scheme_id varchar [note: 'Foreign key linking to randomization.rand_scheme. Business justification: Sample size calculations depend directly on the randomization scheme\'s allocation_ratio, block structure, and stratification.']
  sap_id varchar [note: 'Reference to the Statistical Analysis Plan (the source system) document that governs or references this sample size calculation.']
  study_id varchar [note: 'Reference to the clinical study for which this sample size calculation was performed.']
  accrual_period_months varchar [note: 'The assumed patient accrual (enrollment) period in months, used in time-to-event sample size calculations to determine the number of events required.']
  allocation_ratio decimal [note: 'The randomization allocation ratio between treatment arms (e.g., \'1:1\', \'2:1\', \'1:1:1\'), specifying the relative number of subjects assigned to each arm.']
  alpha_level decimal(10,6) [note: 'The pre-specified Type I error rate (significance level, alpha) used in the sample size calculation, typically 0.05 for two-sided or 0.025 for one-sided tests.']
  alpha_spending_method varchar [note: 'The alpha-spending function applied to control Type I error across planned interim analyses (e.g., O\'Brien-Fleming, Pocock, Lan-DeMets). Null or \'none\' if no interim analysis is planned.']
  amendment_reason varchar [note: 'Narrative justification for revising a prior version of the sample size calculation, such as updated assumptions from interim data, protocol amendment, or regulatory feedback.']
  approval_date date [note: 'The date on which the sample size calculation was formally approved by the responsible biostatistician, marking readiness for inclusion in regulatory submissions.']
  calc_date date [note: 'The date on which this sample size calculation was performed or finalized, serving as the principal business event date for regulatory traceability.']
  calc_identifier varchar [note: 'Externally-known alphanumeric code or reference number assigned to this sample size calculation, used in regulatory submissions and protocol documentation (e.g., SSC-2024-001).']
  calc_status varchar [note: 'Current lifecycle status of the sample size calculation record, from initial draft through regulatory approval to archival.']
  calc_version varchar [note: 'Version number of this sample size calculation (e.g., v1.0, v2.1), enabling tracking of revisions driven by protocol amendments or updated assumptions.']
  created_timestamp timestamp [note: 'The date and time when this sample size calculation record was first created in the system, supporting audit trail requirements under 21 CFR Part 11.']
  dropout_rate decimal(10,6) [note: 'The assumed proportion of enrolled subjects expected to discontinue or be lost to follow-up, used to inflate the calculated sample size to ensure adequate evaluable subjects.']
  effect_size decimal(18,6) [note: 'The clinically meaningful difference or effect size assumed between treatment arms (e.g., mean difference, odds ratio, hazard ratio) used as the basis for the sample size calculation.']
  effect_size_unit varchar [note: 'Unit of measurement for the assumed effect size (e.g., mmHg, %, hazard ratio, odds ratio, mean difference), providing dimensional context for regulatory interpretation.']
  event_rate_control decimal(10,6) [note: 'The assumed event rate or response rate in the control arm, applicable for binary or time-to-event endpoints. Null for continuous endpoints.']
  event_rate_treatment decimal(10,6) [note: 'The assumed event rate or response rate in the treatment arm, applicable for binary or time-to-event endpoints. Null for continuous endpoints.']
  follow_up_period_months varchar [note: 'The assumed minimum follow-up period in months after the last patient enrolled, used in time-to-event calculations to ensure sufficient events are observed.']
  hypothesis_type varchar [note: 'The statistical hypothesis framework applied (superiority, non-inferiority, equivalence), which determines the directionality and margin used in the sample size formula.']
  interim_analysis_planned boolean [note: 'Indicates whether one or more interim analyses are planned for this study, which may require alpha-spending adjustments to the sample size calculation.']
  median_survival_control decimal(18,6) [note: 'The assumed median survival time in the control arm for time-to-event endpoints, used in log-rank or exponential model-based sample size calculations. Null for non-survival endpoints.']
  non_inferiority_margin decimal(18,6) [note: 'The pre-specified non-inferiority or equivalence margin (delta) used in the hypothesis test, applicable when hypothesis_type is non_inferiority or equivalence. Null for superiority designs.']
  number_of_arms varchar [note: 'Total number of treatment arms (including control) in the study design, used to determine the allocation structure and multiplicity adjustments.']
  number_of_events_required varchar [note: 'The minimum number of primary endpoint events (e.g., deaths, progressions) required to achieve the specified power for time-to-event analyses. Null for non-event-driven endpoints.']
  power decimal(10,6) [note: 'The pre-specified statistical power (1 minus Type II error rate, beta) used in the calculation, representing the probability of detecting the assumed effect size. Typically 0.80 or 0.90.']
  primary_endpoint_type varchar [note: 'Statistical nature of the primary efficacy endpoint (e.g., continuous, binary, time-to-event, ordinal, count) that drives the choice of sample size formula.']
  reference_source varchar [note: 'Citation or reference for the data source used to derive the assumed effect size, standard deviation, or event rate (e.g., published literature citation, prior Phase II study identifier, internal pilot data).']
  sample_size_per_arm varchar [note: 'The calculated number of subjects required per treatment arm to achieve the specified power at the given alpha level, accounting for the assumed effect size and standard deviation.']
  software_name varchar [note: 'Name of the validated statistical software used to perform the sample size calculation (e.g., PASS, nQuery Advisor, SAS PROC POWER, R), required for regulatory audit trail.']
  software_version varchar [note: 'Version number of the statistical software used (e.g., PASS 2023, nQuery 9.1), required for reproducibility and regulatory validation documentation.']
  standard_deviation decimal(18,6) [note: 'The assumed population standard deviation for continuous endpoints, derived from prior studies or literature, used in the sample size formula. Null for non-continuous endpoints.']
  statistical_method varchar [note: 'The specific statistical formula or method used for the calculation (e.g., two-sample t-test, log-rank test, chi-square test, Kaplan-Meier), providing methodological traceability.']
  study_design_type varchar [note: 'The clinical trial design type (e.g., parallel group, crossover, factorial, adaptive) that determines the statistical methodology applied in the sample size calculation.']
  study_phase varchar [note: 'Clinical development phase of the study (Phase I through Phase IV) for which the sample size is being calculated, influencing regulatory expectations and statistical rigor.']
  test_sidedness varchar [note: 'Specifies whether the statistical test is one-sided or two-sided, directly affecting the critical value and resulting sample size.']
  total_enrollment_target varchar [note: 'The total number of subjects to be enrolled (randomized) after inflating the total sample size by the assumed dropout rate, representing the actual recruitment target submitted in the protocol.']
  total_sample_size varchar [note: 'The total number of subjects required across all treatment arms before applying the dropout inflation, representing the minimum evaluable sample.']
  updated_timestamp timestamp [note: 'The date and time when this sample size calculation record was most recently modified, supporting version control and audit trail requirements.']

  Note: 'Records sample size calculations performed during study design and protocol development. Captures study phase, primary endpoint type, assumed effect size, standard deviation, alpha level, power, dropout rate, allocation ratio, calculated sample size per'
}

  output_title varchar [note: 'Full descriptive title of the TLF output as it appears in the header of the produced document (e.g., \'Summary of Adverse Events by System Organ Class and Preferred Term — Safety Population\'). Used for CSR cross-referencing and regulatory submission.']

  production_run_timestamp timestamp [note: 'Date and time when the SAS program was executed to produce this TLF output instance. Serves as the principal business event timestamp for the production lifecycle, supporting ALCOA+ contemporaneous documentation requirements.']

  qc_status varchar [note: 'Current QC validation status of this TLF output. Indicates whether the output has passed independent validation, is pending review, is under active review, has failed validation, or has been formally waived per documented justification.']
  run_number varchar [note: 'Sequential run number for this TLF output, incremented each time the SAS program is executed for the same output_number. Enables tracking of the full production history from first run to final delivery.']
  sas_program_name varchar [note: 'Name of the SAS program file used to produce this TLF output in SAS Drug Development (e.g., t_14_1_1_demog.sas). Provides full program traceability for audit and replication purposes.']
  sas_program_path varchar [note: 'Full file system or repository path to the SAS program in SAS Drug Development used to produce this TLF output. Supports traceability and regulatory inspection readiness.']
  sas_program_version varchar [note: 'Version identifier of the SAS program used to generate this output, as tracked in SAS Drug Development version control. Enables exact reproduction of results and supports regulatory audit trails.']
  unblinding_authorization_ref varchar [note: 'Reference number or document identifier for the formal unblinding authorization (e.g., DSMB/DMC recommendation, sponsor authorization memo) that permitted production of this unblinded TLF output.']

  alpha_spending_function varchar [note: 'The pre-specified alpha spending function used to allocate the overall Type I error rate across interim looks, as defined in the the source system. Common functions include O\'Brien-Fleming, Pocock, Lan-DeMets O\'Brien-Fleming approximation, Lan-DeMets']
  alpha_spending_parameter decimal(8,6) [note: 'Numeric parameter (gamma) for the selected alpha spending function, where applicable (e.g., the gamma parameter for Hwang-Shih-DeCani function). Null for functions that do not require a parameter.']

  analysis_outcome varchar [note: 'The formal decision or recommendation resulting from the interim analysis: continue (study proceeds as planned), stop_efficacy (early termination for demonstrated benefit), stop_futility (early termination for lack of benefit), stop_safety (early']
  analysis_status varchar [note: 'Current lifecycle state of the interim analysis: planned (scheduled but not yet initiated), in_progress (analysis underway), completed (results finalized), cancelled (analysis removed from plan), or on_hold (temporarily suspended).']
  analysis_type varchar [note: 'Classification of the interim analysis by its primary statistical purpose: efficacy (test for early stopping due to benefit), futility (test for early stopping due to lack of benefit), safety (review of accumulating safety data), adaptive (pre-specified']
  conditional_power decimal(5,4) [note: 'Probability of achieving a statistically significant result at the final analysis, conditional on the data observed at this interim look and assuming the originally hypothesized treatment effect. Used in futility assessments.']
  confidentiality_level varchar [note: 'Data classification level assigned to the interim analysis results and associated outputs, controlling access and distribution. Interim analysis results are typically restricted to prevent unblinding of the broader study team.']
  created_timestamp timestamp [note: 'Timestamp when this interim analysis record was first created in the system, supporting audit trail requirements under 21 CFR Part 11 and ALCOA+ data integrity principles.']
  data_cutoff_date date [note: 'The date through which subject data was included in the interim analysis dataset. All data collected after this date is excluded from the analysis. Critical for regulatory traceability and blinding integrity.']
  dsmb_involved boolean [note: 'Indicates whether a Data Safety Monitoring Board (DSMB) or Data Monitoring Committee (DMC) reviewed the unblinded interim analysis results (True = DSMB/DMC reviewed; False = internal review only).']
  dsmb_meeting_date date [note: 'Date on which the Data Safety Monitoring Board (DSMB) or Data Monitoring Committee (DMC) convened to review the interim analysis results and issue a recommendation.']

  events_planned_total varchar [note: 'Total number of primary endpoint events required for the final analysis as specified in the the source system size calculation. Used as the denominator for the information fraction in event-driven trials.']
  firewall_maintained boolean [note: 'Indicates whether a blinding firewall was maintained between the unblinded interim analysis team and the blinded study team (True = firewall in place; False = firewall not maintained or not applicable).']
  futility_boundary_binding boolean [note: 'Indicates whether the futility stopping boundary is binding (True = mandatory stop if crossed; False = non-binding/advisory only). Binding futility boundaries affect the overall Type I error calculation.']
  futility_boundary_value decimal(10,6) [note: 'Pre-specified critical value for the futility stopping boundary at this interim look. If the observed test statistic falls below this boundary, early stopping for futility (lack of efficacy) may be triggered.']

  information_fraction_planned decimal(5,4) [note: 'Pre-specified proportion of the total planned statistical information (e.g., events, subjects) accumulated at the time of this interim analysis, expressed as a decimal between 0 and 1 (e.g., 0.5000 = 50% of planned events).']
  notes varchar [note: 'Free-text field for capturing additional context, operational notes, deviations from the pre-specified plan, or DSMB/DMC commentary relevant to this interim analysis that is not captured in structured fields.']
  observed_p_value decimal(10,8) [note: 'The nominal p-value from the primary hypothesis test at this interim analysis. Must be interpreted in the context of the alpha spending boundary, not as a standalone significance threshold.']
  observed_test_statistic decimal(10,6) [note: 'The actual computed test statistic (e.g., z-score, chi-square, log-rank statistic) from the interim analysis dataset. Compared against efficacy and futility boundaries to determine the outcome.']
  planned_analysis_date date [note: 'Pre-specified calendar date on which the interim analysis is planned to be conducted, as documented in the the source system charter.']
  regulatory_submission_required boolean [note: 'Indicates whether the interim analysis results or the resulting design adaptation must be submitted to a regulatory authority (FDA, EMA, PMDA, etc.) as part of an IND, NDA, BLA, or MAA amendment (True = submission required; False = not required).']
  results_disclosed_externally boolean [note: 'Indicates whether the interim analysis results have been disclosed externally (e.g., to regulators, in a public registry, or in a publication) prior to study completion (True = disclosed; False = not disclosed).']
  revised_sample_size varchar [note: 'Updated total sample size determined through the pre-specified sample size re-estimation procedure at this interim analysis. Null if sample_size_reestimated is False.']
  sample_size_reestimated boolean [note: 'Indicates whether a pre-specified sample size re-estimation was performed as part of this interim analysis (True = sample size re-estimated; False = no re-estimation performed).']
  sas_program_version varchar [note: 'Version identifier of the SAS Drug Development program or analysis package used to execute this interim analysis, enabling reproducibility and audit traceability.']
  stopping_rule_description varchar [note: 'Narrative description of the specific stopping rule(s) triggered at this interim analysis, including the criterion crossed and the observed vs. boundary values. Populated only when stopping_rule_triggered is True.']
  stopping_rule_triggered boolean [note: 'Indicates whether any pre-specified stopping rule (efficacy, futility, or safety) was triggered by the results of this interim analysis (True = stopping rule crossed; False = no stopping rule triggered).']

  unblinding_scope varchar [note: 'Defines the extent of treatment assignment unblinding performed for this interim analysis: full (all treatment assignments revealed to the analysis team), partial (only aggregate or summary-level unblinding), or none (blinded analysis only).']

  Note: 'Records planned and executed interim analyses for a study. Captures interim analysis number, type (efficacy, futility, safety, adaptive), planned information fraction, actual analysis date, DSMB/DMC involvement flag, unblinding scope (full/partial/none)'

  endpoint_classification varchar [note: 'Hierarchical classification of the endpoint within the study\'s inferential framework: primary (confirmatory, controls Type I error), secondary (supportive), exploratory (hypothesis-generating), or safety (adverse event-related).']

  null_hypothesis varchar [note: 'Formal statement of the null hypothesis (H0) for this endpoint as specified in the the source system is no difference in overall survival between treatment and control arms\'). Required for confirmatory endpoints per ICH E9.']

  sap_version varchar [note: 'Version number of the the source system which this endpoint was defined or last modified (e.g., \'v1.0\', \'v2.1\'). Supports version-controlled traceability of endpoint definitions across the source system to database lock.']
  sensitivity_analysis_flag boolean [note: 'Indicates whether one or more pre-specified sensitivity analyses are defined for this endpoint in the the source system the robustness of the primary analysis results. True if sensitivity analyses are planned; False otherwise.']
  significance_level decimal(6,4) [note: 'Pre-specified Type I error rate (alpha) for this endpoint, typically 0.05 for primary endpoints or adjusted values for multiplicity-controlled secondary endpoints. Defined in the the source system database lock.']
  statistical_test_method varchar [note: 'The primary statistical test or model used to analyze this endpoint (e.g., \'ANCOVA\', \'Log-rank test\', \'Cox proportional hazards model\', \'Mixed Model for Repeated Measures (MMRM)\', \'Wilcoxon rank-sum test\').']

  testing_sequence_order varchar [note: 'Numeric position of this endpoint within the pre-specified hierarchical or fixed-sequence testing procedure. Determines the order in which endpoints are tested to control Type I error. Lower values are tested first.']

  trigger_type varchar [note: 'Classification of the event that necessitated re-consent. Drives workflow routing and regulatory reporting. Values: protocol_amendment (change to study protocol), new_safety_information (SAE/SUSAR/IB update), icf_version_update (administrative ICF']
  updated_timestamp timestamp [note: 'The timestamp at which this re-consent trigger record was most recently modified. Required for audit trail integrity, change tracking, and ALCOA+ compliance in the Silver Layer lakehouse.']

  Note: 'Records events that necessitate re-consent of a subject, such as a protocol amendment, new safety information, ICF version update, or regulatory authority requirement.'

  irb_iec_approval_required boolean [note: 'Indicates whether specific IRB (Institutional Review Board) or IEC (Independent Ethics Committee) approval was required for the use of LAR consent procedures for this subject population at this site.']
  jurisdiction varchar [note: 'The legal jurisdiction (country, state, or province) under whose laws the LAR\'s authority document was issued and is recognized. Governs applicable legal standards for LAR validity (e.g., US-CA, US-NY, GBR, DEU).']
  last_name varchar [note: 'Legal family name or surname of the Legally Authorized Representative as it appears on their government-issued identification or legal authority document.']
  legal_authority_document_date date [note: 'Date on which the legal authority document (e.g., court order, power of attorney) was issued or became effective. Used to validate currency of authorization.']
  legal_authority_document_type varchar [note: 'Classification of the legal instrument that establishes the LAR\'s authority to consent on behalf of the subject (e.g., court order, power of attorney, guardianship certificate). Required for regulatory compliance per 21 CFR 50.3(l).']
  mailing_address_line1 varchar [note: 'First line of the LAR\'s mailing address (street number and name). Used for postal correspondence, regulatory notifications, and ICF delivery.']
  mailing_address_line2 varchar [note: 'Second line of the LAR\'s mailing address (apartment, suite, unit number). Supplements address line 1 for complete postal delivery.']
  mailing_city varchar [note: 'City or municipality of the LAR\'s mailing address. Required for complete postal address and jurisdictional determination.']
  mailing_country_code varchar [note: 'ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 three-letter country code for the LAR\'s mailing address (e.g., USA, GBR, DEU). Determines applicable privacy regulations (GDPR, HIPAA) and legal authority standards.']
  mailing_postal_code varchar [note: 'Postal or ZIP code of the LAR\'s mailing address. Required for complete postal address and geographic analytics.']
  mailing_state_province varchar [note: 'State, province, or region of the LAR\'s mailing address. Used for jurisdictional compliance and postal delivery.']
  middle_name varchar [note: 'Legal middle name or initial of the Legally Authorized Representative as recorded on official identification documents. May be null if not applicable.']
  notes varchar [note: 'Free-text field for site staff to record additional observations, special circumstances, or contextual information about the LAR\'s authorization that are not captured in structured fields. Subject to ALCOA+ principles.']
  population_category varchar [note: 'Classification of the vulnerable population category that necessitates LAR consent for this subject. Determines applicable regulatory requirements and IRB/IEC conditions.']
  preferred_contact_method varchar [note: 'The LAR\'s preferred channel for receiving communications from the site, including re-consent notifications and study updates. Drives outreach workflow in Clinpal and the source system']
  preferred_language varchar [note: 'ISO 639-1/639-2 language code representing the LAR\'s preferred language for consent documentation and communications (e.g., \'en\', \'es\', \'fr-CA\'). Ensures ICF is provided in a language the LAR understands per GCP.']
  primary_phone varchar [note: 'Primary telephone number for contacting the Legally Authorized Representative. Used for re-consent notifications, safety communications, and site follow-up.']
  re_consent_required boolean [note: 'Indicates whether a re-consent process is required for this LAR due to a protocol amendment, new safety information, or ICF version update. Triggers re-consent workflow in Clinpal.']
  re_consent_trigger_reason varchar [note: 'Reason code for why re-consent is required from the LAR. Drives re-consent workflow prioritization and regulatory documentation in the eConsent system.']
  relationship_type varchar [note: 'Categorical classification of the LAR\'s legal or familial relationship to the trial subject (e.g., parent, legal guardian, healthcare proxy). Determines the basis of legal authority.']
  subject_assent_date date [note: 'Date on which the subject\'s assent was obtained alongside the LAR\'s consent. Applicable for pediatric or partially capacitated subjects. Null if assent was not required or not obtained.']
  subject_assent_obtained boolean [note: 'Indicates whether the subject\'s assent (agreement to participate, distinct from formal consent) was obtained in addition to the LAR\'s consent. Applicable for pediatric subjects with developing capacity per 21 CFR 50.55.']
  updated_timestamp timestamp [note: 'Timestamp of the most recent modification to the LAR master record. Used for change tracking, audit trail compliance, and Silver layer incremental processing.']
  verification_date date [note: 'Date on which the LAR\'s identity and legal authority documentation were verified by authorized site personnel (PI or CRC). Required for GCP audit trail.']
  verification_status varchar [note: 'Status of the site staff\'s verification of the LAR\'s identity and legal authority documentation. Tracks whether the CRC or PI has confirmed the LAR\'s credentials per GCP requirements.']
  withdrawal_date date [note: 'Date on which the LAR withdrew their consent authorization on behalf of the subject, or the date on which the LAR\'s authority was formally revoked. Triggers subject withdrawal workflow.']
  withdrawal_reason varchar [note: 'Free-text or coded reason for the withdrawal of the LAR\'s consent authorization or revocation of legal authority. Required for regulatory reporting and subject safety follow-up.']

  Note: 'Master record for a Legally Authorized Representative (LAR) associated with a trial subject who lacks capacity to consent independently. Stores LAR full name, relationship to subject, contact details, legal authority documentation type and reference'
}

Table consent.icf_amendment {
  icf_amendment_id varchar [pk, note: 'Unique surrogate identifier for the ICF amendment record in the Databricks Silver Layer. Primary key for this entity.']
  clinpal_workflow_id varchar [note: 'The workflow identifier assigned by the Clinpal eConsent system for the re-consent or new consent workflow triggered by this amendment. Enables traceability between the amendment record and the eConsent execution.']
  country_id varchar [note: 'Foreign key linking to study.country. Business justification: ICF amendments have country-specific applicability and require country-level regulatory submission and approval. The existing country_code plain attribute is a denormalization of study.country.']
  ethics_approval_id varchar [note: 'Foreign key linking to compliance.ethics_approval. Business justification: GCP requires that amended ICFs are only implemented after ethics committee approval.']
  ethics_submission_id varchar [note: 'Foreign key linking to compliance.ethics_submission. Business justification: An ICF amendment is formally submitted to the ethics committee via an ethics_submission.']
  icf_version_id varchar [note: 'Reference to the new ICF version produced as a result of this amendment. Null until the amended ICF version is formally approved and issued.']
  ind_application_id varchar [note: 'Foreign key linking to regulatory.ind_application. Business justification: IB safety updates with new risk information directly trigger ICF amendments per ICH E6 GCP.']
  protocol_id varchar [note: 'Foreign key linking to study.protocol. Business justification: ICF amendments are directly triggered by protocol amendments and must reference the governing protocol version.']
  regulatory_binder_id varchar [note: 'Foreign key linking to document.regulatory_binder. Business justification: ICF amendments requiring regulatory submission (regulatory_submission_required flag) are filed in regulatory binders for agency review.']
  study_protocol_amendment_id varchar [note: 'Foreign key linking to study.study_protocol_amendment. Business justification: Protocol amendments directly drive ICF amendments — when a study_protocol_amendment is approved, corresponding ICF amendments must be issued.']
  submission_id varchar [note: 'Foreign key linking to regulatory.submission. Business justification: ICF amendments with \'regulatory_submission_required=true\' must be filed as part of a regulatory submission.']
  superseded_by_amendment_icf_amendment_id varchar [note: 'Reference to the subsequent amendment that supersedes this one, if applicable. Null for the current active amendment. Enables full amendment lineage chain reconstruction for regulatory inspection.']
  susar_id varchar [note: 'Foreign key linking to safety.safety_communication. Business justification: Safety-related ICF amendments are directly triggered by safety communications (e.g., SUSAR letters, urgent safety measures).']
  tmf_document_id varchar [note: 'Foreign key linking to document.tmf_document. Business justification: ICF amendments are essential TMF documents (DIA TMF Reference Model). Regulatory inspectors verify amendments against TMF filings.']
  affected_subject_population varchar [note: 'Defines which subject population is required to undergo re-consent as a result of this amendment. Drives the re-consent workflow in Clinpal and determines the scope of CRA site monitoring activities.']
  amendment_date date [note: 'The principal real-world date on which the amendment was formally initiated or authored. Serves as the primary business event date for the amendment lifecycle.']
  amendment_number varchar [note: 'Externally-known sequential identifier for the amendment (e.g., AM-001, AM-002). Used in regulatory submissions, IRB/IEC correspondence, and TMF filing to uniquely reference the amendment within the study.']
  amendment_status varchar [note: 'Current lifecycle state of the ICF amendment. Tracks progression from initial drafting through IRB/IEC submission, approval or rejection, and eventual supersession by a subsequent amendment.']
  amendment_type varchar [note: 'Classification of the nature of change driving the amendment. Safety updates require expedited IRB/IEC review; protocol changes may require full board review; administrative corrections may qualify for expedited review.']
  capacity_assessment_required boolean [note: 'Indicates whether a subject capacity or competency assessment is required before re-consent can be obtained under this amendment. Relevant for vulnerable populations, pediatric studies, or subjects with cognitive impairment.']
  change_description varchar [note: 'Detailed narrative describing the nature and rationale of the changes introduced by this amendment. Captures what was changed, why it was changed, and the impact on subject safety or study conduct.']
  created_timestamp timestamp [note: 'Timestamp when this ICF amendment record was first created in the Databricks Silver Layer. Supports ALCOA+ audit trail requirements and data lineage tracking per 21 CFR Part 11.']
  deviation_risk_level varchar [note: 'Risk classification assigned to the amendment indicating the potential for protocol deviations if re-consent is not completed within the required timeframe. Informs monitoring prioritization in the source system']
  econsent_applicable boolean [note: 'Indicates whether the amended ICF will be deployed via the Clinpal eConsent platform. When True, triggers the eConsent build and validation workflow in Clinpal for the resulting ICF version.']
  gdpr_applicable boolean [note: 'Indicates whether GDPR data privacy provisions apply to this amendment, typically for studies enrolling subjects in EU/EEA countries. When True, the amended ICF must include GDPR-compliant data processing disclosures.']
  hipaa_applicable boolean [note: 'Indicates whether HIPAA authorization provisions apply to this amendment, typically for studies enrolling subjects at U.S. sites. When True, the amended ICF must include a HIPAA-compliant authorization section.']
  implementation_date date [note: 'The date from which the amended ICF version becomes effective for use at clinical sites. Sites must not use the amended ICF prior to this date. Typically set to or after the IRB/IEC approval date.']
  language_code varchar [note: 'ISO 639-1 language code (optionally with ISO 3166-1 country subtag) of the amended ICF document (e.g., en-US, fr-FR, de-DE). Multi-language studies require separate amendment tracking per language version.']
  lar_consent_applicable boolean [note: 'Indicates whether consent from a Legally Authorized Representative (LAR) is applicable for this amendment, typically for subjects who lack decision-making capacity. Triggers LAR-specific consent workflow in Clinpal.']
  notes varchar [note: 'Free-text field for additional operational notes, internal comments, or contextual information related to the amendment that does not fit into structured fields. Not intended for regulatory submission content.']
  reconsent_deadline_date date [note: 'The date by which all affected subjects must complete re-consent. Null when reconsent_required is False. Used to monitor site compliance and escalate overdue re-consent activities.']
  reconsent_required boolean [note: 'Indicates whether currently enrolled subjects are obligated to provide re-consent under this amendment. True triggers re-consent workflow initiation in Clinpal and site notification via the source system']
  regulatory_submission_required boolean [note: 'Indicates whether this amendment must be submitted to a health authority (e.g., FDA, EMA) as part of an IND, CTA, or equivalent regulatory filing. True triggers a regulatory submission workflow in Veeva Vault.']
  rejection_reason varchar [note: 'Free-text description of the reason provided by the IRB or IEC for rejecting or deferring the amendment. Populated only when irb_iec_decision is rejected or deferred. Required for CAPA tracking in MasterControl.']
  requiring_authority varchar [note: 'The regulatory authority, ethics committee, or organizational body that mandated or triggered this amendment. Supports regulatory inspection readiness by documenting the source of the amendment requirement.']
  reviewed_by varchar [note: 'Name or identifier of the Principal Investigator (PI) or medical monitor who reviewed and approved the amendment content prior to IRB/IEC submission. Supports GCP audit trail requirements.']
  safety_related boolean [note: 'Indicates whether this amendment was triggered by a safety finding, SUSAR, SAE signal, or DSMB/DMC recommendation. Safety-related amendments require expedited IRB/IEC review and may trigger immediate site notification.']
  site_applicability varchar [note: 'Defines whether this amendment applies to all clinical sites globally, a specific subset of sites, or only sites within a particular country. Drives site notification and monitoring workflows in the source system']
  sponsor_approval_date date [note: 'Date on which the pharmaceutical or biotech sponsor formally approved the amendment content prior to IRB/IEC submission. Required for sponsor oversight documentation in the TMF.']
  updated_timestamp timestamp [note: 'Timestamp when this ICF amendment record was last modified in the Databricks Silver Layer. Supports change tracking, audit trail completeness, and ALCOA+ contemporaneous documentation requirements.']

  Note: 'Tracks amendments to an approved ICF version, capturing the amendment number, amendment date, nature of change (safety update, protocol change, administrative correction), regulatory authority requiring the amendment, IRB/IEC submission date and approval'
}

Table randomization.rand_scheme {
  rand_scheme_id varchar [pk, note: 'Unique surrogate identifier for the randomization scheme record in the lakehouse silver layer. Primary key for this entity.']
  compliance_sop_id varchar [note: 'Foreign key linking to compliance.compliance_sop. Business justification: GCP requires randomization scheme generation and validation to be governed by a specific compliance SOP. Regulatory inspectors verify SOP compliance for randomization procedures.']
  ind_application_id varchar [note: 'Foreign key linking to regulatory.ind_application. Business justification: A randomization scheme is designed and authorized under a specific IND application.']
  protocol_id varchar [note: 'Foreign key linking to study.protocol. Business justification: Randomization schemes are designed against a specific protocol version per ICH E9(R1) and GCP requirements.']
  study_id varchar [note: 'Reference to the clinical study for which this randomization scheme is defined. Links the scheme to its parent protocol.']
  tmf_document_id varchar [note: 'Foreign key linking to document.tmf_document. Business justification: The randomization scheme is an essential TMF document per ICH E6 and DIA Reference Model.']
  activation_date date [note: 'Date on which the randomization scheme was activated in the IRT/RTSM system and made available for subject allocation. Marks transition to \'active\' status.']
  allocation_algorithm varchar [note: 'The statistical randomization algorithm used to assign subjects to treatment arms. \'simple\' = unrestricted random; \'block\' = fixed block sizes; \'stratified_block\' = blocks within strata; \'minimization\' = dynamic balancing; \'adaptive\' = response-adaptive']
  allocation_ratio decimal [note: 'Randomization allocation ratio; implements CDISC SDTM TS parameter RANDQT / trial design allocation ratio.']
  approval_date date [note: 'Date on which the randomization scheme received formal biostatistics and QA approval, authorizing its use in the study. Marks transition from \'draft\' to \'approved\' status.']
  approved_by varchar [note: 'Name or user identifier of the individual (QA or biostatistics lead) who formally approved the randomization scheme. Supports 21 CFR Part 11 electronic signature audit trail.']
  blinding_type varchar [note: 'Blinding type; implements CDISC SDTM TS parameter BLIND (TSVAL where TSPARMCD=BLIND).']
  block_size_list varchar [note: 'Comma-separated list of permissible block sizes used in block or stratified-block randomization (e.g., \'4,6,8\'). Variable block sizes reduce predictability. Null for non-block algorithms.']
  cdisc_sdtm_domain varchar [note: 'Target CDISC SDTM domain for randomization data (e.g., DM.ARM/ACTARM, TA); implements SDTM domain reference.']
  created_timestamp timestamp [note: 'Timestamp when this randomization scheme record was first created in the lakehouse. Supports ALCOA+ audit trail requirements and 21 CFR Part 11 compliance.']
  generation_method_description varchar [note: 'Narrative description of the randomization list generation methodology, including algorithm parameters, SAS/R procedure used, and any special considerations. Included in the Randomization Plan and CSR.']
  generation_software varchar [note: 'Name and version of the software used to generate the randomization list (e.g., \'SAS 9.4\', \'R 4.2.1\', \'the source system 21.3\'). Required for regulatory submission and reproducibility validation.']
  geographic_scope varchar [note: 'Comma-separated list of 3-letter ISO country codes where this randomization scheme is applicable (e.g., \'USA,GBR,DEU\'). Relevant for multi-regional trials with country-specific regulatory requirements.']
  irb_iec_approval_required boolean [note: 'Indicates whether a scheme amendment requires re-submission to the Institutional Review Board (IRB) or Independent Ethics Committee (IEC). Relevant when stratification factors or allocation ratios change.']
  irt_scheme_reference varchar [note: 'The scheme identifier or configuration reference as recorded in the IRT/RTSM system (e.g., the source system scheme ID or Medidata Rave RTSM list ID). Enables cross-system traceability.']
  irt_system_name varchar [note: 'Name of the IRT/IVRS/RTSM system used to execute this randomization scheme (e.g., \'the source system \'Medidata Rave RTSM\', \'Almac IXRS\'). Identifies the operational system of record for subject allocation.']
  is_centralized boolean [note: 'Indicates whether randomization is performed centrally via IRT/IVRS/RTSM (True) or locally at the site (False). Centralized randomization is the standard for GCP-compliant multi-center trials.']
  is_stratified_by_site boolean [note: 'Indicates whether randomization is stratified by investigative site. Site stratification is common in multi-center trials to ensure balance across sites.']
  is_variable_block boolean [note: 'Indicates whether variable (random) block sizes are used rather than a fixed block size. Variable blocks reduce the ability to predict upcoming assignments and are preferred for double-blind studies.']
  list_generation_date date [note: 'Date on which the randomization list was generated using the specified software and seed. Required for audit trail and regulatory submission documentation.']
  minimization_objective_function varchar [note: 'For minimization or covariate-adaptive algorithms, the mathematical objective function used to minimize imbalance across covariates (e.g., \'range\', \'variance\', \'weighted_range\'). Null for non-minimization schemes.']
  minimization_probability decimal(5,4) [note: 'For minimization algorithms, the probability (0.0–1.0) of assigning a subject to the arm that minimizes imbalance (e.g., 0.8000 = 80% biased coin). Null for non-minimization schemes.']
  notes varchar [note: 'Free-text field for additional operational notes, amendment rationale, or special instructions related to this randomization scheme. Not intended for structured data.']
  random_seed varchar [note: 'Numeric seed value used to initialize the pseudo-random number generator for reproducible list generation. Classified confidential to protect blinding integrity; disclosed only at database lock (DBL) or unblinding.']
  regulatory_submission_flag boolean [note: 'Indicates whether this randomization scheme version has been included in a regulatory submission (IND, NDA, BLA, MAA, or eCTD package). Triggers additional change-control requirements.']
  retirement_date date [note: 'Date on which the randomization scheme was retired or superseded. Null if the scheme is still active. Used for version lifecycle management and TMF archival.']
  sap_version_reference varchar [note: 'Version identifier of the Statistical Analysis Plan (the source system) that specifies this randomization scheme. Ensures traceability between the scheme implementation and the approved statistical methodology.']
  scheme_code varchar [note: 'Externally-known alphanumeric code uniquely identifying this randomization scheme within the RTSM/IRT system (e.g., the source system or Medidata Rave RTSM). Used as the business key for cross-system reference.']
  scheme_name varchar [note: 'Human-readable descriptive name of the randomization scheme (e.g., \'Phase III Stratified Block Randomization v2\'). Used in reports, TMF documentation, and biostatistics deliverables.']
  scheme_status varchar [note: 'Current lifecycle status of the randomization scheme. \'draft\' = under development; \'approved\' = biostatistics/QA sign-off obtained; \'active\' = in use for subject allocation; \'suspended\' = temporarily halted (e.g., DSMB hold); \'retired\' = superseded or']
  scheme_version varchar [note: 'Version identifier of the randomization scheme (e.g., \'1.0\', \'2.1\'). Incremented when the scheme is amended post-approval. Supports audit trail and regulatory submission traceability.']
  strata_count varchar [note: 'Total number of distinct strata defined by the combination of stratification factors. Used to validate that the randomization list covers all strata and to monitor enrollment balance.']
  stratification_factors varchar [note: 'Semicolon-separated list of stratification factors used to define strata for stratified randomization (e.g., \'site;gender;disease_severity\'). Defined in the protocol and the source system. Null for non-stratified schemes.']
  total_randomization_slots varchar [note: 'Total number of randomization positions (slots) generated in the scheme list. Represents the maximum number of subjects that can be randomized under this scheme version.']
  treatment_arm_count varchar [note: 'Number of treatment arms (including placebo/control) defined in this randomization scheme. Must align with the protocol and allocation ratio.']
  unblinding_procedure varchar [note: 'Defines the authorized unblinding procedure for this scheme. \'emergency_only\' = individual subject emergency unblinding; \'dsmb_only\' = unblinding restricted to DSMB/DMC; \'dbk_full\' = full unblinding at database lock; \'partial_sponsor\' = sponsor']
  updated_timestamp timestamp [note: 'Timestamp of the most recent update to this randomization scheme record. Supports change tracking, audit trail, and version control in the silver layer.']

  Note: 'Master definition of a randomization scheme for a clinical study. Captures the allocation algorithm type (simple, block, stratified, minimization, adaptive), block sizes, allocation ratio, seed values, and scheme version.'
}

Table randomization.rand_list {

  document_sop_id varchar [note: 'Foreign key linking to document.document_sop. Business justification: Randomization list generation and validation must follow a documented SOP per GCP requirements. Regulatory inspectors verify which SOP version governed each list\'s creation.']

  blinding_level varchar [note: 'Blinding level; implements CDISC SDTM TS parameter BLIND.']

  created_timestamp timestamp [note: 'Date and time when this randomization list record was first captured in the data platform. Supports ALCOA+ audit trail requirements.']
  dsmb_access_granted boolean [note: 'Indicates whether the Data Safety Monitoring Board (DSMB) / Data Monitoring Committee (DMC) has been granted access to the unblinded version of this randomization list for interim safety reviews.']
  generated_by varchar [note: 'Name or user identifier of the biostatistician or system process that generated the randomization list. Supports ALCOA+ attributability requirement.']
  generation_method varchar [note: 'Algorithm or statistical method used to generate the randomization list (e.g., permuted block, minimization, stratified). Documented in the the source system']
  generation_timestamp timestamp [note: 'Date and time when the randomization list was computationally generated by the IRT/IVRS/RTSM system. Serves as the principal business event timestamp for this artifact.']
  geographic_scope varchar [note: 'Country or region code(s) for which this randomization list is applicable (ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 codes, comma-separated). Relevant for multi-regional trials with country-specific lists.']
  irb_iec_approval_required boolean [note: 'Indicates whether IRB/IEC approval is required before activating this randomization list (e.g., for protocol amendments that change the randomization scheme).']
  irt_list_type varchar [note: 'Scope of the randomization list as configured in the IRT/IVRS/RTSM system — whether it applies globally across all sites, to specific sites, strata, or countries.']
  is_blinded boolean [note: 'Indicates whether treatment assignments in this list are masked (True) or open-label (False). Drives access control and unblinding procedures in the IRT/IVRS/RTSM system.']
  is_stratified boolean [note: 'Indicates whether this randomization list uses stratified randomization (True) or unstratified simple/block randomization (False).']
  kit_assignment_enabled boolean [note: 'Indicates whether this randomization list is linked to investigational product kit assignment in the RTSM/supply chain module. When True, kit numbers are assigned at the point of randomization.']
  list_description varchar [note: 'Free-text description of the randomization list, including any special conditions, amendments, or notes relevant to its use in the study.']
  list_number varchar [note: 'Externally-known unique identifier or code for this randomization list as referenced in the IRT/IVRS/RTSM system and the Statistical Analysis Plan (the source system). Used for regulatory traceability.']
  list_status varchar [note: 'Current lifecycle status of the randomization list. Controls whether the list is available for subject assignment in the IRT/IVRS/RTSM system. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: draft|pending_approval|approved|active|superseded|retired — promote to reference product if']
  list_version varchar [note: 'Version identifier of the randomization list (e.g., v1.0, v2.0). Incremented when the list is regenerated or amended, supporting audit trail and regulatory traceability.']
  notes varchar [note: 'Free-text field for additional operational notes, amendment rationale, or regulatory comments associated with this randomization list.']
  randomization_seed varchar [note: 'The random number generator seed value used to produce this list. Classified as confidential to protect blinding integrity. Required for reproducibility validation and regulatory inspection.']
  sap_reference varchar [note: 'Document identifier or section reference in the Statistical Analysis Plan (the source system) that specifies the randomization methodology for this list. Ensures traceability to the approved statistical methodology.']
  source_system_list_reference varchar [note: 'Native identifier of this randomization list in the originating IRT/IVRS/RTSM system (Medidata Rave RTSM or the source system Used for cross-system reconciliation.']
  stratification_factors varchar [note: 'Comma-separated list of stratification factors applied when generating this randomization list (e.g., \'site, disease_severity, age_group\'). Reflects the protocol-defined stratification variables.']
  superseded_timestamp timestamp [note: 'Date and time when this randomization list was superseded by a newer version. Null if the list is still active. Supports version lifecycle audit trail.']
  total_slots varchar [note: 'Total number of randomization positions (slots) in this list, representing the maximum number of subjects that can be assigned using this list.']
  treatment_arm_count varchar [note: 'Number of distinct treatment arms (including placebo/control) covered by this randomization list. Validates alignment with the protocol-defined study design.']
  unblinding_procedure varchar [note: 'Defined procedure type for unblinding this randomization list. Governs when and how treatment assignments may be revealed (e.g., emergency unblinding, post-DBL unblinding).']
  updated_timestamp timestamp [note: 'Date and time when this randomization list record was last modified in the data platform. Supports change tracking and audit trail.']
  validation_status varchar [note: 'Status of the User Acceptance Testing (UAT) and quality control validation performed on this randomization list prior to activation. Ensures the list meets protocol specifications before use.']
  validation_timestamp timestamp [note: 'Date and time when the randomization list completed User Acceptance Testing (UAT) validation. Null if validation has not yet been performed.']

  Note: 'The generated randomization list produced from a randomization scheme. Stores the ordered sequence of treatment assignments, list version, generation timestamp, generation method, blinding level, and approval status.'
}

Table randomization.rand_code {
  rand_code_id varchar [pk, note: 'Unique surrogate identifier for each randomization code (slot) record in the Silver layer. Primary key for this data product.']
  clinical_trial_authorization_id varchar [note: 'Foreign key linking to regulatory.clinical_trial_authorization. Business justification: Each randomization code is assigned in a specific country under an active CTA.']
  investigational_site_id varchar [note: 'Reference to the investigational site to which this randomization code is allocated. Site-specific lists restrict code consumption to the assigned site.']
  irt_transaction_id varchar [note: 'Unique transaction identifier generated by the IRT/IVRS/RTSM system at the moment of code assignment. Used for reconciliation between the EDC and RTSM systems.']
  rand_list_id varchar [note: 'Reference to the parent randomization list from which this code slot was generated. A study may have multiple lists (e.g., per stratum or per site).']
  rand_scheme_id varchar [note: 'Foreign key linking to randomization.stratification_cell. Business justification: Each rand_code slot belongs to a specific stratification cell that determines its allocation.']
  study_id varchar [note: 'Reference to the clinical study (protocol) to which this randomization code belongs. Links the code to its parent study context.']
  study_site_id varchar [note: 'Foreign key linking to site.study_site. Business justification: IRT systems allocate randomization codes to specific study sites for dispensing control. Code allocation reports and drug accountability reconciliation require study-site-level tracking.']
  treatment_arm_id varchar [note: 'Foreign key linking to randomization.treatment_arm. Business justification: Each rand_code slot is allocated to exactly one treatment arm. rand_code currently stores treatment_arm_code (STRING) and treatment_arm_label (STRING) as denormalized references.']
  allocation_ratio_denominator varchar [note: 'Denominator of the randomization allocation ratio (e.g., 3 in a 2:1 ratio, representing total parts). Together with the numerator, documents the intended allocation balance.']
  allocation_ratio_numerator varchar [note: 'Numerator of the randomization allocation ratio for the treatment arm assigned to this code (e.g., 2 in a 2:1 ratio). Used to verify list balance and document the randomization scheme.']
  assigned_timestamp timestamp [note: 'Date and time when this randomization code was consumed and assigned to a subject via the IRT/RTSM system. The principal business event timestamp for this entity. Null if not yet assigned.']
  assignment_status varchar [note: 'Current lifecycle status of this randomization code slot: available (not yet consumed), assigned (linked to a subject), cancelled (voided without assignment), replaced (superseded by a new code), reserved (held for a specific site/stratum), expired (past']
  blinding_type varchar [note: 'Blinding type; implements CDISC SDTM TS parameter BLIND.']
  block_number varchar [note: 'Block identifier within the randomization list to which this code belongs. Used for permuted-block randomization schemes to verify block completeness and balance.']
  block_size varchar [note: 'Number of randomization slots in the block containing this code. For variable block size designs, records the actual block size assigned to this slot.']
  cancellation_reason varchar [note: 'Free-text or coded reason for cancellation of this randomization code (e.g., subject screen failure, site closure, protocol amendment). Required for regulatory audit trail.']
  cancelled_timestamp timestamp [note: 'Date and time when this randomization code was cancelled or voided in the IRT/RTSM system. Null if the code was not cancelled.']
  code_number varchar [note: 'The externally-known alphanumeric randomization code identifier as generated by the RTSM/IRT system (e.g., \'RC-0042\'). This is the business-facing code printed on the randomization schedule and referenced in regulatory submissions.']
  created_timestamp timestamp [note: 'Date and time when this randomization code record was first created in the source IRT/RTSM system. Supports ALCOA+ audit trail and 21 CFR Part 11 compliance.']
  dispensing_visit_number varchar [note: 'Protocol-defined visit number at which the IMP kit linked to this randomization code is to be dispensed to the subject. Aligns with the study schedule of assessments.']
  expiry_date date [note: 'Date after which this randomization code is no longer valid for assignment. Codes past expiry are automatically set to \'expired\' status by the IRT/RTSM system.']
  irt_system_source varchar [note: 'Identifies the IRT/RTSM system that generated and managed this randomization code (e.g., Medidata Rave RTSM, the source system Supports multi-system reconciliation and data lineage.']
  is_emergency_unblinding_eligible boolean [note: 'Indicates whether this randomization code is eligible for emergency unblinding by site staff via the IRT system (True) or requires sponsor/DSMB authorization (False). Governs site-level unblinding access controls.']
  is_rescue_medication_eligible boolean [note: 'Indicates whether the treatment arm assigned to this code permits rescue medication dispensing (True) or not (False). Drives IRT/RTSM dispensing logic for rescue kits.']
  is_unblinded boolean [note: 'Indicates whether the treatment arm assignment for this code has been formally unblinded (True) or remains blinded (False). Set to True upon emergency or end-of-study unblinding events.']
  kit_code varchar [note: 'Pre-assigned IMP kit code linked to this randomization slot for dispensing via IRT/RTSM. Connects the randomization event to the supply chain kit that must be dispensed to the subject.']
  last_modified_timestamp timestamp [note: 'Date and time of the most recent modification to this randomization code record in the source system. Required for change tracking and ALCOA+ audit trail compliance.']
  list_version_number varchar [note: 'Version number of the randomization list from which this code was generated (e.g., \'1.0\', \'2.1\'). Tracks list amendments due to protocol changes and supports regulatory audit trail.']
  notes varchar [note: 'Free-text field for operational notes or comments entered by the IRT/RTSM administrator regarding this randomization code (e.g., manual override justification, reconciliation notes).']
  protocol_amendment_number varchar [note: 'Protocol amendment version under which this randomization code was generated or last modified. Tracks list changes driven by protocol amendments for regulatory traceability.']
  randomization_method varchar [note: 'Statistical algorithm used to generate this randomization code (e.g., permuted_block, minimization, adaptive). Documented for regulatory submission and biostatistical validation.']
  randomization_seed varchar [note: 'Cryptographic seed value used by the randomization algorithm to generate this code list. Classified as confidential to protect blinding integrity. Required for regulatory reproducibility validation.']
  region_code varchar [note: 'Sponsor-defined geographic region code (e.g., \'NA\', \'EU\', \'APAC\') associated with the site for this code. Used as a stratification factor in multi-regional trials.']
  replacement_code_number varchar [note: 'Code number of the replacement randomization slot issued when this code was cancelled or replaced. Enables traceability of code replacement chains in the audit trail.']
  sequence_position varchar [note: 'Sequential ordinal position of this code within its randomization list. Determines the order in which codes are consumed during subject enrollment.']
  source_system_code_reference varchar [note: 'Native primary key or unique identifier of this randomization code record in the originating IRT/RTSM source system (Medidata Rave RTSM or the source system Enables reconciliation and data lineage tracing back to the system of record.']
  unblinding_reason varchar [note: 'Documented reason for unblinding this randomization code, required for regulatory audit trail. Null if the code has not been unblinded.']
  unblinding_timestamp timestamp [note: 'Date and time when the treatment arm assignment was formally unblinded. Null if the code remains blinded. Captured per ALCOA+ principles for regulatory audit trail.']

  Note: 'Individual randomization code (slot) within a randomization list. Each code represents a single subject allocation slot with its sequential position number, pre-assigned treatment arm, stratification cell membership, kit code linkage for IMP dispensing'
}

Table randomization.treatment_arm {
  treatment_arm_id varchar [pk, note: 'Primary key for treatment_arm']

  allocation_ratio_numerator varchar [note: 'Numerator component of the randomization allocation ratio for this arm (e.g., 2 in a 2:1 ratio). Used with the denominator to compute the target allocation percentage and configure the randomization schedule in IRT/RTSM systems.']

  arm_end_date date [note: 'Date on which this treatment arm was closed to new randomizations or formally ended per protocol or protocol amendment. Nullable for arms that remain open. Used for enrollment closure tracking and database lock (DBL) preparation.']

  dosing_frequency varchar [note: 'Frequency of investigational product administration for subjects in this arm (e.g., \'QD - Once Daily\', \'BID - Twice Daily\', \'QW - Once Weekly\'). Mapped to CDISC Controlled Terminology FREQ variable in the EX domain.']
  edc_arm_code varchar [note: 'Treatment arm code as configured in the Electronic Data Capture (EDC) system (Medidata Rave EDC or the source system Used for eCRF field population, data validation rules, and SDTM mapping. Ensures consistency between EDC and IRT arm definitions.']
  irt_arm_code varchar [note: 'Treatment arm code as configured in the Interactive Response Technology (IRT) / Interactive Voice Response System (IVRS) / Randomization and Trial Supply Management (RTSM) system (Medidata Rave RTSM).']
  is_control_arm boolean [note: 'Indicates whether this treatment arm serves as the control arm (placebo or active comparator) in the study. Used in statistical analysis to define the reference group for primary and secondary endpoint comparisons.']
  max_subject_count varchar [note: 'Maximum number of subjects permitted in this treatment arm. Enforced by IRT/RTSM to prevent over-enrollment. May be set for adaptive designs or safety-driven enrollment caps.']
  min_subject_count varchar [note: 'Minimum number of subjects required in this treatment arm to maintain statistical validity and meet protocol-defined endpoints. Used by DSMB/DMC for interim analysis decisions and by biostatistics for power calculations.']
  modified_timestamp timestamp [note: 'Timestamp of the most recent modification to this treatment arm record. Supports audit trail requirements under 21 CFR Part 11 and ALCOA+ data integrity principles. Updated on every change to the record.']
  notes varchar [note: 'Free-text field for additional operational notes, clarifications, or sponsor-specific instructions related to this treatment arm definition. Not used for regulatory submissions; intended for internal data management and CTMS operational use.']
  planned_subject_count varchar [note: 'Target number of subjects planned for enrollment and randomization into this treatment arm as defined in the study protocol and sample size calculation. Used for enrollment tracking, site feasibility, and supply planning.']
  protocol_section_reference varchar [note: 'Reference to the specific section(s) of the study protocol document that defines this treatment arm (e.g., \'Section 5.2 - Treatment Arms and Dosing Regimen\').']
  randomization_method varchar [note: 'Statistical randomization method used to allocate subjects to this treatment arm. Drives IRT/RTSM algorithm configuration in Medidata Rave RTSM and the source system Documented in the the source system']
  regulatory_submission_flag boolean [note: 'Indicates whether this treatment arm definition has been included in a regulatory submission (IND, NDA, BLA, MAA, or CTD). Used for submission readiness tracking and eCTD package assembly in Veeva Vault.']
  route_of_administration varchar [note: 'Route of administration; implements SDTM --ROUTE (e.g., EX.EXROUTE) / USDM AdministrableProduct route; governed by CDISC CT ROUTE codelist.']

  sdtm_arm_value decimal(18,2) [note: 'SDTM ARM value reference; implements SDTM DM.ARM/ARMCD.']
  stratification_factors varchar [note: 'Comma-separated list of stratification factors applied during randomization to this arm (e.g., \'region, disease severity, prior treatment\'). Defined in the protocol and the source system.']
  suspension_reason varchar [note: 'Reason for temporary suspension of randomization to this treatment arm (e.g., safety signal, supply shortage, protocol amendment). Documented for regulatory compliance and DSMB/DMC review. Populated only when arm_status is \'suspended\'.']
  target_allocation_pct decimal(5,2) [note: 'Target percentage of randomized subjects to be allocated to this treatment arm as specified in the Statistical Analysis Plan (the source system) and protocol. Used for enrollment monitoring, supply forecasting, and IRT/RTSM configuration.']
  treatment_description varchar [note: 'Free-text treatment description; implements USDM StudyArm.description / SDTM TA.ETCD element description.']
  unblinding_procedure varchar [note: 'Description of the emergency unblinding procedure applicable to this treatment arm, including authorized personnel, system access method (e.g., IRT/IVRS emergency unblinding), and documentation requirements.']
  washout_period_days varchar [note: 'Number of days required for washout between treatment periods for this arm in crossover or multi-period study designs. Defined in the protocol based on pharmacokinetic (PK) half-life data. Used for visit scheduling and IRT/RTSM period management.']

  Note: 'Master definition of each treatment arm within a clinical study. Captures arm name, arm code, arm type (experimental, active comparator, placebo, open-label extension), blinding role, target allocation percentage, and arm status.'
}

Table randomization.stratification_factor {
  stratification_factor_id varchar [pk, note: 'Unique surrogate identifier for the stratification factor record within the randomization scheme. Primary key for this entity.']

  regulatory_protocol_amendment_id varchar [note: 'Foreign key linking to regulatory.regulatory_protocol_amendment. Business justification: Stratification factors are frequently added, modified, or removed via protocol amendments.']
  study_id varchar [note: 'Reference to the clinical study for which this stratification factor is defined. Enables direct study-level filtering without joining through the scheme.']
  adam_variable varchar [note: 'Target ADaM variable name for this stratification factor; implements ADaM variable reference (e.g., ADaM STRATxxx).']
  approval_date date [note: 'The date on which this stratification factor configuration was formally approved by the biostatistics or RTSM team. Required for regulatory audit trail and TMF documentation.']
  covariate_adjustment_method varchar [note: 'Statistical method used to adjust for this stratification factor in the primary analysis: \'ancova\' for Analysis of Covariance, \'cmh\' for Cochran-Mantel-Haenszel test, \'logistic_regression\' for binary endpoints, \'none\' if not used as a covariate in']
  created_timestamp timestamp [note: 'The date and time when this stratification factor record was first created in the data platform, in ISO 8601 format with timezone offset. Supports audit trail requirements under 21 CFR Part 11 and ALCOA+ principles.']
  data_source_type varchar [note: 'Identifies the system or method from which the stratification factor value is captured at randomization: \'ecrf\' from the EDC eCRF, \'ivrs\' from Interactive Voice Response System, \'irt\' from IRT/RTSM, \'central_lab\' from laboratory results, \'manual_entry\'']
  ecrf_field_reference varchar [note: 'The eCRF form and field identifier in the EDC system (e.g., Medidata Rave) from which the stratification factor value is sourced at the time of randomization (e.g., \'SCREENING.DISVSEV\'). Enables traceability from randomization to source data.']
  effective_end_date date [note: 'The date on which this stratification factor ceased to be effective for new randomizations, typically due to protocol amendment or study close-out. Null for currently active factors.']
  effective_start_date date [note: 'The date from which this stratification factor became effective for subject randomization, typically aligned with protocol approval or amendment effective date. Subjects randomized on or after this date are stratified using this factor.']
  factor_code varchar [note: 'Short, system-level alphanumeric code uniquely identifying the stratification factor within the scheme (e.g., REGION, DISEASE_STAGE, GENDER). Used as the programmatic key in RTSM/IRT configuration and SDTM mapping.']

  factor_name varchar [note: 'Human-readable name of the stratification factor as displayed in the RTSM/IRT interface and statistical analysis plan (e.g., \'Geographic Region\', \'Baseline Disease Severity\', \'Prior Treatment Status\').']
  factor_status varchar [note: 'Lifecycle status of the stratification factor within the scheme design workflow: \'draft\' during initial configuration, \'approved\' after biostatistics/RTSM sign-off, \'active\' when live in the IRT system, \'suspended\' during protocol amendment review']
  factor_type varchar [note: 'Classification of the factor\'s measurement scale: \'categorical\' for nominal groupings (e.g., region), \'continuous_binned\' for numeric ranges converted to categories (e.g., age groups), \'ordinal\' for ranked categories (e.g., disease severity), \'binary\' for']
  irt_parameter_name varchar [note: 'The exact parameter name as configured in the IRT/IVRS/RTSM system (e.g., Medidata Rave RTSM or the source system for this stratification factor. Used for system integration and UAT validation.']
  is_active boolean [note: 'Indicates whether this stratification factor is currently active and in use for subject randomization (True) or has been deactivated via protocol amendment (False). Inactive factors are retained for historical traceability.']
  is_blinded boolean [note: 'Indicates whether the stratification factor value is masked from unblinded personnel (True) or visible to all study team members (False). Relevant for double-blind studies where certain stratification criteria could reveal treatment assignment.']
  is_primary_factor boolean [note: 'Indicates whether this factor is designated as a primary stratification factor (True) versus a secondary or exploratory factor (False) in the Statistical Analysis Plan. Primary factors are used in the primary efficacy analysis.']
  is_used_in_primary_analysis boolean [note: 'Indicates whether this stratification factor is included as a covariate in the primary statistical analysis model (True) or is used only for randomization balance without inclusion in the primary analysis (False).']
  level_count varchar [note: 'Total number of enumerated levels (strata) defined for this stratification factor. Drives the dimensionality of the stratification matrix and the number of randomization lists required. For example, a 3-region factor has level_count = 3.']
  max_imbalance_threshold decimal(5,2) [note: 'The maximum allowable imbalance (as a percentage or absolute count, per unit_of_imbalance) between treatment arms within any stratum defined by this factor before a balancing action is triggered in the minimization algorithm.']
  minimization_variant varchar [note: 'Specific variant of the minimization algorithm applied for this factor: \'pocock_simon\' for the Pocock-Simon method, \'weighted_minimization\' for factor-weighted minimization, \'biased_coin\' for biased-coin minimization, \'deterministic\' for deterministic']
  minimization_weight decimal(5,4) [note: 'Numeric weight assigned to this stratification factor in a minimization or weighted minimization algorithm (e.g., Pocock-Simon). Values typically range from 0.0 to 1.0, with higher weights indicating greater influence on treatment allocation balance.']
  missing_value_handling varchar [note: 'Defines the RTSM system behavior when the stratification factor value is missing or unknown at the time of randomization: \'block_randomization\' to prevent randomization, \'assign_default_level\' to use a pre-specified default level, \'flag_and_hold\' to alert']
