Table compliance.capa {
  capa_id varchar [pk, note: 'Unique system-generated identifier for the CAPA record. Primary key for the CAPA lifecycle master record sourced from MasterControl CAPA module.']
  audit_id varchar [note: 'Identifier of the internal or external audit that generated the finding triggering this CAPA. Null if the CAPA was not initiated from an audit. Enables audit-to-CAPA traceability.']
  bioanalytical_assay_id varchar [note: 'Foreign key linking to laboratory.bioanalytical_assay. Business justification: CAPAs are raised against bioanalytical assays requiring method revalidation, reagent lot changes, or ISR protocol revisions.']
  compliance_sop_id varchar [note: 'Foreign key linking to compliance.sop. Business justification: capa.sop_reference is a free-text string identifying the SOP associated with the CAPA. Replacing it with a FK to sop.sop_id enables structured linkage between CAPAs and the SOPs they address']
  health_authority_id varchar [note: 'Foreign key to the regulatory inspection record']
  lab_facility_id varchar [note: 'Foreign key linking to laboratory.lab_facility. Business justification: CAPAs are raised against specific lab facilities following audit findings or quality events (e.g., LIMS validation gap, specimen handling SOP non-compliance).']
  protocol_id varchar [note: 'Foreign key linking to study.protocol. Business justification: CAPAs triggered by protocol deviations or audit findings are protocol-version specific. compliance_capa has study_id but no protocol_id.']
  study_id varchar [note: 'Identifier of the clinical study associated with this CAPA. Links the CAPA to the relevant study protocol for study-level quality tracking and regulatory reporting.']
  study_site_id varchar [note: 'Identifier of the investigational site associated with this CAPA, if site-specific. Null for sponsor-level or cross-site CAPAs. Supports site-level quality performance analytics.']
  tmf_document_id varchar [note: 'Foreign key linking to document.tmf_document. Business justification: CAPAs generate corrective documents (updated SOPs, revised procedures) that must be filed in the TMF. GCP requires CAPA documentation to be inspection-ready.']
  actual_completion_date date [note: 'Actual calendar date on which all corrective and preventive actions were completed and verified. Null until CAPA is closed. Used to calculate cycle time and on-time closure rate KPIs.']
  approval_date date [note: 'Date on which the CAPA plan was formally approved by the authorized QA approver in MasterControl. Marks the transition from initiation to active execution phase.']
  capa_type varchar [note: 'Indicates whether the action is corrective (addressing an existing non-conformance), preventive (addressing a potential non-conformance), or both. Drives workflow routing in MasterControl.']
  closure_justification varchar [note: 'Narrative justification provided by the responsible owner and QA approver at the time of CAPA closure, summarizing evidence that all actions were completed and the root cause was resolved. Required for regulatory inspection readiness.']
  compliance_capa_status varchar [note: 'Current lifecycle state of the CAPA record. Drives workflow routing, escalation triggers, and regulatory reporting. \'Overdue\' is system-set when target completion date is passed without closure.']
  corrective_action_plan varchar [note: 'Detailed description of the corrective actions planned or implemented to address the identified root cause and prevent recurrence of the quality issue. Core CAPA deliverable per GCP requirements.']
  created_timestamp timestamp [note: 'System timestamp recording when the CAPA record was first created in the lakehouse silver layer. Supports audit trail, data lineage, and 21 CFR Part 11 electronic records compliance.']
  data_integrity_impact_flag boolean [note: 'Indicates whether the quality issue underlying this CAPA had or could have had an impact on clinical data integrity. Triggers data review, potential database query, and regulatory notification workflows.']
  effectiveness_check_date date [note: 'Planned or actual date on which the effectiveness of the implemented corrective and preventive actions will be or was verified. Required by GCP to confirm the CAPA resolved the root cause.']
  effectiveness_check_description varchar [note: 'Narrative description of the methodology and findings from the effectiveness check, including evidence reviewed and conclusions drawn. Supports regulatory inspection readiness.']
  effectiveness_check_result varchar [note: 'Outcome of the effectiveness verification assessment confirming whether the implemented CAPA actions successfully resolved the root cause and prevented recurrence. Drives CAPA closure or re-opening decisions.']
  gcp_impact_assessment varchar [note: 'Assessment of the impact of the underlying quality issue on GCP compliance and data integrity. Drives CAPA priority, escalation, and regulatory reporting decisions. Aligned with FDA and EMA GCP inspection classification standards.']
  immediate_action_taken varchar [note: 'Description of any immediate containment or interim actions taken at the time of CAPA initiation to mitigate the impact of the quality issue before the full corrective action is implemented.']
  initiation_date date [note: 'Calendar date on which the CAPA was formally initiated and entered into MasterControl. Serves as the start of the CAPA lifecycle clock for overdue tracking and regulatory reporting.']
  mastercontrol_record_number varchar [note: 'Native record identifier assigned by the MasterControl CAPA module. Used for source system traceability, data lineage, and reconciliation between the lakehouse silver layer and the operational system of record.']
  preventive_action_plan varchar [note: 'Detailed description of the preventive actions planned to eliminate the potential for recurrence of similar quality issues across the organization or study portfolio.']
  priority varchar [note: 'Risk-based priority level assigned to the CAPA, reflecting the severity and urgency of the underlying quality issue. Drives escalation timelines and resource allocation.']
  problem_description varchar [note: 'Detailed description of the quality issue, non-conformance, or finding that triggered the CAPA. Captures the \'what happened\' narrative for audit trail and regulatory inspection purposes.']
  recurrence_flag boolean [note: 'Indicates whether this CAPA addresses a recurring quality issue that has been the subject of a prior CAPA. True signals a systemic quality problem requiring escalated management attention.']
  reference_number varchar [note: 'Externally-known, human-readable CAPA reference number assigned by MasterControl upon initiation (e.g., CAPA-2024-00123). Used in audit trails, regulatory submissions, and sponsor communications.']
  regulatory_reportable_flag boolean [note: 'Indicates whether this CAPA is associated with a finding that requires regulatory reporting to FDA, EMA, MHRA, or other health authority. Drives regulatory submission workflow in Veeva Vault.']
  responsible_department varchar [note: 'Organizational department or functional area accountable for CAPA execution (e.g., Clinical Operations, Data Management, Regulatory Affairs, Quality Assurance). Used for departmental quality KPI reporting.']
  root_cause_category varchar [note: 'Standardized category classifying the root cause of the quality issue (e.g., training deficiency, process gap, system failure, communication breakdown, resource constraint). Used for trend analysis and systemic quality improvement.']
  root_cause_description varchar [note: 'Detailed narrative describing the identified root cause of the quality issue, as determined through root cause analysis (RCA). Supports regulatory inspection readiness and CAPA justification.']
  source_reference_code varchar [note: 'Identifier of the originating record that triggered this CAPA (e.g., audit finding ID, inspection finding ID, protocol deviation ID, or QC failure ID). Enables traceability back to the root triggering event.']
  source_type varchar [note: 'Category of the triggering event that initiated the CAPA. Classifies whether the CAPA originated from an internal audit, regulatory inspection, protocol deviation, QC failure, self-identified quality issue, complaint, or safety signal.']
  sponsor_notification_date date [note: 'Date on which the study sponsor was formally notified of this CAPA. Null if sponsor_notified_flag is False. Supports sponsor oversight audit trail.']
  sponsor_notified_flag boolean [note: 'Indicates whether the study sponsor has been formally notified of this CAPA. Required for CRO-managed studies where sponsor oversight obligations apply per ICH E6(R2) GCP.']
  subject_safety_impact_flag boolean [note: 'Indicates whether the quality issue underlying this CAPA had or could have had a direct impact on subject safety. Triggers expedited review and potential safety reporting obligations.']
  target_completion_date date [note: 'Planned date by which all corrective and preventive actions must be completed and the CAPA closed. Used for overdue status calculation, escalation triggers, and sponsor/regulatory reporting.']
  title varchar [note: 'Short, descriptive title summarizing the quality issue or finding that triggered the CAPA. Used for identification in dashboards, reports, and audit-readiness reviews.']
  training_required_flag boolean [note: 'Indicates whether the corrective or preventive action includes a mandatory training component. When True, triggers training assignment workflow in MasterControl training management module.']
  updated_timestamp timestamp [note: 'System timestamp recording when the CAPA record was last modified in the lakehouse silver layer. Supports change tracking, audit trail integrity, and 21 CFR Part 11 electronic records compliance.']

  Note: 'Master record for Corrective and Preventive Actions (CAPA) initiated in response to audit findings, inspection findings, protocol deviations, QC failures, or self-identified quality issues.'
}

Table compliance.protocol_deviation {
  protocol_deviation_id varchar [pk, note: 'Primary key for protocol_deviation']
  arm_id varchar [note: 'Foreign key linking to study.arm. Business justification: Protocol deviations are classified by treatment arm in CSR deviation tables (ICH E3 Section 10.2). Arm-level deviation counts are required for per-arm safety and efficacy population analyses.']
  capa_id varchar [note: 'Reference to the associated CAPA record in MasterControl, if a corrective and preventive action has been initiated in response to this deviation.']
  compliance_sop_id varchar [note: 'Foreign key linking to compliance.compliance_sop. Business justification: Protocol deviations frequently trigger mandatory retraining as corrective action.']
  dosing_regimen_id varchar [note: 'Foreign key linking to study.dosing_regimen. Business justification: Dosing deviations (wrong dose level, wrong frequency, wrong regimen) are a major deviation category in pharmacovigilance and CSR deviation tables.']
  eligibility_criterion_id varchar [note: 'Foreign key linking to study.eligibility_criterion. Business justification: Eligibility criterion violations are a primary deviation category. ICH E3 CSR Section 10.2 requires listing deviations by the specific inclusion/exclusion criterion violated.']
  pk_sample_id varchar [note: 'Foreign key linking to laboratory.pk_sample. Business justification: PK sample collection outside the sampling window, incorrect processing, or missed collections constitute protocol deviations requiring formal documentation.']
  principal_investigator_id varchar [note: 'Foreign key linking to site.principal_investigator. Business justification: PI is accountable for protocol adherence per ICH-GCP. Deviation reporting, PI notification tracking, IRB/IEC reporting, and investigator performance assessment require direct PI']
  protocol_id varchar [note: 'Foreign key linking to study.protocol. Business justification: Protocol deviations are violations of a specific protocol version. Direct FK to protocol enables deviation analysis by protocol version, supports CSR deviation summaries, and is required for']
  protocol_lab_schedule_id varchar [note: 'Foreign key linking to laboratory.protocol_lab_schedule. Business justification: Protocol deviations for missed or incorrect lab assessments are evaluated against the protocol lab schedule.']
  sap_id varchar [note: 'Foreign key linking to biostatistics.estimand. Business justification: ICH E9(R1) requires deviations to be assessed against estimand strategies (intercurrent events, missing data).']
  shipment_id varchar [note: 'Foreign key linking to supply.shipment. Business justification: Shipment failures (delayed delivery causing missed dose window, wrong kits shipped) are a documented category of protocol deviations.']
  specimen_collection_id varchar [note: 'Foreign key linking to laboratory.specimen_collection. Business justification: Specimen collection errors (wrong tube, wrong time, insufficient volume) are among the most frequent protocol deviation types.']
  study_id varchar [note: 'Reference to the clinical study (protocol) under which this deviation occurred. Links to the study master record.']
  study_site_id varchar [note: 'Reference to the investigational site where the protocol deviation was identified or occurred.']
  tmf_document_id varchar [note: 'Foreign key linking to document.tmf_document. Business justification: Protocol deviations must be documented in the TMF per ICH E6(R2). The deviation record references the specific TMF document (e.g., deviation report, PI notification letter).']
  trial_subject_id varchar [note: 'Reference to the study subject (patient) associated with this deviation, if applicable. Nullable for site-level or system-level deviations not tied to a specific subject.']
  visit_id varchar [note: 'Reference to the monitoring visit during which this deviation was identified, if applicable. Links to the monitoring visit record for traceability.']
  audit_readiness_status varchar [note: 'Indicates the current audit readiness state of this deviation record, confirming that all required documentation, reporting, and CAPA activities are complete and the record is inspection-ready.']
  corrective_action_summary varchar [note: 'Brief summary of the immediate corrective actions taken to address the deviation and prevent recurrence, prior to or independent of a formal CAPA. Captures site-level remediation steps.']
  created_timestamp timestamp [note: 'Timestamp when the protocol deviation record was first created in the source system (CTMS or EDC). Supports ALCOA+ audit trail requirements.']
  data_integrity_impact varchar [note: 'Assessment of whether the deviation compromised the integrity, reliability, or interpretability of study data. Informs decisions on data exclusion, sensitivity analyses, or database lock.']
  detected_by varchar [note: 'The method or source by which the deviation was detected. Indicates whether it was found during CRA monitoring visit, site self-identification, sponsor audit, regulatory inspection, central data review, or subject report.']
  deviation_category varchar [note: 'Classification of the deviation by severity and regulatory impact. \'Major\' deviations directly affect subject safety, data integrity, or regulatory compliance. \'Minor\' deviations have minimal impact.']
  deviation_description varchar [note: 'Detailed narrative description of the protocol deviation, including what protocol requirement was not met, the circumstances under which it occurred, and any immediate actions taken. Sourced from the eCRF or CTMS deviation entry.']
  deviation_ref_number varchar [note: 'Externally-known, human-readable unique reference number assigned to the protocol deviation record, typically generated by the CTMS (the source system or EDC (Medidata Rave). Used for cross-system traceability and regulatory correspondence.']
  deviation_status varchar [note: 'Current workflow lifecycle state of the deviation record. \'Open\' indicates newly identified; \'under_review\' indicates active investigation; \'resolved\' indicates corrective action completed; \'closed\' indicates fully adjudicated and archived; \'escalated\'']
  deviation_type varchar [note: 'Functional classification of the deviation describing which protocol requirement was violated. Common types include: eligibility, dosing, visit_window, prohibited_medication, consent, randomization, assessments, sample_collection, concomitant_medication']
  discovery_date date [note: 'The date on which the protocol deviation was first identified or discovered, which may differ from the occurrence date. Used to calculate detection lag and assess monitoring effectiveness.']
  ecrf_form_ref varchar [note: 'Reference to the specific eCRF form or data point in Medidata Rave EDC that is associated with this deviation, enabling direct traceability to the source data record.']
  include_in_csr_flag boolean [note: 'Indicates whether this deviation must be listed or summarized in the Clinical Study Report (CSR) per ICH E3 requirements. Major and important deviations are typically included.']
  irb_iec_reported_date date [note: 'The date on which the deviation was formally submitted to the IRB/IEC. Used to verify compliance with reporting timelines and to support audit readiness.']
  irb_iec_reporting_required boolean [note: 'Indicates whether this deviation must be reported to the Institutional Review Board (IRB) or Independent Ethics Committee (IEC) per applicable regulations and the IRB/IEC-approved protocol.']
  occurrence_date date [note: 'The date on which the protocol deviation actually occurred (i.e., the date the protocol requirement was not met). This is the principal real-world event date per CDISC SDTM DVSTDTC.']
  pi_notified_date date [note: 'The date on which the Principal Investigator (PI) was formally notified of the deviation. Required for GCP compliance and site management accountability.']
  protocol_requirement_ref varchar [note: 'Specific section, clause, or criterion number within the study protocol that was deviated from (e.g., \'Section 5.3 Inclusion Criterion 2\'). Enables precise traceability to the protocol document.']
  protocol_version varchar [note: 'Version of the study protocol that was in effect at the time the deviation occurred. Critical for determining which protocol requirements were applicable.']
  regulatory_authority_reported_date date [note: 'The date on which the deviation was formally submitted to the applicable regulatory authority (FDA, EMA, PMDA, etc.), where regulatory reporting was required.']
  regulatory_reporting_required boolean [note: 'Indicates whether this deviation must be reported to a regulatory authority (e.g., FDA, EMA, PMDA) as part of IND safety reporting or clinical trial notification obligations.']
  repeat_deviation_flag boolean [note: 'Indicates whether this deviation is a recurrence of a previously identified deviation of the same type at the same site or by the same subject. Used for trend analysis and escalation decisions.']
  reported_date date [note: 'The date on which the deviation was formally reported to the sponsor, IRB/IEC, or regulatory authority as required. Used to assess compliance with reporting timelines.']
  resolution_date date [note: 'The date on which the deviation was resolved and corrective actions were confirmed as complete. Marks the end of the active deviation lifecycle.']
  root_cause_category varchar [note: 'Categorized root cause of the deviation as determined during investigation. Common categories include: training_gap, communication_failure, process_gap, system_error, oversight, workload, protocol_complexity, subject_non_compliance.']
  root_cause_description varchar [note: 'Detailed narrative of the identified root cause of the protocol deviation, as documented during the investigation process. Supports CAPA development and trend analysis.']
  source_system_record_number varchar [note: 'The native record identifier from the originating source system (e.g., Medidata Rave deviation ID or the source system deviation record ID). Enables upstream reconciliation and audit trail.']
  sponsor_reported_date date [note: 'The date on which the deviation was formally communicated to the sponsor. Used to verify compliance with sponsor notification timelines per the Clinical Trial Agreement.']
  sponsor_reporting_required boolean [note: 'Indicates whether this deviation must be formally reported to the study sponsor per the Clinical Trial Agreement and sponsor SOPs.']
  subject_excluded_from_pp_flag boolean [note: 'Indicates whether this deviation resulted in the exclusion of the subject from the Per Protocol (PP) analysis population, as determined by the biostatistics team per the Statistical Analysis Plan (the source system).']
  subject_impact_assessment varchar [note: 'Assessment of whether the deviation had an impact on subject safety, rights, or well-being. Used to determine reporting obligations and CAPA urgency.']
  updated_timestamp timestamp [note: 'Timestamp of the most recent modification to the protocol deviation record. Supports ALCOA+ audit trail and change tracking requirements.']

  Note: 'Transactional record of protocol deviations identified during study conduct. Captures deviation reference number, study and site identifiers, subject identifier (if applicable), deviation category (major, minor, important), deviation type (eligibility'
}

Table compliance.compliance_sop {
  compliance_sop_id varchar [pk, note: 'Unique surrogate identifier for the Standard Operating Procedure record in the quality management system. Primary key for the sop data product.']
  superseded_sop_compliance_sop_id varchar [note: 'Reference to the sop record that this version supersedes. Supports version lineage navigation and ensures the document control chain of custody is maintained for regulatory inspection.']
  applicable_roles varchar [note: 'Comma-separated list of job roles or role groups required to be trained on and comply with this SOP (e.g., CRA, CRC, PI, QA Manager, Data Manager). Drives training assignment generation in MasterControl.']
  approval_date date [note: 'Date on which the SOP version received final authorized approval in MasterControl. Distinct from the effective date; the SOP may be approved before it becomes operationally binding to allow training completion.']
  approver_name varchar [note: 'Full name of the authorized signatory who approved the current version of the SOP. Typically a senior QA or functional head. Required for regulatory inspection readiness and 21 CFR Part 11 electronic signature compliance.']
  audit_finding_reference varchar [note: 'Reference identifier of the internal or external audit finding that prompted this SOP revision or creation. Supports traceability from audit observations to corrective document updates.']
  capa_reference_number varchar [note: 'Reference number of any CAPA record in MasterControl that triggered the creation or revision of this SOP version. Links SOP updates to root cause corrective actions identified through audits, inspections, or deviation investigations.']
  change_control_number varchar [note: 'Reference number of the change control record in MasterControl that authorized the creation or revision of this SOP version. Provides traceability from the SOP to the formal change management process.']
  confidentiality_level varchar [note: 'Data classification level assigned to the SOP document content, governing who may access and distribute it. Aligns with the organization\'s information security policy and GDPR/HIPAA data handling requirements.']
  created_timestamp timestamp [note: 'Date and time when the SOP record was first created in the quality management system. Supports ALCOA+ audit trail requirements and data lineage tracking in the Silver Layer lakehouse.']
  deviation_classification_relevance varchar [note: 'Indicates the severity classification of protocol deviations that non-compliance with this SOP would typically generate (critical, major, minor). Used by QA to pre-classify deviation risk and prioritize SOP compliance monitoring.']
  document_category varchar [note: 'Functional category grouping for the SOP within the document management taxonomy (e.g., Quality Management, Clinical Operations, Data Management, Regulatory Affairs, Safety, Laboratory, Finance).']
  document_status varchar [note: 'Current lifecycle state of the SOP document within the quality management system workflow. Controls whether the SOP is actionable for training and compliance purposes. \'approved\' is the only status permitting operational use.']
  document_type varchar [note: 'Classification of the document within the quality management system hierarchy. SOPs define mandatory procedures; work instructions provide step-by-step task guidance; policies set organizational rules; guidance documents are advisory.']
  effective_date date [note: 'Date on which the approved SOP version becomes operationally binding for all applicable staff and sites. Training must be completed by this date. Aligns with the ALCOA+ principle of contemporaneous documentation.']
  electronic_signature_required boolean [note: 'Indicates whether this SOP requires electronic signatures for approval in compliance with FDA 21 CFR Part 11 and EU Annex 11 electronic records requirements. When True, wet signatures are not acceptable as the sole approval mechanism.']
  expiry_date date [note: 'Date on which the SOP version is scheduled to expire and must be reviewed, revised, or retired. Typically set to a fixed interval (e.g., 2–3 years) from the effective date per the organization\'s document control SOP.']
  gdpr_applicable boolean [note: 'Indicates whether this SOP governs processes that involve personal data subject to GDPR requirements (e.g., patient data handling, consent management, data subject rights). Drives GDPR compliance review during SOP periodic review.']
  geographic_applicability varchar [note: 'Countries or regions where this SOP is applicable, expressed as ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 country codes or region labels (e.g., USA, GBR, DEU, GLOBAL). Relevant for multi-regional trials where regulatory requirements differ by jurisdiction.']
  hipaa_applicable boolean [note: 'Indicates whether this SOP governs processes subject to HIPAA Privacy and Security Rules for U.S.-based studies involving protected health information (PHI). Relevant for studies conducted at U.S. sites.']
  inspection_readiness_flag boolean [note: 'Indicates whether this SOP has been reviewed and confirmed as current and compliant in preparation for a regulatory inspection (FDA, EMA, MHRA, PMDA). Set to True when QA has verified the SOP is up-to-date and all training is complete.']
  language_code varchar [note: 'ISO 639-1 language code of the SOP document (e.g., en, fr, de, ja). Supports multi-language document management for global trials and ensures site staff receive SOPs in the appropriate language.']
  last_modified_timestamp timestamp [note: 'Date and time when the SOP record was most recently updated in the quality management system or the lakehouse Silver Layer. Supports change detection, incremental ETL processing, and audit trail completeness.']
  mastercontrol_doc_number varchar [note: 'Native document identifier assigned by the MasterControl quality management system. Used for direct cross-reference and deep-linking back to the source system record for audit trail and change control purposes.']
  owner_department varchar [note: 'Name of the organizational department accountable for authoring, maintaining, and periodically reviewing this SOP (e.g., Quality Assurance, Data Management, Regulatory Affairs). Determines the primary escalation path for SOP-related queries.']
  owner_role varchar [note: 'Job role or title of the individual responsible for the SOP within the owning department (e.g., QA Manager, Director of Data Management). Used for accountability tracking and escalation in audit findings.']
  parent_sop_number varchar [note: 'SOP number of the higher-level or governing SOP under which this SOP sits in the document hierarchy (e.g., a site-specific SOP may reference a global SOP as its parent). Supports hierarchical document structure navigation.']
  process_area varchar [note: 'Primary clinical trial business process area governed by this SOP (e.g., Study Protocol Design, Patient Recruitment, Adverse Event Reporting, Site Monitoring, Data Management, Regulatory Submission). Used for process-level compliance gap analysis.']
  purpose_description varchar [note: 'Brief statement of the business purpose and objective of the SOP, summarizing what process it governs and why it exists. Sourced from the SOP document\'s purpose/objective section.']
  qms_workflow_stage varchar [note: 'Current stage of the SOP within the MasterControl quality management system workflow. More granular than document_status; tracks the specific workflow step the document is in during its lifecycle (e.g., authoring, peer review, QA review, approval']
  regulatory_basis varchar [note: 'Primary regulatory practice standard(s) that this SOP is designed to satisfy: Good Clinical Practice (GCP), Good Laboratory Practice (GLP), Good Manufacturing Practice (GMP), or applicable combinations.']
  regulatory_references varchar [note: 'Free-text or structured list of specific regulatory citations, guidelines, and standards that this SOP implements or references (e.g., ICH E6(R2) Section 5.18, FDA 21 CFR Part 312, EU CTR 536/2014 Article 47).']
  review_due_date date [note: 'Scheduled date by which the SOP owner must initiate a periodic review to confirm continued applicability and accuracy. May precede the expiry date to allow time for revision and approval before expiry.']
  revision_summary varchar [note: 'Brief narrative describing the nature and rationale of changes made in this version relative to the superseded version (e.g., \'Updated to reflect ICH E6(R3) requirements; added remote monitoring guidance\'). Required for change control documentation.']
  scope_description varchar [note: 'Narrative description of the scope and applicability of the SOP, including which studies, sites, roles, or geographies it applies to. Sourced from the SOP document\'s scope section. Critical for determining applicability during inspections.']
  sop_number varchar [note: 'Externally-known, human-readable document control number assigned to the SOP within MasterControl (e.g., QA-GCP-001). Serves as the business identifier used in audit trails, regulatory submissions, and training records.']
  sox_applicable boolean [note: 'Indicates whether this SOP governs financial reporting or internal control processes subject to SOX compliance requirements (e.g., finance, procurement, project accounting SOPs). Relevant for publicly-listed sponsors and CROs.']
  superseded_version_number varchar [note: 'Version number of the immediately preceding SOP version that this current version replaces. Enables version lineage tracing and ensures retired versions are correctly linked in the document control audit trail.']
  title varchar [note: 'Full descriptive title of the SOP as it appears on the document cover page and in the quality management system. Used for search, display, and regulatory filing purposes.']
  training_completion_deadline_days varchar [note: 'Number of calendar days from the SOP effective date within which all applicable staff must complete the required training. Used by MasterControl to auto-calculate individual training due dates and trigger overdue notifications.']
  training_required boolean [note: 'Indicates whether completion of a formal training event is mandatory for all applicable staff before they may operate under this SOP. When True, a training assignment must be created in MasterControl for each in-scope role upon SOP approval.']
  version_number varchar [note: 'Current version identifier of the SOP document (e.g., 1.0, 2.1, 3.0). Incremented upon each approved revision cycle. Used to ensure staff are trained on and referencing the correct version.']

  Note: 'Master record for Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs) managed within the quality management system. Captures SOP number, title, version, effective date, expiry date, SOP owner (department/role), applicable process area, regulatory basis (GCP, GLP, GMP)'
}

Table compliance.quality_event {
  quality_event_id varchar [pk, note: 'Unique system-generated identifier for the quality event record within the MasterControl quality management module. Serves as the primary key for all downstream references to this quality event.']
  adverse_event_id varchar [note: 'Foreign key linking to safety.adverse_event. Business justification: Quality events are routinely triggered by AE reporting failures (late submission, incorrect coding, missing causality).']
  bioanalytical_assay_id varchar [note: 'Foreign key linking to laboratory.bioanalytical_assay. Business justification: Quality events are raised against bioanalytical assays (e.g., QC sample failure, calibration curve rejection, ISR failure exceeding acceptance criteria).']
  capa_id varchar [note: 'Reference to the formal CAPA record initiated in MasterControl as a result of this quality event. Populated only when capa_required is True and the CAPA has been formally opened. Null until CAPA is initiated.']
  compliance_sop_id varchar [note: 'Foreign key linking to compliance.sop. Business justification: quality_event.affected_sop_number is a free-text string identifying the SOP implicated in the quality event.']
  consent_subject_consent_id varchar [note: 'Foreign key linking to subject.subject_consent. Business justification: Consent process failures (re-consent not obtained after protocol amendment, expired ICF version used) are a direct source of quality events.']
  database_lock_event_id varchar [note: 'Foreign key linking to biostatistics.database_lock_event. Business justification: Quality events arising from database lock failures (outstanding queries, failed QC checks, unauthorized lock) must reference the specific DBL event.']
  deviation_id varchar [note: 'Foreign key linking to subject.subject_deviation. Business justification: Subject deviations are a primary source of quality events. quality_event already has protocol_deviation_id (compliance-domain classification) but not subject_deviation_id']
  dsmb_recommendation_id varchar [note: 'Foreign key linking to safety.dsmb_recommendation. Business justification: DSMB recommendations (stopping rules triggered, protocol amendments required, informed consent updates) generate quality events in the QMS for implementation tracking.']
  lab_panel_id varchar [note: 'Foreign key linking to laboratory.lab_panel. Business justification: Quality events are raised against specific lab panels (e.g., reagent lot failure affecting entire panel, method drift detected across panel analytes).']
  lab_result_id varchar [note: 'Foreign key linking to laboratory.lab_result. Business justification: Quality events are frequently triggered by laboratory data issues — systematic result errors, instrument failures, reagent lot problems. quality_event has affected_data_domain.']
  manufacture_batch_id varchar [note: 'Foreign key linking to supply.manufacture_batch. Business justification: Manufacturing batch failures, OOS results, and QP release holds are quality events under GMP.']
  parent_event_quality_event_id varchar [note: 'Reference to a prior quality event record that this event is a recurrence of, or a related parent event in a cluster of related quality issues. Populated when recurrence_flag is True or when events are grouped for systemic analysis.']
  pk_sample_id varchar [note: 'Foreign key linking to laboratory.pk_sample. Business justification: Quality events are raised against PK samples (e.g., insufficient volume, incorrect storage temperature, freeze-thaw cycle exceedance).']
  principal_investigator_id varchar [note: 'Foreign key linking to site.principal_investigator. Business justification: Quality events at sites require PI notification and response per GCP. PI accountability for data integrity, subject safety, and regulatory compliance tracking require direct PI']
  protocol_deviation_id varchar [note: 'Foreign key linking to compliance.protocol_deviation. Business justification: quality_event.deviation_reference_number is a free-text string referencing a related protocol deviation.']
  reference_range_id varchar [note: 'Foreign key linking to laboratory.reference_range. Business justification: Quality events are raised when reference ranges are found incorrect, outdated, or misapplied (e.g., wrong sex-specific range applied, CTCAE grading threshold error).']
  sdv_review_id varchar [note: 'Foreign key linking to subject.sdv_review. Business justification: SDV review outcomes with high error rates or low coverage percentages are a direct trigger for quality events under risk-based monitoring frameworks.']
  serious_adverse_event_id varchar [note: 'Foreign key linking to safety.serious_adverse_event. Business justification: Quality events are triggered by SAE reporting process failures (missed 15-day deadline, incorrect blinding status, incomplete narrative).']
  signal_id varchar [note: 'Foreign key linking to safety.signal. Business justification: Safety signal detection triggers quality events in the QMS (e.g., signal requiring process review, risk minimization measure implementation).']
  specimen_aliquot_id varchar [note: 'Foreign key linking to laboratory.specimen_aliquot. Business justification: Quality events are raised against specific aliquots (e.g., temperature excursion in long-term storage, volume below minimum threshold, stability expiry breach).']
  specimen_collection_id varchar [note: 'Foreign key linking to laboratory.specimen_collection. Business justification: Specimen collection quality failures (hemolysis, lipemia, inadequate volume) are formal quality events requiring CAPA.']
  specimen_shipment_id varchar [note: 'Foreign key linking to laboratory.specimen_shipment. Business justification: Temperature excursions during specimen shipment are a named quality event type in clinical trials. specimen_shipment has temperature_excursion_flag.']
  study_id varchar [note: 'Reference to the clinical study affected by this quality event. Links the event to the specific protocol under which the quality issue was identified.']
  study_site_id varchar [note: 'Reference to the investigational site where the quality event was identified or originated. Null if the event is study-wide or sponsor/CRO-level rather than site-specific.']
  subject_consent_consent_subject_consent_id varchar [note: 'Foreign key linking to consent.subject_consent. Business justification: Quality events in clinical trials frequently arise from consent process failures (wrong ICF version used, consent obtained after procedures, missing signatures).']
  tmf_document_id varchar [note: 'Foreign key linking to document.tmf_document. Business justification: Quality events (e.g., data integrity issues, GCP violations) reference specific TMF documents as the affected or corrective record.']
  visit_id varchar [note: 'Foreign key linking to subject.subject_visit. Business justification: Quality events in clinical trials are frequently triggered by specific visit-level anomalies (missed assessments, out-of-window visits, data entry errors at visit).']
  affected_data_domain varchar [note: 'The CDISC SDTM or clinical data domain affected by the quality event (e.g., AE, CM, LB, VS, DM, DS, EX). Used for data management impact assessment, targeted re-monitoring, and SDTM submission quality review. Null if the event is not data-domain-specific.']
  affected_process varchar [note: 'The specific clinical trial business process or functional area impacted by the quality event (e.g., informed consent management, adverse event reporting, randomization, data entry, site monitoring, regulatory submission).']
  audit_readiness_flag boolean [note: 'Indicates whether this quality event record has been reviewed and confirmed as complete and audit-ready for regulatory inspection or sponsor audit purposes. True: record is audit-ready.']
  capa_required boolean [note: 'Indicates whether a formal Corrective and Preventive Action (CAPA) has been determined to be required for this quality event. True: CAPA must be initiated in MasterControl. False: event can be resolved without formal CAPA.']
  created_timestamp timestamp [note: 'System timestamp when the quality event record was first created in MasterControl. Supports 21 CFR Part 11 audit trail requirements and ALCOA+ attributability. Format: yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX.']
  data_integrity_impact boolean [note: 'Indicates whether the quality event has compromised or potentially compromised the integrity of clinical trial data in the EDC or source documents. True: data integrity affected. False: no data integrity impact.']
  error_count varchar [note: 'Number of errors, discrepancies, or non-conformances identified within the QC sample reviewed. Used in conjunction with sample_size to compute error rate for quality trending and threshold monitoring.']
  error_rate decimal(5,4) [note: 'Proportion of errors identified relative to the total sample size (error_count / sample_size). Expressed as a decimal (e.g., 0.0250 = 2.50%). Used for quality threshold monitoring, KPI reporting, and CAPA escalation triggers.']
  event_description varchar [note: 'Detailed narrative description of the quality event, including what was observed, where it occurred, and the potential impact on subject safety, data integrity, or regulatory compliance.']
  event_reference_number varchar [note: 'Human-readable, externally-visible reference number assigned to the quality event upon creation in MasterControl. Used in audit trails, regulatory correspondence, and CAPA linkage. Format: QE-YYYY-NNNNNN.']
  event_status varchar [note: 'Current lifecycle status of the quality event within the MasterControl workflow. Open: newly identified, awaiting triage. Under Review: QA/QC team actively investigating. Pending CAPA: CAPA determination made, awaiting CAPA initiation.']
  event_type varchar [note: 'Classification of the quality event by its nature. Drives routing, escalation rules, and CAPA determination logic. Values: data_quality_issue (EDC/eCRF data errors), process_non_compliance (GCP/SOP deviation), system_failure (EDC, CTMS, or IRT system']
  identification_source varchar [note: 'The activity or mechanism through which the quality event was detected. Drives root cause analysis and process improvement analytics. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE']
  identified_date date [note: 'Calendar date on which the quality event was first identified or detected. This is the principal real-world event date per ALCOA+ contemporaneous documentation requirements. Distinct from the record creation timestamp.']
  immediate_action_taken varchar [note: 'Description of any immediate containment or corrective actions taken at the time of quality event identification, prior to formal CAPA initiation. Examples: data query raised in EDC, site notified, process halted.']
  irb_iec_reportable boolean [note: 'Indicates whether this quality event must be reported to the Institutional Review Board (IRB) or Independent Ethics Committee (IEC) overseeing the study. True: IRB/IEC notification required. False: not required.']
  protocol_deviation_category varchar [note: 'Classification of the quality event as a protocol deviation per ICH E6(R2) and sponsor requirements. Major: deviation that may affect subject safety or data integrity. Minor: deviation with minimal impact.']
  qc_outcome varchar [note: 'Overall outcome of the QC review activity that generated this quality event. Pass: quality threshold met, no significant issues. Fail: quality threshold exceeded, formal action required.']
  recurrence_flag boolean [note: 'Indicates whether this quality event represents a recurrence of a previously identified and closed quality event of the same type at the same site or study. True: recurrence identified. False: first occurrence.']
  regulatory_authority_notified varchar [note: 'Name of the regulatory authority (e.g., FDA, EMA, MHRA, PMDA, TGA, Health Canada) notified of this quality event, if applicable. Null if regulatory_reportability is not_reportable. Supports regulatory submission tracking and inspection readiness.']
  regulatory_reportability varchar [note: 'Assessment of whether this quality event requires reporting to a regulatory authority (FDA, EMA, MHRA, etc.) or to the sponsor. Reportable: must be submitted to regulatory body. Not Reportable: no regulatory notification required.']
  resolution_date date [note: 'Date on which the quality event was formally resolved and closed in MasterControl. Populated when event_status transitions to closed. Used to calculate time-to-resolution KPIs and assess compliance with quality SLA targets.']
  resolution_description varchar [note: 'Narrative description of how the quality event was resolved, including actions taken, verification of effectiveness, and confirmation that the issue has been addressed.']
  review_date date [note: 'Date on which the QA reviewer formally assessed and triaged the quality event in MasterControl. Used to measure triage cycle time and compliance with internal quality SLA targets for event review.']
  reviewed_by varchar [note: 'Name or user identifier of the Quality Assurance (QA) professional who reviewed and assessed the quality event in MasterControl. Supports 21 CFR Part 11 electronic signature audit trail and GCP oversight accountability.']
  root_cause_category varchar [note: 'High-level categorization of the root cause identified during quality event investigation. Used for systemic quality trending, SOP improvement prioritization, and CAPA effectiveness analysis.']
  root_cause_description varchar [note: 'Detailed narrative of the root cause identified through investigation of the quality event. Captured by the QA investigator following root cause analysis. Supports CAPA development and regulatory inspection readiness.']
  sample_size varchar [note: 'Total number of records, data points, or items reviewed during the QC activity that identified this quality event. Used to calculate error rate and assess the statistical significance of the finding. Applicable when the event originates from a QC review.']
  severity varchar [note: 'Risk-based severity classification of the quality event per GCP quality standards. Critical: may impact subject safety or data integrity requiring immediate action. Major: significant GCP deviation with potential regulatory impact.']
  sponsor_notification_date date [note: 'Date on which the study sponsor was formally notified of this quality event. Populated when sponsor_notified is True. Used to verify compliance with contractual and regulatory notification timelines.']
  sponsor_notified boolean [note: 'Indicates whether the study sponsor has been formally notified of this quality event. True: sponsor notification sent. False: sponsor not yet notified. Required for CRO-sponsor quality agreement compliance and sponsor oversight obligations under ICH']
  subject_safety_impact boolean [note: 'Indicates whether the quality event has a direct or potential impact on the safety of enrolled study subjects. True: subject safety may be or has been affected. False: no subject safety impact identified.']
  updated_timestamp timestamp [note: 'System timestamp of the most recent modification to the quality event record in MasterControl. Required for audit trail completeness under 21 CFR Part 11 and ICH E6(R2). Format: yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX.']

  Note: 'Transactional record capturing quality events identified through QC reviews, self-inspections, routine quality monitoring, or proactive quality surveillance activities.'
}

Table compliance.risk_assessment {
  risk_assessment_id varchar [pk, note: 'Unique system-generated identifier for each quality risk assessment record within the compliance domain. Serves as the primary key for the risk_assessment data product.']
  audit_id varchar [note: 'Foreign key linking to compliance.audit. Business justification: Risk assessments can be scoped to audits (pre-audit risk assessment, post-audit risk evaluation).']

  capa_id varchar [note: 'Foreign key linking to compliance.compliance_capa. Business justification: Risk assessments with capa_required_flag=true should link to the resulting CAPA. A risk assessment that identifies unacceptable risk triggers a CAPA for remediation.']
  compliance_sop_id varchar [note: 'Foreign key linking to compliance.compliance_sop. Business justification: Risk assessments are conducted per SOPs and can assess SOP compliance or be governed by a specific SOP.']
  depot_id varchar [note: 'Foreign key linking to supply.depot. Business justification: Depot qualification risk assessments evaluate cold chain capability, geographic coverage, and GMP compliance.']
  health_authority_id varchar [note: 'Foreign key to the regulatory inspection associated with this risk assessment.']
  imp_master_id varchar [note: 'Foreign key linking to supply.imp_master. Business justification: IMP-specific risk assessments cover stability risks, cold chain requirements, controlled substance handling, and biological product safety.']
  investigational_product_id varchar [note: 'Foreign key linking to study.investigational_product. Business justification: IP-specific risk assessments (storage, handling, blinding integrity, controlled substance risk) are a GCP and GMP requirement.']
  lab_facility_id varchar [note: 'Foreign key linking to laboratory.lab_facility. Business justification: Risk-based monitoring requires formal risk assessments of laboratory facilities as part of vendor qualification and ongoing oversight.']
  lab_panel_id varchar [note: 'Foreign key linking to laboratory.lab_panel. Business justification: Risk assessments are scoped to specific lab panels in clinical operations (e.g., critical safety panels with high risk of missed collections, biomarker panels with complex stability']
  signal_id varchar [note: 'Foreign key linking to safety.safety_signal. Business justification: ICH E6 R2 risk-based monitoring requires that identified safety signals directly inform quality risk assessments. Risk management plans are updated when signals are detected.']
  study_id varchar [note: 'Foreign key linking to study.study. Business justification: ICH E6 R2 mandates study-level risk-based monitoring plans with documented risk assessments. risk_assessment has no study_id currently.']
  tmf_document_id varchar [note: 'Foreign key linking to document.tmf_document. Business justification: Risk assessments reference specific TMF documents as supporting evidence (e.g., protocol, IB, site agreements).']
  approval_date date [note: 'Date on which the risk assessment was formally approved by the authorized QA signatory. Required for regulatory audit trail and 21 CFR Part 11 electronic records compliance.']
  assessment_date date [note: 'The date on which the risk assessment was formally conducted and documented. Represents the principal business event date for this record. Used for trend analysis and review frequency tracking.']
  assessment_status varchar [note: 'Current lifecycle state of the risk assessment record in MasterControl: draft (being authored), in_review (under QA/sponsor review), approved (formally accepted), active (monitoring in progress), closed (risk resolved or accepted), cancelled (assessment']
  capa_required_flag boolean [note: 'Indicates whether a formal Corrective and Preventive Action (CAPA) record must be initiated as a result of this risk assessment. Typically set to True when residual risk rating is critical or high, or when identified gaps meet CAPA threshold criteria.']
  control_measures_description varchar [note: 'Narrative description of the existing or planned quality control and risk mitigation measures applied to reduce the identified risk (e.g., enhanced SDV, targeted monitoring, additional training, SOP updates, EDC edit checks). Sourced from MasterControl.']
  created_timestamp timestamp [note: 'Timestamp when this risk assessment record was first created in the source system (MasterControl). Supports audit trail requirements under 21 CFR Part 11 and ICH E6(R2) for electronic records.']
  data_integrity_impact_flag boolean [note: 'Indicates whether the identified risk has a potential or actual impact on clinical data integrity (ALCOA+ principles: Attributable, Legible, Contemporaneous, Original, Accurate). Triggers enhanced data review and potential database lock delay.']
  gcp_impact_flag boolean [note: 'Indicates whether the identified risk has a direct impact on Good Clinical Practice (GCP) compliance. Drives escalation to QA leadership and potential regulatory notification obligations.']
  identified_gaps varchar [note: 'Narrative description of quality gaps, process deficiencies, or compliance vulnerabilities identified during the risk assessment (e.g., missing SDV documentation, incomplete ICF versions, delayed SAE reporting).']
  inherent_detectability_score varchar [note: 'Numeric score (typically 1–5) representing the ability to detect the risk before it causes harm, prior to control measures. Used in FMEA-style risk scoring (Risk Priority Number = Likelihood × Impact × Detectability).']
  inherent_impact_score varchar [note: 'Numeric score (typically 1–5) representing the severity of impact on patient safety, data integrity, or regulatory compliance if the risk materializes before controls are applied. Component of the inherent risk score calculation.']
  inherent_likelihood_score varchar [note: 'Numeric score (typically 1–5) representing the probability of the risk occurring before any control measures are applied. Component of the inherent risk score calculation per ICH Q9 risk estimation methodology.']
  inherent_risk_rating varchar [note: 'Qualitative risk rating derived from the inherent risk score before controls: critical, high, medium, or low. Used for risk prioritization, escalation thresholds, and sponsor/QA reporting dashboards.']
  inherent_risk_score decimal(5,2) [note: 'Composite numeric risk score calculated before control measures are applied, typically derived from likelihood, impact, and detectability scores (e.g., product or weighted sum). Establishes the baseline risk level for prioritization.']
  inspection_readiness_flag boolean [note: 'Indicates whether this risk assessment was conducted specifically in preparation for a regulatory inspection (FDA, EMA, MHRA, PMDA, or sponsor audit). Enables filtering of inspection-readiness assessments for pre-inspection reporting.']
  mastercontrol_record_number varchar [note: 'The native record identifier assigned by MasterControl (the system of record for this data product) to the risk assessment document. Enables direct traceability back to the source system for audit and reconciliation purposes.']
  next_review_date date [note: 'Scheduled date for the next periodic review of this risk assessment, based on the defined review frequency. Supports proactive risk monitoring and inspection readiness. Calculated from assessment_date and review_frequency_days.']
  reference_number varchar [note: 'Externally-known, human-readable unique reference number assigned to the risk assessment record in MasterControl (e.g., RA-2024-00123). Used for cross-system traceability, audit trails, and regulatory inspection readiness.']
  regulatory_authority varchar [note: 'The primary regulatory authority whose standards and guidelines govern this risk assessment (e.g., FDA, EMA, MHRA, PMDA, TGA, Health Canada). Determines applicable GCP framework and reporting obligations.']
  remediation_plan varchar [note: 'Documented plan for addressing identified gaps and reducing residual risk, including specific actions, responsible parties, and target timelines. Distinct from CAPA (which is a formal corrective/preventive action record); this is the risk-level']
  remediation_status varchar [note: 'Current status of remediation activities for identified gaps: not_started, in_progress, completed, or overdue. Supports inspection readiness dashboards and QA oversight reporting.']
  remediation_target_date date [note: 'Target completion date for the remediation actions identified in the risk assessment. Used for tracking remediation progress and escalation when overdue.']
  residual_detectability_score varchar [note: 'Numeric score (typically 1–5) representing the ability to detect the risk after control measures are in place. Component of the residual risk score calculation.']
  residual_impact_score varchar [note: 'Numeric score (typically 1–5) representing the severity of impact after control measures have been applied. Used to calculate the residual risk score.']
  residual_likelihood_score varchar [note: 'Numeric score (typically 1–5) representing the probability of the risk occurring after control measures have been applied. Used to calculate the residual risk score.']
  residual_risk_rating varchar [note: 'Qualitative risk rating after control measures are applied: critical, high, medium, or low. Drives risk acceptance decisions, escalation to DSMB/DMC, and CAPA initiation. A residual rating of critical or high typically triggers mandatory CAPA.']
  residual_risk_score decimal(5,2) [note: 'Composite numeric risk score calculated after control measures are applied. Represents the remaining risk exposure. Compared against risk acceptance thresholds to determine if further mitigation is required.']
  review_frequency_days varchar [note: 'Defined interval in calendar days between periodic re-assessments of this risk (e.g., 30, 60, 90, 180 days). Drives scheduling of next_review_date and ensures ongoing risk monitoring per ICH Q9 principles.']
  risk_acceptance_decision varchar [note: 'Formal decision on whether the residual risk level is acceptable: accepted (risk within tolerance), not_accepted (requires further mitigation or CAPA), or conditionally_accepted (accepted with defined monitoring conditions).']
  risk_category varchar [note: 'High-level classification of the risk domain being assessed: data_integrity (ALCOA+ violations, EDC issues), patient_safety (adverse event under-reporting, protocol deviations), regulatory_compliance (GCP, ICH, FDA/EMA non-compliance), or operational']
  risk_description varchar [note: 'Detailed narrative describing the identified risk, including the potential failure mode, root cause hypothesis, and potential impact on study quality, patient safety, or regulatory compliance. Sourced from MasterControl risk assessment form.']
  risk_owner_department varchar [note: 'Organizational department of the risk owner (e.g., Quality Assurance, Data Management, Clinical Operations, Regulatory Affairs). Used for departmental risk reporting and workload analysis.']
  risk_subcategory varchar [note: 'More granular classification within the risk category (e.g., \'Source Data Verification\', \'Informed Consent Process\', \'SAE Reporting Timeliness\', \'Protocol Deviation Management\'). Enables detailed risk trending and root cause analysis.']
  scope varchar [note: 'Defines the level at which the risk assessment was conducted: study-level (entire protocol), site-level (specific investigational site), process-level (e.g., data management, consent), system-level (e.g., EDC, CTMS), or inspection-readiness']
  sponsor_notified_flag boolean [note: 'Indicates whether the study sponsor has been formally notified of this risk assessment and its findings, as required by the Clinical Trial Agreement and GCP obligations. Relevant for high/critical risk ratings.']
  subject_safety_impact_flag boolean [note: 'Indicates whether the identified risk has a potential or actual impact on the safety of study subjects/patients. Triggers mandatory escalation to the Principal Investigator (PI), DSMB/DMC, and sponsor safety team.']
  title varchar [note: 'Descriptive title summarizing the subject and scope of the risk assessment (e.g., \'Site-Level GCP Compliance Risk Assessment – Site 1042 Q3 2024\'). Used for identification and reporting.']
  updated_timestamp timestamp [note: 'Timestamp of the most recent modification to this risk assessment record in the source system. Required for change tracking, audit trail compliance, and Silver layer incremental load processing.']

  Note: 'Master record for quality risk assessments conducted at study, site, process, system, or inspection-readiness level to support risk-based quality management (RBQM).'
}

  submission_portal_url varchar [note: 'URL of the ethics committee\'s electronic submission portal or online application system. Used by CRAs and regulatory affairs teams to route submissions and track application status.']
  submission_strategy varchar [note: 'The agreed or required approach for submitting protocol amendments, safety reports, and annual reviews to this ethics committee for this specific program. May differ by committee and program based on regulatory jurisdiction and committee preferences.']
  updated_timestamp timestamp [note: 'Date and time when the ethics committee master record was last modified, in ISO 8601 format with timezone offset. Supports audit trail requirements under 21 CFR Part 11 and ALCOA+ principles.']
  veeva_vault_record_number varchar [note: 'Unique record identifier for this ethics committee in Veeva Vault eTMF, used to cross-reference TMF documents, ethics approval letters, and correspondence stored in the document management system.']

  Note: 'Master record for each IRB or IEC body providing ethical oversight for clinical trials, capturing committee name, type, jurisdiction, and accreditation status'
}

Table compliance.ethics_submission {
  ethics_submission_id varchar [pk, note: 'Unique surrogate identifier for each ethics submission record in the lakehouse silver layer. Primary key for this entity.']
  ethics_committee_id varchar [note: 'Reference to the Institutional Review Board (IRB) or Independent Ethics Committee (IEC) to which this submission is directed. Links to the ethics committee master record.']
  icf_version_id varchar [note: 'Foreign key linking to consent.consent_icf_version. Business justification: Ethics submissions formally submit specific ICF versions for IRB/IEC review. Linking ethics_submission to consent_icf_version normalizes the denormalized icf_version_submitted']
  ind_application_id varchar [note: 'Foreign key linking to regulatory.ind_application. Business justification: IB updates (especially SUSAR-triggered amendments) require IRB/IEC submission. ethics_submission already stores investigator_brochure_version as a denormalized text field.']
  parent_submission_ethics_submission_id varchar [note: 'Reference to the original or preceding ethics submission that this record amends or continues. Enables lineage tracking across the full submission history for a study.']
  primary_amended_ethics_submission_id varchar [note: 'Self-referencing FK on ethics_submission (amended_ethics_submission_id)']
  principal_investigator_id varchar [note: 'Reference to the Principal Investigator (PI) named on this ethics submission. The PI is the party responsible for the conduct of the study at the site.']
  protocol_id varchar [note: 'Foreign key linking to study.protocol. Business justification: Ethics submissions are submitted for a specific protocol version. ethics_submission has study_id and study_protocol_amendment_id but no direct protocol_id.']
  study_id varchar [note: 'Reference to the clinical study for which this ethics submission is made. Links to the study master record.']
  study_protocol_amendment_id varchar [note: 'Foreign key linking to study.study_protocol_amendment. Business justification: Ethics submissions are triggered by protocol amendments (substantial modifications requiring IRB/IEC resubmission).']
  study_site_id varchar [note: 'Reference to the investigational site associated with this ethics submission. Applicable when the submission is site-specific (e.g., local IRB/IEC review).']
  tmf_document_id varchar [note: 'Foreign key linking to document.tmf_document. Business justification: Ethics submissions and their supporting documents must be filed in the TMF as essential documents. The plain-text tmf_document_reference is a denormalization.']
  approval_expiry_date date [note: 'Date on which the current IRB or IEC approval expires, triggering the need for a continuing review submission to maintain authorization for study conduct.']
  conditions_of_approval varchar [note: 'Free-text description of any conditions, stipulations, or modifications required by the IRB or IEC as part of a conditional approval decision. Must be addressed before study initiation or continuation.']
  continuing_review_due_date date [note: 'Date by which the next continuing review submission must be filed with the IRB or IEC to maintain uninterrupted approval. Calculated from the approval expiry date minus any required lead time.']
  created_timestamp timestamp [note: 'Timestamp when this ethics submission record was first created in the system. Supports ALCOA+ data integrity principles and audit trail requirements.']
  decision_date date [note: 'Date on which the IRB or IEC issued its formal decision (approval, conditional approval, rejection, or other outcome) on this submission.']
  decision_outcome varchar [note: 'The formal decision rendered by the IRB or IEC on this submission. Drives downstream study activation, amendment implementation, and regulatory reporting.']
  inspection_readiness_flag boolean [note: 'Indicates whether this ethics submission record and its associated documentation are complete and ready for regulatory inspection review. Used in audit readiness dashboards.']
  irb_iec_name varchar [note: 'Full legal name of the IRB or IEC receiving this submission. Retained directly on the record for reporting and audit trail purposes independent of the master reference.']
  irb_iec_reference_number varchar [note: 'Reference or tracking number assigned by the IRB or IEC upon receipt of the submission. Used for all correspondence and follow-up with the ethics committee.']
  pi_name varchar [note: 'Full name of the Principal Investigator (PI) as listed on the ethics submission. Retained directly on the record for audit trail and regulatory correspondence.']
  protocol_version varchar [note: 'Version identifier of the study protocol included in this submission package (e.g., v1.0, v2.1). Critical for linking the submission to the exact protocol document reviewed.']
  receipt_confirmed_date date [note: 'Date on which the IRB or IEC formally acknowledged receipt of the submission package. Marks the start of the review clock for regulatory timeline tracking.']
  regulatory_authority varchar [note: 'The national or regional regulatory authority whose requirements govern this ethics submission. Determines applicable reporting timelines and documentation standards.']
  response_due_date date [note: 'Date by which the sponsor or investigator must respond to IRB or IEC queries, conditions, or requests for additional information following a conditional approval or deferral.']
  response_submitted_date date [note: 'Date on which the sponsor or investigator submitted a formal response to IRB or IEC queries or conditions of approval.']
  review_deadline_date date [note: 'Target date by which the IRB or IEC is expected to complete its review and issue a decision, based on regulatory timelines or committee meeting schedules.']
  review_type varchar [note: 'Classification of the review procedure applied by the IRB or IEC (e.g., full board convened review, expedited review for minimal-risk studies, exempt determination). Determines regulatory timelines and quorum requirements.']
  subject_enrollment_authorized boolean [note: 'Indicates whether this ethics approval authorizes the enrollment of new subjects at the site. False for submissions that do not grant or maintain enrollment authorization (e.g., pending conditions).']
  submission_category varchar [note: 'Detailed categorization of the submission content beyond the submission type, enabling granular tracking of what changed or was reported. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE']
  submission_country varchar [note: 'ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 country code of the jurisdiction in which this ethics submission is filed. Determines applicable regulatory framework (e.g., FDA, EMA, PMDA, Health Canada).']
  submission_date date [note: 'The date on which the submission package was formally transmitted to the IRB or IEC. This is the principal real-world business event date for this transaction.']
  submission_method varchar [note: 'The channel or mechanism used to transmit the submission package to the IRB or IEC (e.g., electronic portal, paper, email). Relevant for 21 CFR Part 11 compliance and audit trail.']
  submission_notes varchar [note: 'Free-text field for capturing additional context, cover letter summary, or operational notes related to this ethics submission that are not captured in structured fields.']
  submission_number varchar [note: 'Externally-known, human-readable reference number assigned to this submission package (e.g., IRB-2024-0042-A01). Used for tracking across systems and correspondence with the ethics committee.']
  submission_status varchar [note: 'Current lifecycle state of the ethics submission package from preparation through final ethics committee decision. Drives workflow and compliance tracking.']
  submission_type varchar [note: 'Classification of the submission package by its purpose in the IRB/IEC review lifecycle. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: initial_review|amendment|continuing_review|safety_report|closure|waiver_request|expedited_review|deviation_report — promote to reference product]']
  updated_timestamp timestamp [note: 'Timestamp of the most recent modification to this ethics submission record. Supports ALCOA+ data integrity principles and change tracking for GCP compliance.']
  veeva_vault_document_number varchar [note: 'Unique document identifier in Veeva Vault eTMF for the submission package. Provides direct linkage to the source document management system for audit and inspection purposes.']
  waiver_granted boolean [note: 'Indicates whether the IRB or IEC granted a waiver of informed consent or waiver of documentation of informed consent as part of this submission decision.']

  Note: 'Tracks each formal submission package sent to an IRB or IEC for a specific study, including initial review, amendments, and continuing review submissions'
}

Table compliance.ethics_approval {
  ethics_approval_id varchar [pk, note: 'Unique surrogate identifier for the ethics approval record in the lakehouse silver layer. Primary key for this entity.']
  country_id varchar [note: 'Foreign key linking to study.country. Business justification: Ethics approvals are country-specific regulatory authorizations. ethics_approval has irb_iec_country as a denormalized text field but no FK to study.country.']
  ethics_committee_id varchar [note: 'Reference to the IRB or IEC body that issued this approval decision. Links to the ethics committee master record.']
  ethics_submission_id varchar [note: 'Foreign key linking to compliance.ethics_submission. Business justification: An ethics approval is the formal decision resulting from an ethics submission. Every approval originates from a specific submission package.']
  protocol_id varchar [note: 'Foreign key linking to study.protocol. Business justification: Ethics approvals are granted for a specific protocol version — a core GCP requirement. Direct FK to protocol enables protocol-version-level approval status tracking, supports site activation']
  study_id varchar [note: 'Reference to the clinical study for which this ethics approval was issued. Links the approval to the study master record.']
  study_protocol_amendment_id varchar [note: 'Foreign key linking to study.study_protocol_amendment. Business justification: Ethics approvals are granted for specific protocol amendments. Direct FK to study_protocol_amendment enables amendment-level approval status tracking, supports site']
  study_site_id varchar [note: 'Reference to the investigational site for which this ethics approval applies. Null if the approval is a central/multi-site approval covering all sites.']
  superseded_ethics_approval_id varchar [note: 'Self-referencing FK on ethics_approval (superseded_ethics_approval_id)']
  tmf_document_id varchar [note: 'Foreign key linking to document.tmf_document. Business justification: Ethics approval letters are essential TMF documents (ICH E6 R2). The ethics_approval.tmf_document_reference plain-text column is a denormalization of this FK.']
  approval_conditions varchar [note: 'Free-text description of any conditions, stipulations, or modifications required by the IRB/IEC as part of a conditional approval. Null for unconditional approvals.']
  approval_letter_date date [note: 'The date printed on the official ethics approval letter issued by the IRB/IEC. May differ from decision_date if the letter is issued after the meeting.']
  approval_reference_number varchar [note: 'Externally-known unique reference number assigned by the Institutional Review Board (IRB) or Independent Ethics Committee (IEC) to this approval decision. Used for regulatory correspondence and audit trail.']
  approval_status varchar [note: 'Current lifecycle status of the ethics approval decision. Approved indicates unconditional approval; approved_with_conditions requires sponsor/PI to satisfy stated conditions; deferred means the committee requires additional information before deciding']
  approval_type varchar [note: 'Categorises the review pathway used by the IRB/IEC: full board review, expedited review, exempt determination, central ethics committee review, or local site-level review.']
  conditions_met_date date [note: 'The date on which the sponsor or PI confirmed that all IRB/IEC-stipulated conditions for a conditional approval were satisfied, enabling the study to proceed.']
  created_timestamp timestamp [note: 'Timestamp when this ethics approval record was first created in the system, conforming to ALCOA+ (Attributable, Legible, Contemporaneous, Original, Accurate) data integrity principles.']
  ctms_record_number varchar [note: 'Record identifier in the source system where this ethics approval is tracked for site activation and monitoring workflows.']
  decision_date date [note: 'The date on which the IRB/IEC formally issued its approval decision. This is the principal real-world event date for this transaction.']
  disapproval_reason varchar [note: 'Free-text reason provided by the IRB/IEC when the submission was disapproved or deferred. Null for approved submissions.']
  effective_date date [note: 'The date from which the ethics approval is binding and the study or amendment may commence at the site. May differ from decision_date if conditions must be met first.']
  expiry_date date [note: 'The date on which the ethics approval expires and must be renewed for the study to continue. Null for approvals with no defined expiry. Drives renewal workflow triggers.']
  gdpr_applicable_flag boolean [note: 'Indicates whether GDPR data protection requirements apply to this ethics approval, relevant for studies conducted in EU/EEA jurisdictions.']
  hipaa_applicable_flag boolean [note: 'Indicates whether HIPAA privacy rule requirements apply to this ethics approval, relevant for studies conducted in the United States.']
  icf_approval_date date [note: 'The date on which the specific ICF version was approved by the IRB/IEC. May differ from the overall protocol decision_date when ICF and protocol are reviewed separately.']
  icf_version_approved varchar [note: 'Version identifier of the Informed Consent Form (ICF) that was reviewed and approved as part of this ethics submission. Null if the submission did not include an ICF.']
  irb_iec_name varchar [note: 'Full legal name of the IRB or IEC that issued this approval. Retained as a denormalized reference for reporting and regulatory submissions.']
  irb_iec_registration_number varchar [note: 'Official registration or accreditation number of the IRB/IEC as assigned by the relevant regulatory authority (e.g., FDA OHRP registration number, EMA ethics committee identifier).']
  pi_name varchar [note: 'Full name of the Principal Investigator (PI) named on the ethics approval. Retained as a denormalized field for regulatory correspondence and inspection readiness.']
  protocol_version varchar [note: 'Version identifier of the study protocol document that was reviewed and approved. Enables tracking of which protocol version holds active ethics approval.']
  quorum_met_flag boolean [note: 'Indicates whether the required quorum of IRB/IEC members was present at the review meeting, as required for a valid approval decision.']
  regulatory_authority_notification_date date [note: 'Date on which the regulatory authority was notified of the IRB/IEC approval decision. Null if regulatory_authority_notified_flag is False.']
  regulatory_authority_notified_flag boolean [note: 'Indicates whether the relevant regulatory authority (e.g., FDA, EMA, MHRA) was notified of the IRB/IEC approval decision as required by applicable regulations.']
  renewal_due_date date [note: 'The date by which a renewal submission must be received by the IRB/IEC to maintain continuous approval. Typically calculated from expiry_date minus the committee\'s required lead time.']
  review_meeting_date date [note: 'The date of the IRB/IEC board meeting at which this submission was formally reviewed and voted upon.']
  submission_date date [note: 'The date on which the sponsor or Principal Investigator (PI) submitted the protocol, amendment, or ICF to the IRB/IEC for review.']
  submission_type varchar [note: 'Classifies the type of submission reviewed by the IRB/IEC: initial protocol review, protocol amendment, annual renewal, safety report, Informed Consent Form (ICF) revision, or other.']
  updated_timestamp timestamp [note: 'Timestamp of the most recent update to this ethics approval record. Supports audit trail and data lineage requirements per ALCOA+ principles.']
  veeva_vault_document_number varchar [note: 'Unique document identifier in Veeva Vault eTMF where the original signed ethics approval letter is archived. Supports 21 CFR Part 11 electronic records compliance.']
  vote_abstain_count varchar [note: 'Number of IRB/IEC board members who abstained from voting at the review meeting.']
  vote_against_count varchar [note: 'Number of IRB/IEC board members who voted against approval at the review meeting.']
  vote_in_favor_count varchar [note: 'Number of IRB/IEC board members who voted in favor of approval at the review meeting. Supports audit trail and quorum verification.']
  vulnerable_population_flag boolean [note: 'Indicates whether the approved study involves vulnerable populations (e.g., minors, pregnant women, prisoners, cognitively impaired individuals) requiring additional IRB/IEC safeguards.']
  waiver_of_consent_flag boolean [note: 'Indicates whether the IRB/IEC granted a waiver or alteration of the informed consent requirement as part of this approval.']

  Note: 'Records the formal approval decision issued by an IRB or IEC for a study protocol, ICF, or amendment including approval conditions and expiry dates'
}
